# 📚 MiMo Life OS — جميع أكواد الأقسام الكاملة

> هذا الملف يحتوي على الكود البرمجي الكامل لكل أقسام الموقع (74 ملف، ~37,000 سطر)
> كل قسم في section منفصل مع اسم الملف + عدد الأسطر

## 📊 إحصائيات
- **عدد الأقسام**: 74
- **إجمالي الأسطر**: ~37,246
- **المسار**: `src/components/sections/`

# 1. الرئيسية

- **الكود (ID)**: `dashboard`
- **المجموعة**: 1001
- **الملف**: `src/components/sections/dashboard.tsx`
- **عدد الأسطر**: 846

## 📝 الكود الكامل

```tsx
'use client';

import { useMemo, useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import {
  FolderKanban, Zap, CheckCircle2, Star, Calendar, ArrowLeft,
  CheckSquare, DollarSign, Flame, BookOpen,
  GraduationCap, Medal, Clock, Briefcase, Trophy, BarChart3, Target, Globe,
  Archive, Plus,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { CalendarView } from '@/components/calendar-view';
import { TagsBrowser } from '@/components/tags-browser';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { useAppStore } from '@/lib/store';
import { PROJECT_STATUS_LABELS, PROJECT_STATUS_COLORS, MOOD_CONFIG, ACHIEVEMENT_TYPE_CONFIG } from '@/types';

// ============ تنسيق التاريخ بالعربية ============
function getArabicDate(): string {
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('ar-SA', {
    weekday: 'long',
    year: 'numeric',
    month: 'long',
    day: 'numeric',
  }).format(new Date());
}

function toArabicNum(n: number) {
  return n.toLocaleString('ar-SA');
}

// ============ أنيميشن ============
const cardVariants = {
  hidden: { opacity: 0, y: 16 },
  visible: (i: number) => ({
    opacity: 1,
    y: 0,
    transition: { delay: i * 0.06, duration: 0.35, ease: 'easeOut' as const },
  }),
};

// ============ المكون الرئيسي ============
export function DashboardSection() {
  const {
    projects, skills, tasks, transactions, habits, journalEntries, getHabitStreak,
    universitySemesters, certificates, workSessions, workExperiences,
    achievements, failures, languages, visionItems,
  } = useAppStore();

  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    const total = projects.length;
    const active = projects.filter((p) => p.status === 'in-progress').length;
    const completed = projects.filter((p) => p.status === 'completed').length;
    return { total, active, completed };
  }, [projects]);

  const recentProjects = useMemo(
    () =>
      [...projects]
        .sort((a, b) => new Date(b.createdAt).getTime() - new Date(a.createdAt).getTime())
        .slice(0, 3),
    [projects]
  );

  const topSkills = useMemo(
    () => [...skills].sort((a, b) => b.level - a.level).slice(0, 5),
    [skills]
  );

  // ---- New Life Stats ----
  const todayStr = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];

  const todayTasks = useMemo(
    () => tasks.filter((t) => t.createdAt.startsWith(todayStr)),
    [tasks, todayStr]
  );
  const todayCompleted = todayTasks.filter((t) => t.completed).length;
  const todayTotal = todayTasks.length;

  const now = new Date();
  const currentMonth = now.getMonth();
  const currentYear = now.getFullYear();

  const monthExpenses = useMemo(
    () => transactions
      .filter((t) => {
        const d = new Date(t.createdAt);
        return t.type === 'expense' && d.getMonth() === currentMonth && d.getFullYear() === currentYear;
      })
      .reduce((s, t) => s + t.amount, 0),
    [transactions, currentMonth, currentYear]
  );

  const monthIncome = useMemo(
    () => transactions
      .filter((t) => {
        const d = new Date(t.createdAt);
        return t.type === 'income' && d.getMonth() === currentMonth && d.getFullYear() === currentYear;
      })
      .reduce((s, t) => s + t.amount, 0),
    [transactions, currentMonth, currentYear]
  );

  const monthNet = monthIncome - monthExpenses;

  const todayJournal = useMemo(
    () => journalEntries.find((e) => e.date === todayStr),
    [journalEntries, todayStr]
  );

  const topStreak = useMemo(() => {
    if (habits.length === 0) return { name: '', streak: 0, emoji: '' };
    let best = { name: '', streak: 0, emoji: '' };
    for (const h of habits) {
      const s = getHabitStreak(h);
      if (s > best.streak) {
        best = { name: h.name, streak: s, emoji: h.emoji };
      }
    }
    return best;
  }, [habits, getHabitStreak]);

  const latestJournal = useMemo(
    () => {
      const sorted = [...journalEntries].sort((a, b) => b.date.localeCompare(a.date));
      return sorted[0] || null;
    },
    [journalEntries]
  );

  // ---- إحصائيات الأقسام الجديدة ----
  const cumulativeGpa = useMemo(() => {
    if (universitySemesters.length === 0) return 0;
    let totalWeighted = 0;
    let totalCredits = 0;
    for (const sem of universitySemesters) {
      for (const c of sem.courses) {
        totalWeighted += (c.grade / c.maxGrade) * c.credits;
        totalCredits += c.credits;
      }
    }
    return totalCredits > 0 ? (totalWeighted / totalCredits) * 100 : 0;
  }, [universitySemesters]);

  const totalWorkHours = useMemo(
    () => workSessions.reduce((sum, s) => sum + s.durationMinutes, 0) / 60,
    [workSessions]
  );

  const recentCerts = useMemo(
    () => [...certificates].sort((a, b) => b.date.localeCompare(a.date)).slice(0, 3),
    [certificates]
  );

  const recentExp = useMemo(
    () => [...workExperiences].sort((a, b) => b.startDate.localeCompare(a.startDate)).slice(0, 3),
    [workExperiences]
  );

  const recentAchievements = useMemo(
    () => [...achievements].sort((a, b) => b.date.localeCompare(a.date)).slice(0, 3),
    [achievements]
  );

  const goalProgress = useMemo(() => {
    if (visionItems.length === 0) return 0;
    return Math.round(visionItems.reduce((s, v) => s + v.progress, 0) / visionItems.length);
  }, [visionItems]);

  const handleViewAll = (section: string) => {
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('navigate-section', { detail: section }));
  };

  function formatHours(h: number): string {
    const hrs = Math.floor(h);
    const mins = Math.round((h - hrs) * 60);
    return mins > 0 ? `${toArabicNum(hrs)}h ${toArabicNum(mins)}m` : `${toArabicNum(hrs)}h`;
  }

  // ============ النسخ الاحتياطي ============
  const [backupInfo, setBackupInfo] = useState<{
    totalBackups: number;
    maxBackups: number;
    latestBackup: { name: string; date: string; dateFormatted: string; sizeFormatted: string } | null;
  } | null>(null);
  const [backupLoading, setBackupLoading] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetch('/api/backup/stats')
      .then((r) => r.json())
      .then((data) => {
        if (data.success) {
          setBackupInfo({
            totalBackups: data.totalBackups,
            maxBackups: data.maxBackups,
            latestBackup: data.latestBackup,
          });
        }
      })
      .catch(() => {});
  }, []);

  const handleCreateBackup = async () => {
    setBackupLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/backup/create', { method: 'POST' });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.success) {
        // تحديث الإحصائيات
        const statsRes = await fetch('/api/backup/stats');
        const statsData = await statsRes.json();
        if (statsData.success) {
          setBackupInfo({
            totalBackups: statsData.totalBackups,
            maxBackups: statsData.maxBackups,
            latestBackup: statsData.latestBackup,
          });
        }
      }
    } catch {
      // تجاهل
    }
    setBackupLoading(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* ============ رسالة الترحيب ============ */}
      <motion.div
        initial={{ opacity: 0, y: -8 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
        transition={{ duration: 0.4 }}
        className="space-y-1"
      >
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
          <Calendar className="w-4 h-4" />
          <span>{getArabicDate()}</span>
        </div>
        <h1 className="text-2xl md:text-3xl font-bold text-foreground">
          أهلاً <span className="text-emerald-600">محمد</span>
        </h1>
      </motion.div>

      {/* ============ بطاقات الإحصائيات — المشاريع ============ */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-3 md:gap-4">
        <motion.div variants={cardVariants} initial="hidden" animate="visible" custom={0}>
          <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
            <CardContent className="p-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                <FolderKanban className="w-5 h-5 text-muted-foreground" />
                <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-[10px] bg-muted text-muted-foreground">
                  الكل
                </Badge>
              </div>
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">{stats.total}</div>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">إجمالي المشاريع</p>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </motion.div>

        <motion.div variants={cardVariants} initial="hidden" animate="visible" custom={1}>
          <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
            <CardContent className="p-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                <Zap className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-500" />
                <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-[10px] bg-amber-50 text-amber-600">
                  نشطة
                </Badge>
              </div>
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">{stats.active}</div>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">مشاريع نشطة</p>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </motion.div>

        <motion.div variants={cardVariants} initial="hidden" animate="visible" custom={2}>
          <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
            <CardContent className="p-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-500" />
                <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-[10px] bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-600">
                  مكتملة
                </Badge>
              </div>
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">{stats.completed}</div>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">مشاريع مكتملة</p>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </motion.div>

        <motion.div variants={cardVariants} initial="hidden" animate="visible" custom={3}>
          <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
            <CardContent className="p-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                <Star className="w-5 h-5 text-muted-foreground" />
                <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-[10px] bg-muted text-muted-foreground">
                  الكل
                </Badge>
              </div>
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">{skills.length}</div>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">المهارات</p>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </motion.div>
      </div>

      {/* ============ بطاقات الحياة — New Row ============ */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-3 md:gap-4">
        {/* Today's Tasks */}
        <motion.div variants={cardVariants} initial="hidden" animate="visible" custom={4}>
          <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
            <CardContent className="p-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                <CheckSquare className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-500" />
                <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-[10px] bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 dark:bg-blue-900/30 dark:text-blue-400">
                  اليوم
                </Badge>
              </div>
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">
                {todayTotal > 0 ? `${toArabicNum(todayCompleted)}/${toArabicNum(todayTotal)}` : '—'}
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">مهام اليوم</p>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </motion.div>

        {/* Month Expenses */}
        <motion.div variants={cardVariants} initial="hidden" animate="visible" custom={5}>
          <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
            <CardContent className="p-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                <DollarSign className={`w-5 h-5 ${monthNet >= 0 ? 'text-emerald-500' : 'text-red-500'}`} />
                <Badge variant="secondary" className={`text-[10px] ${monthNet >= 0 ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-900/30 dark:text-emerald-400' : 'bg-red-100 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-900/30 dark:text-red-400'}`}>
                  الشهر
                </Badge>
              </div>
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">
                {transactions.length > 0 ? `${toArabicNum(monthExpenses)} ₪` : '—'}
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">مصروفات الشهر</p>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </motion.div>

        {/* Today's Mood */}
        <motion.div variants={cardVariants} initial="hidden" animate="visible" custom={6}>
          <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
            <CardContent className="p-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                <BookOpen className="w-5 h-5 text-muted-foreground" />
                <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-[10px] bg-muted text-muted-foreground">
                  المزاج
                </Badge>
              </div>
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">
                {todayJournal ? (
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span>{MOOD_CONFIG[todayJournal.mood].emoji}</span>
                    <span className="text-base">{MOOD_CONFIG[todayJournal.mood].label}</span>
                  </span>
                ) : '—'}
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">مزاج اليوم</p>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </motion.div>

        {/* Top Streak */}
        <motion.div variants={cardVariants} initial="hidden" animate="visible" custom={7}>
          <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
            <CardContent className="p-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                <Flame className="w-5 h-5 text-orange-500" />
                <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-[10px] bg-orange-100 text-orange-700 dark:bg-orange-900/30 dark:text-orange-400">
                  Streak
                </Badge>
              </div>
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">
                {topStreak.streak > 0 ? (
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span>🔥</span>
                    <span>{toArabicNum(topStreak.streak)}</span>
                  </span>
                ) : '—'}
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
                {topStreak.streak > 0 ? topStreak.name : 'أعلى streak'}
              </p>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </motion.div>
      </div>

      {/* ============ التقويم ============ */}
      <motion.div variants={cardVariants} initial="hidden" animate="visible" custom={8}>
        <CalendarView />
      </motion.div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-4 md:gap-6">
        {/* ============ آخر المشاريع ============ */}
        <motion.div variants={cardVariants} initial="hidden" animate="visible" custom={8}>
          <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
            <CardContent className="p-4 md:p-6">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
                <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-foreground">آخر المشاريع</h2>
                <Button
                  variant="ghost"
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={() => handleViewAll('projects')}
                  className="text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground gap-1"
                >
                  عرض الكل
                  <ArrowLeft className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                </Button>
              </div>
              {recentProjects.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="text-center py-8 text-muted-foreground text-sm">
                  <FolderKanban className="w-8 h-8 mx-auto mb-2 opacity-40" />
                  <p>لا توجد مشاريع بعد</p>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="space-y-3">
                  {recentProjects.map((project) => (
                    <motion.div
                      key={project.id}
                      initial={{ opacity: 0, x: 8 }}
                      animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }}
                      transition={{ duration: 0.25 }}
                      className="flex items-center gap-3 p-3 rounded-lg border border-border hover:border-border transition-colors"
                    >
                      {project.images.length > 0 ? (
                        <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-lg overflow-hidden bg-muted shrink-0">
                          <img
                            src={project.images[0]}
                            alt={project.title}
                            className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                          />
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-lg bg-muted flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                          <FolderKanban className="w-5 h-5 text-muted-foreground" />
                        </div>
                      )}
                      <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                        <p className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground truncate">{project.title}</p>
                        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
                          {new Date(project.createdAt).toLocaleDateString('ar-SA')}
                        </p>
                      </div>
                      <Badge
                        variant="secondary"
                        className={`text-[10px] shrink-0 ${PROJECT_STATUS_COLORS[project.status]}`}
                      >
                        {PROJECT_STATUS_LABELS[project.status]}
                      </Badge>
                    </motion.div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </motion.div>

        {/* ============ المهارات الأعلى ============ */}
        <motion.div variants={cardVariants} initial="hidden" animate="visible" custom={9}>
          <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
            <CardContent className="p-4 md:p-6">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
                <h2 className="text-base font-semibold text-foreground">المهارات الأعلى</h2>
                <Button
                  variant="ghost"
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={() => handleViewAll('skills')}
                  className="text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground gap-1"
                >
                  عرض الكل
                  <ArrowLeft className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                </Button>
              </div>
              {topSkills.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="text-center py-8 text-muted-foreground text-sm">
                  <Star className="w-8 h-8 mx-auto mb-2 opacity-40" />
                  <p>لا توجد مهارات بعد</p>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="space-y-4">
                  {topSkills.map((skill, i) => (
                    <motion.div
                      key={skill.id}
                      initial={{ opacity: 0, x: 8 }}
                      animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }}
                      transition={{ delay: i * 0.05, duration: 0.25 }}
                      className="space-y-1.5"
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
                          <span className="text-base">{skill.icon || '💻'}</span>
                          <span className="font-medium text-foreground truncate">{skill.name}</span>
                        </div>
                        <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground shrink-0 mr-2">{skill.level}%</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="h-1.5 bg-muted rounded-full overflow-hidden">
                        <motion.div
                          initial={{ width: 0 }}
                          animate={{ width: `${skill.level}%` }}
                          transition={{ delay: i * 0.05 + 0.2, duration: 0.6, ease: 'easeOut' }}
                          className={`h-full rounded-full ${
                            skill.level >= 75
                              ? 'bg-emerald-500'
                              : skill.level >= 50
                              ? 'bg-amber-500'
                              : 'bg-gray-400'
                          }`}
                        />
                      </div>
                    </motion.div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </motion.div>
      </div>

      {/* ============ بطاقات المسيرة ============ */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-3 md:gap-4">
        <motion.div variants={cardVariants} initial="hidden" animate="visible" custom={8}>
          <Card className="border border-border bg-background cursor-pointer hover:border-teal-300 transition-colors" onClick={() => handleViewAll('university')}>
            <CardContent className="p-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                <GraduationCap className="w-5 h-5 text-teal-500" />
                <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-[10px] bg-teal-50 text-teal-600 dark:bg-teal-900/30 dark:text-teal-400">GPA</Badge>
              </div>
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">
                {universitySemesters.length > 0 ? cumulativeGpa.toFixed(1) : '—'}
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">المعدل التراكمي</p>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </motion.div>

        <motion.div variants={cardVariants} initial="hidden" animate="visible" custom={9}>
          <Card className="border border-border bg-background cursor-pointer hover:border-amber-300 transition-colors" onClick={() => handleViewAll('certificates')}>
            <CardContent className="p-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                <Medal className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-500" />
                <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-[10px] bg-amber-50 text-amber-600 dark:bg-amber-900/30 dark:text-amber-400">إنجازات</Badge>
              </div>
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">{toArabicNum(certificates.length)}</div>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">شهادة وإنجاز</p>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </motion.div>

        <motion.div variants={cardVariants} initial="hidden" animate="visible" custom={10}>
          <Card className="border border-border bg-background cursor-pointer hover:border-blue-300 transition-colors" onClick={() => handleViewAll('workhours')}>
            <CardContent className="p-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                <Clock className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-500" />
                <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-[10px] bg-blue-50 text-blue-600 dark:bg-blue-900/30 dark:text-blue-400">ساعات</Badge>
              </div>
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">
                {totalWorkHours > 0 ? formatHours(totalWorkHours) : '—'}
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">إجمالي ساعات العمل</p>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </motion.div>

        <motion.div variants={cardVariants} initial="hidden" animate="visible" custom={11}>
          <Card className="border border-border bg-background cursor-pointer hover:border-orange-300 transition-colors" onClick={() => handleViewAll('experience')}>
            <CardContent className="p-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                <Briefcase className="w-5 h-5 text-orange-500" />
                <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-[10px] bg-orange-50 text-orange-600 dark:bg-orange-900/30 dark:text-orange-400">خبرات</Badge>

              >

                ) : (
                  <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                )}
                {backupLoading ? 'جاري...' : 'نسخة الآن'}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </motion.div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// ============ مساعدات ============

function getYoutubeEmbedUrl(url: string): string | null {
  const match = url.match(
    /(?:youtube\.com\/watch\?v=|youtu\.be\/|youtube\.com\/embed\/)([a-zA-Z0-9_-]{11})/
  );
  return match ? `https://www.youtube.com/embed/${match[1]}` : null;
}

function formatDate(dateStr: string): string {
  if (!dateStr) return '';
  try {
    return new Date(dateStr).toLocaleDateString('ar-SA', {
      year: 'numeric',
      month: 'short',
      day: 'numeric',
    });
  } catch {
    return dateStr;
  }
}

function formatSize(bytes: number): string {
  if (bytes < 1024) return `${bytes} بايت`;
  if (bytes < 1024 * 1024) return `${(bytes / 1024).toFixed(1)} ك.ب`;
  return `${(bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)} م.ب`;
}

function getAttachmentIcon(cat: ProjectAttachment['category']) {
  switch (cat) {
    case 'image': return <ImageIcon className="w-5 h-5 text-teal-500" />;
    case 'video': return <Video className="w-5 h-5 text-rose-500" />;
    case 'document': return <FileText className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-500" />;
    case 'code': return <FileCode className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-500" />;
    case 'archive': return <FileArchive className="w-5 h-5 text-orange-500" />;
    case 'audio': return <Music className="w-5 h-5 text-purple-500" />;
    default: return <File className="w-5 h-5 text-gray-400" />;
  }
}

function simpleMarkdownRender(md: string): string {
  let html = md
    // Code blocks
    .replace(/```(\w*)\n([\s\S]*?)```/g, '<pre class="bg-zinc-900 dark:bg-zinc-800 text-zinc-100 rounded-lg p-4 my-3 overflow-x-auto text-sm font-mono"><code>$2</code></pre>')
    // Inline code
    .replace(/`([^`]+)`/g, '<code class="bg-muted px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-sm font-mono">$1</code>')
    // Headers
    .replace(/^### (.+)$/gm, '<h3 class="text-base font-bold mt-4 mb-2 text-foreground">$1</h3>')
    .replace(/^## (.+)$/gm, '<h2 class="text-lg font-bold mt-5 mb-2 text-foreground">$1</h2>')
    .replace(/^# (.+)$/gm, '<h1 class="text-xl font-bold mt-6 mb-3 text-foreground">$1</h1>')
    // Bold
    .replace(/\*\*(.+?)\*\*/g, '<strong class="font-bold">$1</strong>')
    // Italic
    .replace(/\*(.+?)\*/g, '<em>$1</em>')
    // Unordered lists
    .replace(/^- (.+)$/gm, '<li class="mr-4 list-disc text-sm">$1</li>')
    // Ordered lists
    .replace(/^\d+\. (.+)$/gm, '<li class="mr-4 list-decimal text-sm">$1</li>')
    // Horizontal rule
    .replace(/^---$/gm, '<hr class="my-4 border-border" />')
    // Paragraphs (double newlines)
    .replace(/\n\n/g, '</p><p class="my-2">')
    // Single newlines within paragraphs
    .replace(/\n/g, '<br />');

  return `<div class="prose prose-sm max-w-none text-foreground/90 leading-relaxed"><p>${html}</p></div>`;
}

  // --- ملاحظات ---
  const [notesText, setNotesText] = useState('');
  const [editingNotes, setEditingNotes] = useState(false);

  // --- تأكيد الحذف ---
  const [deleteConfirmOpen, setDeleteConfirmOpen] = useState(false);
  const [deleteTarget, setDeleteTarget] = useState<{
    type: 'project' | 'image' | 'video' | 'snippet' | 'attachment';
    id: string;
    extra?: string;
  } | null>(null);

  // --- Toast ---
  const [toasts, setToasts] = useState<Toast[]>([]);

  // --- تغييرات غير محفوظة ---
  const [hasUnsaved, setHasUnsaved] = useState(false);

  // ============ Toast مساعد ============

  const showToast = useCallback((message: string, type: 'success' | 'error' = 'success') => {
    const id = Date.now().toString();
    setToasts((prev) => [...prev, { id, message, type }]);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setToasts((prev) => prev.filter((t) => t.id !== id));
    }, 3500);
  }, []);

  // ============ المشاريع المفلترة ============

  const filteredProjects = useMemo(() => {
    let result = [...projects];
    if (statusFilter !== 'all') {
      result = result.filter((p) => p.status === statusFilter);
    }
    if (categoryFilter !== 'all') {
      result = result.filter((p) => p.category === categoryFilter);
    }
    if (tagFilter !== 'all') {
      result = result.filter((p) => p.tags && p.tags.includes(tagFilter));
    }
    if (debouncedSearch.trim()) {
      const q = debouncedSearch.trim().toLowerCase();
      result = result.filter((p) =>
        p.title.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        p.description.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        p.technologies.some((t) => t.toLowerCase().includes(q))
      );
    }
    result.sort((a, b) => {
      if (sortOrder === 'name') return a.title.localeCompare(b.title, 'ar');
      const dateA = new Date(a.createdAt).getTime();
      const dateB = new Date(b.createdAt).getTime();
      return sortOrder === 'newest' ? dateB - dateA : dateA - dateB;
    });
    return result;
  }, [projects, statusFilter, categoryFilter, tagFilter, debouncedSearch, sortOrder]);

  // جميع الوسوم المستخدمة
  const allTags = useMemo(() => {
    const tagSet = new Set<string>();
    projects.forEach((p) => (p.tags || []).forEach((t) => tagSet.add(t)));
    return Array.from(tagSet).sort();
  }, [projects]);

  // ============ المشروع المحدد ============

  const selectedProject = useMemo(
    () => projects.find((p) => p.id === selectedProjectId) ?? null,
    [projects, selectedProjectId]
  );

  // --- تتبع التغييرات غير المحفوظة ---
  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedProject) {
      const dirty = planText !== selectedProject.executionPlan;
      setHasUnsaved(dirty || editingNotes);
    } else {
      setHasUnsaved(false);
    }
  }, [planText, editingNotes, selectedProject]);

  // ============ معالجات القائمة ============

  const openAddDialog = () => {
    setEditingProject(null);
    setForm(emptyForm);
    setTechInput('');
    setDialogOpen(true);
  };

  const openEditDialog = (project: Project) => {
    setEditingProject(project);
    setForm({
      title: project.title,
      description: project.description,
      status: project.status,
      category: project.category,
      technologies: [...project.technologies],
      links: project.links.length > 0
        ? project.links.map((l) => ({ ...l }))
        : [{ label: '', url: '' }],
      startDate: project.startDate,
      endDate: project.endDate,
      notes: project.notes,
      tags: project.tags ? [...project.tags] : [],
      showInPortfolio: project.showInPortfolio ?? true,
    });
    setTechInput('');
    setDialogOpen(true);
  };

  const handleSaveProject = () => {
    if (!form.title.trim()) return;
    const cleanLinks = form.links.filter((l) => l.label.trim() && l.url.trim());
    if (editingProject) {
      updateProject(editingProject.id, { ...form, links: cleanLinks });
      showToast('تم تحديث المشروع بنجاح');
    } else {
      addProject({
        ...form,
        links: cleanLinks,
        images: [],
        youtubeVideos: [],
        codeSnippets: [],
        attachments: [],
        executionPlan: '',
      });
      showToast('تم إنشاء المشروع بنجاح');
    }
    setDialogOpen(false);
    setForm(emptyForm);
    setEditingProject(null);
  };

  // ============ التكنولوجيات ============

  const handleTechKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      e.preventDefault();
      const val = techInput.trim();
      if (val && !form.technologies.includes(val)) {
        setForm({ ...form, technologies: [...form.technologies, val] });
        setTechInput('');
      }
    }
  };

  const removeTech = (tech: string) => {
    setForm({ ...form, technologies: form.technologies.filter((t) => t !== tech) });
  };

  // ============ الروابط الديناميكية ============

  const addLinkField = () => {
    setForm({ ...form, links: [...form.links, { label: '', url: '' }] });
  };

  const removeLinkField = (index: number) => {
    setForm({ ...form, links: form.links.filter((_, i) => i !== index) });
  };

  const updateLink = (index: number, field: keyof ProjectLink, value: string) => {
    const newLinks = [...form.links];
    newLinks[index] = { ...newLinks[index], [field]: value };
    setForm({ ...form, links: newLinks });
  };

  // ============ عرض التفاصيل ============

  const openDetail = (id: string) => {
    setSelectedProjectId(id);
    setView('detail');
    setDetailTab('info');
    setEditingNotes(false);
    setVideoInput('');
    setVideoUploading(false);
    setUploading(false);
    setAttachUploading(false);
    setGalleryDragOver(false);
    setAttachDragOver(false);
    setPlanPreview(false);
    setPlanDirty(false);
  };

  const closeDetail = () => {
    if (hasUnsaved) {
      const ok = window.confirm('يوجد تغييرات غير محفوظة. هل تريد المغادرة؟');
      if (!ok) return;
    }
    setView('list');
    setSelectedProjectId(null);
    setHasUnsaved(false);
  };

  // ============ رفع صور متعددة ============

  const uploadImages = useCallback(
    async (files: FileList | File[]) => {
      if (!selectedProjectId) return;
      const fileList = Array.from(files).filter((f) => f.type.startsWith('image/'));
      if (fileList.length === 0) {
        showToast('الرجاء اختيار ملفات صور فقط', 'error');
        return;
      }
      setUploading(true);
      setUploadProgress(`جارٍ رفع ${fileList.length} صورة...`);
      try {
        const formData = new FormData();
        fileList.forEach((f) => formData.append('files', f));
        const res = await fetch('/api/upload', { method: 'POST', body: formData });
        const data = await res.json();
        if (data.results) {
          for (const r of data.results) {
            if (r.success && r.url) {
              addProjectImage(selectedProjectId, r.url);
            }
          }
          const ok = data.results.filter((r: { success: boolean }) => r.success).length;
          showToast(`تم رفع ${ok} صورة بنجاح`);
        } else if (data.url) {
          addProjectImage(selectedProjectId, data.url);
          showToast('تم رفع الصورة بنجاح');
        } else {
          showToast('فشل رفع الصور', 'error');
        }
      } catch {
        showToast('خطأ في رفع الصور', 'error');
      } finally {
        setUploading(false);
        setUploadProgress('');
      }
    },
    [selectedProjectId, addProjectImage, showToast]
  );

  const handleGalleryFileChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (e.target.files && e.target.files.length > 0) {
      uploadImages(e.target.files);
      e.target.value = '';
    }
  };

  const handleGalleryDrop = (e: React.DragEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setGalleryDragOver(false);
    if (e.dataTransfer.files && e.dataTransfer.files.length > 0) {
      uploadImages(e.dataTransfer.files);
    }
  };

  // ============ حذف صورة (إصلاح البق) ============

  const deleteImage = (imageUrl: string) => {
    if (!selectedProjectId) return;
    removeProjectImage(selectedProjectId, imageUrl);
    // إصلاح: استخدام query param بدلاً من JSON body
    fetch(`/api/upload?url=${encodeURIComponent(imageUrl)}`, { method: 'DELETE' }).catch(() => {});
    showToast('تم حذف الصورة');
  };

  // ============ فيديوهات YouTube ============

  const handleAddVideo = () => {
    if (!selectedProjectId || !videoInput.trim()) return;
    addProjectVideo(selectedProjectId, videoInput.trim());
    setVideoInput('');
    showToast('تم إضافة رابط الفيديو');
  };

  const deleteVideo = (videoUrl: string) => {
    if (!selectedProjectId) return;
    removeProjectVideo(selectedProjectId, videoUrl);
    showToast('تم حذف الفيديو');
  };

  // ============ رفع فيديو مباشر ============

  const handleVideoFileChange = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (!selectedProjectId || !e.target.files?.[0]) return;
    const file = e.target.files[0];
    setVideoUploading(true);
    try {
      const formData = new FormData();
      formData.append('file', file);
      const res = await fetch('/api/upload', { method: 'POST', body: formData });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.url) {
        addProjectAttachment(selectedProjectId, {
          id: Date.now().toString() + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2),
          name: file.name,
          url: data.url,
          size: data.size || file.size,
          sizeFormatted: data.sizeFormatted || formatSize(file.size),
          mimeType: file.type,
          category: 'video',
          uploadedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        });
        showToast('تم رفع الفيديو بنجاح');
      } else {
        showToast(data.error || 'فشل رفع الفيديو', 'error');
      }
    } catch {
      showToast('خطأ في رفع الفيديو', 'error');
    } finally {
      setVideoUploading(false);
      e.target.value = '';
    }
  };

  // ============ المرفقات ============

  const uploadAttachments = useCallback(
    async (files: FileList | File[]) => {
      if (!selectedProjectId) return;
      const fileList = Array.from(files);
      if (fileList.length === 0) return;
      setAttachUploading(true);
      setUploadProgress(`جارٍ رفع ${fileList.length} ملف...`);
      try {
        const formData = new FormData();
        fileList.forEach((f) => formData.append('files', f));
        const res = await fetch('/api/upload', { method: 'POST', body: formData });
        const data = await res.json();

        const results = data.results || (data.url ? [{ ...data, originalName: data.originalName || fileList[0].name, category: data.category || 'other' }] : []);

        for (let i = 0; i < results.length; i++) {
          const r = results[i];
          if (r.success && r.url) {
            const origName = r.originalName || fileList[i]?.name || 'ملف';
            const cat = (r.category as ProjectAttachment['category']) || 'other';
            addProjectAttachment(selectedProjectId, {
              id: Date.now().toString() + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2) + i,
              name: origName,
              url: r.url,
              size: r.size || 0,
              sizeFormatted: r.sizeFormatted || formatSize(r.size || 0),
              mimeType: r.mimeType || '',
              category: cat,
              uploadedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
            });
          }
        }
        const ok = results.filter((r: { success: boolean }) => r.success).length;
        showToast(`تم رفع ${ok} ملف بنجاح`);
      } catch {
        showToast('خطأ في رفع المرفقات', 'error');
      } finally {
        setAttachUploading(false);
        setUploadProgress('');
      }
    },
    [selectedProjectId, addProjectAttachment, showToast]
  );

  const handleAttachFileChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (e.target.files && e.target.files.length > 0) {
      uploadAttachments(e.target.files);
      e.target.value = '';
    }
  };

  const handleAttachDrop = (e: React.DragEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setAttachDragOver(false);
    if (e.dataTransfer.files && e.dataTransfer.files.length > 0) {
      uploadAttachments(e.dataTransfer.files);
    }
  };

  const deleteAttachment = (attachmentId: string, url: string) => {
    if (!selectedProjectId) return;
    removeProjectAttachment(selectedProjectId, attachmentId);
    fetch(`/api/upload?url=${encodeURIComponent(url)}`, { method: 'DELETE' }).catch(() => {});
    showToast('تم حذف المرفق');
  };

  // ============ أقواس الكود ============

  const openSnippetDialog = (snippet?: CodeSnippet) => {
    if (snippet) {
      setEditingSnippetId(snippet.id);
      setSnippetForm({ title: snippet.title, language: snippet.language, code: snippet.code });
    } else {
      setEditingSnippetId(null);
      setSnippetForm({ title: '', language: 'javascript', code: '' });
    }
    setSnippetDialogOpen(true);
  };

  const handleSaveSnippet = () => {
    if (!selectedProjectId || !snippetForm.title.trim() || !snippetForm.code.trim()) return;
    if (editingSnippetId) {
      updateCodeSnippet(selectedProjectId, editingSnippetId, {
        title: snippetForm.title,
        language: snippetForm.language,
        code: snippetForm.code,
      });
      showToast('تم تحديث الكود');
    } else {
      addCodeSnippet(selectedProjectId, {
        title: snippetForm.title,
        language: snippetForm.language,
        code: snippetForm.code,
      });
      showToast('تم إضافة الكود');
    }
    setSnippetDialogOpen(false);
    setSnippetForm({ title: '', language: 'javascript', code: '' });
    setEditingSnippetId(null);
  };

  const handleDeleteSnippet = (snippetId: string) => {
    if (!selectedProjectId) return;
    deleteCodeSnippet(selectedProjectId, snippetId);
    showToast('تم حذف الكود');
  };

  const copyCode = (code: string, snippetId: string) => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(code).then(() => {
      setCopiedSnippetId(snippetId);
      showToast('تم نسخ الكود');
      setTimeout(() => setCopiedSnippetId(null), 2000);
    });
  };

  // ============ خطة التنفيذ ============

  useEffect(() => {
    if (selectedProject) {
      setPlanText(selectedProject.executionPlan || '');
      setPlanDirty(false);
    }
  }, [selectedProjectId]);

  const handleSavePlan = () => {
    if (!selectedProjectId) return;
    updateProjectExecutionPlan(selectedProjectId, planText);
    setPlanDirty(false);
    setHasUnsaved(false);
    showToast('تم حفظ خطة التنفيذ');
  };

  // ============ ملاحظات ============

  const startEditNotes = () => {
    if (selectedProject) {
      setNotesText(selectedProject.notes || '');
      setEditingNotes(true);
    }
  };

  const handleSaveNotes = () => {
    if (!selectedProjectId) return;
    updateProject(selectedProjectId, { notes: notesText });
    setEditingNotes(false);
    showToast('تم حفظ الملاحظات');
  };

  // ============ الحذف العام ============

  const requestDelete = (
    type: 'project' | 'image' | 'video' | 'snippet' | 'attachment',
    id: string,
    extra?: string
  ) => {
    setDeleteTarget({ type, id, extra });
    setDeleteConfirmOpen(true);
  };

  const handleConfirmDelete = () => {
    if (!deleteTarget) return;
    const { type, id, extra } = deleteTarget;
    switch (type) {
      case 'project':
        deleteProject(id);
        closeDetail();
        showToast('تم حذف المشروع');
        break;
      case 'image':
        if (selectedProjectId && extra) deleteImage(extra);
        break;
      case 'video':
        if (selectedProjectId && extra) deleteVideo(extra);
        break;
      case 'snippet':
        if (selectedProjectId) handleDeleteSnippet(id);
        break;
      case 'attachment':
        if (selectedProjectId && extra) deleteAttachment(id, extra);
        break;
    }
    setDeleteConfirmOpen(false);
    setDeleteTarget(null);
  };

  // ============ المرفقات المفلترة ============

  const filteredAttachments = useMemo(() => {
    if (!selectedProject) return [];
    if (attachFilter === 'all') return selectedProject.attachments;
    return selectedProject.attachments.filter((a) => a.category === attachFilter);
  }, [selectedProject, attachFilter]);

  // ================================================================
  // عرض قائمة المشاريع
  // ================================================================

  if (view === 'list') {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-6">
        {/* === الترويسة === */}
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2 text-foreground">
              <FolderKanban className="w-6 h-6 text-emerald-600" />
              المشاريع
            </h2>
            <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm mt-1">
              إدارة وتوثيق مشاريعك بالكامل
            </p>
          </div>
          <Button
            onClick={openAddDialog}
            className="bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white gap-2 shrink-0"
          >
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
            إضافة مشروع
          </Button>
        </div>

        {/* === الفلاتر === */}
        <div className="space-y-4">
          {/* تبويبات الحالة */}
          <Tabs
            value={statusFilter}
            onValueChange={(v) => setStatusFilter(v as StatusFilter)}
            dir="rtl"
          >
            <TabsList className="bg-muted h-auto flex-wrap gap-1 p-1">
              {STATUS_TABS.map((tab) => {
                const count =
                  tab.value === 'all'
                    ? projects.length
                    : projects.filter((p) => p.status === tab.value).length;
                return (
                  <TabsTrigger
                    key={tab.value}
                    value={tab.value}
                    className="data-[state=active]:bg-background data-[state=active]:text-foreground data-[state=active]:shadow-sm text-muted-foreground text-sm px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md"
                  >
                    {tab.label} ({count})
                  </TabsTrigger>
                );
              })}
            </TabsList>
          </Tabs>

          {/* البحث + فلتر الفئة + ترتيب */}
          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-3">
            <div className="relative flex-1">
              <Search className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />
              <Input
                placeholder="البحث في المشاريع (الاسم، الوصف، التقنيات)..."
                value={searchQuery}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                className="pr-10 bg-background border-border"
                dir="rtl"
              />
              {searchQuery !== debouncedSearch && (
                <div className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2">
                  <div className="w-3 h-3 border-2 border-emerald-500 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" />
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
            <Select value={categoryFilter} onValueChange={setCategoryFilter}>
              <SelectTrigger className="w-full sm:w-44 bg-background border-border">
                <SelectValue placeholder="كل الفئات" />
              </SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                <SelectItem value="all">كل الفئات</SelectItem>
                {PROJECT_CATEGORIES.map((cat) => (
                  <SelectItem key={cat} value={cat}>{cat}</SelectItem>
                ))}
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
            <Select value={sortOrder} onValueChange={(v) => setSortOrder(v as SortOption)}>
              <SelectTrigger className="w-full sm:w-40 bg-background border-border">
                <SelectValue />
              </SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                {SORT_OPTIONS.map((opt) => (
                  <SelectItem key={opt.value} value={opt.value}>{opt.label}</SelectItem>
                ))}
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* === شبكة المشاريع === */}
        {filteredProjects.length === 0 ? (
          <motion.div
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
            className="text-center py-20"
          >
            <div className="text-6xl mb-4">🚀</div>
            <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-foreground mb-2">
              {projects.length === 0 ? 'ابدأ أول مشروع!' : 'لا توجد نتائج'}
            </h3>
            <p className="text-muted-foreground mb-4">
              {projects.length === 0
                ? 'اضغط + لإضافة مشروع جديد وابدأ بناء معرض أعمالك'
                : 'جرب تغيير معايير البحث أو الفلتر'}
            </p>
            {projects.length === 0 && (
              <Button
                onClick={openAddDialog}
                variant="outline"
                className="gap-2 border-emerald-200 text-emerald-700 hover:bg-emerald-50 dark:border-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-400 dark:hover:bg-emerald-900/30"
              >
                <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
                إضافة مشروع
              </Button>
            )}
          </motion.div>
        ) : (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
            <AnimatePresence mode="popLayout">
              {filteredProjects.map((project, index) => (
                <motion.div
                  key={project.id}
                  layout
                  initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 16 }}
                  animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                  exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }}
                  transition={{ delay: index * 0.04, duration: 0.25 }}
                >
                  <Card
                    className="cursor-pointer hover:border-emerald-300 transition-colors bg-background border-border group"
                    onClick={() => openDetail(project.id)}
                  >
                    <CardHeader className="pb-0">
                      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                        <CardTitle className="text-base font-semibold text-foreground line-clamp-1">
                          {project.title}
                        </CardTitle>
                        <Badge
                          variant="secondary"
                          className={`text-[11px] shrink-0 flex items-center gap-1 ${PROJECT_STATUS_COLORS[project.status]}`}
                        >
                          {STATUS_ICONS[project.status]}
                          {PROJECT_STATUS_LABELS[project.status]}
                        </Badge>
                      </div>
                    </CardHeader>
                    <CardContent className="space-y-3">
                      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground line-clamp-2 leading-relaxed">
                        {project.description || 'لا يوجد وصف'}
                      </p>

                      <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[11px] border-border text-muted-foreground">
                        {project.category}
                      </Badge>

                      {project.technologies.length > 0 && (
                        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
                          {project.technologies.slice(0, 4).map((tech) => (
                            <Badge
                              key={tech}
                              variant="secondary"
                              className="text-[10px] bg-muted text-muted-foreground"
                            >
                              {tech}
                            </Badge>
                          ))}
                          {project.technologies.length > 4 && (
                            <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-[10px] bg-muted text-muted-foreground">
                              +{project.technologies.length - 4}
                            </Badge>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      )}

                      {project.tags && project.tags.length > 0 && (
                        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
                          {project.tags.slice(0, 3).map((tag) => (
                            <Badge
                              key={tag}
                              variant="outline"
                              className="text-[10px] border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400"
                            >
                              #{tag}
                            </Badge>
                          ))}
                          {project.tags.length > 3 && (
                            <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[10px] border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400">
                              +{project.tags.length - 3}
                            </Badge>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      )}

                      <Separator className="bg-muted" />

                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                          {project.images.length > 0 && (
                            <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                              <ImageIcon className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              {project.images.length}
                            </span>
                          )}
                          {project.attachments.length > 0 && (
                            <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                              <Paperclip className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              {project.attachments.length}
                            </span>
                          )}
                          {project.youtubeVideos.length > 0 && (
                            <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                              <Video className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              {project.youtubeVideos.length}
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </div>
                        <span>{formatDate(project.createdAt)}</span>
                      </div>
                    </CardContent>
                  </Card>
                </motion.div>
              ))}
            </AnimatePresence>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* === حوار إضافة/تعديل المشروع === */}
        <Dialog open={dialogOpen} onOpenChange={setDialogOpen}>
          <DialogContent dir="rtl" className="bg-background max-w-2xl max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
            <DialogHeader>
              <DialogTitle className="text-foreground">
                {editingProject ? 'تعديل المشروع' : 'إضافة مشروع جديد'}
              </DialogTitle>
              <DialogDescription className="text-muted-foreground">
                {editingProject ? 'قم بتعديل بيانات المشروع' : 'أدخل بيانات المشروع الجديد'}
              </DialogDescription>
            </DialogHeader>
            <div className="space-y-4 py-2">
              {/* العنوان */}
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>عنوان المشروع *</Label>
                <Input
                  value={form.title}
                  onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, title: e.target.value })}
                  placeholder="مثال: تطبيق إدارة المهام"
                  className="border-border"
                />
              </div>

              {/* الوصف */}
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>الوصف</Label>
                <Textarea
                  value={form.description}
                  onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, description: e.target.value })}
                  placeholder="وصف تفصيلي للمشروع..."
                  className="border-border min-h-[100px] resize-y"
                />
              </div>

              {/* الحالة + الفئة */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label>الحالة</Label>
                  <Select
                    value={form.status}
                    onValueChange={(v) => setForm({ ...form, status: v as Project['status'] })}
                  >
                    <SelectTrigger className="border-border">
                      <SelectValue />
                    </SelectTrigger>
                    <SelectContent>
                      {Object.entries(PROJECT_STATUS_LABELS).map(([key, label]) => (
                        <SelectItem key={key} value={key}>{label}</SelectItem>
                      ))}
                    </SelectContent>
                  </Select>
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label>الفئة</Label>
                  <Select value={form.category} onValueChange={(v) => setForm({ ...form, category: v })}>
                    <SelectTrigger className="border-border">
                      <SelectValue />
                    </SelectTrigger>
                    <SelectContent>
                      {PROJECT_CATEGORIES.map((cat) => (
                        <SelectItem key={cat} value={cat}>{cat}</SelectItem>
                      ))}
                    </SelectContent>
                  </Select>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* التواريخ */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label>تاريخ البدء</Label>
                  <Input
                    type="date"
                    value={form.startDate}
                    onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, startDate: e.target.value })}
                    className="border-border"
                    dir="ltr"
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label>تاريخ الانتهاء</Label>
                  <Input
                    type="date"
                    value={form.endDate}
                    onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, endDate: e.target.value })}
                    className="border-border"
                    dir="ltr"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* التقنيات */}
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>التقنيات المستخدمة</Label>
                <div className="flex gap-2">
                  <Input
                    value={techInput}
                    onChange={(e) => setTechInput(e.target.value)}
                    onKeyDown={handleTechKeyDown}
                    placeholder="اكتب التقنية ثم اضغط Enter"
                    className="border-border"
                  />
                </div>
                {form.technologies.length > 0 && (
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 mt-2">
                    {form.technologies.map((tech) => (
                      <Badge
                        key={tech}
                        variant="secondary"
                        className="gap-1 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-900/30 dark:text-emerald-400 pr-1"
                      >
                        {tech}
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => removeTech(tech)}
                          className="hover:bg-emerald-200 dark:hover:bg-emerald-800 rounded-full p-0.5"
                        >
                          <X className="w-3 h-3" />
                        </button>
                      </Badge>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* الوسوم */}
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>الوسوم</Label>
                <TagInput
                  value={form.tags}
                  onChange={(tags) => setForm({ ...form, tags })}
                  placeholder="اكتب وسم ثم اضغط Enter"
                />
              </div>

              {/* الروابط */}
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <Label>الروابط</Label>
                  <Button
                    type="button"
                    variant="outline"
                    size="sm"
                    onClick={addLinkField}
                    className="text-xs h-7 gap-1 border-border"
                  >
                    <Plus className="w-3 h-3" />
                    إضافة رابط
                  </Button>
                </div>
                {form.links.map((link, idx) => (
                  <div key={idx} className="flex gap-2 items-center">
                    <Input
                      value={link.label}
                      onChange={(e) => updateLink(idx, 'label', e.target.value)}
                      placeholder="عنوان الرابط"
                      className="border-border text-sm h-9"
                    />
                    <Input
                      value={link.url}
                      onChange={(e) => updateLink(idx, 'url', e.target.value)}
                      placeholder="https://..."
                      className="border-border text-sm h-9 flex-1"
                      dir="ltr"
                    />
                    {form.links.length > 1 && (
                      <Button
                        type="button"
                        variant="ghost"
                        size="icon"
                        className="h-9 w-9 shrink-0 text-red-500 hover:text-red-700"
                        onClick={() => removeLinkField(idx)}
                      >
                        <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                      </Button>
                    )}
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>

              {/* عرض في المعرض */}
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <Label>عرض في معرض الأعمال</Label>
                <Switch
                  checked={form.showInPortfolio}
                  onCheckedChange={(v) => setForm({ ...form, showInPortfolio: v })}
                />
              </div>
            </div>
            <DialogFooter className="gap-2">
              <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setDialogOpen(false)} className="border-border text-muted-foreground">
                إلغاء
              </Button>
              <Button
                onClick={handleSaveProject}
                disabled={!form.title.trim()}
                className="bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white"
              >
                <Save className="w-4 h-4 ml-1" />
                {editingProject ? 'حفظ التعديلات' : 'إنشاء المشروع'}
              </Button>
            </DialogFooter>
          </DialogContent>
        </Dialog>

        {/* === تأكيد الحذف === */}
        {deleteConfirmOpen && (
          <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center">
            <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/50" onClick={() => setDeleteConfirmOpen(false)} />
            <motion.div
              initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
              exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }}
              className="relative bg-background rounded-lg border border-border p-6 max-w-sm w-full mx-4 shadow-lg"
              dir="rtl"
            >
              <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-foreground mb-2">تأكيد الحذف</h3>
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-6">
                {deleteTarget?.type === 'project'
                  ? 'هل أنت متأكد من حذف هذا المشروع؟ لا يمكن التراجع عن هذا الإجراء.'
                  : 'هل أنت متأكد من حذف هذا العنصر؟'}
              </p>
              <div className="flex gap-2 justify-end">
                <Button
                  variant="outline"
                  onClick={() => setDeleteConfirmOpen(false)}
                  className="border-border text-muted-foreground"
                >
                  إلغاء
                </Button>
                <Button
                  onClick={handleConfirmDelete}
                  className="bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700 text-white"
                >
                  حذف
                </Button>
              </div>
            </motion.div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* === Toasts === */}
        <div className="fixed bottom-4 left-4 z-50 space-y-2">
          <AnimatePresence>
            {toasts.map((toast) => (
              <motion.div
                key={toast.id}
                initial={{ opacity: 0, x: -20, y: 20 }}
                animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0, y: 0 }}
                exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -20 }}
                className={`px-4 py-3 rounded-lg shadow-lg text-sm text-white flex items-center gap-2 ${
                  toast.type === 'success' ? 'bg-emerald-600' : 'bg-red-600'
                }`}
              >
                {toast.type === 'success' ? <Check className="w-4 h-4" /> : <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4" />}
                {toast.message}
              </motion.div>
            ))}
          </AnimatePresence>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // ================================================================
  // عرض تفاصيل المشروع
  // ================================================================

  if (!selectedProject) return null;

  // ========================================
  // Tab 1: معلومات أساسية
  // ========================================
  const renderInfoTab = () => (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* معلومات المشروع الأساسية */}
      <Card className="bg-background border-border">
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle className="text-base font-semibold text-foreground">معلومات المشروع</CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="space-y-4">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label className="text-muted-foreground text-xs">الحالة</Label>
              <Badge className={`${PROJECT_STATUS_COLORS[selectedProject.status]} flex items-center gap-1 w-fit`}>
                {STATUS_ICONS[selectedProject.status]}
                {PROJECT_STATUS_LABELS[selectedProject.status]}
              </Badge>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label className="text-muted-foreground text-xs">الفئة</Label>
              <Badge variant="outline" className="border-border text-muted-foreground">{selectedProject.category}</Badge>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label className="text-muted-foreground text-xs">تاريخ البدء</Label>
              <p className="text-sm text-foreground">{selectedProject.startDate ? formatDate(selectedProject.startDate) : '—'}</p>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label className="text-muted-foreground text-xs">تاريخ الانتهاء</Label>
              <p className="text-sm text-foreground">{selectedProject.endDate ? formatDate(selectedProject.endDate) : '—'}</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* الوصف */}
      <Card className="bg-background border-border">
        <CardHeader>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <CardTitle className="text-base font-semibold text-foreground">الوصف</CardTitle>
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              size="sm"
              onClick={() => openEditDialog(selectedProject)}
              className="text-xs gap-1 h-7 border-border text-muted-foreground"
            >
              <Pencil className="w-3 h-3" />
              تعديل
            </Button>
          </div>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap">
            {selectedProject.description || 'لا يوجد وصف'}
          </p>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* التقنيات */}
      {selectedProject.technologies.length > 0 && (
        <Card className="bg-background border-border">
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle className="text-base font-semibold text-foreground">التقنيات المستخدمة</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
              {selectedProject.technologies.map((tech) => (
                <Badge
                  key={tech}
                  variant="secondary"
                  className="bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-900/30 dark:text-emerald-400"
                >
                  {tech}
                </Badge>
              ))}
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}

      {/* الروابط */}
      {selectedProject.links.length > 0 && (
        <Card className="bg-background border-border">
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle className="text-base font-semibold text-foreground">الروابط</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              {selectedProject.links.map((link, idx) => (
                <a
                  key={idx}
                  href={link.url}
                  target="_blank"
                  rel="noopener noreferrer"
                  className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 hover:underline"
                >
                  <ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  {link.label || link.url}
                </a>
              ))}
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}

      {/* الملاحظات */}
      <Card className="bg-background border-border">
        <CardHeader>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <CardTitle className="text-base font-semibold text-foreground flex items-center gap-2">
              <StickyNote className="w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />
              ملاحظات
            </CardTitle>
            {!editingNotes ? (
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                size="sm"
                onClick={startEditNotes}
                className="text-xs gap-1 h-7 border-border text-muted-foreground"
              >
                <Pencil className="w-3 h-3" />
                تعديل
              </Button>
            ) : (
              <div className="flex gap-1.5">
                <Button
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={handleSaveNotes}
                  className="text-xs gap-1 h-7 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white"
                >
                  <Save className="w-3 h-3" />
                  حفظ
                </Button>
                <Button
                  variant="outline"
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={() => setEditingNotes(false)}
                  className="text-xs h-7 border-border text-muted-foreground"
                >
                  إلغاء
                </Button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          {editingNotes ? (
            <Textarea
              value={notesText}
              onChange={(e) => setNotesText(e.target.value)}
              className="border-border min-h-[120px] resize-y"
              placeholder="اكتب ملاحظاتك هنا..."
            />
          ) : (
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap">
              {selectedProject.notes || 'لا توجد ملاحظات'}
            </p>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* عرض في المعرض */}
      <Card className="bg-background border-border">
        <CardContent className="flex items-center justify-between pt-6">
          <Label>عرض في معرض الأعمال</Label>
          <Switch
            checked={selectedProject.showInPortfolio}
            onCheckedChange={(v) => {
              updateProject(selectedProject.id, { showInPortfolio: v });
              showToast(v ? 'سيظهر المشروع في المعرض' : 'لن يظهر المشروع في المعرض');
            }}
          />
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );

  // ========================================
  // Tab 2: المعرض (الصور)
  // ========================================
  const renderGalleryTab = () => (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* منطقة رفع الصور */}
      <div
        onDragOver={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); setGalleryDragOver(true); }}
        onDragLeave={() => setGalleryDragOver(false)}
        onDrop={handleGalleryDrop}
        className={`border-2 border-dashed rounded-xl p-6 text-center transition-colors ${
          galleryDragOver
            ? 'border-emerald-400 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-900/20'
            : 'border-border hover:border-emerald-300'
        }`}
      >
        <Upload className={`w-8 h-8 mx-auto mb-3 ${galleryDragOver ? 'text-emerald-500' : 'text-muted-foreground'}`} />
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-2">
          {uploading ? uploadProgress : 'اسحب الصور هنا أو انقر للاختيار'}
        </p>
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground/70 mb-3">يدعم JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, AVIF — حتى 20MB لكل صورة</p>
        <div className="flex gap-2 justify-center">
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => galleryInputRef.current?.click()}
            disabled={uploading}
            className="gap-1.5 border-emerald-200 text-emerald-700 hover:bg-emerald-50 dark:border-emerald-800 dark:text-emerald-400 dark:hover:bg-emerald-900/30"
          >
            <ImageIcon className="w-4 h-4" />
            {uploading ? 'جارٍ الرفع...' : 'اختيار صور'}
          </Button>
        </div>
        <input
          ref={galleryInputRef}
          type="file"
          accept="image/*"
          multiple
          onChange={handleGalleryFileChange}
          className="hidden"
        />
      </div>

      {/* عدد الصور */}
      {selectedProject.images.length > 0 && (
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            {selectedProject.images.length} صورة
          </p>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* شبكة الصور */}
      {selectedProject.images.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="text-center py-12">
          <ImageIcon className="w-12 h-12 mx-auto text-muted-foreground/30 mb-3" />
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">لم يتم إضافة صور بعد</p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
          <AnimatePresence>
            {selectedProject.images.map((imgUrl, idx) => (
              <motion.div
                key={imgUrl}
                initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }}
                animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
                exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.9 }}
                transition={{ delay: idx * 0.03 }}
                className="relative group rounded-lg overflow-hidden border border-border aspect-square cursor-pointer"
                onClick={() => { setLightboxIdx(idx); setLightboxOpen(true); }}
              >
                <img
                  src={imgUrl}
                  alt={`${selectedProject.title} - ${idx + 1}`}
                  className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                />
                <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/50 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                  <Button
                    variant="secondary"
                    size="icon"
                    className="h-8 w-8 bg-white/90 text-foreground hover:bg-white"
                    onClick={(e) => {
                      e.stopPropagation();
                      setLightboxIdx(idx);
                      setLightboxOpen(true);
                    }}
                  >
                    <Eye className="w-4 h-4" />
                  </Button>
                  <Button
                    variant="destructive"
                    size="icon"
                    className="h-8 w-8"
                    onClick={(e) => {
                      e.stopPropagation();
                      requestDelete('image', selectedProject.id, imgUrl);
                    }}
                  >
                    <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                  </Button>
                </div>
                {imgUrl.startsWith('http') && (
                  <div className="absolute top-1 left-1">
                    <Badge className="text-[9px] bg-black/60 text-white border-0 px-1.5 py-0">
                      رابط
                    </Badge>
                  </div>
                )}
              </motion.div>
            ))}
          </AnimatePresence>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );

  // ========================================
  // Tab 3: الفيديوهات
  // ========================================
  const renderVideosTab = () => (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* YouTube */}
      <Card className="bg-background border-border">
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle className="text-base font-semibold text-foreground flex items-center gap-2">
            <Video className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-500" />
            روابط YouTube
          </CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="space-y-4">
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <Input
              placeholder="أدخل رابط YouTube..."
              value={videoInput}
              onChange={(e) => setVideoInput(e.target.value)}
              onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && handleAddVideo()}
              className="bg-background border-border text-sm flex-1"
              dir="ltr"
            />
            <Button
              onClick={handleAddVideo}
              disabled={!videoInput.trim()}
              size="sm"
              className="bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white gap-1.5 shrink-0"
            >
              <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
              إضافة
            </Button>
          </div>

          {selectedProject.youtubeVideos.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground text-center py-4">
              لم يتم إضافة فيديوهات YouTube بعد
            </p>
          ) : (
            <div className="space-y-4">
              {selectedProject.youtubeVideos.map((videoUrl, idx) => {
                const embedUrl = getYoutubeEmbedUrl(videoUrl);
                return (
                  <motion.div
                    key={idx}
                    initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }}
                    animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                    transition={{ delay: idx * 0.05 }}
                    className="space-y-2"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground truncate max-w-xs" dir="ltr">
                        {videoUrl}
                      </span>
                      <Button
                        variant="ghost"
                        size="icon"
                        className="h-7 w-7 text-red-500 hover:text-red-700 hover:bg-red-50 shrink-0"
                        onClick={() => requestDelete('video', selectedProject.id, videoUrl)}
                      >
                        <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      </Button>
                    </div>
                    {embedUrl ? (
```
