```tsx
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSuccess: (key: CryptoKey) => void;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
}) {
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    if (!password.trim()) return;
    setLoading(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/master-password/verify', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ masterPassword: password }),
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok) {
        setError(data.error || 'كلمة المرور غير صحيحة');
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }
      const key = await deriveKey(password, data.salt);
      setPassword('');
      setLoading(false);
      onSuccess(key);
    } catch {
      setError('فشل الاتصال بالخادم');
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={(o) => { if (!o) { setPassword(''); setError(''); onClose(); } }}>
      <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-[400px]">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Lock className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-500" />
            {title}
          </DialogTitle>
        </DialogHeader>
        <div className="space-y-3 py-2">
          {description && (
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{description}</p>
          )}
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label>كلمة المرور الرئيسية</Label>
            <Input
              type="password"
              value={password}
              onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
              onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && handleSubmit()}
              placeholder="••••••••••••"
              autoFocus
              dir="ltr"
            />
          </div>
          {error && (
            <p className="text-sm text-destructive flex items-center gap-1">
              <ShieldAlert className="w-4 h-4" />
              {error}
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
        <DialogFooter>
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => { setPassword(''); setError(''); onClose(); }}>
            إلغاء
          </Button>
          <Button onClick={handleSubmit} disabled={loading || !password.trim()}>
            {loading ? <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" /> : <Lock className="w-4 h-4" />}
            فتح
          </Button>
        </DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

// ============ Component ============
export function NotesSection() {
  const {
    notes, addNote, updateNote, deleteNote, toggleNotePin,
  } = useAppStore();

  // State
  const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState<'grid' | 'list'>('grid');
  const [noteDialogOpen, setNoteDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingNote, setEditingNote] = useState<Note | null>(null);
  const [noteForm, setNoteForm] = useState({
    title: '',
    content: '',
    color: 'yellow' as Note['color'],
    folder: '',
    tags: [] as string[],
    isSecret: false,
  });
  const [tagInput, setTagInput] = useState('');
  const [folderFilter, setFolderFilter] = useState<string>('all');
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');

  // Master Password dialog for encryption
  const [masterPwDialog, setMasterPwDialog] = useState<{
    open: boolean;
    action: 'encrypt' | 'decrypt';
    noteId?: string;
  }>({ open: false, action: 'encrypt' });

  // Decrypted content cache (in memory only, cleared on unmount)
  const decryptedCache = useRef<Map<string, string>>(new Map());
  const [decryptedView, setDecryptedView] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // ============ Handlers ============
  const openNewNoteDialog = () => {
    setEditingNote(null);
    setNoteForm({
      title: '', content: '', color: 'yellow', folder: '', tags: [], isSecret: false,
    });
    setTagInput('');
    setNoteDialogOpen(true);
  };

  const openEditNoteDialog = useCallback(async (note: Note) => {
    // If secret note — need to decrypt first
    if (note.isSecret && note.encryptedContent) {
      // Check if already decrypted in cache
      const cached = decryptedCache.current.get(note.id);
      if (cached) {
        setEditingNote(note);
        setNoteForm({
          title: note.title,
          content: cached,
          color: note.color,
          folder: note.folder,
          tags: note.tags || [],
          isSecret: true,
        });
        setTagInput('');
        setNoteDialogOpen(true);
      } else {
        // Need master password to decrypt
        setMasterPwDialog({ open: true, action: 'decrypt', noteId: note.id });
      }
      return;
    }

    // Normal note
    setEditingNote(note);
    setNoteForm({
      title: note.title,
      content: note.content,
      color: note.color,
      folder: note.folder,
      tags: note.tags || [],
      isSecret: false,
    });
    setTagInput('');
    setNoteDialogOpen(true);
  }, []);

  const handleMasterPwSuccess = useCallback(async (key: CryptoKey) => {
    const { action, noteId } = masterPwDialog;
    setMasterPwDialog({ open: false, action: 'encrypt' });

    if (action === 'decrypt' && noteId) {
      const note = notes.find((n) => n.id === noteId);
      if (!note || !note.encryptedContent) return;

      try {
        const decrypted = await decryptText(note.encryptedContent, key);
        decryptedCache.current.set(noteId, decrypted);

        setEditingNote(note);
        setNoteForm({
          title: note.title,
          content: decrypted,
          color: note.color,
          folder: note.folder,
          tags: note.tags || [],
          isSecret: true,
        });
        setTagInput('');
        setNoteDialogOpen(true);
      } catch {
        toast({ title: 'خطأ', description: 'فشل فك التشفير — كلمة المرور خاطئة', variant: 'destructive' });
      }
    } else if (action === 'encrypt') {
      // Encrypt the note content
      const contentToEncrypt = noteForm.content;
      if (!contentToEncrypt) {
        toast({ title: 'خطأ', description: 'لا يوجد محتوى للتشفير', variant: 'destructive' });
        return;
      }

      try {
        const encrypted = await encryptText(contentToEncrypt, key);
        const now = new Date().toISOString();

        if (editingNote) {
          updateNote(editingNote.id, {
            title: noteForm.title,
            content: '[مشفر 🔒]',
            encryptedContent: encrypted,
            isSecret: true,
            color: noteForm.color,
            folder: noteForm.folder,
            tags: noteForm.tags,
          });
        } else {
          addNote({
            title: noteForm.title,
            content: '[مشفر 🔒]',
            encryptedContent: encrypted,
            isSecret: true,
            color: noteForm.color,
            folder: noteForm.folder,
            tags: noteForm.tags,
          });
        }
        setNoteDialogOpen(false);
        toast({ title: 'تم', description: 'تم حفظ الملاحظة السرية مشفّرة' });
      } catch {
        toast({ title: 'خطأ', description: 'فشل التشفير', variant: 'destructive' });
      }
    }
  }, [masterPwDialog, notes, noteForm, editingNote, updateNote, addNote]);

  const handleAddTag = () => {
    const tag = tagInput.trim();
    if (tag && !noteForm.tags.includes(tag)) {
      setNoteForm({ ...noteForm, tags: [...noteForm.tags, tag] });
      setTagInput('');
    }
  };

  const handleRemoveTag = (tag: string) => {
    setNoteForm({ ...noteForm, tags: noteForm.tags.filter((t) => t !== tag) });
  };

  const saveNote = () => {
    if (!noteForm.title.trim()) return;

    // If secret note — need master password to encrypt
    if (noteForm.isSecret) {
      setMasterPwDialog({ open: true, action: 'encrypt' });
      return;
    }

    // Normal note — save directly
    const data = {
      title: noteForm.title,
      content: noteForm.content,
      color: noteForm.color,
      folder: noteForm.folder,
      tags: noteForm.tags,
      isSecret: false,
      encryptedContent: '',
    };

    if (editingNote) {
      updateNote(editingNote.id, data);
    } else {
      addNote(data);
    }
    setNoteDialogOpen(false);
  };

  // ============ Filtering ============
  const filteredNotes = useMemo(() => {
    return notes
      .filter((n) => folderFilter === 'all' || n.folder === folderFilter)
      .filter((n) => {
        if (!searchQuery) return true;
        const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
        return (
          n.title.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          n.content.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          (n.tags || []).some((t) => t.toLowerCase().includes(q))
        );
      })
      .sort((a, b) => {
        if (a.isPinned && !b.isPinned) return -1;
        if (!a.isPinned && b.isPinned) return 1;
        return new Date(b.updatedAt).getTime() - new Date(a.updatedAt).getTime();
      });
  }, [notes, folderFilter, searchQuery]);

  const usedFolders = useMemo(() => {
    return [...new Set(notes.map((n) => n.folder).filter(Boolean))];
  }, [notes]);

  const pinnedCount = notes.filter((n) => n.isPinned).length;
  const secretCount = notes.filter((n) => n.isSecret).length;

  // ============ UI Helpers ============
  const getColorClasses = (color: Note['color']) => NOTE_COLORS[color] || NOTE_COLORS.default;

  const formatDate = (dateStr: string) => {
    try {
      const d = new Date(dateStr);
      return d.toLocaleDateString('ar', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' });
    } catch {
      return dateStr;
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between flex-wrap gap-3">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground flex items-center gap-2">
            <StickyNote className="w-6 h-6 text-amber-500" />
            الملاحظات
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-1">
            {notes.length} ملاحظة
            {pinnedCount > 0 && ` · ${pinnedCount} مثبتة`}
            {secretCount > 0 && ` · ${secretCount} سرية 🔒`}
          </p>
        </div>
        <Button onClick={openNewNoteDialog} className="gap-2">
          <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
          ملاحظة جديدة
        </Button>
      </div>

      {/* Filters */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
        <div className="relative flex-1 min-w-[200px]">
          <Search className="w-4 h-4 absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" />
          <Input
            value={searchQuery}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="ابحث في الملاحظات..."
            className="pr-10"
          />
        </div>
        {usedFolders.length > 0 && (
          <Select value={folderFilter} onValueChange={setFolderFilter}>
            <SelectTrigger className="w-[150px]"><SelectValue placeholder="كل المجلدات" /></SelectTrigger>
            <SelectContent>
              <SelectItem value="all">كل المجلدات</SelectItem>
              {usedFolders.map((f) => (
                <SelectItem key={f} value={f}><Folder className="w-4 h-4 inline ml-2" />{f}</SelectItem>
              ))}
            </SelectContent>
          </Select>
        )}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1 border rounded-md p-1">
          <Button variant={viewMode === 'grid' ? 'default' : 'ghost'} size="icon" className="h-8 w-8" onClick={() => setViewMode('grid')}>
            <LayoutGrid className="w-4 h-4" />
          </Button>
          <Button variant={viewMode === 'list' ? 'default' : 'ghost'} size="icon" className="h-8 w-8" onClick={() => setViewMode('list')}>
            <List className="w-4 h-4" />
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Notes List */}
      {filteredNotes.length === 0 ? (
        <Card>
          <CardContent className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-16 text-center">
            <StickyNote className="w-12 h-12 text-muted-foreground mb-3" />
            <p className="text-lg font-medium text-foreground">
              {notes.length === 0 ? 'لا توجد ملاحظات بعد' : 'لا توجد نتائج مطابقة'}
            </p>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-1">
              {notes.length === 0 ? 'ابدأ بإنشاء أول ملاحظة لك' : 'جرّب تغيير كلمات البحث أو الفلتر'}
            </p>
            {notes.length === 0 && (
              <Button onClick={openNewNoteDialog} className="mt-4 gap-2">
                <Plus className="w-4 h-4" /> إنشاء ملاحظة
              </Button>
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      ) : (
        <div className={viewMode === 'grid' ? 'grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4' : 'flex flex-col gap-3'}>
          <AnimatePresence mode="popLayout">
            {filteredNotes.map((note) => {
              const colorClasses = getColorClasses(note.color);
              return (
                <motion.div
                  key={note.id}
                  layout
                  initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }}
                  animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
                  exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }}
                  transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}
                >
                  <Card className={`${colorClasses.bg} ${colorClasses.border} border-2 hover:shadow-md transition-shadow relative group`}>
                    {note.isPinned && (
                      <div className="absolute top-2 left-2">
                        <Pin className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-500 fill-amber-500" />
                      </div>
                    )}
                    {note.isSecret && (
                      <div className="absolute top-2 right-2" title="ملاحظة سرية">
                        <Lock className="w-4 h-4 text-red-500" />
                      </div>
                    )}
                    <CardContent className="p-4">
                      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2 mb-2">
                        <h3 className="font-bold text-foreground line-clamp-1 flex-1">
                          {note.title}
                        </h3>
                        <div className="flex gap-1 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">
                          <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7" onClick={() => toggleNotePin(note.id)} title={note.isPinned ? 'إلغاء التثبيت' : 'تثبيت'}>

                          </Button>
                          <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7" onClick={() => openEditNoteDialog(note)}>
                            <Pencil className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </Button>
                          <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7 text-destructive" onClick={() => deleteNote(note.id)}>
                            <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </Button>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {note.isSecret ? (
                        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground/60 italic mb-3 flex items-center gap-1">
                          <Lock className="w-3 h-3" />
                          محتوى مشفّر — اضغط تعديل للفتح
                        </p>
                      ) : (
                        note.content && (
                          <p className="text-sm text-foreground/80 line-clamp-4 whitespace-pre-wrap mb-3">
                            {note.content}
                          </p>
                        )
                      )}

                      {note.tags && note.tags.length > 0 && (
                        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1 mb-2">
                          {note.tags.map((tag) => (
                            <Badge key={tag} variant="secondary" className="text-xs">{tag}</Badge>
                          ))}

                      )}

                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                        {note.folder && (

                      </div>
                    </CardContent>
                  </Card>
                </motion.div>
              );
            })}
          </AnimatePresence>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Add/Edit Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={noteDialogOpen} onOpenChange={setNoteDialogOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-[500px]">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
              {noteForm.isSecret && <Lock className="w-5 h-5 text-red-500" />}

          <div className="space-y-4 py-4 max-h-[60vh] overflow-y-auto">

              </Label>
              <Textarea
                id="note-content"
                value={noteForm.content}
                onChange={(e) => setNoteForm({ ...noteForm, content: e.target.value })}
                placeholder={noteForm.isSecret ? "اكتب المحتوى السري هنا — سيُشفّر قبل الحفظ" : "اكتب ملاحظتك هنا..."}
                rows={5}
              />
            </div>

            {/* Secret toggle */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Button
                type="button"
                variant={noteForm.isSecret ? 'destructive' : 'outline'}
                size="sm"
                onClick={() => setNoteForm({ ...noteForm, isSecret: !noteForm.isSecret })}
                className="gap-1.5"
              >
                <Lock className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                {noteForm.isSecret ? '🔒 سرّي' : 'عادي'}
              </Button>
              {noteForm.isSecret && (
                <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                  المحتوى سيُشفّر بـ AES-256 — يتطلب كلمة المرور الرئيسية للفتح
                </span>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Color */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>اللون</Label>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                {(Object.keys(NOTE_COLORS) as Note['color'][]).map((color) => {
                  const c = NOTE_COLORS[color];
                  return (
                    <button
                      key={color}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setNoteForm({ ...noteForm, color })}
                      className={`w-8 h-8 rounded-full ${c.bg} border-2 ${noteForm.color === color ? 'border-foreground scale-110' : 'border-transparent'} transition-all`}
                      title={c.label}
                    />
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Folder */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="note-folder">المجلد (اختياري)</Label>
              <Input
                id="note-folder"
                value={noteForm.folder}
                onChange={(e) => setNoteForm({ ...noteForm, folder: e.target.value })}
                placeholder="مثلاً: جامعة، عمل، شخصي"
                list="existing-folders"
              />
              <datalist id="existing-folders">
                {usedFolders.map((f) => (<option key={f} value={f} />))}
              </datalist>
            </div>

            {/* Tags */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>الوسوم</Label>
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                <Input
                  value={tagInput}
                  onChange={(e) => setTagInput(e.target.value)}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); handleAddTag(); } }}
                  placeholder="أضف وسماً واضغط Enter"
                />
                <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={handleAddTag}>إضافة</Button>
              </div>
              {noteForm.tags.length > 0 && (
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1 mt-2">
                  {noteForm.tags.map((tag) => (
                    <Badge key={tag} variant="secondary" className="gap-1">
                      {tag}
                      <button type="button" onClick={() => handleRemoveTag(tag)} className="hover:text-destructive">
                        <X className="w-3 h-3" />
                      </button>
                    </Badge>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          <DialogFooter>
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setNoteDialogOpen(false)}>إلغاء</Button>
            <Button onClick={saveNote} disabled={!noteForm.title.trim()} className="gap-1.5">
              {noteForm.isSecret && <Lock className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
              {editingNote ? 'حفظ التغييرات' : 'إنشاء الملاحظة'}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>

      {/* Master Password Dialog */}
      <MasterPasswordDialog
        open={masterPwDialog.open}
        onClose={() => setMasterPwDialog({ open: false, action: 'encrypt' })}
        onSuccess={handleMasterPwSuccess}
        title={masterPwDialog.action === 'encrypt' ? 'تشفير الملاحظة السرية' : 'فتح ملاحظة سرية'}
        description={masterPwDialog.action === 'encrypt'
          ? 'أدخل كلمة المرور الرئيسية لتشفير المحتوى بـ AES-256'
          : 'أدخل كلمة المرور الرئيسية لفك تشفير المحتوى'}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
export function IdeasSection() {

  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<string>('all');
  const [form, setForm] = useState({

          i.title.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          i.description.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          (i.tags || []).some((t) => t.toLowerCase().includes(q))
        );
      })
      .sort((a, b) => new Date(b.createdAt).getTime() - new Date(a.createdAt).getTime());
  }, [ideas, statusFilter, searchQuery]);

  const openNew = () => {
    setEditing(null);
    setForm({ title: '', description: '', category: 'project', priority: 'medium', status: 'new', tags: [] });
    setTagInput('');
    setDialogOpen(true);
  };

  const openEdit = (idea: Idea) => {
    setEditing(idea);
    setForm({
      title: idea.title,
      description: idea.description,
      category: idea.category || 'project',
      priority: idea.priority,
      status: idea.status,
      tags: idea.tags || [],
    });
    setTagInput('');
    setDialogOpen(true);
  };

  const handleAddTag = () => {
    const tag = tagInput.trim();
    if (tag && !form.tags.includes(tag)) {
      setForm({ ...form, tags: [...form.tags, tag] });
      setTagInput('');
    }
  };

  const save = () => {
    if (!form.title.trim()) return;
    if (editing) {
      updateIdea(editing.id, form);
    } else {
      addIdea(form);
    }
    setDialogOpen(false);
  };

  const stats = {
    total: ideas.length,
    new: ideas.filter((i) => i.status === 'new').length,
    inProgress: ideas.filter((i) => i.status === 'in-progress').length,
    implemented: ideas.filter((i) => i.status === 'implemented').length,
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-900/30 flex items-center justify-center">
            <Lightbulb className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-lg font-bold text-foreground">الأفكار</h1>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              {stats.total} فكرة · {stats.new} جديدة · {stats.inProgress} قيد التنفيذ · {stats.implemented} منفذة
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <Button size="sm" onClick={openNew} className="gap-1.5">
          <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
          فكرة جديدة
        </Button>
      </div>

      {/* أدوات */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
        <div className="relative flex-1 min-w-[200px]">
          <Search className="w-4 h-4 absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" />
          <Input
            value={searchQuery}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="ابحث في الأفكار..."
            className="pr-10"
          />
        </div>
        <Select value={statusFilter} onValueChange={setStatusFilter}>
          <SelectTrigger className="w-[140px]">
            <Filter className="w-4 h-4 ml-2" />
            <SelectValue />
          </SelectTrigger>
          <SelectContent>
            <SelectItem value="all">كل الحالات</SelectItem>
            {Object.entries(IDEA_STATUS_CONFIG).map(([key, cfg]) => (
              <SelectItem key={key} value={key}>
                {cfg.icon} {cfg.label}
              </SelectItem>
            ))}
          </SelectContent>
        </Select>
      </div>

      {/* القائمة */}
      {filtered.length === 0 ? (
        <Card>
          <CardContent className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-16 text-center">
            <Lightbulb className="w-12 h-12 text-muted-foreground mb-3" />
            <p className="text-lg font-medium text-foreground">
              {ideas.length === 0 ? 'لا توجد أفكار بعد' : 'لا توجد نتائج'}
            </p>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-1">
              {ideas.length === 0 ? 'سجّل أول فكرة تخطر ببالك' : 'جرّب تغيير الفلتر'}
            </p>
            {ideas.length === 0 && (
              <Button onClick={openNew} className="mt-4 gap-2">
                <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
                إضافة فكرة
              </Button>
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
          <AnimatePresence mode="popLayout">
            {filtered.map((idea) => {
              const statusCfg = IDEA_STATUS_CONFIG[idea.status];
              const priorityCfg = PRIORITY_CONFIG[idea.priority];
              const categoryCfg = IDEA_CATEGORIES.find((c) => c.id === idea.category);
              return (
                <motion.div
                  key={idea.id}
                  layout
                  initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }}
                  animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
                  exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }}
                  transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}
                >
                  <Card className="border border-border bg-background hover:shadow-md transition-shadow group">
                    <CardContent className="p-4">
                      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2 mb-2">
                        <h3 className="font-bold text-foreground line-clamp-1 flex-1">
                          {statusCfg.icon} {idea.title}
                        </h3>
                        <div className="flex gap-1 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">
                          <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7" onClick={() => openEdit(idea)}>
                            <Pencil className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </Button>
                          <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7 text-destructive" onClick={() => deleteIdea(idea.id)}>
                            <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </Button>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      {idea.description && (
                        <p className="text-sm text-foreground/80 line-clamp-3 mb-3">{idea.description}</p>
                      )}
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1 mb-2">
                        <Badge variant="secondary" className={`text-[10px] ${statusCfg.color}`}>
                          {statusCfg.label}
                        </Badge>
                        <Badge variant="outline" className={`text-[10px] ${priorityCfg.color}`}>
                          {priorityCfg.icon} {priorityCfg.label}
                        </Badge>
                        {categoryCfg && (
                          <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[10px]">
                            {categoryCfg.icon} {categoryCfg.label}
                          </Badge>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      {idea.tags && idea.tags.length > 0 && (
                        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
                          {idea.tags.map((tag) => (
                            <Badge key={tag} variant="secondary" className="text-[10px]">{tag}</Badge>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </CardContent>
                  </Card>
                </motion.div>
              );
            })}
          </AnimatePresence>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={dialogOpen} onOpenChange={setDialogOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-[500px]">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>{editing ? 'تعديل الفكرة' : 'فكرة جديدة'}</DialogTitle>
          </DialogHeader>
          <div className="space-y-4 py-2 max-h-[60vh] overflow-y-auto">
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>العنوان *</Label>
              <Input
                value={form.title}
                onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, title: e.target.value })}
                placeholder="عنوان الفكرة"
                autoFocus
              />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>الوصف</Label>
              <Textarea
                value={form.description}
                onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, description: e.target.value })}
                placeholder="اشرح فكرتك..."
                rows={3}
              />
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>الفئة</Label>
                <Select value={form.category} onValueChange={(v) => setForm({ ...form, category: v })}>
                  <SelectTrigger><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectContent>
                    {IDEA_CATEGORIES.map((c) => (
                      <SelectItem key={c.id} value={c.id}>{c.icon} {c.label}</SelectItem>
                    ))}
                  </SelectContent>
                </Select>
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>الأولوية</Label>
                <Select value={form.priority} onValueChange={(v) => setForm({ ...form, priority: v as Idea['priority'] })}>
                  <SelectTrigger><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectContent>
                    {(['high', 'medium', 'low'] as const).map((p) => (
                      <SelectItem key={p} value={p}>{PRIORITY_CONFIG[p].icon} {PRIORITY_CONFIG[p].label}</SelectItem>
                    ))}
                  </SelectContent>
                </Select>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>الحالة</Label>
              <Select value={form.status} onValueChange={(v) => setForm({ ...form, status: v as Idea['status'] })}>
                <SelectTrigger><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  {Object.entries(IDEA_STATUS_CONFIG).map(([key, cfg]) => (
                    <SelectItem key={key} value={key}>{cfg.icon} {cfg.label}</SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>الوسوم</Label>
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                <Input
                  value={tagInput}
                  onChange={(e) => setTagInput(e.target.value)}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); handleAddTag(); } }}
                  placeholder="أضف وسماً واضغط Enter"
                />
                <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={handleAddTag}>إضافة</Button>
              </div>
              {form.tags.length > 0 && (
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1 mt-2">
                  {form.tags.map((tag) => (
                    <Badge key={tag} variant="secondary" className="gap-1">
                      {tag}
                      <button type="button" onClick={() => setForm({ ...form, tags: form.tags.filter((t) => t !== tag) })}>
                        <X className="w-3 h-3" />
                      </button>
                    </Badge>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
          <DialogFooter>
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setDialogOpen(false)}>إلغاء</Button>
            <Button onClick={save} disabled={!form.title.trim()}>
              {editing ? 'حفظ' : 'إضافة'}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## 📝 الكود الكامل

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { DollarSign, Plus, Trash2, TrendingUp, TrendingDown, Calendar } from 'lucide-react';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogTrigger, DialogFooter, DialogClose } from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@/components/ui/select';
import { useAppStore } from '@/lib/store';
import { FINANCE_CATEGORIES, type Transaction } from '@/types';

export function FinanceSection() {
  const { transactions, addTransaction, deleteTransaction } = useAppStore();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [desc, setDesc] = useState('');
  const [amount, setAmount] = useState('');
  const [type, setType] = useState<Transaction['type']>('expense');
  const [category, setCategory] = useState('food');

  const now = new Date();
  const currentMonth = now.getMonth();
  const currentYear = now.getFullYear();

  const monthTransactions = useMemo(
    () => transactions.filter((t) => {
      const d = new Date(t.createdAt);
      return d.getMonth() === currentMonth && d.getFullYear() === currentYear;
    }),
    [transactions, currentMonth, currentYear]
  );

  const totalIncome = useMemo(
    () => monthTransactions.filter((t) => t.type === 'income').reduce((s, t) => s + t.amount, 0),
    [monthTransactions]
  );

  const totalExpenses = useMemo(
    () => monthTransactions.filter((t) => t.type === 'expense').reduce((s, t) => s + t.amount, 0),
    [monthTransactions]
  );

  const net = totalIncome - totalExpenses;

  // Last 7 days expenses for bar chart
  const last7Days = useMemo(() => {
    const days: { label: string; total: number }[] = [];
    for (let i = 6; i >= 0; i--) {
      const d = new Date(now);
      d.setDate(d.getDate() - i);
      const dateStr = d.toISOString().split('T')[0];
      const dayLabel = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('ar-SA', { weekday: 'short' }).format(d);
      const dayExpenses = transactions
        .filter((t) => t.type === 'expense' && t.createdAt.startsWith(dateStr))
        .reduce((s, t) => s + t.amount, 0);
      days.push({ label: dayLabel, total: dayExpenses });
    }
    return days;
  }, [transactions, now]);

  const maxExpense = Math.max(...last7Days.map((d) => d.total), 1);

  const getCategoryInfo = (catId: string) => {
    const cat = FINANCE_CATEGORIES.find((c) => c.id === catId);
    return cat || { icon: '📦', label: catId };
  };

  const formatArabicDate = (dateStr: string) => {
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('ar-SA', {
      month: 'short',
      day: 'numeric',
    }).format(new Date(dateStr));
  };

  const toArabicNum = (n: number) => n.toLocaleString('ar-SA');

  const handleAdd = () => {
    if (!desc.trim() || !amount || Number(amount) <= 0) return;
    addTransaction({
      description: desc.trim(),
      amount: Number(amount),
      type,
      category,
    });
    setDesc('');
    setAmount('');
    setType('expense');
    setCategory('food');
    setOpen(false);
  };

  const sortedTransactions = useMemo(
    () => [...monthTransactions].sort((a, b) => new Date(b.createdAt).getTime() - new Date(a.createdAt).getTime()),
    [monthTransactions]
  );

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-900/30 flex items-center justify-center">
            <DollarSign className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-lg font-bold text-foreground">المالية</h1>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">تتبع مصاريفك ودخلك الشهري</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
          <DialogTrigger asChild>
            <Button size="sm" className="gap-1.5">
              <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
              معاملة جديدة
            </Button>
          </DialogTrigger>
          <DialogContent>
            <DialogHeader>
              <DialogTitle>معاملة جديدة</DialogTitle>
            </DialogHeader>
            <div className="space-y-4 py-2">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>الوصف</Label>
                <Input placeholder="مثال: غداء في المطعم" value={desc} onChange={(e) => setDesc(e.target.value)} />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>المبلغ</Label>
                <Input type="number" placeholder="0.00" value={amount} onChange={(e) => setAmount(e.target.value)} />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>النوع</Label>
                <Select value={type} onValueChange={(v) => setType(v as Transaction['type'])}>
                  <SelectTrigger className="w-full">
                    <SelectValue />
                  </SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectContent>
                    <SelectItem value="expense">مصروف</SelectItem>
                    <SelectItem value="income">دخل</SelectItem>
                  </SelectContent>
                </Select>
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>التصنيف</Label>
                <Select value={category} onValueChange={setCategory}>
                  <SelectTrigger className="w-full">
                    <SelectValue />
                  </SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectContent>
                    {FINANCE_CATEGORIES.map((cat) => (
                      <SelectItem key={cat.id} value={cat.id}>
                        <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <span>{cat.icon}</span>
                          <span>{cat.label}</span>
                        </span>
                      </SelectItem>
                    ))}
                  </SelectContent>
                </Select>
              </div>
            </div>
            <DialogFooter>
              <DialogClose asChild>
                <Button variant="outline">إلغاء</Button>
              </DialogClose>
              <Button onClick={handleAdd} disabled={!desc.trim() || !amount || Number(amount) <= 0}>إضافة</Button>
            </DialogFooter>
          </DialogContent>
        </Dialog>
      </div>

      {/* Summary Cards */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
        <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
          <CardContent className="p-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mb-1">
              <TrendingUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-500" />
              <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">إجمالي الدخل</span>
            </div>
            <p className="text-sm font-bold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">{toArabicNum(totalIncome)} ₪</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
        <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
          <CardContent className="p-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mb-1">
              <TrendingDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-red-500" />
              <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">إجمالي المصروفات</span>
            </div>
            <p className="text-sm font-bold text-red-600 dark:text-red-400">{toArabicNum(totalExpenses)} ₪</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
        <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
          <CardContent className="p-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mb-1">
              <DollarSign className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${net >= 0 ? 'text-emerald-500' : 'text-red-500'}`} />
              <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">الصافي</span>
            </div>
            <p className={`text-sm font-bold ${net >= 0 ? 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400' : 'text-red-600 dark:text-red-400'}`}>
              {net >= 0 ? '+' : ''}{toArabicNum(net)} ₪
            </p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>

      {/* Bar Chart - Last 7 Days Expenses */}
      {last7Days.some((d) => d.total > 0) && (
        <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
          <CardContent className="p-4">
            <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground mb-3">مصروفات آخر ٧ أيام</h3>
            <div className="flex items-end gap-2 h-28">
              {last7Days.map((day, i) => {
                const h = Math.max((day.total / maxExpense) * 96, day.total > 0 ? 4 : 0);
                return (
                  <div key={i} className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center gap-1">
                    {day.total > 0 && (
                      <span className="text-[9px] text-muted-foreground">{toArabicNum(day.total)}</span>
                    )}
                    <div className="w-full flex items-end justify-center" style={{ height: '96px' }}>
                      <motion.div
                        initial={{ height: 0 }}
                        animate={{ height: `${h}px` }}
                        transition={{ delay: i * 0.05, duration: 0.3 }}
                        className={`w-full max-w-[32px] rounded-t-md ${day.total > 0 ? 'bg-red-400 dark:bg-red-500/70' : 'bg-muted'}`}
                      />
                    </div>
                    <span className="text-[9px] text-muted-foreground">{day.label}</span>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}

      {/* Transaction List */}
      <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
        <CardContent className="p-4">
          <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground mb-3">معاملات الشهر</h3>
          {sortedTransactions.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="text-center py-6 text-muted-foreground text-sm">
              <DollarSign className="w-8 h-8 mx-auto mb-2 opacity-40" />
              <p>لا توجد معاملات هذا الشهر</p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="space-y-2 max-h-96 overflow-y-auto">
              <AnimatePresence mode="popLayout">
                {sortedTransactions.map((tx) => {
                  const catInfo = getCategoryInfo(tx.category);
                  return (
                    <motion.div
                      key={tx.id}
                      layout
                      initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }}
                      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                      exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -20 }}
                      className="flex items-center gap-3 p-2.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-muted transition-colors"
                    >
                      <span className="text-xl">{catInfo.icon}</span>
                      <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                        <p className="text-sm text-foreground truncate">{tx.description}</p>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-0.5">
                          <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-[10px] bg-muted text-muted-foreground">
                            {catInfo.label}
                          </Badge>
                          <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1">
                            <Calendar className="w-3 h-3" />
                            {formatArabicDate(tx.createdAt)}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <span className={`text-sm font-bold shrink-0 ${tx.type === 'income' ? 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400' : 'text-red-600 dark:text-red-400'}`}>
                        {tx.type === 'income' ? '+' : '-'}{toArabicNum(tx.amount)} ₪
                      </span>
                      <Button
                        variant="ghost"
                        size="icon"
                        className="h-7 w-7 text-muted-foreground hover:text-red-500 shrink-0"
                        onClick={() => deleteTransaction(tx.id)}
                      >
                        <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      </Button>
                    </motion.div>
                  );
                })}
              </AnimatePresence>
            </div>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## 📝 الكود الكامل

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { BookOpen, Save, Trash2, Calendar, ChevronLeft } from 'lucide-react';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { ScrollArea } from '@/components/ui/scroll-area';
import { Separator } from '@/components/ui/separator';
import { useAppStore } from '@/lib/store';
import { MOOD_CONFIG, type JournalEntry } from '@/types';

function getTodayStr(): string {
  return new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];
}

function formatDateArabic(dateStr: string): string {
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('ar-SA', {
    weekday: 'long',
    year: 'numeric',
    month: 'long',
    day: 'numeric',
  }).format(new Date(dateStr + 'T12:00:00'));
}

function formatShortDateArabic(dateStr: string): string {
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('ar-SA', {
    month: 'short',
    day: 'numeric',
  }).format(new Date(dateStr + 'T12:00:00'));
}

export function JournalSection() {
  const { journalEntries, saveJournalEntry, deleteJournalEntry } = useAppStore();

  const todayStr = getTodayStr();
  const todayEntry = useMemo(
    () => journalEntries.find((e) => e.date === todayStr),
    [journalEntries, todayStr]
  );

  const [mood, setMood] = useState<JournalEntry['mood']>(todayEntry?.mood ?? 'okay');
  const [text, setText] = useState(todayEntry?.text ?? '');

    todayEntry?.gratitudes?.length === 3 ? [...todayEntry.gratitudes] : ['', '', '']
  );
  const [viewingEntry, setViewingEntry] = useState<JournalEntry | null>(null);

  const isTodayViewing = viewingEntry && viewingEntry.date === todayStr;

  const pastEntries = useMemo(
    () =>
      [...journalEntries]
        .sort((a, b) => b.date.localeCompare(a.date))
        .filter((e) => e.date !== todayStr),
    [journalEntries, todayStr]
  );

  const handleSave = () => {
    saveJournalEntry({
      date: todayStr,
      mood,
      text,
      gratitudes,
    });
  };

  const handleGratitudeChange = (index: number, value: string) => {
    const updated = [...gratitudes];
    updated[index] = value;
    setGratitudes(updated);
  };

  const moods: JournalEntry['mood'][] = ['excellent', 'good', 'okay', 'sad', 'terrible'];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">

      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">

          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{formatDateArabic(todayStr)}</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* View Mode */}
      {viewingEntry && !isTodayViewing ? (

          <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
            <CardContent className="p-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => setViewingEntry(null)} className="gap-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    <ChevronLeft className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    رجوع
                  </Button>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <span className="text-2xl">{MOOD_CONFIG[viewingEntry.mood].emoji}</span>
                  <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-xs bg-muted text-muted-foreground">
                    {MOOD_CONFIG[viewingEntry.mood].label}
                  </Badge>
                </div>
              </div>
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-2 flex items-center gap-1">
                <Calendar className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                {formatDateArabic(viewingEntry.date)}
              </p>
              <Separator className="my-3 bg-border" />
              {viewingEntry.text && (
                <p className="text-sm text-foreground whitespace-pre-wrap mb-4">{viewingEntry.text}</p>
              )}
              {viewingEntry.gratitudes.filter(Boolean).length > 0 && (
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground">الامتنان:</p>
                  {viewingEntry.gratitudes.map((g, i) =>
                    g ? (
                      <div key={i} className="flex items-start gap-2 text-sm text-foreground">
                        <span className="text-emerald-500 mt-0.5">❤</span>
                        <span>{g}</span>
                      </div>
                    ) : null
                  )}
                </div>
              )}
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </motion.div>
      ) : (

          {/* Today's Entry Form */}
          <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
            <CardContent className="p-4 space-y-4">
              {/* Mood Selector */}
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label className="text-sm">مزاج اليوم</Label>
                <div className="flex gap-2 justify-center">
                  {moods.map((m) => (
                    <button
                      key={m}

                      onClick={() => setMood(m)}
                      className={`w-12 h-12 rounded-xl text-2xl flex items-center justify-center transition-all ${
                        mood === m
                          ? 'bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-900/30 ring-2 ring-emerald-500 scale-110'
                          : 'bg-muted hover:bg-muted/80'
                      }`}
                      title={MOOD_CONFIG[m].label}
                    >
                      {MOOD_CONFIG[m].emoji}

                  ))}
                </div>
                <p className="text-center text-xs text-muted-foreground">{MOOD_CONFIG[mood].label}</p>
              </div>

              <Separator className="bg-border" />
```

```tsx
const EMOJI_OPTIONS = ['💪', '🏃', '📚', '🤲', '🧘', '💧', '✍️', '🎵', '😴', '🥗', '🧹', '🙏'];

const SUGGESTIONS: Array<{ name: string; emoji: string }> = [
  { name: 'رياضة', emoji: '🏃' },
  { name: 'قراءة', emoji: '📚' },
  { name: 'صلاة', emoji: '🤲' },
  { name: 'تأمل', emoji: '🧘' },
  { name: 'شرب ماء', emoji: '💧' },
];

function getLast7Days(): string[] {
  const days: string[] = [];
  const now = new Date();
  for (let i = 6; i >= 0; i--) {
    const d = new Date(now);
    d.setDate(d.getDate() - i);
    days.push(d.toISOString().split('T')[0]);
  }
  return days;
}

function getDayLabel(dateStr: string): string {
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('ar-SA', { weekday: 'short' }).format(new Date(dateStr + 'T12:00:00'));
}

function getDayNum(dateStr: string): string {
  return new Date(dateStr + 'T12:00:00').getDate().toLocaleString('ar-SA');
}

function toArabicNum(n: number) {
  return n.toLocaleString('ar-SA');
}

export function HabitsSection() {

  const last7 = getLast7Days();

    if (!name.trim()) return;
    addHabit({ name: name.trim(), emoji });
    setName('');
    setEmoji('💪');

  };

  const handleAddSuggestion = (s: { name: string; emoji: string }) => {

  };

  const handleToggle = (habitId: string, date: string) => {
    toggleHabitDay(habitId, date);
  };

  const handleDelete = (id: string) => {

      deleteHabit(id);
      setConfirmDelete(null);
    } else {
      setConfirmDelete(id);
      setTimeout(() => setConfirmDelete(null), 3000);
    }
  };

  return (

            <DialogFooter>

              </DialogClose>

            </DialogFooter>
          </DialogContent>

      </div>

      {/* Habits Grid */}
      {habits.length === 0 ? (
        <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
          <CardContent className="p-8 text-center">

            {/* Suggestion chips */}
            <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-2">

                >

              ))}

      ) : (

                >

                </button>
              ))}

      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```
