```tsx
'use client';

import { useState, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { Image, Film, FileText, Plus, Pencil, Trash2, X, Upload, Tag } from 'lucide-react';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogDescription,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from '@/components/ui/select';
import { useAppStore } from '@/lib/store';
import { MEDIA_TYPE_CONFIG } from '@/types';
import type { MediaItem, MediaType } from '@/types';

// ============ ثوابت ============
const FILTER_TABS: Array<{ value: 'all' | MediaType; label: string; icon: string }> = [
  { value: 'all', label: 'الكل', icon: '📚' },
  { value: 'image', label: 'صور', icon: '🖼️' },
  { value: 'video', label: 'فيديو', icon: '🎬' },
  { value: 'file', label: 'ملفات', icon: '📎' },
];

const FILE_ACCEPT_MAP: Record<MediaType, string> = {
  image: 'image/*,video/*',
  video: 'image/*,video/*',
  file: '.pdf,.doc,.docx,.ppt,.pptx,.xls,.xlsx,.zip,.rar',
};

function detectMediaType(file: File): MediaType {
  if (file.type.startsWith('video/')) return 'video';
  if (file.type.startsWith('image/')) return 'image';
  return 'file';
}

function getMediaTypeIcon(type: MediaType) {
  switch (type) {
    case 'image': return Image;
    case 'video': return Film;
    case 'file': return FileText;
  }
}

// ============ نموذج ============
interface MediaForm {
  title: string;
  description: string;
  type: MediaType;
  url: string;
  thumbnailUrl: string;
  tags: string[];
  date: string;
  file: File | null;
}

const emptyForm: MediaForm = {
  title: '',
  description: '',
  type: 'image',
  url: '',
  thumbnailUrl: '',
  tags: [],
  date: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
  file: null,
};

// ============ المكون الرئيسي ============
export function LibrarySection() {
  const { mediaItems, addMediaItem, updateMediaItem, deleteMediaItem } = useAppStore();
  const [activeFilter, setActiveFilter] = useState<'all' | MediaType>('all');
  const [dialogOpen, setDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [detailOpen, setDetailOpen] = useState(false);
  const [lightboxOpen, setLightboxOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingItem, setEditingItem] = useState<MediaItem | null>(null);
  const [selectedItem, setSelectedItem] = useState<MediaItem | null>(null);
  const [form, setForm] = useState<MediaForm>(emptyForm);
  const [tagInput, setTagInput] = useState('');
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);
  const [deleteConfirm, setDeleteConfirm] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const filteredItems = useMemo(() => {
    if (activeFilter === 'all') return mediaItems;
    return mediaItems.filter((m) => m.type === activeFilter);
  }, [mediaItems, activeFilter]);

  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    const images = mediaItems.filter((m) => m.type === 'image').length;
    const videos = mediaItems.filter((m) => m.type === 'video').length;
    const files = mediaItems.filter((m) => m.type === 'file').length;
    return { total: mediaItems.length, images, videos, files };
  }, [mediaItems]);

  const openAdd = () => {
    setEditingItem(null);
    setForm(emptyForm);
    setTagInput('');
    setDialogOpen(true);
  };

  const openEdit = (item: MediaItem) => {
    setEditingItem(item);
    setForm({
      title: item.title,
      description: item.description,
      type: item.type,
      url: item.url,
      thumbnailUrl: item.thumbnailUrl || '',
      tags: [...item.tags],
      date: item.date,
      file: null,
    });
    setTagInput('');
    setDialogOpen(true);
  };

  const openDetail = (item: MediaItem) => {
    setSelectedItem(item);
    setDetailOpen(true);
    setDeleteConfirm(null);
  };

  const handleFileSelect = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;

    // عند اختيار صورة أو فيديو، نكتشف النوع الفعلي
    if (form.type === 'image' || form.type === 'video') {
      const detectedType = detectMediaType(file);
      setForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, file, type: detectedType }));
    } else {
      setForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, file }));
    }

    // تعبئة العنوان تلقائياً إن كان فارغاً
    if (!form.title.trim()) {
      const nameWithoutExt = file.name.replace(/\.[^/.]+$/, '');
      setForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, title: nameWithoutExt }));
    }
  };

  const handleTagInputKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ',') {
      e.preventDefault();
      addTag();
    }
  };

  const addTag = () => {
    const tag = tagInput.trim();
    if (tag && !form.tags.includes(tag)) {
      setForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, tags: [...prev.tags, tag] }));
      setTagInput('');
    }
  };

  const removeTag = (tag: string) => {
    setForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, tags: prev.tags.filter((t) => t !== tag) }));
  };

  const handleSave = async () => {
    if (!form.title.trim()) return;

    setUploading(true);
    try {
      let url = form.url;
      let thumbnailUrl = form.thumbnailUrl;

      // رفع ملف جديد إن وُجد
      if (form.file) {
        const formData = new FormData();
        formData.append('file', form.file);
        const res = await fetch('/api/upload', { method: 'POST', body: formData });
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error('فشل رفع الملف');
        const data = await res.json();
        url = data.url;
      }

      if (editingItem) {
        // حذف الملف القديم إن تم استبداله
        if (form.file && editingItem.url) {
          try {
            await fetch(`/api/upload?url=${encodeURIComponent(editingItem.url)}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
          } catch {
            // تجاهل خطأ حذف الملف القديم
          }
        }
        updateMediaItem(editingItem.id, {
          title: form.title.trim(),
          description: form.description.trim(),
          type: form.type,
          url,
          thumbnailUrl: thumbnailUrl || undefined,
          tags: form.tags,
          date: form.date,
        });
      } else {
        addMediaItem({
          title: form.title.trim(),
          description: form.description.trim(),
          type: form.type,
          url,
          thumbnailUrl: thumbnailUrl || undefined,
          tags: form.tags,
          date: form.date,
        });
      }

      setDialogOpen(false);
      setForm(emptyForm);
      setEditingItem(null);
      setTagInput('');
    } catch {
      // يمكن إضافة toast هنا
    } finally {
      setUploading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async (id: string) => {
    const item = mediaItems.find((m) => m.id === id);
    if (item?.url) {
      try {
        await fetch(`/api/upload?url=${encodeURIComponent(item.url)}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
      } catch {
        // تجاهل خطأ حذف الملف
      }
    }
    deleteMediaItem(id);
    setDeleteConfirm(null);
    setDetailOpen(false);
    setSelectedItem(null);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* ============ الترويسة ============ */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground flex items-center gap-2">
            📚 المكتبة
          </h2>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm mt-1">صور، فيديوهات وملفاتك في مكان واحد</p>
        </div>
        <Button onClick={openAdd} className="gap-2 bg-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-800 text-white">
          <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
          إضافة ملف
        </Button>
      </div>

      {/* ============ إحصائيات ============ */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-3">
        <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
          <CardContent className="p-4 text-center">
            <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">{stats.total}</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">إجمالي</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
        <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
          <CardContent className="p-4 text-center">
            <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-emerald-600">{stats.images}</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">صور</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
        <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
          <CardContent className="p-4 text-center">
            <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-amber-600">{stats.videos}</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">فيديو</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
        <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
          <CardContent className="p-4 text-center">
            <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-orange-600">{stats.files}</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">ملفات</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>

      {/* ============ فلتر الأنواع ============ */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        {FILTER_TABS.map((tab) => {
          const count =
            tab.value === 'all'
              ? mediaItems.length
              : mediaItems.filter((m) => m.type === tab.value).length;
          const isActive = activeFilter === tab.value;
          return (
            <Button
              key={tab.value}
              variant={isActive ? 'default' : 'outline'}
              size="sm"
              onClick={() => setActiveFilter(tab.value)}
              className={
                isActive
                  ? 'bg-gray-900 text-white hover:bg-gray-800'
                  : 'border-border text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted'
              }
            >
              {tab.icon} {tab.label}
              <Badge
                variant="secondary"
                className={`mr-1.5 text-[10px] px-1.5 ${
                  isActive ? 'bg-white/20 text-white' : 'bg-muted text-muted-foreground'
                }`}
              >
                {count}
              </Badge>
            </Button>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* ============ شبكة المكتبة ============ */}
      {filteredItems.length === 0 ? (
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 16 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          className="text-center py-16"
        >
          <div className="text-5xl mb-3 opacity-40">📂</div>
          <h3 className="text-base font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">
            المكتبة فارغة — ابدأ بإضافة صور أو ملفات
          </h3>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-4">ارفع صورك وملفاتك لإدارتها بسهولة</p>
          <Button onClick={openAdd} variant="outline" className="gap-2">
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
            إضافة ملف
          </Button>
        </motion.div>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
          <AnimatePresence mode="popLayout">
            {filteredItems.map((item, index) => {
              const TypeIcon = getMediaTypeIcon(item.type);
              const config = MEDIA_TYPE_CONFIG[item.type];
              return (
                <motion.div
                  key={item.id}
                  layout
                  initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.96 }}
                  animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
                  exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.96 }}
                  transition={{ delay: index * 0.03 }}
                >
                  <Card
                    className="border border-border bg-background hover:border-border transition-colors cursor-pointer overflow-hidden"
                    onClick={() => openDetail(item)}
                  >
                    {/* معاينة الوسائط */}
                    <div className="relative aspect-video bg-muted/50 flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden">
                      {item.type === 'image' && item.url ? (
                        <img
                          src={item.url}
                          alt={item.title}
                          className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                        />
                      ) : item.type === 'video' ? (
                        item.thumbnailUrl ? (
                          <img
                            src={item.thumbnailUrl}
                            alt={item.title}
                            className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                          />
                        ) : (
                          <Film className="w-12 h-12 text-muted-foreground/40" />
                        )
                      ) : (
                        <FileText className="w-12 h-12 text-muted-foreground/40" />
                      )}
                      {/* شارة النوع */}
                      <div className="absolute top-2 right-2">
                        <Badge className="bg-black/60 text-white border-0 text-[10px] backdrop-blur-sm">
                          {config.icon} {config.label}
                        </Badge>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <CardContent className="p-4">
                      <h3 className="font-medium text-sm text-foreground truncate mb-1">
                        {item.title}
                      </h3>
                      {item.description && (
                        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground line-clamp-2 mb-2">
                          {item.description}
                        </p>
                      )}
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                          {new Date(item.date).toLocaleDateString('ar-PS')}
                        </span>
                        {item.tags.length > 0 && (
                          <div className="flex gap-1 overflow-hidden">
                            {item.tags.slice(0, 2).map((tag) => (
                              <Badge
                                key={tag}
                                variant="secondary"
                                className="text-[10px] px-1.5 bg-muted text-muted-foreground"
                              >
                                {tag}
                              </Badge>
                            ))}
                            {item.tags.length > 2 && (
                              <Badge
                                variant="secondary"
                                className="text-[10px] px-1.5 bg-muted text-muted-foreground"
                              >
                                +{item.tags.length - 2}
                              </Badge>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </CardContent>
                  </Card>
                </motion.div>
              );
            })}
          </AnimatePresence>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ============ حوار إضافة/تعديل ============ */}
      <Dialog open={dialogOpen} onOpenChange={(open) => {
        if (!open) {
          setDialogOpen(false);
          setForm(emptyForm);
          setEditingItem(null);
          setTagInput('');
        }
      }}>
        <DialogContent className="max-w-md" dir="rtl">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>
              {editingItem ? 'تعديل الملف' : 'إضافة ملف جديد'}
            </DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>
              {editingItem ? 'قم بتعديل بيانات الملف' : 'اختر ملفاً وأدخل بياناته'}
            </DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>

          <div className="space-y-4">
            {/* رفع الملف */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>الملف</Label>
              <div
                className="border-2 border-dashed border-border rounded-lg p-6 text-center cursor-pointer hover:border-foreground/30 transition-colors"
                onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
              >
                <input
                  ref={fileInputRef}
                  type="file"
                  className="hidden"
                  accept={FILE_ACCEPT_MAP[form.type]}
                  onChange={handleFileSelect}
                />
                {form.file ? (
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                    <Badge variant="secondary" className="bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-900/30 dark:text-emerald-400">
                      ✓ {form.file.name}
                    </Badge>
                    <Button
                      type="button"
                      variant="ghost"
                      size="icon"
                      className="h-6 w-6 text-muted-foreground hover:text-red-500"
                      onClick={(e) => {
                        e.stopPropagation();
                        setForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, file: null }));
                        if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = '';
                      }}
                    >
                      <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <Upload className="w-8 h-8 mx-auto text-muted-foreground mb-2" />
                    <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">اضغط لاختيار ملف</p>
                    <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mt-1">
                      {form.type === 'file'
                        ? 'PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, ZIP, RAR'
                        : 'صور و فيديوهات'}
                    </p>
                  </>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* النوع */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>النوع</Label>
              <Select
                value={form.type}
                onValueChange={(val) => setForm({ ...form, type: val as MediaType, file: null })}
              >
                <SelectTrigger className="border-border">
                  <SelectValue />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  {Object.entries(MEDIA_TYPE_CONFIG).map(([key, config]) => (
                    <SelectItem key={key} value={key}>
                      {config.icon} {config.label}
                    </SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>

            {/* العنوان */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="media-title">العنوان</Label>
              <Input
                id="media-title"
                placeholder="مثال: لقطة شاشة للمشروع"
                value={form.title}
                onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, title: e.target.value })}
                className="border-border"
              />
            </div>

            {/* الوصف */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="media-desc">الوصف</Label>
              <Textarea
                id="media-desc"
                placeholder="وصف مختصر للملف..."
                value={form.description}
                onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, description: e.target.value })}
                className="border-border resize-none"
                rows={3}
              />
            </div>

            {/* التاريخ */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="media-date">التاريخ</Label>
              <Input
                id="media-date"
                type="date"
                value={form.date}
                onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, date: e.target.value })}
                className="border-border"
              />
            </div>

            {/* الوسوم */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>الوسوم</Label>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <div className="relative flex-1">
                  <Tag className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                  <Input
                    placeholder="أدخل وسم ثم Enter..."
                    value={tagInput}
                    onChange={(e) => setTagInput(e.target.value)}
                    onKeyDown={handleTagInputKeyDown}
                    onBlur={addTag}
                    className="border-border pr-9"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
              {form.tags.length > 0 && (
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 mt-2">
                  {form.tags.map((tag) => (
                    <Badge
                      key={tag}
                      variant="secondary"
                      className="gap-1 bg-muted text-muted-foreground"
                    >
                      {tag}
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => removeTag(tag)}
                        className="hover:text-red-500 transition-colors"
                      >
                        <X className="w-3 h-3" />
                      </button>
                    </Badge>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          <DialogFooter>
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => {
              setDialogOpen(false);
              setForm(emptyForm);
              setEditingItem(null);
              setTagInput('');
            }} className="border-border">
              إلغاء
            </Button>
            <Button
              onClick={handleSave}
              disabled={!form.title.trim() || uploading}
              className="bg-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-800 text-white gap-2"
            >
              {uploading ? (
                <>
                  <span className="w-4 h-4 border-2 border-white/30 border-t-white rounded-full animate-spin" />
                  جاري الرفع...
                </>
              ) : editingItem ? (
                <>
                  <Pencil className="w-4 h-4" />
                  حفظ التعديلات
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
                  إضافة
                </>
              )}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>

      {/* ============ حوار التفاصيل ============ */}
      <Dialog open={detailOpen} onOpenChange={(open) => {
        if (!open) {
          setDetailOpen(false);
          setSelectedItem(null);
          setDeleteConfirm(null);
        }
      }}>
        <DialogContent className="max-w-lg" dir="rtl">
          {selectedItem && (
            <>
              <DialogHeader>
                <DialogTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  {MEDIA_TYPE_CONFIG[selectedItem.type].icon} {selectedItem.title}
                </DialogTitle>
                <DialogDescription>
                  {new Date(selectedItem.date).toLocaleDateString('ar-PS')}
                </DialogDescription>
              </DialogHeader>

              {/* معاينة الوسائط */}
              <div className="rounded-lg overflow-hidden bg-muted/50">
                {selectedItem.type === 'image' && selectedItem.url ? (
                  <img
                    src={selectedItem.url}
                    alt={selectedItem.title}
                    className="w-full max-h-80 object-contain cursor-pointer"
                    onClick={() => setLightboxOpen(true)}
                  />
                ) : selectedItem.type === 'video' && selectedItem.url ? (
                  <video
                    src={selectedItem.url}
                    controls
                    className="w-full max-h-80"
                  />
                ) : selectedItem.url ? (
                  <div className="p-8 text-center">
                    <FileText className="w-16 h-16 mx-auto text-muted-foreground/40 mb-3" />
                    <a
                      href={selectedItem.url}
                      target="_blank"
                      rel="noopener noreferrer"
                      className="text-sm text-foreground underline underline-offset-4 hover:text-foreground/80"
                    >
                      فتح الملف
                    </a>
                  </div>
                ) : null}
              </div>

              {/* الوصف */}
              {selectedItem.description && (
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed">
                  {selectedItem.description}
                </p>
              )}

              {/* الوسوم */}
              {selectedItem.tags.length > 0 && (
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                  {selectedItem.tags.map((tag) => (
                    <Badge
                      key={tag}
                      variant="secondary"
                      className="bg-muted text-muted-foreground"
                    >
                      {tag}
                    </Badge>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}

              {/* أزرار التعديل والحذف */}
              <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 pt-2">
                <Button
                  variant="outline"
                  size="sm"
                  className="gap-1.5 border-border"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setDetailOpen(false);
                    openEdit(selectedItem);
                  }}
                >
                  <Pencil className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  تعديل
                </Button>

                {deleteConfirm === selectedItem.id ? (
                  <div className="flex gap-2">
                    <Button
                      size="sm"
                      variant="destructive"
                      className="h-8 text-xs"
                      onClick={() => handleDelete(selectedItem.id)}
                    >
                      تأكيد الحذف
                    </Button>
                    <Button
                      size="sm"
                      variant="outline"
                      className="h-8 text-xs"
                      onClick={() => setDeleteConfirm(null)}
                    >
                      إلغاء
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <Button
                    variant="outline"
                    size="sm"
                    className="gap-1.5 border-border text-red-500 hover:text-red-600 hover:bg-red-50 dark:hover:bg-red-950/30"
                    onClick={() => setDeleteConfirm(selectedItem.id)}
                  >
                    <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    حذف
                  </Button>
                )}
              </div>
            </>
          )}
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>

      {/* ============ معرض الصور (Lightbox) ============ */}
      <Dialog open={lightboxOpen} onOpenChange={setLightboxOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="max-w-4xl p-2 bg-black/95 border-none" dir="rtl">
          {selectedItem?.type === 'image' && selectedItem.url && (
            <img
              src={selectedItem.url}
              alt={selectedItem.title}
              className="w-full h-full max-h-[85vh] object-contain rounded-lg"
            />
          )}
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## 📝 الكود الكامل

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { GraduationCap, Plus, Trash2, Pencil, ChevronDown, ChevronUp, BookOpen, TrendingUp, Save } from 'lucide-react';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { Progress } from '@/components/ui/progress';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogTrigger, DialogFooter, DialogClose } from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@/components/ui/select';
import { useAppStore } from '@/lib/store';
import { SEMESTER_SEASON_LABELS, type UniversitySemester, type UniversityCourse } from '@/types';
import { v4 as uuid } from 'uuid';

const getGradeLetter = (grade: number, maxGrade: number): string => {
  const pct = (grade / maxGrade) * 100;
  if (pct >= 90) return 'A';
  if (pct >= 80) return 'B';
  if (pct >= 70) return 'C';
  if (pct >= 60) return 'D';
  return 'F';
};

const getGradeLetterColor = (letter: string): string => {
  switch (letter) {
    case 'A': return 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400';
    case 'B': return 'text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400';
    case 'C': return 'text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400';
    case 'D': return 'text-orange-600 dark:text-orange-400';
    case 'F': return 'text-red-600 dark:text-red-400';
    default: return 'text-muted-foreground';
  }
};

const getGpaColor = (gpa: number): string => {
  if (gpa >= 85) return 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400';
  if (gpa >= 70) return 'text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400';
  return 'text-red-600 dark:text-red-400';
};

interface SemesterForm {
  name: string;
  season: UniversitySemester['season'];
  year: number;
  startDate: string;
  endDate: string;
  notes: string;
}

const emptySemesterForm: SemesterForm = {
  name: '',
  season: 'fall',
  year: new Date().getFullYear(),
  startDate: '',
  endDate: '',
  notes: '',
};

interface CourseForm {
  name: string;
  code: string;
  credits: number;
  grade: number;
  maxGrade: number;
}

const emptyCourseForm: CourseForm = {
  name: '',
  code: '',
  credits: 3,
  grade: 0,
  maxGrade: 100,
};

export function UniversitySection() {
  const {
    universitySemesters,
    addSemester,
    updateSemester,
    deleteSemester,
    addSemesterCourse,
    updateSemesterCourse,
    deleteSemesterCourse,
  } = useAppStore();

  const [expandedId, setExpandedId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Semester dialog
  const [semesterOpen, setSemesterOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingSemesterId, setEditingSemesterId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [semesterForm, setSemesterForm] = useState<SemesterForm>(emptySemesterForm);

  // Course dialog
  const [courseOpen, setCourseOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingCourseId, setEditingCourseId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [courseForm, setCourseForm] = useState<CourseForm>(emptyCourseForm);
  const [courseSemesterId, setCourseSemesterId] = useState<string>('');

  // Stats
  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    const totalCredits = universitySemesters.reduce((sum, sem) => sum + sem.totalCredits, 0);
    const cumulativeGpa = totalCredits > 0
      ? universitySemesters.reduce((sum, sem) => sum + sem.gpa * sem.totalCredits, 0) / totalCredits
      : 0;
    return {
      totalSemesters: universitySemesters.length,
      cumulativeGpa: Math.round(cumulativeGpa * 10) / 10,
      totalCredits,
    };
  }, [universitySemesters]);

  // Semester handlers
  const handleOpenSemester = () => {
    setSemesterForm(emptySemesterForm);
    setEditingSemesterId(null);
    setSemesterOpen(true);
  };

  const handleEditSemester = (sem: UniversitySemester) => {
    setSemesterForm({
      name: sem.name,
      season: sem.season,
      year: sem.year,
      startDate: sem.startDate,
      endDate: sem.endDate,
      notes: sem.notes,
    });
    setEditingSemesterId(sem.id);
    setSemesterOpen(true);
  };

  const handleSaveSemester = () => {
    if (!semesterForm.name.trim()) return;
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const data = {
      name: semesterForm.name.trim(),
      season: semesterForm.season,
      year: semesterForm.year,
      startDate: semesterForm.startDate,
      endDate: semesterForm.endDate,
      notes: semesterForm.notes.trim(),
    };
    if (editingSemesterId) {
      updateSemester(editingSemesterId, data);
    } else {
      addSemester({
        ...data,
        gpa: 0,
        totalCredits: 0,
        earnedCredits: 0,
        courses: [],
      });
    }
    setSemesterOpen(false);
  };

  // Course handlers
  const handleOpenCourse = (semesterId: string) => {
    setCourseForm(emptyCourseForm);
    setEditingCourseId(null);
    setCourseSemesterId(semesterId);
    setCourseOpen(true);
  };

  const handleEditCourse = (semesterId: string, course: UniversityCourse) => {
    setCourseForm({
      name: course.name,
      code: course.code,
      credits: course.credits,
      grade: course.grade,
      maxGrade: course.maxGrade,
    });
    setEditingCourseId(course.id);
    setCourseSemesterId(semesterId);
    setCourseOpen(true);
  };

  const handleSaveCourse = () => {
    if (!courseForm.name.trim() || !courseForm.code.trim()) return;
    const data = {
      name: courseForm.name.trim(),
      code: courseForm.code.trim(),
      credits: courseForm.credits,
      grade: courseForm.grade,
      maxGrade: courseForm.maxGrade,
    };
    if (editingCourseId) {
      updateSemesterCourse(courseSemesterId, editingCourseId, data);
    } else {
      addSemesterCourse(courseSemesterId, data);
    }
    setCourseOpen(false);
  };

  const toggleExpand = (id: string) => {
    setExpandedId((prev) => (prev === id ? null : id));
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-900/30 flex items-center justify-center">
            <GraduationCap className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-lg font-bold text-foreground">الجامعة</h1>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">تتبع الفصول الدراسية والمعدلات</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <Dialog open={semesterOpen} onOpenChange={setSemesterOpen}>
          <DialogTrigger asChild>
            <Button size="sm" className="gap-1.5" onClick={handleOpenSemester}>
              <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
              فصل جديد
            </Button>
          </DialogTrigger>
          <DialogContent className="max-w-lg">
            <DialogHeader>
              <DialogTitle>{editingSemesterId ? 'تعديل الفصل الدراسي' : 'فصل دراسي جديد'}</DialogTitle>
            </DialogHeader>
            <div className="space-y-4 py-2 max-h-[60vh] overflow-y-auto">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>اسم الفصل</Label>
                <Input placeholder="مثال: الفصل الأول" value={semesterForm.name} onChange={(e) => setSemesterForm({ ...semesterForm, name: e.target.value })} />
              </div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label>الفصل</Label>
                  <Select value={semesterForm.season} onValueChange={(v) => setSemesterForm({ ...semesterForm, season: v as UniversitySemester['season'] })}>
                    <SelectTrigger className="w-full">
                      <SelectValue />
                    </SelectTrigger>
                    <SelectContent>
                      {(['fall', 'spring', 'summer'] as const).map((s) => (
                        <SelectItem key={s} value={s}>
                          {SEMESTER_SEASON_LABELS[s]}
                        </SelectItem>
                      ))}
                    </SelectContent>
                  </Select>
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label>السنة</Label>
                  <Input
                    type="number"
                    value={semesterForm.year}
                    onChange={(e) => setSemesterForm({ ...semesterForm, year: parseInt(e.target.value) || new Date().getFullYear() })}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label>تاريخ البداية</Label>
                  <Input
                    type="date"
                    value={semesterForm.startDate}
                    onChange={(e) => setSemesterForm({ ...semesterForm, startDate: e.target.value })}
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label>تاريخ النهاية</Label>
                  <Input
                    type="date"
                    value={semesterForm.endDate}
                    onChange={(e) => setSemesterForm({ ...semesterForm, endDate: e.target.value })}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>ملاحظات</Label>
                <Textarea
                  placeholder="أي ملاحظات إضافية..."
                  value={semesterForm.notes}
                  onChange={(e) => setSemesterForm({ ...semesterForm, notes: e.target.value })}
                  rows={3}
                  className="resize-none"
                />
              </div>
            </div>
            <DialogFooter>
              <DialogClose asChild>
                <Button variant="outline">إلغاء</Button>
              </DialogClose>
              <Button onClick={handleSaveSemester} disabled={!semesterForm.name.trim()}>
                <Save className="w-4 h-4 ml-1" />
                {editingSemesterId ? 'حفظ التعديلات' : 'إضافة'}
              </Button>
            </DialogFooter>
          </DialogContent>
        </Dialog>
      </div>

      {/* Stats Bar */}
      {universitySemesters.length > 0 && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
          <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
            <CardContent className="p-3 flex flex-col items-center gap-1">
              <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">الفصول</span>
              <span className="text-lg font-bold text-foreground">{stats.totalSemesters}</span>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
          <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
            <CardContent className="p-3 flex flex-col items-center gap-1">
              <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1">
                <TrendingUp className="w-3 h-3" />
                المعدل التراكمي
              </span>
              <span className={`text-lg font-bold ${getGpaColor(stats.cumulativeGpa)}`}>
                {stats.cumulativeGpa}%
              </span>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
          <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
            <CardContent className="p-3 flex flex-col items-center gap-1">
              <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">الساعات</span>
              <span className="text-lg font-bold text-foreground">{stats.totalCredits}</span>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Semester List */}
      {universitySemesters.length === 0 ? (
        <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
          <CardContent className="p-8 text-center">
            <GraduationCap className="w-10 h-10 mx-auto mb-3 text-muted-foreground opacity-40" />
            <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm">🎓 لم تضف أي فصل دراسي بعد — ابدأ بتسجيل فصلك الأول</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <AnimatePresence mode="popLayout">
            {universitySemesters.map((sem) => {
              const isExpanded = expandedId === sem.id;
              const gradeLetter = getGradeLetter(sem.gpa, 100);
              return (
                <motion.div
                  key={sem.id}
                  layout
                  initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }}
                  animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                  exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -20 }}
                >
                  <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
                    <CardContent className="p-4 space-y-3">
                      {/* Semester Header Row */}
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                        <button
                          className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-0 flex-1 text-right"
                          onClick={() => toggleExpand(sem.id)}
                        >
                          <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-lg bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-900/30 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                            <BookOpen className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
                          </div>
                          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                            <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-foreground truncate">{sem.name}</h3>
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-0.5">
                              <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0">
                                {SEMESTER_SEASON_LABELS[sem.season]}
                              </Badge>
                              <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{sem.year}</span>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </button>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
                          {/* GPA */}
                          <div className="text-center px-2">
                            <span className={`text-sm font-bold ${getGpaColor(sem.gpa)}`}>
                              {Math.round(sem.gpa * 10) / 10}%
                            </span>
                            <span className={`text-xs font-bold ml-1 ${getGradeLetterColor(gradeLetter)}`}>
                              {gradeLetter}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                          {/* Credits */}
                          <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0">
                            {sem.totalCredits} ساعة
                          </Badge>
                          {/* Expand Icon */}
                          {isExpanded ? (
                            <ChevronUp className="w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                          ) : (
                            <ChevronDown className="w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {/* Notes */}
                      {sem.notes && !isExpanded && (
                        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground bg-muted/50 rounded-md p-2 line-clamp-1">{sem.notes}</p>
                      )}

                      {/* Expanded Content: Courses */}
                      <AnimatePresence>
                        {isExpanded && (
                          <motion.div
                            initial={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
                            animate={{ height: 'auto', opacity: 1 }}
                            exit={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
                            transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}
                            className="overflow-hidden"
                          >
                            <div className="space-y-3 pt-1">
                              {/* Semester Actions */}
                              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                  <Button
                                    variant="ghost"
                                    size="icon"
                                    className="h-7 w-7 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
                                    onClick={() => handleEditSemester(sem)}
                                  >
                                    <Pencil className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                                  </Button>
                                  <Button
                                    variant="ghost"
                                    size="icon"
                                    className="h-7 w-7 text-muted-foreground hover:text-red-500"
                                    onClick={() => {
                                      deleteSemester(sem.id);
                                      if (expandedId === sem.id) setExpandedId(null);
                                    }}
                                  >
                                    <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                                  </Button>
                                </div>
                                <Button
                                  size="sm"
                                  variant="outline"
                                  className="gap-1 text-xs h-7"
                                  onClick={() => handleOpenCourse(sem.id)}
                                >
                                  <Plus className="w-3 h-3" />
                                  مادة جديدة
                                </Button>
                              </div>

                              {/* Notes in expanded */}
                              {sem.notes && (
                                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground bg-muted/50 rounded-md p-2">{sem.notes}</p>
                              )}

                              {/* Courses Table */}
                              {sem.courses.length === 0 ? (
                                <div className="text-center py-4">
                                  <BookOpen className="w-6 h-6 mx-auto mb-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-40" />
                                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">لا توجد مواد في هذا الفصل</p>
                                </div>
                              ) : (
                                <div className="space-y-2 max-h-96 overflow-y-auto">
                                  {/* Table Header */}
                                  <div className="grid grid-cols-12 gap-2 px-2 text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">
                                    <div className="col-span-2">الرمز</div>
                                    <div className="col-span-4">المادة</div>
                                    <div className="col-span-1 text-center">ساعة</div>
                                    <div className="col-span-3 text-center">الدرجة</div>
                                    <div className="col-span-1 text-center">التقدير</div>
                                    <div className="col-span-1"></div>
                                  </div>
                                  {/* Course Rows */}
                                  {sem.courses.map((course) => {
                                    const letter = getGradeLetter(course.grade, course.maxGrade);
                                    const pct = course.maxGrade > 0 ? Math.round((course.grade / course.maxGrade) * 100) : 0;
                                    return (
                                      <div
                                        key={course.id}
                                        className="grid grid-cols-12 gap-2 items-center px-2 py-2 rounded-md hover:bg-muted/50 transition-colors"
                                      >
                                        <div className="col-span-2">
                                          <span className="text-xs font-mono text-muted-foreground">{course.code}</span>
                                        </div>
                                        <div className="col-span-4 min-w-0">
                                          <span className="text-xs font-medium text-foreground truncate block">{course.name}</span>
                                        </div>
                                        <div className="col-span-1 text-center">
                                          <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{course.credits}</span>
                                        </div>
                                        <div className="col-span-3 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                          <div className="flex-1 h-1.5 bg-muted rounded-full overflow-hidden">
                                            <motion.div
                                              className="h-full rounded-full"
                                              style={{
                                                width: `${pct}%`,
                                                backgroundColor: pct >= 70 ? '#10b981' : pct >= 60 ? '#f59e0b' : '#ef4444',
                                              }}
                                              initial={{ width: 0 }}
                                              animate={{ width: `${pct}%` }}
                                              transition={{ duration: 0.5 }}
                                            />
                                          </div>
                                          <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground w-8 text-left shrink-0">{course.grade}/{course.maxGrade}</span>
                                        </div>
                                        <div className="col-span-1 text-center">
                                          <span className={`text-xs font-bold ${getGradeLetterColor(letter)}`}>{letter}</span>
                                        </div>
                                        <div className="col-span-1 flex items-center justify-end gap-0.5">
                                          <Button
                                            variant="ghost"
                                            size="icon"
                                            className="h-6 w-6 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
                                            onClick={() => handleEditCourse(sem.id, course)}
                                          >
                                            <Pencil className="w-3 h-3" />
                                          </Button>
                                          <Button
                                            variant="ghost"
                                            size="icon"
                                            className="h-6 w-6 text-muted-foreground hover:text-red-500"
                                            onClick={() => deleteSemesterCourse(sem.id, course.id)}
                                          >
                                            <Trash2 className="w-3 h-3" />
                                          </Button>
                                        </div>
                                      </div>
                                    );
                                  })}
                                </div>
                              )}
                            </div>
                          </motion.div>
                        )}
                      </AnimatePresence>
                    </CardContent>
                  </Card>
                </motion.div>
              );
            })}
          </AnimatePresence>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Add Course Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={courseOpen} onOpenChange={setCourseOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="max-w-lg">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>{editingCourseId ? 'تعديل المادة' : 'مادة جديدة'}</DialogTitle>
          </DialogHeader>
          <div className="space-y-4 py-2">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div className="space-y-2 col-span-2 sm:col-span-1">
                <Label>رمز المادة</Label>
                <Input placeholder="مثال: CS101" value={courseForm.code} onChange={(e) => setCourseForm({ ...courseForm, code: e.target.value })} />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2 col-span-2 sm:col-span-1">
                <Label>اسم المادة</Label>
                <Input placeholder="مثال: برمجة ١" value={courseForm.name} onChange={(e) => setCourseForm({ ...courseForm, name: e.target.value })} />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>الساعات</Label>
                <Input
                  type="number"
                  min={0}
                  value={courseForm.credits}
                  onChange={(e) => setCourseForm({ ...courseForm, credits: parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0 })}
                />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>الدرجة</Label>
                <Input
                  type="number"
                  min={0}
                  value={courseForm.grade}
                  onChange={(e) => setCourseForm({ ...courseForm, grade: parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0 })}
                />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>الدرجة العظمى</Label>
                <Input
                  type="number"
                  min={1}
                  value={courseForm.maxGrade}
                  onChange={(e) => setCourseForm({ ...courseForm, maxGrade: parseFloat(e.target.value) || 100 })}
                />
              </div>
            </div>
            {/* Grade Preview */}
            <div className="bg-muted/50 rounded-md p-3 flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">التقدير المتوقع</span>
              <span className={`text-sm font-bold ${getGradeLetterColor(getGradeLetter(courseForm.grade, courseForm.maxGrade || 1))}`}>
                {getGradeLetter(courseForm.grade, courseForm.maxGrade || 1)}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <DialogFooter>
            <DialogClose asChild>
              <Button variant="outline">إلغاء</Button>
            </DialogClose>
            <Button
              onClick={handleSaveCourse}
              disabled={!courseForm.name.trim() || !courseForm.code.trim()}
            >
              <Save className="w-4 h-4 ml-1" />
              {editingCourseId ? 'حفظ التعديلات' : 'إضافة'}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </div>
  );
}
```
