## 📝 الكود الكامل

```tsx
'use client';

// المواد الدراسية — Course Management UI

import { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  BookOpen, Plus, Pencil, Trash2, Search, Clock, MapPin, User, Mail,
  Link2, Video, Check, X, Calendar, GraduationCap, ExternalLink,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogFooter, DialogDescription } from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import {
  AlertDialog, AlertDialogAction, AlertDialogCancel, AlertDialogContent,
  AlertDialogDescription, AlertDialogFooter, AlertDialogHeader, AlertDialogTitle,
} from '@/components/ui/alert-dialog';
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@/components/ui/select';
import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from '@/components/ui/tabs';
import { useAppStore } from '@/lib/store';
import { toast } from '@/hooks/use-toast';
import { COURSE_COLORS } from '@/types';
import type { Course, Lecture } from '@/types';

const DAYS = ['الأحد', 'الإثنين', 'الثلاثاء', 'الأربعاء', 'الخميس', 'الجمعة', 'السبت'];
const today = () => new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

interface CourseForm {
  name: string; code: string; doctor: string; doctorEmail: string; doctorOffice: string;
  credits: string; room: string; semester: string; color: string; notes: string;
  schedule: Array<{ day: string; startTime: string; endTime: string }>;
  links: Array<{ label: string; url: string }>;
}
const emptyCourseForm: CourseForm = {
  name: '', code: '', doctor: '', doctorEmail: '', doctorOffice: '',
  credits: '3', room: '', semester: '', color: COURSE_COLORS[0], notes: '', schedule: [], links: [],
};

interface LectureForm {
  title: string; date: string; duration: string; recordingUrl: string; notes: string; attended: boolean;
}
const emptyLectureForm: LectureForm = {
  title: '', date: today(), duration: '90', recordingUrl: '', notes: '', attended: false,
};

// ============ Course Card ============
function CourseCard({ course, onOpen, onEdit, onDelete }: {
  course: Course; onOpen: () => void; onEdit: (e: React.MouseEvent) => void; onDelete: (e: React.MouseEvent) => void;
}) {
  return (
    <Card className="group relative overflow-hidden cursor-pointer transition-all hover:shadow-md hover:border-primary/40" onClick={onOpen}>
      <div className="absolute top-0 inset-x-0 h-1.5" style={{ backgroundColor: course.color }} />
      <CardContent className="p-4 pt-5 space-y-3">
        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
          <div className="space-y-1 min-w-0 flex-1">
            <h3 className="font-semibold leading-tight truncate">{course.name || 'بدون اسم'}</h3>
            {course.code && <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{course.code}</p>}
          </div>
          <div className="flex gap-0.5 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">
            <Button size="icon" variant="ghost" className="h-7 w-7" onClick={onEdit} aria-label="تعديل"><Pencil className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /></Button>
            <Button size="icon" variant="ghost" className="h-7 w-7 text-destructive" onClick={onDelete} aria-label="حذف"><Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /></Button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
          {course.credits > 0 && <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-xs"><GraduationCap className="h-3 w-3 ml-1" />{course.credits} ساعة</Badge>}
          {course.room && <Badge variant="outline" className="text-xs"><MapPin className="h-3 w-3 ml-1" />{course.room}</Badge>}
        </div>
        {course.doctor && <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground"><User className="h-3 w-3 shrink-0" /><span className="truncate">{course.doctor}</span></div>}
        {course.schedule?.length > 0 && (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            <Clock className="h-3 w-3 shrink-0" />
            <span className="truncate">{course.schedule.slice(0, 2).map(s => `${s.day} ${s.startTime}`).join(' · ')}{course.schedule.length > 2 && ` +${course.schedule.length - 2}`}</span>
          </div>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

// ============ Lecture Row ============
function LectureRow({ lecture, onToggleAttended, onEdit, onDelete }: {
  lecture: Lecture; onToggleAttended: () => void; onEdit: () => void; onDelete: () => void;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-lg border p-3 hover:bg-muted/40 transition-colors">
      <button
        type="button" onClick={onToggleAttended}
        className={`mt-0.5 flex h-5 w-5 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border-2 transition-colors ${lecture.attended ? 'border-emerald-500 bg-emerald-500 text-white' : 'border-muted-foreground/40 hover:border-emerald-500'}`}
        aria-label={lecture.attended ? 'تم الحضور' : 'تعليم كمحضور'}
      >{lecture.attended && <Check className="h-3 w-3" />}</button>
      <div className="flex-1 min-w-0 space-y-1">
        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
          <p className="font-medium text-sm leading-tight">{lecture.title || 'محاضرة بدون عنوان'}</p>
          <div className="flex gap-0.5 shrink-0">
            <Button size="icon" variant="ghost" className="h-6 w-6" onClick={onEdit} aria-label="تعديل"><Pencil className="h-3 w-3" /></Button>
            <Button size="icon" variant="ghost" className="h-6 w-6 text-destructive" onClick={onDelete} aria-label="حذف"><Trash2 className="h-3 w-3" /></Button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1"><Calendar className="h-3 w-3" />{lecture.date}</span>
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1"><Clock className="h-3 w-3" />{lecture.duration} د</span>
          {lecture.recordingUrl && (
            <a href={lecture.recordingUrl} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} className="flex items-center gap-1 text-primary hover:underline">
              <Video className="h-3 w-3" />تسجيل
            </a>
          )}
        </div>
        {lecture.notes && <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground line-clamp-2">{lecture.notes}</p>}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export function CoursesSection() {
  const { courses, lectures, addCourse, updateCourse, deleteCourse, addLecture, updateLecture, deleteLecture,
    universityProjects, academicResources, grades, professors, scheduleEvents, addScheduleEvent, deleteScheduleEvent,
  } = useAppStore();
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [semesterFilter, setSemesterFilter] = useState('all');
  const [courseDialogOpen, setCourseDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingCourseId, setEditingCourseId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [courseForm, setCourseForm] = useState<CourseForm>(emptyCourseForm);
  const [detailCourseId, setDetailCourseId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [detailTab, setDetailTab] = useState('overview');
  const [deleteCourseId, setDeleteCourseId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [deleteLectureId, setDeleteLectureId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [lectureDialogCourseId, setLectureDialogCourseId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [editingLectureId, setEditingLectureId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [lectureForm, setLectureForm] = useState<LectureForm>(emptyLectureForm);

  const semesters = useMemo(() => {
    const set = new Set<string>();
    courses.forEach(c => c.semester && set.add(c.semester));
    return Array.from(set).sort();
  }, [courses]);

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    const q = search.trim().toLowerCase();
    return courses.filter(c => {
      if (semesterFilter !== 'all' && c.semester !== semesterFilter) return false;
      if (!q) return true;
      return [c.name, c.code, c.doctor, c.room, c.semester].some(x => x?.toLowerCase().includes(q));
    });
  }, [courses, search, semesterFilter]);

  const totalCredits = useMemo(() => filtered.reduce((s, c) => s + (c.credits || 0), 0), [filtered]);
  const detailCourse = detailCourseId ? courses.find(c => c.id === detailCourseId) : null;
  const detailLectures = detailCourseId ? lectures.filter(l => l.courseId === detailCourseId) : [];

  const openAddCourse = () => { setCourseForm(emptyCourseForm); setEditingCourseId(null); setCourseDialogOpen(true); };
  const openEditCourse = (course: Course) => {
    setCourseForm({
      name: course.name, code: course.code, doctor: course.doctor, doctorEmail: course.doctorEmail,
      doctorOffice: course.doctorOffice, credits: String(course.credits || 0), room: course.room,
      semester: course.semester, color: course.color, notes: course.notes,
      schedule: course.schedule?.length ? course.schedule : [], links: course.links?.length ? course.links : [],
    });
    setEditingCourseId(course.id); setCourseDialogOpen(true);
  };
  const saveCourse = () => {
    if (!courseForm.name.trim()) { toast({ title: 'اسم المادة مطلوب', variant: 'destructive' }); return; }
    const data = {
      name: courseForm.name.trim(), code: courseForm.code.trim(), doctor: courseForm.doctor.trim(),
      doctorEmail: courseForm.doctorEmail.trim(), doctorOffice: courseForm.doctorOffice.trim(),
      credits: parseInt(courseForm.credits) || 0, room: courseForm.room.trim(), semester: courseForm.semester.trim(),
      color: courseForm.color, notes: courseForm.notes.trim(), schedule: courseForm.schedule,
      links: courseForm.links.filter(l => l.url.trim()),
    };
    if (editingCourseId) { updateCourse(editingCourseId, data); toast({ title: 'تم تحديث المادة' }); }
    else { addCourse(data); toast({ title: 'تمت إضافة المادة' }); }
    setCourseDialogOpen(false);
  };
  const confirmDeleteCourse = () => {
    if (!deleteCourseId) return;
    deleteCourse(deleteCourseId);
    if (detailCourseId === deleteCourseId) setDetailCourseId(null);
    setDeleteCourseId(null);
    toast({ title: 'تم حذف المادة' });
  };

  // Schedule/Link form helpers
  const addScheduleSlot = () => setCourseForm(f => ({ ...f, schedule: [...f.schedule, { day: DAYS[0], startTime: '08:00', endTime: '09:30' }] }));
  const updateScheduleSlot = (i: number, field: 'day' | 'startTime' | 'endTime', v: string) =>
    setCourseForm(f => ({ ...f, schedule: f.schedule.map((s, idx) => idx === i ? { ...s, [field]: v } : s) }));
  const removeScheduleSlot = (i: number) => setCourseForm(f => ({ ...f, schedule: f.schedule.filter((_, idx) => idx !== i) }));
  const addLink = () => setCourseForm(f => ({ ...f, links: [...f.links, { label: '', url: '' }] }));
  const updateLink = (i: number, field: 'label' | 'url', v: string) =>
    setCourseForm(f => ({ ...f, links: f.links.map((l, idx) => idx === i ? { ...l, [field]: v } : l) }));
  const removeLink = (i: number) => setCourseForm(f => ({ ...f, links: f.links.filter((_, idx) => idx !== i) }));

  // Lecture handlers
  const openAddLecture = (courseId: string) => { setLectureForm(emptyLectureForm); setEditingLectureId(null); setLectureDialogCourseId(courseId); };
  const openEditLecture = (lecture: Lecture) => {
    setLectureForm({
      title: lecture.title, date: lecture.date || today(), duration: String(lecture.duration || 90),
      recordingUrl: lecture.recordingUrl, notes: lecture.notes, attended: lecture.attended,
    });
    setEditingLectureId(lecture.id); setLectureDialogCourseId(lecture.courseId);
  };
  const saveLecture = () => {
    if (!lectureDialogCourseId) return;
    if (!lectureForm.title.trim()) { toast({ title: 'عنوان المحاضرة مطلوب', variant: 'destructive' }); return; }
    const data = {
      courseId: lectureDialogCourseId, title: lectureForm.title.trim(), date: lectureForm.date,
      duration: parseInt(lectureForm.duration) || 0, recordingUrl: lectureForm.recordingUrl.trim(),
      notes: lectureForm.notes.trim(), attachments: [] as Array<{ name: string; url: string }>, attended: lectureForm.attended,
    };
    if (editingLectureId) { updateLecture(editingLectureId, data); toast({ title: 'تم تحديث المحاضرة' }); }
    else { addLecture(data); toast({ title: 'تمت إضافة المحاضرة' }); }
    setLectureDialogCourseId(null); setEditingLectureId(null);
  };
  const confirmDeleteLecture = () => { if (!deleteLectureId) return; deleteLecture(deleteLectureId); setDeleteLectureId(null); toast({ title: 'تم حذف المحاضرة' }); };
  const toggleAttended = (lecture: Lecture) => updateLecture(lecture.id, { attended: !lecture.attended });

  // renderField helper (avoids ESLint react-hooks/static-components)
  const renderField = (label: string, input: React.ReactNode, className = '') => (
    <div className={`space-y-1.5 ${className}`}><Label>{label}</Label>{input}</div>
  );

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Header + Stats */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2"><BookOpen className="h-6 w-6 text-primary" />المواد الدراسية</h2>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-1">إدارة المواد، المحاضرات، والجدول</p>
        </div>
        <Button onClick={openAddCourse}><Plus className="h-4 w-4 ml-1" />إضافة مادة</Button>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 sm:max-w-md">
        <Card><CardContent className="p-4 flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-primary/10 text-primary"><BookOpen className="h-5 w-5" /></div>
          <div><p className="text-2xl font-bold leading-none">{courses.length}</p><p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">إجمالي المواد</p></div>
        </CardContent></Card>
        <Card><CardContent className="p-4 flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-primary/10 text-primary"><GraduationCap className="h-5 w-5" /></div>
          <div><p className="text-2xl font-bold leading-none">{totalCredits}</p><p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">الساعات المعتمدة</p></div>
        </CardContent></Card>
      </div>

      {/* Toolbar + Grid */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
        <div className="relative flex-1 min-w-[200px]">
          <Search className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground pointer-events-none" />
          <Input placeholder="ابحث باسم المادة، الرمز، الدكتور..." value={search} onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)} className="pr-9" />
        </div>
        <Select value={semesterFilter} onValueChange={setSemesterFilter}>
          <SelectTrigger className="w-[180px]"><SelectValue placeholder="كل الفصول" /></SelectTrigger>
          <SelectContent>
            <SelectItem value="all">كل الفصول</SelectItem>
            {semesters.map(s => <SelectItem key={s} value={s}>{s}</SelectItem>)}
          </SelectContent>
        </Select>
      </div>

      {filtered.length === 0 ? (
        <Card><CardContent className="py-12 text-center text-muted-foreground">
          <BookOpen className="h-10 w-10 mx-auto mb-3 opacity-50" />
          <p>{courses.length === 0 ? 'لا توجد مواد بعد. ابدأ بإضافة مادة جديدة.' : 'لا توجد نتائج مطابقة'}</p>
        </CardContent></Card>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
          {filtered.map(course => (
            <CourseCard key={course.id} course={course}
              onOpen={() => { setDetailCourseId(course.id); setDetailTab('overview'); }}
              onEdit={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); openEditCourse(course); }}
              onDelete={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); setDeleteCourseId(course.id); }}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Detail Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={!!detailCourse} onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setDetailCourseId(null)}>
        <DialogContent className="max-w-3xl max-h-[85vh] overflow-y-auto">
          {detailCourse && (
            <>
              <DialogHeader>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                  <div className="h-10 w-1.5 rounded-full" style={{ backgroundColor: detailCourse.color }} />
                  <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                    <DialogTitle className="text-xl truncate">{detailCourse.name || 'بدون اسم'}</DialogTitle>
                    <DialogDescription className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 mt-1">
                      {detailCourse.code && <span>{detailCourse.code}</span>}
                      {detailCourse.credits > 0 && <span>· {detailCourse.credits} ساعة معتمدة</span>}
                      {detailCourse.semester && <span>· {detailCourse.semester}</span>}
                      {detailCourse.room && <span>· {detailCourse.room}</span>}
                    </DialogDescription>
                  </div>
                  <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => openEditCourse(detailCourse)}><Pencil className="h-3.5 w-3.5 ml-1" />تعديل</Button>
                </div>
              </DialogHeader>

              <Tabs value={detailTab} onValueChange={setDetailTab} className="w-full">
                <TabsList className="grid w-full grid-cols-5">
                  <TabsTrigger value="overview">نظرة عامة</TabsTrigger>
                  <TabsTrigger value="lectures">المحاضرات ({detailLectures.length})</TabsTrigger>
                  <TabsTrigger value="projects">مشاريع ({universityProjects.filter(p => p.courseId === detailCourse.id).length})</TabsTrigger>
                  <TabsTrigger value="grades">درجات ({grades.filter(g => g.subject === detailCourse.name).length})</TabsTrigger>
                  <TabsTrigger value="library">مكتبة ({academicResources.filter(r => r.courseId === detailCourse.id).length})</TabsTrigger>
                </TabsList>

                <TabsContent value="overview" className="space-y-3 mt-4">
                  {(detailCourse.doctor || detailCourse.doctorEmail || detailCourse.doctorOffice) && (
                    <div className="rounded-lg border p-3 space-y-2">
                      <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">الدكتور</p>
                      {detailCourse.doctor && <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm"><User className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />{detailCourse.doctor}</div>}
                      {detailCourse.doctorEmail && <a href={`mailto:${detailCourse.doctorEmail}`} className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-primary hover:underline"><Mail className="h-4 w-4" />{detailCourse.doctorEmail}</a>}
                      {detailCourse.doctorOffice && <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm"><MapPin className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />{detailCourse.doctorOffice}</div>}
                    </div>
                  )}
                  {detailCourse.schedule?.length > 0 && (
                    <div className="rounded-lg border p-3 space-y-2">
                      <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1.5"><Clock className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />الجدول الأسبوعي</p>
                      <div className="space-y-1.5">
                        {detailCourse.schedule.map((s, i) => (
                          <div key={i} className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
                            <span className="font-medium">{s.day}</span>
                            <span className="text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">{s.startTime} - {s.endTime}</span>
                          </div>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}
                  {detailCourse.links?.length > 0 && (
                    <div className="rounded-lg border p-3 space-y-2">
                      <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1.5"><Link2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />الروابط</p>
                      <div className="space-y-1">
                        {detailCourse.links.filter(l => l.url).map((l, i) => (
                          <a key={i} href={l.url} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-primary hover:underline">
                            <ExternalLink className="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0" /><span className="truncate">{l.label || l.url}</span>
                          </a>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}
                  {detailCourse.notes && (
                    <div className="rounded-lg border p-3 space-y-1">
                      <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">ملاحظات</p>
                      <p className="text-sm whitespace-pre-wrap">{detailCourse.notes}</p>
                    </div>
                  )}
                  {!detailCourse.doctor && !detailCourse.schedule?.length && !detailCourse.links?.length && !detailCourse.notes && (
                    <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground text-center py-6">لا توجد تفاصيل إضافية. عدّل المادة لإضافة معلومات.</p>
                  )}
                </TabsContent>

                <TabsContent value="lectures" className="space-y-3 mt-4">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{detailLectures.length} محاضرة</p>
                    <Button size="sm" onClick={() => openAddLecture(detailCourse.id)}><Plus className="h-3.5 w-3.5 ml-1" />محاضرة جديدة</Button>
                  </div>
                  {detailLectures.length === 0 ? (
                    <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground text-center py-8">لا توجد محاضرات بعد</p>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="space-y-2 max-h-[40vh] overflow-y-auto pl-1">
                      {detailLectures.map(l => (
                        <LectureRow key={l.id} lecture={l}
                          onToggleAttended={() => toggleAttended(l)}
                          onEdit={() => openEditLecture(l)}
                          onDelete={() => setDeleteLectureId(l.id)}
                        />
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </TabsContent>

                <TabsContent value="projects" className="space-y-3 mt-4">
                  {(() => {
                    const courseProjects = universityProjects.filter(p => p.courseId === detailCourse.id);
                    return courseProjects.length === 0 ? (
                      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground text-center py-8">لا توجد مشاريع لهذه المادة</p>
                    ) : (
                      <div className="space-y-2 max-h-[40vh] overflow-y-auto pl-1">
                        {courseProjects.map(p => (
                          <div key={p.id} className="rounded-lg border p-3 space-y-1">
                            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                              <p className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">{p.title}</p>
                              <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-[10px]">{p.status}</Badge>
                            </div>
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                              <div className="flex-1 h-1.5 bg-muted rounded-full overflow-hidden">
                                <div className="h-full bg-primary rounded-full" style={{ width: `${p.progress}%` }} />
                              </div>
                              <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{p.progress}%</span>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    );
                  })()}
                </TabsContent>

                <TabsContent value="grades" className="space-y-3 mt-4">
                  {(() => {
                    const courseGrades = grades.filter(g => g.subject === detailCourse.name);
                    return courseGrades.length === 0 ? (
                      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground text-center py-8">لا توجد درجات لهذه المادة</p>
                    ) : (
                      <div className="space-y-2 max-h-[40vh] overflow-y-auto pl-1">
                        {courseGrades.map(g => (
                          <div key={g.id} className="rounded-lg border p-3 flex items-center justify-between">
                            <div>
                              <p className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">{g.testName}</p>
                              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{g.score}/{g.maxScore}</p>
                            </div>
                            <div className="text-right">
                              <p className={`text-lg font-bold ${g.percentage >= 60 ? 'text-emerald-600' : 'text-red-500'}`}>
                                {g.percentage.toFixed(0)}%
                              </p>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    );
                  })()}
                </TabsContent>

                <TabsContent value="library" className="space-y-3 mt-4">
                  {(() => {
                    const courseResources = academicResources.filter(r => r.courseId === detailCourse.id);
                    return courseResources.length === 0 ? (
                      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground text-center py-8">لا توجد موارد لهذه المادة</p>
                    ) : (
                      <div className="space-y-2 max-h-[40vh] overflow-y-auto pl-1">
                        {courseResources.map(r => (
                          <div key={r.id} className="rounded-lg border p-3 flex items-center justify-between">
                            <div>
                              <p className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">{r.title}</p>
                              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{r.type} · {(r.fileSize / 1024).toFixed(0)} KB</p>
                            </div>
                            {r.fileUrl && (
                              <a href={r.fileUrl} download={r.fileName} className="text-primary hover:underline text-xs">تحميل</a>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    );
                  })()}
                </TabsContent>
              </Tabs>
            </>
          )}
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>

      {/* Add/Edit Course Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={courseDialogOpen} onOpenChange={setCourseDialogOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="max-w-2xl max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>{editingCourseId ? 'تعديل المادة' : 'مادة جديدة'}</DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>أدخل تفاصيل المادة الدراسية</DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>
          <div className="space-y-4 py-2">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              {renderField('اسم المادة *', <Input value={courseForm.name} onChange={e => setCourseForm(f => ({ ...f, name: e.target.value }))} placeholder="مثال: برمجة الحاسوب" />, 'sm:col-span-2')}
              {renderField('رمز المادة', <Input value={courseForm.code} onChange={e => setCourseForm(f => ({ ...f, code: e.target.value }))} placeholder="CS101" />)}
              {renderField('الساعات المعتمدة', <Input type="number" min={0} max={10} value={courseForm.credits} onChange={e => setCourseForm(f => ({ ...f, credits: e.target.value }))} />)}
              {renderField('الدكتور', <Input value={courseForm.doctor} onChange={e => setCourseForm(f => ({ ...f, doctor: e.target.value }))} placeholder="د. اسم" />)}
              {renderField('القاعة', <Input value={courseForm.room} onChange={e => setCourseForm(f => ({ ...f, room: e.target.value }))} placeholder="A101" />)}
              {renderField('بريد الدكتور', <Input type="email" value={courseForm.doctorEmail} onChange={e => setCourseForm(f => ({ ...f, doctorEmail: e.target.value }))} placeholder="doc@uni.edu" />)}
              {renderField('مكتب الدكتور', <Input value={courseForm.doctorOffice} onChange={e => setCourseForm(f => ({ ...f, doctorOffice: e.target.value }))} placeholder="مبنى C - طابق 2" />)}
              {renderField('الفصل الدراسي', <Input value={courseForm.semester} onChange={e => setCourseForm(f => ({ ...f, semester: e.target.value }))} placeholder="الفصل الأول 2024" />)}
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <Label>اللون</Label>
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                  {COURSE_COLORS.map(c => (
                    <button key={c} type="button" onClick={() => setCourseForm(f => ({ ...f, color: c }))}
                      className={`h-7 w-7 rounded-full border-2 transition-all ${courseForm.color === c ? 'ring-2 ring-offset-2 ring-primary scale-110' : 'border-transparent'}`}
                      style={{ backgroundColor: c }} aria-label={`لون ${c}`} />
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <Label>الجدول الأسبوعي</Label>
                <Button type="button" variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={addScheduleSlot}><Plus className="h-3.5 w-3.5 ml-1" />إضافة موعد</Button>
              </div>
              {courseForm.schedule.map((s, idx) => (
                <div key={idx} className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Select value={s.day} onValueChange={v => updateScheduleSlot(idx, 'day', v)}>
                    <SelectTrigger className="w-28"><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
                    <SelectContent>{DAYS.map(d => <SelectItem key={d} value={d}>{d}</SelectItem>)}</SelectContent>
                  </Select>
                  <Input type="time" value={s.startTime} onChange={e => updateScheduleSlot(idx, 'startTime', e.target.value)} className="flex-1" />
                  <span className="text-muted-foreground text-xs">-</span>
                  <Input type="time" value={s.endTime} onChange={e => updateScheduleSlot(idx, 'endTime', e.target.value)} className="flex-1" />
                  <Button type="button" variant="ghost" size="icon" onClick={() => removeScheduleSlot(idx)} aria-label="حذف"><X className="h-4 w-4 text-destructive" /></Button>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <Label>روابط</Label>
                <Button type="button" variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={addLink}><Plus className="h-3.5 w-3.5 ml-1" />إضافة رابط</Button>
              </div>
              {courseForm.links.map((l, idx) => (
                <div key={idx} className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Input placeholder="عنوان" value={l.label} onChange={e => updateLink(idx, 'label', e.target.value)} className="w-32" />
                  <Input placeholder="https://..." value={l.url} onChange={e => updateLink(idx, 'url', e.target.value)} className="flex-1" />
                  <Button type="button" variant="ghost" size="icon" onClick={() => removeLink(idx)} aria-label="حذف"><X className="h-4 w-4 text-destructive" /></Button>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>

            {renderField('ملاحظات', <Textarea rows={3} value={courseForm.notes} onChange={e => setCourseForm(f => ({ ...f, notes: e.target.value }))} placeholder="ملاحظات عامة عن المادة..." />)}
          </div>
          <DialogFooter>
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setCourseDialogOpen(false)}>إلغاء</Button>
            <Button onClick={saveCourse}>{editingCourseId ? 'حفظ' : 'إضافة'}</Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>

      {/* Lecture Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={!!lectureDialogCourseId} onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setLectureDialogCourseId(null)}>
        <DialogContent className="max-w-lg">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>{editingLectureId ? 'تعديل محاضرة' : 'محاضرة جديدة'}</DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>سجّل تفاصيل المحاضرة</DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>
          <div className="space-y-3 py-2">
            {renderField('عنوان المحاضرة *', <Input value={lectureForm.title} onChange={e => setLectureForm(f => ({ ...f, title: e.target.value }))} placeholder="محاضرة 1: مقدمة" />)}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              {renderField('التاريخ', <Input type="date" value={lectureForm.date} onChange={e => setLectureForm(f => ({ ...f, date: e.target.value }))} />)}
              {renderField('المدة (دقيقة)', <Input type="number" min={0} value={lectureForm.duration} onChange={e => setLectureForm(f => ({ ...f, duration: e.target.value }))} />)}
            </div>
            {renderField('رابط التسجيل', <Input value={lectureForm.recordingUrl} onChange={e => setLectureForm(f => ({ ...f, recordingUrl: e.target.value }))} placeholder="https://..." />)}
            {renderField('ملاحظات', <Textarea rows={3} value={lectureForm.notes} onChange={e => setLectureForm(f => ({ ...f, notes: e.target.value }))} placeholder="أبرز النقاط..." />)}
            <label className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer select-none">
              <input type="checkbox" checked={lectureForm.attended} onChange={e => setLectureForm(f => ({ ...f, attended: e.target.checked }))} className="h-4 w-4 rounded" />
              <span className="text-sm">تم الحضور</span>
            </label>
          </div>
          <DialogFooter>
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setLectureDialogCourseId(null)}>إلغاء</Button>
            <Button onClick={saveLecture}>{editingLectureId ? 'حفظ' : 'إضافة'}</Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>

      {/* Delete Course Confirmation */}
      <AlertDialog open={!!deleteCourseId} onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setDeleteCourseId(null)}>
        <AlertDialogContent>
          <AlertDialogHeader>
            <AlertDialogTitle>حذف المادة</AlertDialogTitle>
            <AlertDialogDescription>هل أنت متأكد من حذف هذه المادة؟ سيتم حذف جميع المحاضرات المرتبطة بها. لا يمكن التراجع.</AlertDialogDescription>
          </AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogFooter>
            <AlertDialogCancel>إلغاء</AlertDialogCancel>
            <AlertDialogAction onClick={confirmDeleteCourse} className="bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground hover:bg-destructive/90">حذف</AlertDialogAction>
          </AlertDialogFooter>
        </AlertDialogContent>
      </AlertDialog>

      <AlertDialog open={!!deleteLectureId} onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setDeleteLectureId(null)}>
        <AlertDialogContent>
          <AlertDialogHeader>
            <AlertDialogTitle>حذف المحاضرة</AlertDialogTitle>
          <AlertDialogDescription>هل أنت متأكد من حذف هذه المحاضرة؟</AlertDialogDescription>
          </AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogFooter>
            <AlertDialogCancel>إلغاء</AlertDialogCancel>
            <AlertDialogAction onClick={confirmDeleteLecture} className="bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground hover:bg-destructive/90">حذف</AlertDialogAction>
          </AlertDialogFooter>
        </AlertDialogContent>
      </AlertDialog>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## 📝 الكود الكامل

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import {
  BookOpen, Plus, Pencil, Trash2, Search, AlertCircle, Calendar, Check,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from '@/components/ui/tabs';
import {
  Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogFooter,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import {
  Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue,
} from '@/components/ui/select';
import { useAppStore } from '@/lib/store';
import type { Homework } from '@/types';

const PRIORITY_CONFIG = {
  high: { label: 'عالية', color: 'bg-red-100 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-900/30 dark:text-red-400', icon: '🔴' },
  medium: { label: 'متوسطة', color: 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-900/30 dark:text-amber-400', icon: '🟡' },
  low: { label: 'منخفضة', color: 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-900/30 dark:text-emerald-400', icon: '🟢' },
};

type FilterTab = 'all' | 'active' | 'completed';

export function HomeworkSection() {
  const { homeworks, addHomework, updateHomework, deleteHomework, toggleHomework } = useAppStore();
  const [dialogOpen, setDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<Homework | null>(null);
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<FilterTab>('all');
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    subject: '',
    title: '',
    description: '',
    dueDate: '',
    priority: 'medium' as Homework['priority'],
    tags: [] as string[],
  });

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    return homeworks
      .filter((h) => {
        if (filter === 'active') return !h.completed;
        if (filter === 'completed') return h.completed;
        return true;
      })
      .filter((h) => {
        if (!searchQuery) return true;
        const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
        return h.title.toLowerCase().includes(q) || h.subject.toLowerCase().includes(q);
      })
      .sort((a, b) => {
        // غير المكتمل أولاً، ثم حسب dueDate
        if (a.completed !== b.completed) return a.completed ? 1 : -1;
        if (a.dueDate && b.dueDate) return new Date(a.dueDate).getTime() - new Date(b.dueDate).getTime();
        return 0;
      });
  }, [homeworks, filter, searchQuery]);

  const openNew = () => {
    setEditing(null);
    setForm({ subject: '', title: '', description: '', dueDate: '', priority: 'medium', tags: [] });
    setDialogOpen(true);
  };

  const openEdit = (hw: Homework) => {
    setEditing(hw);
    setForm({
      subject: hw.subject,
      title: hw.title,
      description: hw.description,
      dueDate: hw.dueDate ? hw.dueDate.split('T')[0] : '',
      priority: hw.priority,
      tags: hw.tags || [],
    });
    setDialogOpen(true);
  };

  const save = () => {
    if (!form.title.trim() || !form.subject.trim()) return;
    const data = {
      ...form,
      dueDate: form.dueDate ? new Date(form.dueDate).toISOString() : '',
    };
    if (editing) {
      updateHomework(editing.id, data);
    } else {
      addHomework(data);
    }
    setDialogOpen(false);
  };

  const formatDueDate = (dateStr: string): { text: string; isOverdue: boolean } => {
    if (!dateStr) return { text: '', isOverdue: false };
    try {
      const d = new Date(dateStr);
      const now = new Date();
      const diffMs = d.getTime() - now.getTime();
      const diffDays = Math.ceil(diffMs / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
      const isOverdue = diffDays < 0;
      if (diffDays === 0) return { text: 'اليوم', isOverdue: false };
      if (diffDays === 1) return { text: 'غداً', isOverdue: false };
      if (diffDays > 0 && diffDays <= 7) return { text: `بعد ${diffDays} أيام`, isOverdue: false };
      const formatted = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('ar-SA', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' }).format(d);
      return { text: formatted, isOverdue };
    } catch {
      return { text: dateStr, isOverdue: false };
    }
  };

  const totalCount = homeworks.length;
  const completedCount = homeworks.filter((h) => h.completed).length;
  const overdueCount = homeworks.filter((h) => {
    if (h.completed || !h.dueDate) return false;
    return new Date(h.dueDate) < new Date();
  }).length;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-indigo-100 dark:bg-indigo-900/30 flex items-center justify-center">
            <BookOpen className="w-5 h-5 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-lg font-bold text-foreground">الواجبات</h1>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              {completedCount} من {totalCount} مكتمل
              {overdueCount > 0 && ` · ${overdueCount} متأخر`}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <Button size="sm" onClick={openNew} className="gap-1.5">
          <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
          واجب جديد
        </Button>
      </div>

      {/* Filter + Search */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
        <Tabs value={filter} onValueChange={(v) => setFilter(v as FilterTab)}>
          <TabsList>
            <TabsTrigger value="all">الكل ({totalCount})</TabsTrigger>
            <TabsTrigger value="active">نشطة ({totalCount - completedCount})</TabsTrigger>
            <TabsTrigger value="completed">مكتملة ({completedCount})</TabsTrigger>
          </TabsList>
        </Tabs>
        <div className="relative flex-1 min-w-[200px]">
          <Search className="w-4 h-4 absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" />
          <Input
            value={searchQuery}
            onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="ابحث في الواجبات..."
            className="pr-10"
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* List */}
      {filtered.length === 0 ? (
        <Card>
          <CardContent className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-16 text-center">
            <BookOpen className="w-12 h-12 text-muted-foreground mb-3" />
            <p className="text-lg font-medium text-foreground">
              {homeworks.length === 0 ? 'لا توجد واجبات بعد' : 'لا توجد نتائج'}
            </p>
            {homeworks.length === 0 && (
              <Button onClick={openNew} className="mt-4 gap-2">
                <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
                إضافة واجب
              </Button>
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <AnimatePresence mode="popLayout">
            {filtered.map((hw) => {
              const due = formatDueDate(hw.dueDate);
              const priorityCfg = PRIORITY_CONFIG[hw.priority];
              return (
                <motion.div key={hw.id} layout initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -20 }}>
                  <Card className={`border bg-background ${hw.completed ? 'opacity-60' : ''} ${due.isOverdue && !hw.completed ? 'border-red-300 dark:border-red-700' : 'border-border'}`}>
                    <CardContent className="p-3 flex items-center gap-3">
                      <button
                        onClick={() => toggleHomework(hw.id)}
                        className={`w-5 h-5 rounded-md border-2 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 transition-colors ${hw.completed ? 'bg-emerald-500 border-emerald-500 text-white' : 'border-border hover:border-emerald-400'}`}
                      >
                        {hw.completed && <Check className="w-3 h-3" />}
                      </button>
                      <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                        <p className={`text-sm ${hw.completed ? 'line-through text-muted-foreground' : 'text-foreground'}`}>
                          {hw.title}
                        </p>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-1 flex-wrap">
                          <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[10px]">{hw.subject}</Badge>
                          <Badge variant="outline" className={`text-[10px] ${priorityCfg.color}`}>
                            {priorityCfg.icon} {priorityCfg.label}
                          </Badge>
                          {hw.dueDate && (
                            <span className={`text-[10px] flex items-center gap-1 ${due.isOverdue && !hw.completed ? 'text-red-500 font-bold' : 'text-muted-foreground'}`}>
                              {due.isOverdue && !hw.completed ? <AlertCircle className="w-3 h-3" /> : <Calendar className="w-3 h-3" />}
                              {due.text}
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </div>
                        {hw.description && (
                          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1 line-clamp-1">{hw.description}</p>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex gap-1 shrink-0">
                        <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-8 w-8" onClick={() => openEdit(hw)}>
                          <Pencil className="w-4 h-4" />
                        </Button>
                        <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-8 w-8 text-destructive" onClick={() => deleteHomework(hw.id)}>
                          <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                        </Button>
                      </div>
                    </CardContent>
                  </Card>
                </motion.div>
              );
            })}
          </AnimatePresence>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={dialogOpen} onOpenChange={setDialogOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-[500px]">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>{editing ? 'تعديل الواجب' : 'واجب جديد'}</DialogTitle>
          </DialogHeader>
          <div className="space-y-4 py-2 max-h-[60vh] overflow-y-auto">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>المادة *</Label>
                <Input value={form.subject} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, subject: e.target.value })} placeholder="مثلاً: فيزياء" />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>الأولوية</Label>
                <Select value={form.priority} onValueChange={(v) => setForm({ ...form, priority: v as Homework['priority'] })}>
                  <SelectTrigger><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectContent>
                    {(['high', 'medium', 'low'] as const).map((p) => (
                      <SelectItem key={p} value={p}>{PRIORITY_CONFIG[p].icon} {PRIORITY_CONFIG[p].label}</SelectItem>
                    ))}
                  </SelectContent>
                </Select>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>العنوان *</Label>
              <Input value={form.title} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, title: e.target.value })} placeholder="مثلاً: حل تمارين الفصل 5" />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>الوصف</Label>
              <Textarea value={form.description} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, description: e.target.value })} rows={2} />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>تاريخ التسليم</Label>
              <Input type="date" value={form.dueDate} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, dueDate: e.target.value })} />
            </div>
          </div>
          <DialogFooter>
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setDialogOpen(false)}>إلغاء</Button>
            <Button onClick={save} disabled={!form.title.trim() || !form.subject.trim()}>
              {editing ? 'حفظ' : 'إضافة'}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## 📝 الكود الكامل

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import {
  GraduationCap, Plus, Pencil, Trash2, Search, TrendingUp, Award,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import {
  Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogFooter,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { useAppStore } from '@/lib/store';
import type { Grade } from '@/types';

function getGradeColor(percentage: number): string {
  if (percentage >= 90) return 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400';
  if (percentage >= 75) return 'text-sky-600 dark:text-sky-400';
  if (percentage >= 60) return 'text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400';
  return 'text-red-600 dark:text-red-400';
}

function getGradeLabel(percentage: number): string {
  if (percentage >= 90) return 'ممتاز';
  if (percentage >= 75) return 'جيد جداً';
  if (percentage >= 60) return 'جيد';
  return 'مقبول';
}

export function GradesSection() {
  const { grades, addGrade, updateGrade, deleteGrade } = useAppStore();
  const [dialogOpen, setDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<Grade | null>(null);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    subject: '',
    testName: '',
    score: 0,
    maxScore: 100,
    date: '',
    notes: '',
  });

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    return grades
      .filter((g) => {
        if (!searchQuery) return true;
        const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
        return g.subject.toLowerCase().includes(q) || g.testName.toLowerCase().includes(q);
      })
      .sort((a, b) => new Date(b.date).getTime() - new Date(a.date).getTime());
  }, [grades, searchQuery]);

  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    if (grades.length === 0) return { average: 0, highest: 0, lowest: 0, count: 0 };
    const percentages = grades.map((g) => g.percentage);
    return {
      average: percentages.reduce((s, p) => s + p, 0) / percentages.length,
      highest: Math.max(...percentages),
      lowest: Math.min(...percentages),
      count: grades.length,
    };
  }, [grades]);

  const openNew = () => {
    setEditing(null);
    setForm({ subject: '', testName: '', score: 0, maxScore: 100, date: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0], notes: '' });
    setDialogOpen(true);
  };

  const openEdit = (grade: Grade) => {
    setEditing(grade);
    setForm({
      subject: grade.subject,
      testName: grade.testName,
      score: grade.score,
      maxScore: grade.maxScore,
      date: grade.date ? grade.date.split('T')[0] : '',
      notes: grade.notes,
    });
    setDialogOpen(true);
  };

  const save = () => {
    if (!form.subject.trim() || !form.testName.trim()) return;
    const data = {
      ...form,
      date: form.date ? new Date(form.date).toISOString() : new Date().toISOString(),
    };
    if (editing) {
      updateGrade(editing.id, data);
    } else {
      addGrade(data);
    }
    setDialogOpen(false);
  };

  const toArabicNum = (n: number) => n.toLocaleString('ar-SA', { maximumFractionDigits: 1 });

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-purple-100 dark:bg-purple-900/30 flex items-center justify-center">
            <GraduationCap className="w-5 h-5 text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-lg font-bold text-foreground">الدرجات</h1>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{grades.length} درجة مسجلة</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <Button size="sm" onClick={openNew} className="gap-1.5">
          <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
          درجة جديدة
        </Button>
      </div>

      {/* Stats */}
      {grades.length > 0 && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
          <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
            <CardContent className="p-3">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
                <TrendingUp className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-500" />
                <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">المعدل العام</span>
              </div>
              <p className={`text-xl font-bold ${getGradeColor(stats.average)}`}>
                {toArabicNum(stats.average)}%
              </p>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
          <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
            <CardContent className="p-3">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
                <Award className="w-4 h-4 text-sky-500" />
                <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">أعلى درجة</span>
              </div>
              <p className={`text-xl font-bold ${getGradeColor(stats.highest)}`}>
                {toArabicNum(stats.highest)}%
              </p>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
          <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
            <CardContent className="p-3">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
                <TrendingUp className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-500 rotate-180" />
                <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">أقل درجة</span>
              </div>
              <p className={`text-xl font-bold ${getGradeColor(stats.lowest)}`}>
                {toArabicNum(stats.lowest)}%
              </p>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Search */}
      <div className="relative">
        <Search className="w-4 h-4 absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" />
        <Input
          value={searchQuery}
          onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="ابحث في الدرجات..."
          className="pr-10"
        />
      </div>

      {/* List */}
      {filtered.length === 0 ? (
        <Card>
          <CardContent className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-16 text-center">
            <GraduationCap className="w-12 h-12 text-muted-foreground mb-3" />
            <p className="text-lg font-medium text-foreground">
              {grades.length === 0 ? 'لا توجد درجات بعد' : 'لا توجد نتائج'}
            </p>
            {grades.length === 0 && (
              <Button onClick={openNew} className="mt-4 gap-2">
                <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
                إضافة درجة
              </Button>
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <AnimatePresence mode="popLayout">
            {filtered.map((grade) => (
              <motion.div key={grade.id} layout initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -20 }}>
                <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
                  <CardContent className="p-3 flex items-center gap-3">
                    {/* Percentage Circle */}
                    <div className={`text-2xl font-bold ${getGradeColor(grade.percentage)} shrink-0 w-16 text-center`}>
                      {toArabicNum(grade.percentage)}%
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                      <p className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">{grade.testName}</p>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-1 flex-wrap">
                        <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[10px]">{grade.subject}</Badge>
                        <Badge variant="secondary" className={`text-[10px] ${getGradeColor(grade.percentage)}`}>
                          {getGradeLabel(grade.percentage)}
                        </Badge>
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                          {toArabicNum(grade.score)} / {toArabicNum(grade.maxScore)}
                        </span>
                        {grade.date && (
                          <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                            {new Intl.DateTimeFormat('ar-SA', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' }).format(new Date(grade.date))}
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      {grade.notes && (
                        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1 line-clamp-1">{grade.notes}</p>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex gap-1 shrink-0">
                      <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-8 w-8" onClick={() => openEdit(grade)}>
                        <Pencil className="w-4 h-4" />
                      </Button>
                      <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-8 w-8 text-destructive" onClick={() => deleteGrade(grade.id)}>
                        <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                      </Button>
                    </div>
                  </CardContent>
                </Card>
              </motion.div>
            ))}
          </AnimatePresence>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={dialogOpen} onOpenChange={setDialogOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-[500px]">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>{editing ? 'تعديل الدرجة' : 'درجة جديدة'}</DialogTitle>
          </DialogHeader>
          <div className="space-y-4 py-2 max-h-[60vh] overflow-y-auto">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>المادة *</Label>
                <Input value={form.subject} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, subject: e.target.value })} placeholder="مثلاً: برمجة" />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>اسم الاختبار *</Label>
                <Input value={form.testName} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, testName: e.target.value })} placeholder="مثلاً: اختبار منتصف الفصل" />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>الدرجة</Label>
                <Input
                  type="number"
                  value={form.score}
                  onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, score: parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0 })}
                />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>الدرجة الكاملة</Label>
                <Input
                  type="number"
                  value={form.maxScore}
                  onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, maxScore: parseFloat(e.target.value) || 100 })}
                />
              </div>
            </div>
            {form.maxScore > 0 && (
              <div className="text-center p-3 bg-muted/50 rounded-lg">
                <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">النسبة المئوية: </span>
                <span className={`text-lg font-bold ${getGradeColor((form.score / form.maxScore) * 100)}`}>
                  {toArabicNum((form.score / form.maxScore) * 100)}%
                </span>
                <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mr-2">
                  ({getGradeLabel((form.score / form.maxScore) * 100)})
                </span>
              </div>
            )}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>التاريخ</Label>
              <Input type="date" value={form.date} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, date: e.target.value })} />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>ملاحظات</Label>
              <Textarea value={form.notes} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, notes: e.target.value })} rows={2} />
            </div>
          </div>
          <DialogFooter>
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setDialogOpen(false)}>إلغاء</Button>
            <Button onClick={save} disabled={!form.subject.trim() || !form.testName.trim()}>
              {editing ? 'حفظ' : 'إضافة'}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </div>
  );
}
```
