```tsx
'use client';

// المشاريع الجامعية — University Projects UI

import { useState, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
import { v4 as uuid } from 'uuid';
import {
  FolderKanban, Plus, Pencil, Trash2, Search, Users, CheckSquare,
  Upload, Clock, Star, X, FileText, ExternalLink,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Progress } from '@/components/ui/progress';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogFooter, DialogDescription } from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import {
  AlertDialog, AlertDialogAction, AlertDialogCancel, AlertDialogContent,
  AlertDialogDescription, AlertDialogFooter, AlertDialogHeader, AlertDialogTitle,
} from '@/components/ui/alert-dialog';
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@/components/ui/select';
import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from '@/components/ui/tabs';
import { useAppStore } from '@/lib/store';
import { toast } from '@/hooks/use-toast';
import { UNIVERSITY_PROJECT_STATUS } from '@/types';
import type { UniversityProject } from '@/types';

type ProjectStatus = keyof typeof UNIVERSITY_PROJECT_STATUS;
const today = () => new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

function computeProgress(tasks: Array<{ completed: boolean }>): number {
  if (!tasks || tasks.length === 0) return 0;
  return Math.round((tasks.filter(t => t.completed).length / tasks.length) * 100);
}
function fmtDate(s: string): string {
  if (!s) return '';
  try { return new Date(s).toLocaleDateString('ar', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' }); }
  catch { return s; }
}

interface ProjectForm {
  title: string; description: string; courseId: string; status: ProjectStatus;
  startDate: string; endDate: string; grade: string; notes: string;
}
const emptyForm: ProjectForm = {
  title: '', description: '', courseId: '', status: 'planning',
  startDate: '', endDate: '', grade: '', notes: '',
};

// ============ Project Card ============
function ProjectCard({ project, courseName, onOpen, onEdit, onDelete }: {
  project: UniversityProject;
  courseName: string;
  onOpen: () => void;
  onEdit: (e: React.MouseEvent) => void;
  onDelete: (e: React.MouseEvent) => void;
}) {
  const status = UNIVERSITY_PROJECT_STATUS[project.status] || UNIVERSITY_PROJECT_STATUS.planning;
  const progress = computeProgress(project.tasks);
  const doneTasks = project.tasks.filter(t => t.completed).length;
  return (
    <Card className="group relative overflow-hidden cursor-pointer transition-all hover:shadow-md hover:border-primary/40" onClick={onOpen}>
      <div className={`absolute top-0 inset-x-0 h-1 ${status.color.split(' ')[0]}`} />
      <CardContent className="p-4 pt-5 space-y-3">
        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
          <div className="space-y-1 min-w-0 flex-1">
            <h3 className="font-semibold leading-tight line-clamp-1">{project.title || 'بدون عنوان'}</h3>
            {courseName && <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground line-clamp-1">{courseName}</p>}
          </div>
          <div className="flex gap-0.5 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity shrink-0">
            <Button size="icon" variant="ghost" className="h-7 w-7" onClick={onEdit} aria-label="تعديل"><Pencil className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /></Button>
            <Button size="icon" variant="ghost" className="h-7 w-7 text-destructive" onClick={onDelete} aria-label="حذف"><Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /></Button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <Badge className={`text-[10px] ${status.color}`}>{status.icon} {status.label}</Badge>
        <div className="space-y-1.5">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
            <span>التقدّم</span>
            <span className="tabular-nums">{progress}% · {doneTasks}/{project.tasks.length}</span>
          </div>
          <Progress value={progress} className="h-1.5" />
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground pt-2 border-t">
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1"><Users className="h-3 w-3" />{project.teamMembers.length}</span>
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1"><CheckSquare className="h-3 w-3" />{doneTasks}/{project.tasks.length}</span>
          {project.files.length > 0 && <span className="flex items-center gap-1"><FolderKanban className="h-3 w-3" />{project.files.length}</span>}
          {project.grade > 0 && <span className="flex items-center gap-1"><Star className="h-3 w-3 text-amber-500" />{project.grade}</span>}
          {project.endDate && <span className="flex items-center gap-1"><Clock className="h-3 w-3" />{fmtDate(project.endDate)}</span>}
        </div>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

export function UniversityProjectsSection() {
  const { universityProjects, addUniversityProject, updateUniversityProject, deleteUniversityProject, courses } = useAppStore();
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<string>('all');
  const [dialogOpen, setDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingId, setEditingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [form, setForm] = useState<ProjectForm>(emptyForm);
  const [detailId, setDetailId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [detailTab, setDetailTab] = useState('overview');
  const [deleteId, setDeleteId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [newTaskTitle, setNewTaskTitle] = useState('');
  const [newTaskAssignee, setNewTaskAssignee] = useState('');
  const [newMember, setNewMember] = useState({ name: '', role: '', contact: '' });
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const courseName = (id?: string | null) => courses.find(c => c.id === id)?.name || '';

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    const q = search.trim().toLowerCase();
    return universityProjects.filter(p => {
      if (statusFilter !== 'all' && p.status !== statusFilter) return false;
      if (!q) return true;
      const tags = Array.isArray(p.tags) ? p.tags.join(' ') : '';
      return [p.title, p.description, p.notes, tags].some(x => x?.toLowerCase().includes(q));
    });
  }, [universityProjects, search, statusFilter]);

  const detailProject = detailId ? universityProjects.find(p => p.id === detailId) : null;

  const openAdd = () => { setForm(emptyForm); setEditingId(null); setDialogOpen(true); };
  const openEdit = (project: UniversityProject) => {
    setForm({
      title: project.title, description: project.description,
      courseId: project.courseId || '', status: project.status,
      startDate: project.startDate ? project.startDate.slice(0, 10) : '',
      endDate: project.endDate ? project.endDate.slice(0, 10) : '',
      grade: project.grade ? String(project.grade) : '', notes: project.notes,
    });
    setEditingId(project.id); setDialogOpen(true);
  };
  const save = () => {
    if (!form.title.trim()) { toast({ title: 'العنوان مطلوب', variant: 'destructive' }); return; }
    const data = {
      title: form.title.trim(), description: form.description.trim(),
      courseId: form.courseId || null, status: form.status,
      startDate: form.startDate ? new Date(form.startDate).toISOString() : '',
      endDate: form.endDate ? new Date(form.endDate).toISOString() : '',
      grade: form.grade ? parseFloat(form.grade) : 0, notes: form.notes.trim(),
    };
    if (editingId) { updateUniversityProject(editingId, data); toast({ title: 'تم تحديث المشروع' }); }
    else {
      addUniversityProject({ ...data, teamMembers: [], progress: 0, tasks: [], files: [], tags: [] });
      toast({ title: 'تمت إضافة المشروع' });
    }
    setDialogOpen(false);
  };
  const confirmDelete = () => {
    if (!deleteId) return;
    deleteUniversityProject(deleteId);
    if (detailId === deleteId) setDetailId(null);
    setDeleteId(null);
    toast({ title: 'تم حذف المشروع' });
  };

  // Task handlers — keep progress in sync
  const addTask = () => {
    if (!detailProject || !newTaskTitle.trim()) return;
    const tasks = [...detailProject.tasks, { id: uuid(), title: newTaskTitle.trim(), completed: false, assignee: newTaskAssignee.trim() }];
    updateUniversityProject(detailProject.id, { tasks, progress: computeProgress(tasks) });
    setNewTaskTitle(''); setNewTaskAssignee('');
  };
  const toggleTask = (taskId: string) => {
    if (!detailProject) return;
    const tasks = detailProject.tasks.map(t => t.id === taskId ? { ...t, completed: !t.completed } : t);
    updateUniversityProject(detailProject.id, { tasks, progress: computeProgress(tasks) });
  };
  const deleteTask = (taskId: string) => {
    if (!detailProject) return;
    const tasks = detailProject.tasks.filter(t => t.id !== taskId);
    updateUniversityProject(detailProject.id, { tasks, progress: computeProgress(tasks) });
  };

  // Member handlers
  const addMember = () => {
    if (!detailProject || !newMember.name.trim()) return;
    const teamMembers = [...detailProject.teamMembers, { name: newMember.name.trim(), role: newMember.role.trim(), contact: newMember.contact.trim() }];
    updateUniversityProject(detailProject.id, { teamMembers });
    setNewMember({ name: '', role: '', contact: '' });
  };
  const removeMember = (idx: number) => {
    if (!detailProject) return;
    updateUniversityProject(detailProject.id, { teamMembers: detailProject.teamMembers.filter((_, i) => i !== idx) });
  };

  // File handlers — upload via /api/uploads
  const onFileChange = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file || !detailProject) return;
    setUploading(true);
    try {
      const fd = new FormData();
      fd.append('file', file);
      const res = await fetch('/api/uploads', { method: 'POST', body: fd });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error || 'فشل الرفع');
      const files = [...detailProject.files, { name: data.originalName || file.name, url: data.url, type: data.mimeType || file.type }];
      updateUniversityProject(detailProject.id, { files });
      toast({ title: 'تم رفع الملف' });
    } catch (err) {
      toast({ title: 'فشل رفع الملف', description: err instanceof Error ? err.message : '', variant: 'destructive' });
    } finally {
      setUploading(false);
      if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = '';
    }
  };
  const removeFile = (idx: number) => {
    if (!detailProject) return;
    updateUniversityProject(detailProject.id, { files: detailProject.files.filter((_, i) => i !== idx) });
  };

  const set = <K extends keyof ProjectForm>(k: K, v: ProjectForm[K]) => setForm(f => ({ ...f, [k]: v }));
  const renderField = (label: string, input: React.ReactNode, className = '') => (
    <div className={`space-y-1.5 ${className}`}><Label>{label}</Label>{input}</div>
  );

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 flex-wrap">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2"><FolderKanban className="h-5 w-5 text-primary" />المشاريع الجامعية</h2>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{universityProjects.length} مشروع · {universityProjects.filter(p => p.status === 'completed' || p.status === 'graded').length} مكتمل</p>
        </div>
        <Button onClick={openAdd}><Plus className="h-4 w-4 ml-1" />إضافة مشروع</Button>
      </div>

      {/* Toolbar */}
      <div className="flex gap-2 flex-wrap">
        <div className="relative flex-1 min-w-[200px]">
          <Search className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
          <Input placeholder="ابحث في المشاريع..." value={search} onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)} className="pr-9" />
        </div>
        <Select value={statusFilter} onValueChange={setStatusFilter}>
          <SelectTrigger className="w-[180px]"><SelectValue placeholder="كل الحالات" /></SelectTrigger>
          <SelectContent>
            <SelectItem value="all">كل الحالات</SelectItem>
            {Object.entries(UNIVERSITY_PROJECT_STATUS).map(([k, v]) => <SelectItem key={k} value={k}>{v.icon} {v.label}</SelectItem>)}
          </SelectContent>
        </Select>
      </div>

      {/* Grid */}
      {filtered.length === 0 ? (
        <Card><CardContent className="p-10 text-center text-muted-foreground">
          <FolderKanban className="h-10 w-10 mx-auto mb-2 opacity-40" />
          {universityProjects.length === 0 ? 'لا توجد مشاريع بعد. ابدأ بإضافة مشروع جديد.' : 'لا توجد نتائج مطابقة.'}
        </CardContent></Card>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
          {filtered.map(p => (
            <ProjectCard key={p.id} project={p} courseName={courseName(p.courseId)}
              onOpen={() => { setDetailId(p.id); setDetailTab('overview'); }}
              onEdit={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); openEdit(p); }}
              onDelete={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); setDeleteId(p.id); }}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Detail Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={!!detailProject} onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setDetailId(null)}>
        <DialogContent className="max-w-3xl max-h-[88vh] overflow-y-auto">
          {detailProject && (() => {
            const s = UNIVERSITY_PROJECT_STATUS[detailProject.status];
            const progress = computeProgress(detailProject.tasks);
            const doneTasks = detailProject.tasks.filter(t => t.completed).length;
            return (
              <>
                <DialogHeader>
                  <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                    <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                      <DialogTitle className="text-xl truncate">{detailProject.title || 'بدون عنوان'}</DialogTitle>
                      <DialogDescription className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 mt-1">
                        <span>{s.icon} {s.label}</span>
                        {detailProject.courseId && <span>· {courseName(detailProject.courseId)}</span>}
                        {detailProject.grade > 0 && <span>· <Star className="inline h-3 w-3 text-amber-500" /> {detailProject.grade}</span>}
                      </DialogDescription>
                    </div>
                    <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => { const p = detailProject; setDetailId(null); openEdit(p); }}><Pencil className="h-3.5 w-3.5 ml-1" />تعديل</Button>
                  </div>
                </DialogHeader>

                <Tabs value={detailTab} onValueChange={setDetailTab} className="w-full">
                  <TabsList className="grid w-full grid-cols-4">
                    <TabsTrigger value="overview">نظرة عامة</TabsTrigger>
                    <TabsTrigger value="tasks">المهام ({detailProject.tasks.length})</TabsTrigger>
                    <TabsTrigger value="team">الفريق ({detailProject.teamMembers.length})</TabsTrigger>
                    <TabsTrigger value="files">الملفات ({detailProject.files.length})</TabsTrigger>
                  </TabsList>

                  {/* Overview */}
                  <TabsContent value="overview" className="space-y-3 mt-4">
                    {detailProject.description && (
                      <div className="rounded-lg border p-3 space-y-1">
                        <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">الوصف</p>
                        <p className="text-sm whitespace-pre-wrap">{detailProject.description}</p>
                      </div>
                    )}
                    <div className="rounded-lg border p-3 space-y-2">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
                        <span className="text-muted-foreground">التقدّم الإجمالي</span>
                        <span className="font-bold tabular-nums">{progress}%</span>
                      </div>
                      <Progress value={progress} className="h-2" />
                      <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{doneTasks} من {detailProject.tasks.length} مهام مكتملة</p>
                    </div>
                    {detailProject.teamMembers.length > 0 && (
                      <div className="rounded-lg border p-3 space-y-2">
                        <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1.5"><Users className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />الفريق</p>
                        <div className="space-y-1.5">
                          {detailProject.teamMembers.map((m, i) => (
                            <div key={i} className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
                              <span className="font-medium">{m.name}</span>
                              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                                {m.role && <span>{m.role}</span>}
                                {m.contact && <span>· {m.contact}</span>}
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    )}
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                      {detailProject.startDate && <div className="rounded-lg border p-3"><p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-1">تاريخ البداية</p><p className="text-sm flex items-center gap-1"><Clock className="h-3 w-3" />{fmtDate(detailProject.startDate)}</p></div>}
                      {detailProject.endDate && <div className="rounded-lg border p-3"><p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-1">تاريخ التسليم</p><p className="text-sm flex items-center gap-1"><Clock className="h-3 w-3" />{fmtDate(detailProject.endDate)}</p></div>}
                    </div>
                    {detailProject.notes && (
                      <div className="rounded-lg border p-3 space-y-1">
                        <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">ملاحظات</p>
                        <p className="text-sm whitespace-pre-wrap">{detailProject.notes}</p>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </TabsContent>

                  {/* Tasks */}
                  <TabsContent value="tasks" className="space-y-3 mt-4">
                    <div className="flex gap-2 flex-wrap">
                      <Input placeholder="عنوان المهمة..." value={newTaskTitle} onChange={(e) => setNewTaskTitle(e.target.value)} className="flex-1 min-w-[150px]" onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && addTask()} />
                      <Input placeholder="المسؤول" value={newTaskAssignee} onChange={(e) => setNewTaskAssignee(e.target.value)} className="w-[140px]" onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && addTask()} />
                      <Button onClick={addTask} disabled={!newTaskTitle.trim()}><Plus className="h-4 w-4 ml-1" />إضافة</Button>
                    </div>
                    {detailProject.tasks.length === 0 ? (
                      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground text-center py-6">لا توجد مهام بعد</p>
                    ) : (
                      <div className="space-y-2 max-h-[40vh] overflow-y-auto pl-1">
                        {detailProject.tasks.map(t => (
                          <div key={t.id} className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-lg border p-2.5 hover:bg-muted/40 transition-colors">
                            <button type="button" onClick={() => toggleTask(t.id)}
                              className={`flex h-5 w-5 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded border-2 transition-colors ${t.completed ? 'border-emerald-500 bg-emerald-500 text-white' : 'border-muted-foreground/40 hover:border-emerald-500'}`}
                              aria-label={t.completed ? 'مكتملة' : 'غير مكتملة'}>{t.completed && <CheckSquare className="h-3 w-3" />}</button>
                            <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                              <p className={`text-sm leading-tight ${t.completed ? 'line-through text-muted-foreground' : ''}`}>{t.title}</p>
                              {t.assignee && <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{t.assignee}</p>}
                            </div>
                            <Button size="icon" variant="ghost" className="h-7 w-7 text-destructive shrink-0" onClick={() => deleteTask(t.id)} aria-label="حذف"><Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /></Button>
                          </div>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </TabsContent>

                  {/* Team */}
                  <TabsContent value="team" className="space-y-3 mt-4">
                    <div className="rounded-lg border p-3 space-y-2">
                      <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground">إضافة عضو</p>
                      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-2">
                        <Input placeholder="الاسم" value={newMember.name} onChange={(e) => setNewMember({ ...newMember, name: e.target.value })} onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && addMember()} />
                        <Input placeholder="الدور" value={newMember.role} onChange={(e) => setNewMember({ ...newMember, role: e.target.value })} onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && addMember()} />
                        <Input placeholder="التواصل" value={newMember.contact} onChange={(e) => setNewMember({ ...newMember, contact: e.target.value })} onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && addMember()} />
                      </div>
                      <Button size="sm" onClick={addMember} disabled={!newMember.name.trim()}><Plus className="h-3.5 w-3.5 ml-1" />إضافة عضو</Button>
                    </div>
                    {detailProject.teamMembers.length === 0 ? (
                      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground text-center py-6">لا يوجد أعضاء بعد</p>
                    ) : (
                      <div className="space-y-2">
                        {detailProject.teamMembers.map((m, i) => (
                          <div key={i} className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-lg border p-2.5">
                            <div className="flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-primary/10 text-primary text-xs font-bold">{m.name.slice(0, 1)}</div>
                            <div className="flex-1 min-w-0 space-y-0.5">
                              <p className="text-sm font-medium leading-tight">{m.name}</p>
                              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                                {m.role && <span>{m.role}</span>}
                                {m.contact && <span>· {m.contact}</span>}
                              </div>
                            </div>
                            <Button size="icon" variant="ghost" className="h-7 w-7 text-destructive shrink-0" onClick={() => removeMember(i)} aria-label="حذف"><Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /></Button>
                          </div>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </TabsContent>

                  {/* Files */}
                  <TabsContent value="files" className="space-y-3 mt-4">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()} disabled={uploading}>
                        <Upload className="h-4 w-4 ml-1" />{uploading ? 'جارٍ الرفع...' : 'رفع ملف'}
                      </Button>
                      <Input ref={fileInputRef} type="file" className="hidden" onChange={onFileChange} />
                    </div>
                    {detailProject.files.length === 0 ? (
                      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground text-center py-6">لا توجد ملفات بعد</p>
                    ) : (
                      <div className="space-y-2">
                        {detailProject.files.map((f, i) => (
                          <div key={i} className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-lg border p-2.5">
                            <FileText className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground shrink-0" />
                            <a href={f.url} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" className="flex-1 min-w-0 text-sm text-primary hover:underline truncate flex items-center gap-1">
                              <span className="truncate">{f.name}</span>
                              <ExternalLink className="h-3 w-3 shrink-0" />
                            </a>
                            {f.type && <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground shrink-0 hidden sm:inline">{f.type}</span>}
                            <Button size="icon" variant="ghost" className="h-7 w-7 text-destructive shrink-0" onClick={() => removeFile(i)} aria-label="حذف"><X className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /></Button>
                          </div>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </TabsContent>
                </Tabs>
              </>
            );
          })()}
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>

      {/* Add/Edit Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={dialogOpen} onOpenChange={setDialogOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="max-w-2xl max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>{editingId ? 'تعديل المشروع' : 'مشروع جديد'}</DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>أدخل تفاصيل المشروع الجامعي</DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>
          <div className="space-y-4 py-2">
            {renderField('العنوان *', <Input value={form.title} onChange={(e) => set('title', e.target.value)} placeholder="مثال: مشروع تخرّج" />)}
            {renderField('الوصف', <Textarea rows={3} value={form.description} onChange={(e) => set('description', e.target.value)} placeholder="وصف مختصر للمشروع..." />)}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              {renderField('المادة المرتبطة',
                <Select value={form.courseId || 'none'} onValueChange={(v) => set('courseId', v === 'none' ? '' : v)}>
                  <SelectTrigger><SelectValue placeholder="بدون" /></SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectContent>
                    <SelectItem value="none">بدون</SelectItem>
                    {courses.map(c => <SelectItem key={c.id} value={c.id}>{c.name}</SelectItem>)}
                  </SelectContent>
                </Select>)}
              {renderField('الحالة',
                <Select value={form.status} onValueChange={(v) => set('status', v as ProjectStatus)}>
                  <SelectTrigger><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectContent>
                    {Object.entries(UNIVERSITY_PROJECT_STATUS).map(([k, v]) => <SelectItem key={k} value={k}>{v.icon} {v.label}</SelectItem>)}
                  </SelectContent>
                </Select>)}
              {renderField('تاريخ البداية', <Input type="date" value={form.startDate} onChange={(e) => set('startDate', e.target.value)} />)}
              {renderField('تاريخ التسليم', <Input type="date" value={form.endDate} onChange={(e) => set('endDate', e.target.value)} />)}
              {renderField('الدرجة', <Input type="number" min={0} max={100} value={form.grade} onChange={(e) => set('grade', e.target.value)} placeholder="0-100" />)}
            </div>
            {renderField('ملاحظات', <Textarea rows={2} value={form.notes} onChange={(e) => set('notes', e.target.value)} placeholder="ملاحظات عامة..." />)}
          </div>
          <DialogFooter>
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setDialogOpen(false)}>إلغاء</Button>
            <Button onClick={save} disabled={!form.title.trim()}>{editingId ? 'حفظ' : 'إضافة'}</Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>

      {/* Delete Confirmation */}
      <AlertDialog open={!!deleteId} onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setDeleteId(null)}>
        <AlertDialogContent>
          <AlertDialogHeader>
            <AlertDialogTitle>حذف المشروع</AlertDialogTitle>
            <AlertDialogDescription>هل أنت متأكد؟ سيتم حذف المشروع وجميع مهامه وملفاته. لا يمكن التراجع.</AlertDialogDescription>
          </AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogFooter>
            <AlertDialogCancel>إلغاء</AlertDialogCancel>
            <AlertDialogAction onClick={confirmDelete} className="bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground hover:bg-destructive/90">حذف</AlertDialogAction>
          </AlertDialogFooter>
        </AlertDialogContent>
      </AlertDialog>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

// الموارد الأكاديمية — Academic Library UI

import { useState, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  FileText, Upload, Download, Search, Trash2, Plus, File, Filter,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogFooter, DialogDescription } from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import {
  AlertDialog, AlertDialogAction, AlertDialogCancel, AlertDialogContent,
  AlertDialogDescription, AlertDialogFooter, AlertDialogHeader, AlertDialogTitle,
} from '@/components/ui/alert-dialog';
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@/components/ui/select';
import { useAppStore } from '@/lib/store';
import { toast } from '@/hooks/use-toast';
import { RESOURCE_TYPES } from '@/types';
import type { AcademicResource } from '@/types';

type ResourceType = keyof typeof RESOURCE_TYPES;

// Format bytes → KB/MB
function formatSize(bytes: number): string {
  if (!bytes || bytes <= 0) return '—';
  if (bytes < 1024) return `${bytes} B`;
  if (bytes < 1024 * 1024) return `${(bytes / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB`;
  return `${(bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)} MB`;
}

// Format date
function fmtDate(s: string): string {
  if (!s) return '';
  try { return new Date(s).toLocaleDateString('ar', { year: 'numeric', month: 'short', day: 'numeric' }); }
  catch { return s; }
}

// Pick icon element based on mime type
function MimeIcon({ mime, className }: { mime: string; className?: string }) {
  if (!mime) return <File className={className} />;
  if (mime.startsWith('image/')) return <FileText className={className} />;
  if (mime === 'application/pdf') return <FileText className={className} />;
  return <File className={className} />;
}

interface ResourceForm {
  title: string; description: string; type: ResourceType;
  courseId: string; semester: string; tags: string;
  fileUrl: string; fileName: string; mimeType: string; fileSize: number;
}
const emptyForm: ResourceForm = {
  title: '', description: '', type: 'lecture',
  courseId: '', semester: '', tags: '',
  fileUrl: '', fileName: '', mimeType: '', fileSize: 0,
};

// ============ Resource Card ============
function ResourceCard({ resource, courseName, onDelete }: {
  resource: AcademicResource;
  courseName: string;
  onDelete: () => void;
}) {
  const typeInfo = RESOURCE_TYPES[resource.type] || RESOURCE_TYPES.other;
  return (
    <Card className="group relative overflow-hidden transition-all hover:shadow-md hover:border-primary/40">
      <CardContent className="p-4 space-y-3">
        <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
          <div className="flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-primary/10 text-primary">
            <MimeIcon mime={resource.mimeType} className="h-5 w-5" />
          </div>
          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 space-y-1">
            <h3 className="font-semibold leading-tight line-clamp-2">{resource.title || 'بدون عنوان'}</h3>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
              <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-[10px]">{typeInfo.icon} {typeInfo.label}</Badge>
              {courseName && <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[10px]">{courseName}</Badge>}
            </div>
          </div>
          <Button size="icon" variant="ghost" className="h-7 w-7 text-destructive opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity shrink-0" onClick={onDelete} aria-label="حذف">
            <Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
          </Button>
        </div>

        {resource.description && (
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground line-clamp-2">{resource.description}</p>
        )}

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground pt-1 border-t">
          {resource.fileSize > 0 && <span className="flex items-center gap-1"><File className="h-3 w-3" />{formatSize(resource.fileSize)}</span>}
          <span>{fmtDate(resource.createdAt)}</span>
          {resource.semester && <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[10px]">{resource.semester}</Badge>}
        </div>

        {resource.fileUrl && (
          <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="w-full h-8 text-xs" asChild>
            <a href={resource.fileUrl} download={resource.fileName || undefined} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">
              <Download className="h-3.5 w-3.5 ml-1" />تحميل الملف
            </a>
          </Button>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

export function AcademicLibrarySection() {
  const { academicResources, addAcademicResource, deleteAcademicResource, courses } = useAppStore();
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [typeFilter, setTypeFilter] = useState<string>('all');
  const [dialogOpen, setDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [form, setForm] = useState<ResourceForm>(emptyForm);
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);
  const [deleteId, setDeleteId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const courseName = (id?: string | null) => courses.find(c => c.id === id)?.name || '';

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    const q = search.trim().toLowerCase();
    return academicResources.filter(r => {
      if (typeFilter !== 'all' && r.type !== typeFilter) return false;
      if (!q) return true;
      const tags = Array.isArray(r.tags) ? r.tags.join(' ') : '';
      return [r.title, r.description, r.fileName, r.semester, tags].some(x => x?.toLowerCase().includes(q));
    });
  }, [academicResources, search, typeFilter]);

  const openAdd = () => { setForm(emptyForm); setDialogOpen(true); };

  const onFileChange = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    setUploading(true);
    try {
      const fd = new FormData();
      fd.append('file', file);
      const res = await fetch('/api/uploads', { method: 'POST', body: fd });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.error || 'فشل الرفع');
      setForm(f => ({
        ...f,
        fileUrl: data.url, fileName: data.originalName || file.name,
        mimeType: data.mimeType || file.type, fileSize: data.size || file.size,
        title: f.title || (data.originalName || file.name).replace(/\.[^.]+$/, ''),
      }));
      toast({ title: 'تم رفع الملف' });
    } catch (err) {
      toast({ title: 'فشل رفع الملف', description: err instanceof Error ? err.message : '', variant: 'destructive' });
    } finally {
      setUploading(false);
    }
  };

  const save = () => {
    if (!form.title.trim()) { toast({ title: 'العنوان مطلوب', variant: 'destructive' }); return; }
    if (!form.fileUrl) { toast({ title: 'الرجاء رفع ملف', variant: 'destructive' }); return; }
    const tags = form.tags.split(',').map(t => t.trim()).filter(Boolean);
    const data = {
      title: form.title.trim(), description: form.description.trim(), type: form.type,
      courseId: form.courseId || null, fileUrl: form.fileUrl, fileName: form.fileName,
      mimeType: form.mimeType, fileSize: form.fileSize, semester: form.semester.trim(), tags,
    };
    addAcademicResource(data);
    toast({ title: 'تمت إضافة المورد' });
    setDialogOpen(false);
  };

  const confirmDelete = () => {
    if (!deleteId) return;
    deleteAcademicResource(deleteId);
    setDeleteId(null);
    toast({ title: 'تم حذف المورد' });
  };

  const set = <K extends keyof ResourceForm>(k: K, v: ResourceForm[K]) => setForm(f => ({ ...f, [k]: v }));
  const renderField = (label: string, input: React.ReactNode, className = '') => (
    <div className={`space-y-1.5 ${className}`}><Label>{label}</Label>{input}</div>
  );

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 flex-wrap">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2"><FileText className="h-5 w-5" />المكتبة الأكاديمية</h2>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{academicResources.length} مورد · {formatSize(academicResources.reduce((s, r) => s + (r.fileSize || 0), 0))} إجمالي</p>
        </div>
        <Button onClick={openAdd}><Plus className="h-4 w-4 ml-1" />رفع مورد</Button>
      </div>

      {/* Toolbar */}
      <div className="flex gap-2 flex-wrap">
        <div className="relative flex-1 min-w-[200px]">
          <Search className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
          <Input placeholder="ابحث في العنوان أو الوصف أو الوسوم..." value={search} onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)} className="pr-9" />
        </div>
        <Select value={typeFilter} onValueChange={setTypeFilter}>
          <SelectTrigger className="w-[180px]">
            <Filter className="h-4 w-4 ml-1" />
            <SelectValue placeholder="كل الأنواع" />
          </SelectTrigger>
          <SelectContent>
            <SelectItem value="all">كل الأنواع</SelectItem>
            {Object.entries(RESOURCE_TYPES).map(([k, v]) => <SelectItem key={k} value={k}>{v.icon} {v.label}</SelectItem>)}
          </SelectContent>
        </Select>
      </div>

      {/* Grid */}
      {filtered.length === 0 ? (
        <Card><CardContent className="p-10 text-center text-muted-foreground">
          <FileText className="h-10 w-10 mx-auto mb-2 opacity-40" />
          {academicResources.length === 0 ? 'لا توجد موارد بعد. ابدأ برفع ملف جديد.' : 'لا توجد نتائج مطابقة.'}
        </CardContent></Card>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
          {filtered.map(r => (
            <ResourceCard key={r.id} resource={r} courseName={courseName(r.courseId)} onDelete={() => setDeleteId(r.id)} />
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Upload Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={dialogOpen} onOpenChange={setDialogOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="max-w-2xl max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>رفع مورد أكاديمي</DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>ارفع محاضرة أو بحثاً أو كتاباً أو ملخصاً واربطه بمادة.</DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            {renderField('العنوان *', <Input value={form.title} onChange={(e) => set('title', e.target.value)} placeholder="محاضرة 1: مقدمة" />)}
            {renderField('النوع',
              <Select value={form.type} onValueChange={(v) => set('type', v as ResourceType)}>
                <SelectTrigger><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  {Object.entries(RESOURCE_TYPES).map(([k, v]) => <SelectItem key={k} value={k}>{v.icon} {v.label}</SelectItem>)}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>)}
            {renderField('المادة المرتبطة',
              <Select value={form.courseId} onValueChange={(v) => set('courseId', v === 'none' ? '' : v)}>
                <SelectTrigger><SelectValue placeholder="بدون" /></SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  <SelectItem value="none">بدون</SelectItem>
                  {courses.map(c => <SelectItem key={c.id} value={c.id}>{c.name}</SelectItem>)}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>)}
            {renderField('الفصل الدراسي', <Input value={form.semester} onChange={(e) => set('semester', e.target.value)} placeholder="2024-1" />)}
            {renderField('الوسوم (افصل بفاصلة)', <Input value={form.tags} onChange={(e) => set('tags', e.target.value)} placeholder="مهم، مراجعة" />, 'sm:col-span-2')}
            {renderField('الوصف', <Textarea rows={2} value={form.description} onChange={(e) => set('description', e.target.value)} placeholder="وصف مختصر..." />, 'sm:col-span-2')}

            {/* File upload */}
            <div className="sm:col-span-2 space-y-1.5">
              <Label>الملف *</Label>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()} disabled={uploading}>
                  <Upload className="h-4 w-4 ml-1" />{uploading ? 'جارٍ الرفع...' : 'اختر ملفاً'}
                </Button>
                <Input ref={fileInputRef} type="file" className="hidden" onChange={onFileChange} />
                {form.fileName && (
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground min-w-0">
                    <File className="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0" />
                    <span className="truncate">{form.fileName}</span>
                    <span className="shrink-0">({formatSize(form.fileSize)})</span>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <DialogFooter>
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setDialogOpen(false)}>إلغاء</Button>
            <Button onClick={save} disabled={uploading || !form.fileUrl}>{uploading ? 'جارٍ الرفع...' : 'حفظ المورد'}</Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>

      {/* Delete confirm */}
      <AlertDialog open={!!deleteId} onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setDeleteId(null)}>
        <AlertDialogContent>
          <AlertDialogHeader>
            <AlertDialogTitle>تأكيد الحذف</AlertDialogTitle>
            <AlertDialogDescription>سيتم حذف المورد من المكتبة. لا يمكن التراجع.</AlertDialogDescription>
          </AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogFooter>
            <AlertDialogCancel>إلغاء</AlertDialogCancel>
            <AlertDialogAction onClick={confirmDelete} className="bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground hover:bg-destructive/90">حذف</AlertDialogAction>
          </AlertDialogFooter>
        </AlertDialogContent>
      </AlertDialog>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## 📝 الكود الكامل

```tsx
'use client';

// الجدول الذكي — Smart Schedule UI

import { useState, useMemo, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  Calendar, Clock, MapPin, Plus, Trash2, Search, Navigation, Check, X,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogFooter, DialogDescription } from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import {
  AlertDialog, AlertDialogAction, AlertDialogCancel, AlertDialogContent,
  AlertDialogDescription, AlertDialogFooter, AlertDialogHeader, AlertDialogTitle,
} from '@/components/ui/alert-dialog';
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@/components/ui/select';
import { useAppStore } from '@/lib/store';
import { toast } from '@/hooks/use-toast';
import { DAYS_OF_WEEK, EVENT_TYPES, COURSE_COLORS } from '@/types';
import type { ScheduleEvent, Course } from '@/types';

type EventType = keyof typeof EVENT_TYPES;
type AttendanceStatus = ScheduleEvent['attendanceStatus'];

const START_HOUR = 8;
const END_HOUR = 20;
const HOUR_PX = 56; // height per hour
const TOTAL_HEIGHT = (END_HOUR - START_HOUR) * HOUR_PX;
const HOURS = Array.from({ length: END_HOUR - START_HOUR + 1 }, (_, i) => START_HOUR + i);

const ATTENDANCE: Record<Exclude<AttendanceStatus, ''>, { label: string; cls: string; dot: string }> = {
  present: { label: 'حاضر', cls: 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-900/30 dark:text-emerald-400', dot: 'bg-emerald-500' },
  absent: { label: 'غائب', cls: 'bg-red-100 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-900/30 dark:text-red-400', dot: 'bg-red-500' },
  late: { label: 'متأخر', cls: 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-900/30 dark:text-amber-400', dot: 'bg-amber-500' },
  excused: { label: 'بعذر', cls: 'bg-sky-100 text-sky-700 dark:bg-sky-900/30 dark:text-sky-400', dot: 'bg-sky-500' },
};

// "HH:MM" → minutes since START_HOUR
function timeToMinutes(t: string): number {
  const [h, m] = (t || '00:00').split(':').map(Number);
  return h * 60 + (m || 0) - START_HOUR * 60;
}
function minutesToTime(min: number): string {
  const total = min + START_HOUR * 60;
  const h = Math.floor(total / 60);
  const m = total % 60;
  return `${String(h).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(m).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}
function nowTimeStr(): string {
  const d = new Date();
  return `${String(d.getHours()).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

function courseColor(courseId: string, courses: Course[], fallback: string): string {
  return courses.find(c => c.id === courseId)?.color || fallback || COURSE_COLORS[0];
}

interface EventForm {
  courseId: string; dayOfWeek: number; startTime: string; endTime: string;
  room: string; type: EventType; notes: string; recurring: boolean;
}
const emptyForm: EventForm = {
  courseId: '', dayOfWeek: 0, startTime: '08:00', endTime: '09:30',
  room: '', type: 'lecture', notes: '', recurring: true,
};

// ============ Event Block (inside grid) ============
function EventBlock({ event, courseName, isCurrent, onClick }: {
  event: ScheduleEvent;
  courseName: string;
  isCurrent: boolean;
  onClick: () => void;
}) {
  const startMin = timeToMinutes(event.startTime);
  const endMin = timeToMinutes(event.endTime);
  const top = (startMin / 60) * HOUR_PX;
  const height = Math.max(((endMin - startMin) / 60) * HOUR_PX, 22);
  const typeInfo = EVENT_TYPES[event.type] || EVENT_TYPES.lecture;
  const baseColor = event.color || typeInfo.color;
  const att = event.attendanceStatus ? ATTENDANCE[event.attendanceStatus] : null;
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={onClick}
      className={`absolute inset-x-1 rounded-md border-r-4 p-1.5 text-right transition-all hover:z-10 hover:shadow-md ${isCurrent ? 'ring-2 ring-primary ring-offset-1 z-10' : ''}`}
      style={{ top: `${top}px`, height: `${height}px`, backgroundColor: `${baseColor}22`, borderColor: baseColor }}
    >
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1 min-w-0">
        <span className="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full shrink-0" style={{ backgroundColor: baseColor }} />
        <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold truncate" style={{ color: baseColor }}>{typeInfo.icon} {courseName || 'حدث'}</span>
      </div>
      {height > 30 && (
        <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground truncate mt-0.5">{event.startTime} - {event.endTime}</p>
      )}
      {height > 45 && event.room && (
        <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground truncate flex items-center gap-0.5"><MapPin className="h-2.5 w-2.5" />{event.room}</p>
      )}
      {att && height > 45 && (
        <Badge variant="secondary" className={`text-[9px] h-4 px-1 mt-0.5 ${att.cls}`}>{att.label}</Badge>
      )}
    </button>
  );
}

export function SmartScheduleSection() {
  const { scheduleEvents, courses, addScheduleEvent, updateScheduleEvent, deleteScheduleEvent } = useAppStore();
  const [dialogOpen, setDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingId, setEditingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [form, setForm] = useState<EventForm>(emptyForm);
  const [deleteId, setDeleteId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [highlightId, setHighlightId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [tick, setTick] = useState(0); // re-render for "current event" detection
  const gridRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const dayRefs = useRef<(HTMLDivElement | null)[]>([]);

  // Re-render every minute so "current event" detection stays fresh
  useEffect(() => {
    const i = setInterval(() => setTick(t => t + 1), 60000);
    return () => clearInterval(i);
  }, []);

  const courseName = (id: string) => courses.find(c => c.id === id)?.name || '';

  // Filtered events by search
  const filteredEvents = useMemo(() => {
    const q = search.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!q) return scheduleEvents;
    return scheduleEvents.filter(e => {
      const cn = courses.find(c => c.id === e.courseId)?.name || '';
      return [cn, e.room, e.notes, e.startTime, e.endTime].some(x => x?.toLowerCase().includes(q));
    });
  }, [scheduleEvents, search, courses]);

  // Group by day for grid
  const eventsByDay = useMemo(() => {
    const map: ScheduleEvent[][] = Array.from({ length: 7 }, () => []);
    filteredEvents.forEach(e => { if (e.dayOfWeek >= 0 && e.dayOfWeek <= 6) map[e.dayOfWeek].push(e); });
    map.forEach(arr => arr.sort((a, b) => timeToMinutes(a.startTime) - timeToMinutes(b.startTime)));
    return map;
  }, [filteredEvents]);

  const todayIdx = new Date().getDay(); // 0=Sun
  const nowMin = timeToMinutes(nowTimeStr());
  const nowInRange = nowMin >= 0 && nowMin <= (END_HOUR - START_HOUR) * 60;

  const currentEvent = useMemo(() => {
    if (!nowInRange) return null;
    return scheduleEvents.find(e =>
      e.dayOfWeek === todayIdx &&
      timeToMinutes(e.startTime) <= nowMin &&
      timeToMinutes(e.endTime) > nowMin
    ) || null;
  }, [scheduleEvents, todayIdx, nowMin, nowInRange, tick]);

  // Stats
  const todayCount = scheduleEvents.filter(e => e.dayOfWeek === todayIdx).length;
  const weekCount = scheduleEvents.length;

  const openAdd = (dayIdx?: number) => {
    setForm({ ...emptyForm, dayOfWeek: dayIdx ?? todayIdx });
    setEditingId(null);
    setDialogOpen(true);
  };
  const openEdit = (e: ScheduleEvent) => {
    setForm({
      courseId: e.courseId, dayOfWeek: e.dayOfWeek, startTime: e.startTime, endTime: e.endTime,
      room: e.room, type: e.type, notes: e.notes, recurring: e.recurring,
    });
    setEditingId(e.id);
    setDialogOpen(true);
  };

  const save = () => {
    if (!form.courseId) { toast({ title: 'الرجاء اختيار المادة', variant: 'destructive' }); return; }
    if (timeToMinutes(form.endTime) <= timeToMinutes(form.startTime)) {
      toast({ title: 'وقت النهاية يجب أن يكون بعد البداية', variant: 'destructive' }); return;
    }
    const color = courseColor(form.courseId, courses, '');
    const data = {
      courseId: form.courseId, dayOfWeek: form.dayOfWeek, startTime: form.startTime, endTime: form.endTime,
      room: form.room.trim(), type: form.type, color, recurring: form.recurring,
      notes: form.notes.trim(), attendanceStatus: '' as AttendanceStatus,
    };
    if (editingId) { updateScheduleEvent(editingId, data); toast({ title: 'تم تحديث الحدث' }); }
    else { addScheduleEvent(data); toast({ title: 'تمت إضافة الحدث' }); }
    setDialogOpen(false);
  };

  const confirmDelete = () => {
    if (!deleteId) return;
    deleteScheduleEvent(deleteId);
    setDeleteId(null);
    toast({ title: 'تم حذف الحدث' });
  };

  const setAttendance = (id: string, status: AttendanceStatus) => {
    updateScheduleEvent(id, { attendanceStatus: status });
    toast({ title: 'تم تحديث الحالة' });
  };

  const scrollToToday = () => {
    const el = dayRefs.current[todayIdx];
    if (el) {
      el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', inline: 'center', block: 'nearest' });
      toast({ title: DAYS_OF_WEEK[todayIdx] });
    }
  };
  const findCurrent = () => {
    if (currentEvent) {
      setHighlightId(currentEvent.id);
      const el = dayRefs.current[todayIdx];
      if (el) el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', inline: 'center', block: 'nearest' });
      toast({ title: 'الحدث الحالي', description: courseName(currentEvent.courseId) });
    } else {
      toast({ title: 'لا يوجد حدث الآن', description: nowInRange ? 'وقتك حر حالياً' : 'خارج وقت الجدول' });
    }
  };

  const set = <K extends keyof EventForm>(k: K, v: EventForm[K]) => setForm(f => ({ ...f, [k]: v }));
  const renderField = (label: string, input: React.ReactNode, className = '') => (
    <div className={`space-y-1.5 ${className}`}><Label>{label}</Label>{input}</div>
  );

  const editingEvent = editingId ? scheduleEvents.find(e => e.id === editingId) : null;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 flex-wrap">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2"><Calendar className="h-5 w-5" />الجدول الأسبوعي</h2>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{weekCount} حدث · {todayCount} اليوم ({DAYS_OF_WEEK[todayIdx]})</p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex gap-2 flex-wrap">
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={scrollToToday}><Navigation className="h-4 w-4 ml-1" />اليوم</Button>
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={findCurrent}><MapPin className="h-4 w-4 ml-1" />أين أنا الآن؟</Button>
          <Button size="sm" onClick={() => openAdd()}><Plus className="h-4 w-4 ml-1" />إضافة حدث</Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Toolbar */}
      <div className="relative max-w-md">
        <Search className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
        <Input placeholder="ابحث في الأحداث..." value={search} onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)} className="pr-9" />
      </div>

      {/* Weekly grid */}
      <Card>
        <CardContent className="p-2 sm:p-4">
          <div ref={gridRef} className="overflow-x-auto">
            <div className="min-w-[760px]">
              {/* Day headers */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-[60px_repeat(7,1fr)] sticky top-0 z-20 bg-background pb-2">
                <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground text-center self-end">الساعة</div>
                {DAYS_OF_WEEK.map((day, idx) => (
                  <div key={day} className="text-center">
                    <div className={`text-xs font-medium ${idx === todayIdx ? 'text-primary' : 'text-foreground'}`}>{day}</div>
                    {idx === todayIdx && <div className="text-[10px] text-primary">اليوم</div>}
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>

              {/* Grid body */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-[60px_repeat(7,1fr)] relative">
                {/* Hour labels column */}
                <div className="relative" style={{ height: `${TOTAL_HEIGHT}px` }}>
                  {HOURS.map((h, i) => (
                    <div key={h} className="absolute right-0 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground -translate-y-1/2" style={{ top: `${i * HOUR_PX}px` }}>
                      <span className="block text-left pl-1" dir="ltr">{String(h).padStart(2, '0')}:00</span>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>

                {/* Day columns */}
                {DAYS_OF_WEEK.map((day, dayIdx) => (
                  <div
                    key={day}
                    ref={(el) => { dayRefs.current[dayIdx] = el; }}
                    className={`relative border-r border-muted/40 ${dayIdx === todayIdx ? 'bg-primary/5' : ''}`}
                    style={{ height: `${TOTAL_HEIGHT}px` }}
                  >
                    {/* hour lines */}
                    {HOURS.map((_, i) => (
                      <div key={i} className="absolute inset-x-0 border-t border-muted/20" style={{ top: `${i * HOUR_PX}px` }} />
                    ))}
                    {/* Add button overlay */}
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => openAdd(dayIdx)}
                      className="absolute inset-0 opacity-0 hover:opacity-100 hover:bg-primary/5 transition-opacity flex items-start justify-center pt-1"
                      aria-label={`إضافة حدث في ${day}`}
                    >
                      <Plus className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
                    </button>
                    {/* events */}
                    {eventsByDay[dayIdx].map(ev => (
                      <EventBlock
                        key={ev.id}
                        event={ev}
                        courseName={courseName(ev.courseId)}
                        isCurrent={currentEvent?.id === ev.id || highlightId === ev.id}
                        onClick={() => openEdit(ev)}
                      />
                    ))}
                  </div>
                ))}

                {/* Now line */}
                {nowInRange && (
                  <div className="absolute pointer-events-none" style={{ top: `${(nowMin / 60) * HOUR_PX}px`, right: 0, left: 0, height: 0 }}>
                    <div className="border-t-2 border-red-500 relative">
                      <span className="absolute -top-2 right-0 text-[9px] bg-red-500 text-white px-1 rounded" dir="ltr">{nowTimeStr()}</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* List view (compact) for small search results */}
      {search.trim() && filteredEvents.length > 0 && (
        <Card><CardContent className="p-3 space-y-2 max-h-72 overflow-y-auto">
          {filteredEvents.map(ev => (
            <div key={ev.id} className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm p-2 rounded hover:bg-muted/40 cursor-pointer" onClick={() => openEdit(ev)}>
              <span className="h-3 w-3 rounded-full shrink-0" style={{ backgroundColor: ev.color || (EVENT_TYPES[ev.type]?.color) }} />
              <span className="font-medium truncate">{courseName(ev.courseId)}</span>
              <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[10px]">{DAYS_OF_WEEK[ev.dayOfWeek]}</Badge>
              <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground" dir="ltr">{ev.startTime}-{ev.endTime}</span>
              {ev.room && <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-0.5"><MapPin className="h-3 w-3" />{ev.room}</span>}
            </div>
          ))}
        </CardContent></Card>
      )}

      {/* Add / Edit Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={dialogOpen} onOpenChange={setDialogOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="max-w-2xl max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>{editingId ? 'تعديل الحدث' : 'إضافة حدث جديد'}</DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>حدد المادة واليوم والوقت لإضافة الحدث للجدول.</DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            {renderField('المادة *',
              <Select value={form.courseId} onValueChange={(v) => set('courseId', v)}>
                <SelectTrigger><SelectValue placeholder="اختر المادة" /></SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  {courses.map(c => <SelectItem key={c.id} value={c.id}>{c.name}{c.code ? ` (${c.code})` : ''}</SelectItem>)}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>, 'sm:col-span-2')}
            {renderField('اليوم',
              <Select value={String(form.dayOfWeek)} onValueChange={(v) => set('dayOfWeek', Number(v))}>
                <SelectTrigger><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  {DAYS_OF_WEEK.map((d, i) => <SelectItem key={i} value={String(i)}>{d}</SelectItem>)}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>)}
            {renderField('النوع',
              <Select value={form.type} onValueChange={(v) => set('type', v as EventType)}>
                <SelectTrigger><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  {Object.entries(EVENT_TYPES).map(([k, v]) => <SelectItem key={k} value={k}>{v.icon} {v.label}</SelectItem>)}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>)}
            {renderField('وقت البداية', <Input type="time" dir="ltr" value={form.startTime} onChange={(e) => set('startTime', e.target.value)} />)}
            {renderField('وقت النهاية', <Input type="time" dir="ltr" value={form.endTime} onChange={(e) => set('endTime', e.target.value)} />)}
            {renderField('القاعة', <Input value={form.room} onChange={(e) => set('room', e.target.value)} placeholder="A-101" />)}
            {renderField('ملاحظات', <Textarea rows={2} value={form.notes} onChange={(e) => set('notes', e.target.value)} placeholder="ملاحظات..." />, 'sm:col-span-2')}
            <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm sm:col-span-2 cursor-pointer">
              <input type="checkbox" checked={form.recurring} onChange={(e) => set('recurring', e.target.checked)} className="h-4 w-4 rounded" />
              <span>حدث متكرر أسبوعياً</span>
            </label>
          </div>

          {/* Attendance status (only when editing) */}
          {editingEvent && (
            <div className="space-y-1.5 pt-2 border-t">
              <Label>حالة الحضور</Label>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                <Button size="sm" variant={editingEvent.attendanceStatus === 'present' ? 'default' : 'outline'} onClick={() => setAttendance(editingEvent.id, 'present')}>
                  <Check className="h-3.5 w-3.5 ml-1" />حاضر
                </Button>
                <Button size="sm" variant={editingEvent.attendanceStatus === 'absent' ? 'default' : 'outline'} onClick={() => setAttendance(editingEvent.id, 'absent')}>
                  <X className="h-3.5 w-3.5 ml-1" />غائب
                </Button>
                <Button size="sm" variant={editingEvent.attendanceStatus === 'late' ? 'default' : 'outline'} onClick={() => setAttendance(editingEvent.id, 'late')}>
                  <Clock className="h-3.5 w-3.5 ml-1" />متأخر
                </Button>
                <Button size="sm" variant={editingEvent.attendanceStatus === 'excused' ? 'default' : 'outline'} onClick={() => setAttendance(editingEvent.id, 'excused')}>
                  بعذر
                </Button>
                {editingEvent.attendanceStatus && (
                  <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setAttendance(editingEvent.id, '')}>مسح</Button>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          <DialogFooter className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 sm:justify-between">
            <div>
              {editingId && (
                <Button variant="ghost" className="text-destructive" onClick={() => { setDeleteId(editingId); setDialogOpen(false); }}>
                  <Trash2 className="h-4 w-4 ml-1" />حذف
                </Button>
              )}
            </div>
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setDialogOpen(false)}>إلغاء</Button>
              <Button onClick={save}>{editingId ? 'حفظ' : 'إضافة'}</Button>
            </div>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>

      {/* Delete confirm */}
      <AlertDialog open={!!deleteId} onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setDeleteId(null)}>
        <AlertDialogContent>
          <AlertDialogHeader>
            <AlertDialogTitle>تأكيد الحذف</AlertDialogTitle>
            <AlertDialogDescription>سيتم حذف الحدث من الجدول. لا يمكن التراجع.</AlertDialogDescription>
          </AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogFooter>
            <AlertDialogCancel>إلغاء</AlertDialogCancel>
            <AlertDialogAction onClick={confirmDelete} className="bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground hover:bg-destructive/90">حذف</AlertDialogAction>
          </AlertDialogFooter>
        </AlertDialogContent>
      </AlertDialog>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

// الدكاترة — Professor Directory UI

import { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  User, Mail, Phone, MapPin, Plus, Pencil, Trash2, Search, Star, Clock, FileText,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogFooter, DialogDescription } from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import {
  AlertDialog, AlertDialogAction, AlertDialogCancel, AlertDialogContent,
  AlertDialogDescription, AlertDialogFooter, AlertDialogHeader, AlertDialogTitle,
} from '@/components/ui/alert-dialog';
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@/components/ui/select';
import { useAppStore } from '@/lib/store';
import { toast } from '@/hooks/use-toast';
import type { Professor } from '@/types';

const RECO_STATUS: Record<Professor['recommendationStatus'], { label: string; cls: string }> = {
  none: { label: 'اطلب توصية', cls: 'bg-muted text-muted-foreground' },
  requested: { label: 'تم الطلب', cls: 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-900/30 dark:text-amber-400' },
  received: { label: 'وصلت التوصية', cls: 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-900/30 dark:text-emerald-400' },
};

const today = () => new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

interface ProfessorForm {
  name: string; title: string; email: string; phone: string; office: string;
  department: string; notes: string; rating: number;
  recommendationStatus: Professor['recommendationStatus']; recommendationDate: string; lastContact: string;
}
const emptyForm: ProfessorForm = {
  name: '', title: '', email: '', phone: '', office: '', department: '', notes: '',
  rating: 0, recommendationStatus: 'none', recommendationDate: '', lastContact: '',
};

// ============ Star rating input ============
function StarInput({ value, onChange }: { value: number; onChange: (v: number) => void }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-1" dir="ltr">
      {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((n) => (
        <button key={n} type="button" onClick={() => onChange(value === n ? 0 : n)} aria-label={`${n} نجوم`}>
          <Star className={`h-6 w-6 transition-colors ${n <= value ? 'fill-amber-400 text-amber-400' : 'text-muted-foreground/40 hover:text-amber-400'}`} />
        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

// ============ Star rating display ============
function Stars({ value }: { value: number }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5" dir="ltr" aria-label={`${value} من 5`}>
      {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((n) => (
        <Star key={n} className={`h-3.5 w-3.5 ${n <= value ? 'fill-amber-400 text-amber-400' : 'text-muted-foreground/30'}`} />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

// ============ Professor Card ============
function ProfessorCard({ prof, onEdit, onDelete, onContact, onUpdateLastContact }: {
  prof: Professor;
  onEdit: () => void;
  onDelete: () => void;
  onContact: () => void;
  onUpdateLastContact: (date: string) => void;
}) {
  const reco = RECO_STATUS[prof.recommendationStatus] || RECO_STATUS.none;
  return (
    <Card className="group relative overflow-hidden transition-all hover:shadow-md hover:border-primary/40">
      <CardContent className="p-4 space-y-3">
        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
          <div className="flex items-start gap-3 min-w-0 flex-1">
            <div className="mt-0.5 flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-primary/10 text-primary">
              <User className="h-5 w-5" />
            </div>
            <div className="min-w-0 space-y-1">
              <h3 className="font-semibold leading-tight truncate">{prof.name || 'بدون اسم'}</h3>
              {prof.title && <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground truncate">{prof.title}</p>}
              {prof.department && <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-[10px]">{prof.department}</Badge>}
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="flex gap-0.5 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity shrink-0">
            <Button size="icon" variant="ghost" className="h-7 w-7" onClick={onEdit} aria-label="تعديل"><Pencil className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /></Button>
            <Button size="icon" variant="ghost" className="h-7 w-7 text-destructive" onClick={onDelete} aria-label="حذف"><Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /></Button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <Stars value={prof.rating} />
          <Badge className={`text-[10px] ${reco.cls}`} variant="secondary">{reco.label}</Badge>
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          {prof.email && (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 truncate"><Mail className="h-3 w-3 shrink-0" /><span className="truncate" dir="ltr">{prof.email}</span></div>
          )}
          {prof.phone && (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 truncate"><Phone className="h-3 w-3 shrink-0" /><span className="truncate" dir="ltr">{prof.phone}</span></div>
          )}
          {prof.office && (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 truncate"><MapPin className="h-3 w-3 shrink-0" /><span className="truncate">{prof.office}</span></div>
          )}
        </div>

        {prof.notes && (
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground line-clamp-2 flex items-start gap-1.5">
            <FileText className="h-3 w-3 shrink-0 mt-0.5" /><span className="line-clamp-2">{prof.notes}</span>
          </p>
        )}

        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 pt-1 border-t">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            <Clock className="h-3 w-3" />
            <span>آخر تواصل:</span>
            <Input
              type="date" value={prof.lastContact || ''} onChange={(e) => onUpdateLastContact(e.target.value)}
              className="h-7 w-[130px] text-xs px-1.5"
            />
          </div>
          <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="h-7 text-xs" onClick={onContact} disabled={!prof.email}>
            <Mail className="h-3 w-3 ml-1" />تواصل
          </Button>
        </div>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

export function ProfessorsSection() {
  const { professors, addProfessor, updateProfessor, deleteProfessor } = useAppStore();
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [deptFilter, setDeptFilter] = useState('all');
  const [dialogOpen, setDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingId, setEditingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [form, setForm] = useState<ProfessorForm>(emptyForm);
  const [deleteId, setDeleteId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const departments = useMemo(() => {
    const set = new Set<string>();
    professors.forEach(p => p.department && set.add(p.department));
    return Array.from(set).sort();
  }, [professors]);

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    const q = search.trim().toLowerCase();
    return professors.filter(p => {
      if (deptFilter !== 'all' && p.department !== deptFilter) return false;
      if (!q) return true;
      return [p.name, p.title, p.email, p.phone, p.office, p.department, p.notes].some(x => x?.toLowerCase().includes(q));
    });
  }, [professors, search, deptFilter]);

  const openAdd = () => { setForm(emptyForm); setEditingId(null); setDialogOpen(true); };
  const openEdit = (p: Professor) => {
    setForm({
      name: p.name, title: p.title, email: p.email, phone: p.phone, office: p.office,
      department: p.department, notes: p.notes, rating: p.rating,
      recommendationStatus: p.recommendationStatus, recommendationDate: p.recommendationDate || '', lastContact: p.lastContact || '',
    });
    setEditingId(p.id); setDialogOpen(true);
  };

  const save = () => {
    if (!form.name.trim()) { toast({ title: 'اسم الدكتور مطلوب', variant: 'destructive' }); return; }
    const data = {
      name: form.name.trim(), title: form.title.trim(), email: form.email.trim(), phone: form.phone.trim(),
      office: form.office.trim(), department: form.department.trim(), notes: form.notes.trim(), rating: form.rating,
      recommendationStatus: form.recommendationStatus, recommendationDate: form.recommendationDate,
      lastContact: form.lastContact,
      consultationHours: [] as Array<{ day: string; startTime: string; endTime: string }>,
      courses: [] as string[], tags: [] as string[],
    };
    if (editingId) { updateProfessor(editingId, data); toast({ title: 'تم تحديث بيانات الدكتور' }); }
    else { addProfessor(data); toast({ title: 'تمت إضافة الدكتور' }); }
    setDialogOpen(false);
  };

  const confirmDelete = () => {
    if (!deleteId) return;
    deleteProfessor(deleteId);
    setDeleteId(null);
    toast({ title: 'تم حذف الدكتور' });
  };

  const contact = (p: Professor) => {
    if (!p.email) return;
    const subject = encodeURIComponent('تواصل بخصوص المادة');
    window.open(`mailto:${p.email}?subject=${subject}`, '_blank');
    updateProfessor(p.id, { lastContact: today() });
    toast({ title: 'تم تسجيل التواصل' });
  };

  const updateLastContact = (id: string, date: string) => updateProfessor(id, { lastContact: date });

  const set = <K extends keyof ProfessorForm>(k: K, v: ProfessorForm[K]) => setForm(f => ({ ...f, [k]: v }));
  const renderField = (label: string, input: React.ReactNode, className = '') => (
    <div className={`space-y-1.5 ${className}`}><Label>{label}</Label>{input}</div>
  );

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 flex-wrap">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2"><User className="h-5 w-5" />الدكاترة</h2>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{professors.length} دكتور · {departments.length} قسم</p>
        </div>
        <Button onClick={openAdd}><Plus className="h-4 w-4 ml-1" />إضافة دكتور</Button>
      </div>

      {/* Toolbar */}
      <div className="flex gap-2 flex-wrap">
        <div className="relative flex-1 min-w-[200px]">
          <Search className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
          <Input placeholder="ابحث بالاسم أو البريد أو القسم..." value={search} onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)} className="pr-9" />
        </div>
        <Select value={deptFilter} onValueChange={setDeptFilter}>
          <SelectTrigger className="w-[180px]"><SelectValue placeholder="كل الأقسام" /></SelectTrigger>
          <SelectContent>
            <SelectItem value="all">كل الأقسام</SelectItem>
            {departments.map(d => <SelectItem key={d} value={d}>{d}</SelectItem>)}
          </SelectContent>
        </Select>
      </div>

      {/* Grid */}
      {filtered.length === 0 ? (
        <Card><CardContent className="p-10 text-center text-muted-foreground">
          <User className="h-10 w-10 mx-auto mb-2 opacity-40" />
          {professors.length === 0 ? 'لا يوجد دكاترة بعد. ابدأ بإضافة دكتور جديد.' : 'لا توجد نتائج مطابقة.'}
        </CardContent></Card>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
          {filtered.map(p => (
            <ProfessorCard
              key={p.id} prof={p}
              onEdit={() => openEdit(p)}
              onDelete={() => setDeleteId(p.id)}
              onContact={() => contact(p)}
              onUpdateLastContact={(date) => updateLastContact(p.id, date)}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Add / Edit Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={dialogOpen} onOpenChange={setDialogOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="max-w-2xl max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>{editingId ? 'تعديل بيانات الدكتور' : 'إضافة دكتور جديد'}</DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>أدخل بيانات الدكتور الأكاديمي ومعلومات التواصل.</DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            {renderField('الاسم *', <Input value={form.name} onChange={(e) => set('name', e.target.value)} placeholder="د. محمد أحمد" />)}
            {renderField('اللقب العلمي', <Input value={form.title} onChange={(e) => set('title', e.target.value)} placeholder="أستاذ مشارك" />)}
            {renderField('البريد الإلكتروني', <Input type="email" dir="ltr" value={form.email} onChange={(e) => set('email', e.target.value)} placeholder="name@uni.edu" />)}
            {renderField('رقم الهاتف', <Input dir="ltr" value={form.phone} onChange={(e) => set('phone', e.target.value)} placeholder="+970..." />)}
            {renderField('المكتب', <Input value={form.office} onChange={(e) => set('office', e.target.value)} placeholder="مبنى أ - طابق 2" />)}
            {renderField('القسم', <Input value={form.department} onChange={(e) => set('department', e.target.value)} placeholder="علوم الحاسوب" />)}
            {renderField('حالة التوصية',
              <Select value={form.recommendationStatus} onValueChange={(v) => set('recommendationStatus', v as Professor['recommendationStatus'])}>
                <SelectTrigger><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  <SelectItem value="none">اطلب توصية</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="requested">تم الطلب</SelectItem>
                  <SelectItem value="received">وصلت التوصية</SelectItem>
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>)}
            {renderField('تاريخ التوصية', <Input type="date" value={form.recommendationDate} onChange={(e) => set('recommendationDate', e.target.value)} />)}
            {renderField('آخر تواصل', <Input type="date" value={form.lastContact} onChange={(e) => set('lastContact', e.target.value)} />)}
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label>التقييم</Label>
              <StarInput value={form.rating} onChange={(v) => set('rating', v)} />
            </div>
            {renderField('ملاحظات', <Textarea rows={3} value={form.notes} onChange={(e) => set('notes', e.target.value)} placeholder="ملاحظات حول الدكتور..." />, 'sm:col-span-2')}
          </div>
          <DialogFooter>
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setDialogOpen(false)}>إلغاء</Button>
            <Button onClick={save}>{editingId ? 'حفظ' : 'إضافة'}</Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>

      {/* Delete confirm */}
      <AlertDialog open={!!deleteId} onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setDeleteId(null)}>
        <AlertDialogContent>
          <AlertDialogHeader>
            <AlertDialogTitle>تأكيد الحذف</AlertDialogTitle>
            <AlertDialogDescription>سيتم حذف بيانات الدكتور نهائياً. لا يمكن التراجع عن هذا الإجراء.</AlertDialogDescription>
          </AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogFooter>
            <AlertDialogCancel>إلغاء</AlertDialogCancel>
            <AlertDialogAction onClick={confirmDelete} className="bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground hover:bg-destructive/90">حذف</AlertDialogAction>
          </AlertDialogFooter>
        </AlertDialogContent>
      </AlertDialog>
    </div>
  );
}
```
