```tsx
'use client';

import { useState, useEffect, useRef, useMemo, useCallback } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { Clock, Play, Square, Plus, Trash2, Timer } from 'lucide-react';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogTrigger, DialogFooter, DialogClose } from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@/components/ui/select';
import { useAppStore } from '@/lib/store';
import { WORK_SESSION_CATEGORIES, type WorkSession } from '@/types';

type FilterTab = 'all' | WorkSession['category'];

const FILTER_TABS: { key: FilterTab; label: string }[] = [
  { key: 'all', label: 'الكل' },
  { key: 'project', label: 'مشروع' },
  { key: 'study', label: 'دراسة' },
  { key: 'work', label: 'عمل' },
  { key: 'volunteer', label: 'تطوع' },
  { key: 'other', label: 'أخرى' },
];

function formatDuration(minutes: number): string {
  if (minutes >= 60) {
    const h = Math.floor(minutes / 60);
    const m = Math.round(minutes % 60);
    return `${h}h ${m}m`;
  }
  return `${Math.round(minutes)}m`;
}

function formatTimerDisplay(ms: number): string {
  const totalSeconds = Math.floor(ms / 1000);
  const h = Math.floor(totalSeconds / 3600);
  const m = Math.floor((totalSeconds % 3600) / 60);
  const s = totalSeconds % 60;
  const pad = (n: number) => n.toString().padStart(2, '0');
  return `${pad(h)}:${pad(m)}:${pad(s)}`;
}

function formatHoursMinutes(minutes: number): string {
  const h = Math.floor(minutes / 60);
  const m = Math.round(minutes % 60);
  if (h === 0) return `${m}د`;
  if (m === 0) return `${h}س`;
  return `${h}س ${m}د`;
}

function toArabicNum(n: number): string {
  return n.toLocaleString('ar-SA');
}

export function WorkHoursSection() {
  const { workSessions, projects, addWorkSession, updateWorkSession, deleteWorkSession } = useAppStore();

  // Timer state
  const [timerTitle, setTimerTitle] = useState('');
  const [timerCategory, setTimerCategory] = useState<WorkSession['category']>('project');
  const [timerProjectId, setTimerProjectId] = useState('');
  const [elapsedMs, setElapsedMs] = useState(0);
  const intervalRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null>(null);
  const startTimeRef = useRef<string>('');

  // Manual add dialog
  const [manualOpen, setManualOpen] = useState(false);
  const [manualTitle, setManualTitle] = useState('');
  const [manualDesc, setManualDesc] = useState('');
  const [manualCategory, setManualCategory] = useState<WorkSession['category']>('project');
  const [manualProjectId, setManualProjectId] = useState('');
  const [manualDate, setManualDate] = useState(new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]);
  const [manualStartTime, setManualStartTime] = useState('09:00');
  const [manualEndTime, setManualEndTime] = useState('10:00');

  // Filter
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<FilterTab>('all');

  // Active session
  const activeSession = useMemo(
    () => workSessions.find((s) => !s.endedAt),
    [workSessions]
  );

  // Completed sessions sorted by start time
  const completedSessions = useMemo(
    () => [...workSessions].filter((s) => s.endedAt).sort((a, b) => new Date(b.startedAt).getTime() - new Date(a.startedAt).getTime()),
    [workSessions]
  );

  // Filtered sessions
  const filteredSessions = useMemo(() => {
    const allSorted = [...workSessions].sort((a, b) => {
      // Active sessions first
      if (!a.endedAt && b.endedAt) return -1;
      if (a.endedAt && !b.endedAt) return 1;
      return new Date(b.startedAt).getTime() - new Date(a.startedAt).getTime();
    });
    if (filter === 'all') return allSorted;
    return allSorted.filter((s) => s.category === filter);
  }, [workSessions, filter]);

  // Stats
  const now = new Date();
  const todayStr = now.toISOString().split('T')[0];

  const todayMinutes = useMemo(() => {
    return workSessions
      .filter((s) => {
        if (s.endedAt) return s.startedAt.startsWith(todayStr);
        return s.startedAt.startsWith(todayStr);
      })
      .reduce((sum, s) => {
        if (s.endedAt) return sum + s.durationMinutes;
        return sum + (Date.now() - new Date(s.startedAt).getTime()) / 60000;
      }, 0);
  }, [workSessions, todayStr]);

  const weekMinutes = useMemo(() => {
    const startOfWeek = new Date(now);
    const day = startOfWeek.getDay();
    startOfWeek.setDate(startOfWeek.getDate() - (day === 0 ? 6 : day - 1));
    startOfWeek.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    const startMs = startOfWeek.getTime();
    return workSessions.reduce((sum, s) => {
      const sTime = new Date(s.startedAt).getTime();
      if (sTime < startMs) return sum;
      if (s.endedAt) return sum + s.durationMinutes;
      return sum + (Date.now() - sTime) / 60000;
    }, 0);
  }, [workSessions, now]);

  const totalMinutes = useMemo(() => {
    return workSessions.reduce((sum, s) => sum + s.durationMinutes, 0);
  }, [workSessions]);

  const totalSessions = workSessions.length;

  // Timer effect — uses refs so it survives re-renders
  useEffect(() => {
    if (activeSession) {
      startTimeRef.current = activeSession.startedAt;
      setTimerTitle(activeSession.title);
      setTimerCategory(activeSession.category);
      setTimerProjectId(activeSession.projectId || '');

      // Calculate initial elapsed
      const calcElapsed = () => Date.now() - new Date(startTimeRef.current).getTime();
      setElapsedMs(calcElapsed());

      intervalRef.current = setInterval(() => {
        setElapsedMs(calcElapsed());
      }, 1000);
    } else {
      if (intervalRef.current) {
        clearInterval(intervalRef.current);
        intervalRef.current = null;
      }
      setElapsedMs(0);
    }

    return () => {
      if (intervalRef.current) {
        clearInterval(intervalRef.current);
        intervalRef.current = null;
      }
    };
  }, [activeSession]);

  // Auto-calculate manual duration
  const manualDurationMinutes = useMemo(() => {
    if (!manualDate || !manualStartTime || !manualEndTime) return 0;
    const start = new Date(`${manualDate}T${manualStartTime}`);
    const end = new Date(`${manualDate}T${manualEndTime}`);
    if (isNaN(start.getTime()) || isNaN(end.getTime()) || end <= start) return 0;
    return Math.round((end.getTime() - start.getTime()) / 60000);
  }, [manualDate, manualStartTime, manualEndTime]);

  const handleStartTimer = useCallback(() => {
    if (!timerTitle.trim()) return;
    addWorkSession({
      title: timerTitle.trim(),
      description: '',
      category: timerCategory,
      projectId: timerProjectId || undefined,
      startedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      endedAt: undefined,
      durationMinutes: 0,
    });
  }, [timerTitle, timerCategory, timerProjectId, addWorkSession]);

  const handleStopTimer = useCallback(() => {
    if (!activeSession) return;
    const endTime = new Date();
    const durationMs = endTime.getTime() - new Date(activeSession.startedAt).getTime();
    const durationMin = Math.round(durationMs / 60000);
    updateWorkSession(activeSession.id, {
      endedAt: endTime.toISOString(),
      durationMinutes: durationMin,
    });
  }, [activeSession, updateWorkSession]);

  const handleAddManual = useCallback(() => {
    if (!manualTitle.trim() || manualDurationMinutes <= 0) return;
    const startedAt = new Date(`${manualDate}T${manualStartTime}:00`).toISOString();
    const endedAt = new Date(`${manualDate}T${manualEndTime}:00`).toISOString();
    addWorkSession({
      title: manualTitle.trim(),
      description: manualDesc.trim(),
      category: manualCategory,
      projectId: manualProjectId || undefined,
      startedAt,
      endedAt,
      durationMinutes: manualDurationMinutes,
    });
    setManualTitle('');
    setManualDesc('');
    setManualCategory('project');
    setManualProjectId('');
    setManualDate(new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]);
    setManualStartTime('09:00');
    setManualEndTime('10:00');
    setManualOpen(false);
  }, [manualTitle, manualDesc, manualCategory, manualProjectId, manualDate, manualStartTime, manualEndTime, manualDurationMinutes, addWorkSession]);

  const getProjectName = (id?: string) => {
    if (!id) return null;
    const p = projects.find((pr) => pr.id === id);
    return p ? p.title : null;
  };

  const formatSessionDate = (dateStr: string) => {
    const d = new Date(dateStr);
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('ar-SA', {
      month: 'short',
      day: 'numeric',
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit',
    }).format(d);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-violet-100 dark:bg-violet-900/30 flex items-center justify-center">
            <Clock className="w-5 h-5 text-violet-600 dark:text-violet-400" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-lg font-bold text-foreground">ساعات العمل</h1>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">تتبع وقتك واستثمره بذكاء</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <Dialog open={manualOpen} onOpenChange={setManualOpen}>
          <DialogTrigger asChild>
            <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="gap-1.5">
              <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
              إضافة يدوية
            </Button>
          </DialogTrigger>
          <DialogContent>
            <DialogHeader>
              <DialogTitle>إضافة جلسة عمل يدوياً</DialogTitle>
            </DialogHeader>
            <div className="space-y-4 py-2">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>العنوان</Label>

        <CardContent className="p-4">

            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="space-y-2 max-h-96 overflow-y-auto">
              <AnimatePresence mode="popLayout">
                {filteredSessions.map((session) => {
                  const catInfo = WORK_SESSION_CATEGORIES[session.category];
                  const projectName = getProjectName(session.projectId);
                  const isActive = !session.endedAt;

                  return (
                    <motion.div
                      key={session.id}
                      layout
                      initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }}
                      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                      exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -20 }}
                      className={`flex items-center gap-3 p-3 rounded-lg transition-colors ${
                        isActive ? 'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-900/20 border border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800/40' : 'hover:bg-muted'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {/* Active indicator */}
                      <div className="shrink-0">
                        {isActive ? (
                          <motion.div
                            className="w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-emerald-500"
                            animate={{ scale: [1, 1.4, 1], opacity: [1, 0.5, 1] }}
                            transition={{ repeat: Infinity, duration: 1.5 }}
                          />
                        ) : (
                          <span className="text-xl">{catInfo.icon}</span>
                        )}
                      </div>

                      {/* Content */}
                      <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                        <p className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground truncate">
                          {session.title}
                          {isActive && (
                            <motion.span
                              className="text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 mr-1.5 text-xs font-normal"
                              animate={{ opacity: [1, 0.4, 1] }}
                              transition={{ repeat: Infinity, duration: 2 }}
                            >
                              (جاري)
                            </motion.span>
                          )}
                        </p>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-0.5 flex-wrap">
                          {!isActive && (
                            <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-[10px] bg-muted text-muted-foreground">
                              {catInfo.label}
                            </Badge>
                          )}
                          {projectName && (
                            <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-0.5">
                              📁 {projectName}
                            </span>
                          )}
                          <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                            {formatSessionDate(session.startedAt)}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {/* Duration */}
                      <div className="shrink-0 text-left">
                        <span className={`text-sm font-bold ${isActive ? 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400' : 'text-foreground'}`}>
                          {isActive ? formatTimerDisplay(elapsedMs) : formatDuration(session.durationMinutes)}
                        </span>
                      </div>

                      {/* Delete */}
                      <Button
                        variant="ghost"
                        size="icon"
                        className="h-7 w-7 text-muted-foreground hover:text-red-500 shrink-0"
                        onClick={() => deleteWorkSession(session.id)}
                      >
                        <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      </Button>
                    </motion.div>
                  );
                })}
              </AnimatePresence>
            </div>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState, useMemo, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { MapPin, Plus, Pencil, Trash2, Star, Upload, X, ExternalLink, Image as ImageIcon } from 'lucide-react';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';

import {
  Dialog,

  DialogTitle,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogDescription,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from '@/components/ui/select';
import { useAppStore } from '@/lib/store';
import { PLACE_CATEGORY_CONFIG, type PlaceCategory, type Place } from '@/types';

// ============ ثوابت ============
type FilterTab = 'all' | PlaceCategory;

const FILTER_TABS: Array<{ value: FilterTab; label: string }> = [
  { value: 'all', label: 'الكل' },
  { value: 'university', label: 'جامعة' },
  { value: 'work', label: 'عمل' },
  { value: 'cafe', label: 'مقهى' },
  { value: 'event', label: 'فعالية' },
  { value: 'travel', label: 'سفر' },
  { value: 'other', label: 'أخرى' },
];

// ============ مكون التقييم بالنجوم ============
function StarRating({
  value,
  onChange,
  readonly = false,
  size = 'sm',
}: {
  value: number;
  onChange?: (val: number) => void;
  readonly?: boolean;
  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';
}) {
  const [hovered, setHovered] = useState(0);

  const sizeClasses = {
    sm: 'w-4 h-4',
    md: 'w-5 h-5',
    lg: 'w-6 h-6',
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5" dir="ltr">
      {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((star) => {
        const filled = hovered ? star <= hovered : star <= value;
        return (
          <button
            key={star}
            type="button"
            disabled={readonly}
            className={`${readonly ? 'cursor-default' : 'cursor-pointer hover:scale-110'} transition-transform`}
            onMouseEnter={() => !readonly && setHovered(star)}
            onMouseLeave={() => !readonly && setHovered(0)}
            onClick={() => onChange?.(star)}
          >
            <Star
              className={`${sizeClasses[size]} ${
                filled
                  ? 'fill-amber-400 text-amber-400'
                  : 'fill-transparent text-muted-foreground/40'
              } transition-colors`}
            />
          </button>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

// ============ نموذج النموذج ============
interface PlaceForm {
  name: string;
  description: string;
  category: PlaceCategory;
  city: string;
  country: string;
  visitedDate: string;
  rating: number;
  notes: string;
  links: { label: string; url: string }[];
  images: string[];
}

const emptyForm: PlaceForm = {
  name: '',
  description: '',
  category: 'cafe',
  city: '',
  country: '',
  visitedDate: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
  rating: 3,
  notes: '',
  links: [],
  images: [],
};

// ============ المكون الرئيسي ============
export function PlacesSection() {
  const { places, addPlace, updatePlace, deletePlace, addPlaceImage, removePlaceImage } = useAppStore();
  const [activeFilter, setActiveFilter] = useState<FilterTab>('all');
  const [dialogOpen, setDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [detailOpen, setDetailOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingPlace, setEditingPlace] = useState<Place | null>(null);
  const [viewingPlace, setViewingPlace] = useState<Place | null>(null);
  const [form, setForm] = useState<PlaceForm>(emptyForm);
  const [deleteConfirm, setDeleteConfirm] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [detailDeleteConfirm, setDetailDeleteConfirm] = useState(false);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const detailFileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);
  const [detailUploading, setDetailUploading] = useState(false);

  // ============ التصفية ============
  const filteredPlaces = useMemo(() => {
    if (activeFilter === 'all') return places;
    return places.filter((p) => p.category === activeFilter);
  }, [places, activeFilter]);

  // ============ الإحصائيات ============
  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    const total = places.length;
    const cities = new Set(places.map((p) => p.city).filter(Boolean)).size;
    const countries = new Set(places.map((p) => p.country).filter(Boolean)).size;
    return { total, cities, countries };
  }, [places]);

  // ============ تاريخ منسق ============
  const formatDate = (dateStr: string) => {
    if (!dateStr) return '';
    try {
      return new Date(dateStr).toLocaleDateString('ar-PS', {
        year: 'numeric',
        month: 'short',
        day: 'numeric',
      });
    } catch {
      return dateStr;
    }
  };

  // ============ فتح الإضافة ============
  const openAdd = () => {
    setEditingPlace(null);
    setForm(emptyForm);
    setDialogOpen(true);
  };

  // ============ فتح التعديل ============
  const openEdit = (place: Place) => {
    setEditingPlace(place);
    setForm({
      name: place.name,
      description: place.description,
      category: place.category,
      city: place.city,
      country: place.country,
      visitedDate: place.visitedDate,
      rating: place.rating,
      notes: place.notes,
      links: [...place.links],
      images: [...place.images],
    });
    setDialogOpen(true);
  };

  // ============ فتح التفاصيل ============
  const openDetail = (place: Place) => {
    setViewingPlace(place);
    setDetailDeleteConfirm(false);
    setDetailOpen(true);
  };

  // ============ رفع صورة ============
  const handleUpload = useCallback(
    async (file: File, mode: 'add' | 'detail') => {
      const setUploadingState = mode === 'add' ? setUploading : setDetailUploading;
      const getForm = () => form;
      const setFormState = (fn: (prev: PlaceForm) => PlaceForm) => setForm(fn);

      setUploadingState(true);
      try {
        const formData = new FormData();
        formData.append('file', file);
        const res = await fetch('/api/upload', { method: 'POST', body: formData });
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error('فشل الرفع');
        const data = await res.json();
        const url = data.url;
        if (mode === 'add') {
          setForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, images: [...prev.images, url] }));
        } else {
          setFormState((prev) => ({ ...prev, images: [...prev.images, url] }));
          if (viewingPlace) {
            addPlaceImage(viewingPlace.id, url);
          }
        }
      } catch {
        // يمكن إضافة toast لاحقاً
      } finally {
        setUploadingState(false);
      }
    },
    [form, viewingPlace, addPlaceImage]
  );

  // ============ حذف صورة ============
  const handleRemoveImage = async (url: string, mode: 'add' | 'detail') => {
    try {
      await fetch(`/api/upload?url=${encodeURIComponent(url)}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
    } catch {
      // تجاهل خطأ الحذف من الخادم
    }
    if (mode === 'add') {
      setForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, images: prev.images.filter((i) => i !== url) }));
    } else {
      setForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, images: prev.images.filter((i) => i !== url) }));
      if (viewingPlace) {
        removePlaceImage(viewingPlace.id, url);
      }
    }
  };

  // ============ حفظ ============
  const handleSave = () => {
    if (!form.name.trim()) return;
    if (editingPlace) {
      updatePlace(editingPlace.id, form);
    } else {
      addPlace(form);
    }
    setDialogOpen(false);
    setForm(emptyForm);
    setEditingPlace(null);
  };

  // ============ حذف ============
  const handleDelete = (id: string) => {
    deletePlace(id);
    setDeleteConfirm(null);
    setDetailOpen(false);
    setViewingPlace(null);
  };

  // ============ الروابط في النموذج ============
  const addLink = () => {
    setForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, links: [...prev.links, { label: '', url: '' }] }));
  };

  const updateLink = (index: number, field: 'label' | 'url', value: string) => {
    setForm((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      links: prev.links.map((link, i) => (i === index ? { ...link, [field]: value } : link)),
    }));
  };

  const removeLink = (index: number) => {
    setForm((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      links: prev.links.filter((_, i) => i !== index),
    }));
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* ============ الترويسة ============ */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground flex items-center gap-2">
            <MapPin className="w-6 h-6 text-rose-500" />
            الأماكن
          </h2>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm mt-1">تتبع الأماكن التي زرتها</p>
        </div>
        <Button onClick={openAdd} className="gap-2 bg-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-800 text-white">
          <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
          مكان جديد
        </Button>
      </div>

      {/* ============ الإحصائيات ============ */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
        <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
          <CardContent className="p-4 text-center">
            <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">{stats.total}</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">إجمالي الأماكن</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
        <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
          <CardContent className="p-4 text-center">

          </CardContent>
        </Card>
        <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
          <CardContent className="p-4 text-center">
            <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-rose-600">{stats.countries}</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">دول</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>

      {/* ============ فلتر الفئات ============ */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        {FILTER_TABS.map((tab) => {
          const count =
            tab.value === 'all'
              ? places.length
              : places.filter((p) => p.category === tab.value).length;
          const isActive = activeFilter === tab.value;
          const icon = tab.value !== 'all' ? PLACE_CATEGORY_CONFIG[tab.value as PlaceCategory].icon : '🌍';
          return (
            <Button
              key={tab.value}
              variant={isActive ? 'default' : 'outline'}
              size="sm"
              onClick={() => setActiveFilter(tab.value)}
              className={
                isActive
                  ? 'bg-gray-900 text-white hover:bg-gray-800'
                  : 'border-border text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted'
              }
            >
              {icon} {tab.label}
              <Badge
                variant="secondary"
                className={`mr-1.5 text-[10px] px-1.5 ${
                  isActive ? 'bg-white/20 text-white' : 'bg-muted text-muted-foreground'
                }`}
              >
                {count}
              </Badge>
            </Button>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* ============ شبكة الأماكن ============ */}
      {filteredPlaces.length === 0 ? (
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 16 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          className="text-center py-16"
        >
          <div className="text-5xl mb-3 opacity-40">📍</div>
          <h3 className="text-base font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">
            لم تسجّل أي أماكن بعد
          </h3>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-4">أضف أول مكان زرته</p>
          <Button onClick={openAdd} variant="outline" className="gap-2">
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
            إضافة مكان
          </Button>
        </motion.div>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
          <AnimatePresence mode="popLayout">
            {filteredPlaces.map((place, index) => (
              <motion.div
                key={place.id}
                layout
                initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.96 }}
                animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
                exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.96 }}
                transition={{ delay: index * 0.03 }}
              >
                <Card
                  className="border border-border bg-background hover:border-border transition-colors cursor-pointer overflow-hidden"
                  onClick={() => openDetail(place)}
                >
                  {/* الصورة المصغرة */}
                  {place.images.length > 0 && (
                    <div className="relative h-40 overflow-hidden">
                      <img
                        src={place.images[0]}
                        alt={place.name}
                        className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                      />
                      <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/30 to-transparent" />
                      <Badge className="absolute top-2 right-2 bg-black/50 text-white border-0 text-[10px]">
                        {PLACE_CATEGORY_CONFIG[place.category].icon}{' '}
                        {PLACE_CATEGORY_CONFIG[place.category].label}
                      </Badge>
                    </div>
                  )}
                  {place.images.length === 0 && (
                    <div className="h-24 bg-muted/50 flex items-center justify-center">
                      <ImageIcon className="w-8 h-8 text-muted-foreground/30" />
                    </div>
                  )}
                  <CardContent className="p-4">
                    {/* الرأس */}
                    <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                      <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                        {place.images.length === 0 && (
                          <Badge
                            variant="secondary"
                            className="text-[10px] mb-1.5 bg-muted text-muted-foreground"
                          >
                            {PLACE_CATEGORY_CONFIG[place.category].icon}{' '}
                            {PLACE_CATEGORY_CONFIG[place.category].label}
                          </Badge>
                        )}
                        <h3 className="font-medium text-sm text-foreground truncate">{place.name}</h3>
                        {(place.city || place.country) && (
                          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5 flex items-center gap-1 truncate">
                            <MapPin className="w-3 h-3 shrink-0" />
                            {[place.city, place.country].filter(Boolean).join('، ')}
                          </p>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5 shrink-0">
                        <Button
                          variant="ghost"
                          size="icon"
                          className="h-7 w-7 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
                          onClick={(e) => {
                            e.stopPropagation();
                            openEdit(place);
                          }}
                        >
                          <Pencil className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        </Button>
                        <Button
                          variant="ghost"
                          size="icon"
                          className="h-7 w-7 text-muted-foreground hover:text-red-500"
                          onClick={(e) => {
                            e.stopPropagation();
                            setDeleteConfirm(place.id);
                          }}
                        >
                          <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        </Button>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* التقييم والتاريخ */}
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between mt-3">
                      <StarRating value={place.rating} readonly size="sm" />
                      {place.visitedDate && (
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                          {formatDate(place.visitedDate)}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    {/* تأكيد الحذف */}
                    <AnimatePresence>
                      {deleteConfirm === place.id && (
                        <motion.div
                          initial={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
                          animate={{ opacity: 1, height: 'auto' }}
                          exit={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
                          className="mt-3 pt-3 border-t border-border"
                        >
                          <p className="text-xs text-red-500 mb-2">هل تريد حذف هذا المكان؟</p>
                          <div className="flex gap-2">
                            <Button
                              size="sm"
                              variant="destructive"
                              className="h-7 text-xs"
                              onClick={(e) => {
                                e.stopPropagation();
                                handleDelete(place.id);
                              }}
                            >
                              حذف
                            </Button>
                            <Button
                              size="sm"
                              variant="outline"
                              className="h-7 text-xs"
                              onClick={(e) => {
                                e.stopPropagation();
                                setDeleteConfirm(null);
                              }}
                            >
                              إلغاء
                            </Button>
                          </div>
                        </motion.div>
                      )}
                    </AnimatePresence>
                  </CardContent>
                </Card>
              </motion.div>
            ))}
          </AnimatePresence>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ============ حوار إضافة/تعديل ============ */}
      <Dialog open={dialogOpen} onOpenChange={setDialogOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="max-w-lg max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto" dir="rtl">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>
              {editingPlace ? 'تعديل المكان' : 'إضافة مكان جديد'}
            </DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>
              {editingPlace ? 'قم بتعديل بيانات المكان' : 'أدخل بيانات المكان الجديد'}
            </DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>

          <div className="space-y-4">
            {/* الاسم */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="place-name">اسم المكان *</Label>
              <Input
                id="place-name"
                placeholder="مثال: مقهى النور"
                value={form.name}
                onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, name: e.target.value })}
                className="border-border"
              />
            </div>

            {/* الوصف */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="place-desc">الوصف</Label>
              <Textarea
                id="place-desc"
                placeholder="وصف مختصر عن المكان..."
                value={form.description}
                onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, description: e.target.value })}

              />
            </div>

            {/* الفئة + التقييم */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>الفئة</Label>
                <Select
                  value={form.category}
                  onValueChange={(val) => setForm({ ...form, category: val as PlaceCategory })}
                >
                  <SelectTrigger className="border-border">
                    <SelectValue />
                  </SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectContent>
                    {Object.entries(PLACE_CATEGORY_CONFIG).map(([key, config]) => (
                      <SelectItem key={key} value={key}>
                        {config.icon} {config.label}
                      </SelectItem>
                    ))}
                  </SelectContent>
                </Select>
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>التقييم</Label>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 h-9">
                  <StarRating
                    value={form.rating}
                    onChange={(val) => setForm({ ...form, rating: val })}
                    size="md"
                  />
                  <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{form.rating}/5</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* المدينة + الدولة */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="place-city">المدينة</Label>
                <Input
                  id="place-city"

                <Label htmlFor="place-country">الدولة</Label>
                <Input
                  id="place-country"

            {/* تاريخ الزيارة */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="place-date">تاريخ الزيارة</Label>
              <Input

            </div>

            {/* ملاحظات */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="place-notes">ملاحظات</Label>

            </div>

            {/* الصور */}
            <div className="space-y-2">

              <input
                ref={fileInputRef}

                  const file = e.target.files?.[0];
                  if (file) handleUpload(file, 'add');
                  e.target.value = '';

              />
              <Button
                type="button"
                variant="outline"
                size="sm"
                className="gap-2 border-dashed border-border"
                onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}

              >
                {uploading ? (
                  <span className="animate-spin">⏳</span>
                ) : (
                  <Upload className="w-4 h-4" />
                )}
                {uploading ? 'جارٍ الرفع...' : 'رفع صورة'}
              </Button>
              {form.images.length > 0 && (
                <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 mt-2">
                  {form.images.map((img, idx) => (
                    <div key={idx} className="relative group aspect-square rounded-lg overflow-hidden border border-border">

                      <button

            {/* الروابط */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">

                <Button type="button" variant="ghost" size="sm" className="h-6 text-xs gap-1" onClick={addLink}>
                  <Plus className="w-3 h-3" />

                </Button>
              </div>
              {form.links.length > 0 && (
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  {form.links.map((link, idx) => (
                    <div key={idx} className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <Input

                      />
                      <Input
                        placeholder="https://..."
                        value={link.url}
                        onChange={(e) => updateLink(idx, 'url', e.target.value)}
                        className="border-border text-sm flex-1"

                      />
                      <Button
                        type="button"

                        onClick={() => removeLink(idx)}
                      >
                        <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      </Button>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          <DialogFooter>
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setDialogOpen(false)} className="border-border">
              إلغاء
            </Button>
            <Button
              onClick={handleSave}

              className="bg-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-800 text-white gap-2"
            >
              {editingPlace ? (

                  <Pencil className="w-4 h-4" />

                  <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />

        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>

      {/* ============ حوار التفاصيل ============ */}
      <Dialog open={detailOpen} onOpenChange={setDetailOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="max-w-lg max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto" dir="rtl">
          {viewingPlace && (
            <>
              <DialogHeader>

                  {PLACE_CATEGORY_CONFIG[viewingPlace.category].icon} {viewingPlace.name}

              <div className="space-y-4">

                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 text-sm">
                  {(viewingPlace.city || viewingPlace.country) && (

                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                  <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">التقييم:</span>
                  <StarRating
                    value={viewingPlace.rating}
                    onChange={(val) => {
                      updatePlace(viewingPlace.id, { rating: val });
                      setViewingPlace({ ...viewingPlace, rating: val });

                  <span className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">{viewingPlace.rating}/5</span>

                {viewingPlace.notes && (
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <Label className="text-muted-foreground text-xs">ملاحظات</Label>
                    <p className="text-sm text-foreground whitespace-pre-wrap bg-muted/50 rounded-lg p-3">
                      {viewingPlace.notes}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* معرض الصور */}
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <Label>الصور ({viewingPlace.images.length})</Label>
                    <input
                      ref={detailFileInputRef}
                      type="file"
                      accept="image/*"
                      className="hidden"
                      onChange={(e) => {
                        const file = e.target.files?.[0];
                        if (file) handleUpload(file, 'detail');
                        e.target.value = '';
                      }}
                    />
                    <Button
                      type="button"
                      variant="ghost"
                      size="sm"
                      className="h-7 text-xs gap-1"
                      onClick={() => detailFileInputRef.current?.click()}
                      disabled={detailUploading}
                    >
                      {detailUploading ? (
                        <span className="animate-spin">⏳</span>
                      ) : (
                        <Upload className="w-3 h-3" />
                      )}
                      {detailUploading ? 'جارٍ الرفع...' : 'إضافة صورة'}
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                  {viewingPlace.images.length > 0 ? (
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                      {viewingPlace.images.map((img, idx) => (
                        <div key={idx} className="relative group aspect-video rounded-lg overflow-hidden border border-border">
                          <img
                            src={img}
                            alt={`صورة ${idx + 1}`}
                            className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                          />
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            className="absolute top-1 left-1 bg-black/60 text-white rounded-full p-1 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity"
                            onClick={() => handleRemoveImage(img, 'detail')}
                          >
                            <X className="w-3 h-3" />
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="text-center py-6 border border-dashed border-border rounded-lg">
                      <ImageIcon className="w-8 h-8 text-muted-foreground/30 mx-auto mb-1" />
                      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">لا توجد صور</p>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* الروابط */}
                {viewingPlace.links.length > 0 && (
                  <div className="space-y-2">
                    <Label>الروابط</Label>
                    <div className="space-y-1.5">
                      {viewingPlace.links.map((link, idx) => (
                        <a
                          key={idx}
                          href={link.url}
                          target="_blank"
                          rel="noopener noreferrer"
                          className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-foreground hover:text-amber-600 transition-colors p-2 rounded-lg hover:bg-muted/50"
                        >
                          <ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0" />
                          <span className="truncate">{link.label || link.url}</span>
                        </a>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* أزرار الإجراءات */}
                <div className="flex gap-2 pt-2 border-t border-border">
                  <Button
                    variant="outline"
                    className="gap-2 flex-1 border-border"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setDetailOpen(false);
                      openEdit(viewingPlace);
                    }}
                  >
                    <Pencil className="w-4 h-4" />
                    تعديل
                  </Button>
                  <Button
                    variant="outline"
                    className="gap-2 flex-1 border-red-200 text-red-500 hover:text-red-600 hover:bg-red-50"
                    onClick={() => setDetailDeleteConfirm(true)}
                  >
                    <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                    حذف
                  </Button>
                </div>

                {/* تأكيد الحذف */}
                <AnimatePresence>
                  {detailDeleteConfirm && (
                    <motion.div
                      initial={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
                      animate={{ opacity: 1, height: 'auto' }}
                      exit={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
                      className="overflow-hidden"
                    >
                      <div className="bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-900/10 rounded-lg p-3 border border-red-200 dark:border-red-900/30">
                        <p className="text-sm text-red-600 dark:text-red-400 mb-2">
                          هل أنت متأكد من حذف &quot;{viewingPlace.name}&quot؛؟ لا يمكن التراجع عن هذا الإجراء.
                        </p>
                        <div className="flex gap-2">
                          <Button
                            size="sm"
                            variant="destructive"
                            className="h-8 text-xs"
                            onClick={() => handleDelete(viewingPlace.id)}
                          >
                            نعم، احذف
                          </Button>
                          <Button
                            size="sm"
                            variant="outline"
                            className="h-8 text-xs border-border"
                            onClick={() => setDetailDeleteConfirm(false)}
                          >
                            إلغاء
                          </Button>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </motion.div>
                  )}
                </AnimatePresence>
              </div>
            </>
          )}
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## 📝 الكود الكامل

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { Trophy, Plus, Pencil, Trash2, Eye, EyeOff } from 'lucide-react';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { Checkbox } from '@/components/ui/checkbox';
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogDescription,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from '@/components/ui/select';
import { useAppStore } from '@/lib/store';
import { ACHIEVEMENT_TYPE_CONFIG } from '@/types';
import type { Achievement, AchievementType } from '@/types';

// ============ ثوابت ============
const ARABIC_MONTHS: Record<string, string> = {
  '01': 'يناير',
  '02': 'فبراير',
  '03': 'مارس',
  '04': 'أبريل',
  '05': 'مايو',
  '06': 'يونيو',
  '07': 'يوليو',
  '08': 'أغسطس',
  '09': 'سبتمبر',
  '10': 'أكتوبر',
  '11': 'نوفمبر',
  '12': 'ديسمبر',
};

const FILTER_TABS: Array<{ value: 'all' | AchievementType; label: string }> = [
  { value: 'all', label: 'الكل' },
  ...Object.entries(ACHIEVEMENT_TYPE_CONFIG).map(([key, config]) => ({
    value: key as AchievementType,
    label: config.label,
  })),
];

function formatDate(date: string): string {
  const [year, month] = date.split('-');
  return `${ARABIC_MONTHS[month] || month} ${year}`;
}

function getYear(date: string): number {
  return parseInt(date.split('-')[0], 10);
}

// ============ نموذج ============
interface AchievementForm {
  title: string;
  description: string;
  date: string;
  type: AchievementType;
  showInPortfolio: boolean;
}

const emptyForm: AchievementForm = {
  title: '',
  description: '',
  date: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 7),
  type: 'personal',
  showInPortfolio: true,
};

// ============ المكون الرئيسي ============
export function AchievementsSection() {
  const { achievements, addAchievement, updateAchievement, deleteAchievement } = useAppStore();
  const [activeFilter, setActiveFilter] = useState<'all' | AchievementType>('all');
  const [dialogOpen, setDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingAchievement, setEditingAchievement] = useState<Achievement | null>(null);
  const [form, setForm] = useState<AchievementForm>(emptyForm);
  const [deleteConfirm, setDeleteConfirm] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const filteredAchievements = useMemo(() => {
    const filtered =
      activeFilter === 'all'
        ? achievements
        : achievements.filter((a) => a.type === activeFilter);
    return [...filtered].sort((a, b) => b.date.localeCompare(a.date));
  }, [achievements, activeFilter]);

  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    const total = achievements.length;
    const currentYear = new Date().getFullYear();
    const thisYear = achievements.filter((a) => getYear(a.date) === currentYear).length;

    // أكثر نوع
    const typeCounts: Record<string, number> = {};
    achievements.forEach((a) => {
      typeCounts[a.type] = (typeCounts[a.type] || 0) + 1;
    });
    const mostType = Object.entries(typeCounts).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])[0];

    return { total, thisYear, mostType };
  }, [achievements]);

  const groupedByYear = useMemo(() => {
    const groups: Record<number, Achievement[]> = {};
    filteredAchievements.forEach((a) => {
      const year = getYear(a.date);
      if (!groups[year]) groups[year] = [];
      groups[year].push(a);
    });
    return Object.entries(groups)
      .sort(([a], [b]) => parseInt(b) - parseInt(a))
      .map(([year, items]) => ({ year: parseInt(year), items }));
  }, [filteredAchievements]);

  const openAdd = () => {
    setEditingAchievement(null);
    setForm(emptyForm);
    setDialogOpen(true);
  };

  const openEdit = (achievement: Achievement) => {
    setEditingAchievement(achievement);
    setForm({
      title: achievement.title,
      description: achievement.description,
      date: achievement.date,
      type: achievement.type,
      showInPortfolio: achievement.showInPortfolio,
    });
    setDialogOpen(true);
  };

  const handleSave = () => {
    if (!form.title.trim()) return;
    if (editingAchievement) {
      updateAchievement(editingAchievement.id, form);
    } else {
      addAchievement(form);
    }
    setDialogOpen(false);
    setForm(emptyForm);
    setEditingAchievement(null);
  };

  const handleDelete = (id: string) => {
    deleteAchievement(id);
    setDeleteConfirm(null);
  };

  const toggleShowInPortfolio = (id: string, value: boolean) => {
    updateAchievement(id, { showInPortfolio: value });
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* ============ الترويسة ============ */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground flex items-center gap-2">
            <Trophy className="w-6 h-6 text-amber-500" />
            الإنجازات
          </h2>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm mt-1">سجل إنجازاتك على خط زمني</p>
        </div>
        <Button onClick={openAdd} className="gap-2 bg-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-800 text-white">
          <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
          إنجاز جديد
        </Button>
      </div>

      {/* ============ إحصائيات ============ */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
        <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
          <CardContent className="p-4 text-center">
            <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">{stats.total}</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">إجمالي الإنجازات</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
        <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
          <CardContent className="p-4 text-center">
            <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-emerald-600">{stats.thisYear}</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">هذه السنة</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
        <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
          <CardContent className="p-4 text-center">
            <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">
              {stats.mostType ? ACHIEVEMENT_TYPE_CONFIG[stats.mostType[0] as AchievementType].icon : '—'}
            </p>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">
              {stats.mostType
                ? ACHIEVEMENT_TYPE_CONFIG[stats.mostType[0] as AchievementType].label
                : 'أكثر نوع'}
            </p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>

      {/* ============ فلتر الأنواع ============ */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        {FILTER_TABS.map((tab) => {
          const count =
            tab.value === 'all'
              ? achievements.length
              : achievements.filter((a) => a.type === tab.value).length;
          const isActive = activeFilter === tab.value;
          return (
            <Button
              key={tab.value}
              variant={isActive ? 'default' : 'outline'}
              size="sm"
              onClick={() => setActiveFilter(tab.value)}
              className={
                isActive
                  ? 'bg-gray-900 text-white hover:bg-gray-800'
                  : 'border-border text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted'
              }
            >
              {tab.label}
              <Badge
                variant="secondary"
                className={`mr-1.5 text-[10px] px-1.5 ${
                  isActive ? 'bg-white/20 text-white' : 'bg-muted text-muted-foreground'
                }`}
              >
                {count}
              </Badge>
            </Button>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* ============ عرض الخط الزمني ============ */}
      {filteredAchievements.length === 0 ? (
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 16 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          className="text-center py-16"
        >
          <div className="text-5xl mb-3 opacity-40">🏆</div>
          <h3 className="text-base font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">
            {achievements.length === 0 ? 'لا توجد إنجازات بعد' : 'لا توجد إنجازات في هذا النوع'}
          </h3>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-4">ابدأ بتسجيل إنجازاتك</p>
          <Button onClick={openAdd} variant="outline" className="gap-2">
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
            إضافة إنجاز
          </Button>
        </motion.div>
      ) : (
        <div className="relative">
          <AnimatePresence mode="popLayout">
            {groupedByYear.map((group) => (
              <motion.div
                key={group.year}
                layout
                initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
                animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
                exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
                className="relative mb-8 last:mb-0"
              >
                {/* عنوان السنة */}
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-4">
                  <div className="w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-amber-500 shrink-0 ring-4 ring-background" />
                  <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-foreground">{group.year}</h3>
                  <div className="flex-1 h-px bg-border" />
                </div>

                {/* عناصر السنة */}
                <div className="relative mr-1.5 border-r-2 border-border pr-6 space-y-4">
                  {group.items.map((achievement, index) => {
                    const config = ACHIEVEMENT_TYPE_CONFIG[achievement.type];
                    return (
                      <motion.div
                        key={achievement.id}
                        layout
                        initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.96 }}
                        animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
                        exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.96 }}
                        transition={{ delay: index * 0.03 }}
                        className="relative"
                      >
                        {/* نقطة الخط الزمني */}
                        <div
                          className={`absolute -right-[1.55rem] top-5 w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full border-2 border-background ${config.color.split(' ')[1] || config.color}`}
                        />

                        <Card className="border border-border bg-background hover:border-border transition-colors">
                          <CardContent className="p-4">
                            {/* الرأس */}
                            <div className="flex items-start justify-between mb-2">
                              <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                                <span
                                  className={`w-9 h-9 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center text-lg shrink-0 ${config.color}`}
                                >
                                  {config.icon}
                                </span>
                                <div>
                                  <h3 className="font-medium text-sm text-foreground">
                                    {achievement.title}
                                  </h3>
                                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-0.5">
                                    <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                                      {formatDate(achievement.date)}
                                    </span>
                                    <Badge
                                      variant="secondary"
                                      className={`text-[10px] ${config.color}`}
                                    >
                                      {config.label}
                                    </Badge>
                                  </div>
                                </div>
                              </div>
                              <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5">
                                <Button
                                  variant="ghost"
                                  size="icon"
                                  className="h-7 w-7 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
                                  onClick={() => openEdit(achievement)}
                                >
                                  <Pencil className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                                </Button>
                                <Button
                                  variant="ghost"
                                  size="icon"
                                  className="h-7 w-7 text-muted-foreground hover:text-red-500"
                                  onClick={() => setDeleteConfirm(achievement.id)}
                                >
                                  <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                                </Button>
                              </div>
                            </div>

                            {/* الوصف */}
                            {achievement.description && (
                              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed mb-3">
                                {achievement.description}
                              </p>
                            )}

                            {/* عرض في المعرض */}
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                              <Checkbox
                                id={`portfolio-${achievement.id}`}
                                checked={achievement.showInPortfolio}
                                onCheckedChange={(checked) =>
                                  toggleShowInPortfolio(achievement.id, checked === true)
                                }
                                className="data-[state=checked]:bg-emerald-500 data-[state=checked]:border-emerald-500"
                              />
                              <Label
                                htmlFor={`portfolio-${achievement.id}`}
                                className="text-xs text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
                              >
                                {achievement.showInPortfolio ? (
                                  <Eye className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-500" />
                                ) : (
                                  <EyeOff className="w-3 h-3" />
                                )}
                                عرض في المعرض
                              </Label>
                            </div>

                            {/* تأكيد الحذف */}
                            <AnimatePresence>
                              {deleteConfirm === achievement.id && (
                                <motion.div
                                  initial={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
                                  animate={{ opacity: 1, height: 'auto' }}
                                  exit={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
                                  className="mt-3 pt-3 border-t border-border"
                                >
                                  <p className="text-xs text-red-500 mb-2">
                                    هل تريد حذف هذا الإنجاز؟
                                  </p>
                                  <div className="flex gap-2">
                                    <Button
                                      size="sm"
                                      variant="destructive"
                                      className="h-7 text-xs"
                                      onClick={() => handleDelete(achievement.id)}
                                    >
                                      حذف
                                    </Button>
                                    <Button
                                      size="sm"
                                      variant="outline"
                                      className="h-7 text-xs"
                                      onClick={() => setDeleteConfirm(null)}
                                    >
                                      إلغاء
                                    </Button>
                                  </div>
                                </motion.div>
                              )}
                            </AnimatePresence>
                          </CardContent>
                        </Card>
                      </motion.div>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              </motion.div>
            ))}
          </AnimatePresence>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ============ حوار إضافة/تعديل ============ */}
      <Dialog open={dialogOpen} onOpenChange={setDialogOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="max-w-md" dir="rtl">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>
              {editingAchievement ? 'تعديل الإنجاز' : 'إضافة إنجاز جديد'}
            </DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>
              {editingAchievement ? 'قم بتعديل بيانات الإنجاز' : 'أدخل بيانات الإنجاز الجديد'}
            </DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>

          <div className="space-y-4">
            {/* العنوان */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="achievement-title">العنوان</Label>
              <Input
                id="achievement-title"
                placeholder="مثال: الفوز بمسابقة البرمجة"
                value={form.title}
                onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, title: e.target.value })}
                className="border-border"
              />
            </div>

            {/* الوصف */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="achievement-description">الوصف</Label>
              <Textarea
                id="achievement-description"
                placeholder="اكتب وصفاً للإنجاز..."
                value={form.description}
                onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, description: e.target.value })}
                className="border-border min-h-[80px]"
              />
            </div>

            {/* التاريخ */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="achievement-date">التاريخ</Label>
              <Input
                id="achievement-date"
                type="month"
                value={form.date}
                onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, date: e.target.value })}
                className="border-border"
              />
            </div>

            {/* النوع */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>النوع</Label>
              <Select
                value={form.type}
                onValueChange={(val) => setForm({ ...form, type: val as AchievementType })}
              >
                <SelectTrigger className="border-border">
                  <SelectValue />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  {Object.entries(ACHIEVEMENT_TYPE_CONFIG).map(([key, config]) => (
                    <SelectItem key={key} value={key}>
                      {config.icon} {config.label}
                    </SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>

            {/* عرض في المعرض */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Checkbox
                id="achievement-portfolio"
                checked={form.showInPortfolio}
                onCheckedChange={(checked) =>
                  setForm({ ...form, showInPortfolio: checked === true })
                }
                className="data-[state=checked]:bg-emerald-500 data-[state=checked]:border-emerald-500"
              />
              <Label
                htmlFor="achievement-portfolio"
                className="text-sm cursor-pointer"
              >
                عرض في المعرض
              </Label>
            </div>
          </div>

          <DialogFooter>
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setDialogOpen(false)} className="border-border">
              إلغاء
            </Button>
            <Button
              onClick={handleSave}
              disabled={!form.title.trim()}
              className="bg-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-800 text-white gap-2"
            >
              {editingAchievement ? (
                <>
                  <Pencil className="w-4 h-4" />
                  حفظ التعديلات
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
                  إضافة
                </>
              )}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </div>
  );
}
```
