```tsx
'use client';

import { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { Flame, Plus, Pencil, Trash2, Clock, AlertTriangle, ChevronDown, ChevronUp, Eye, EyeOff } from 'lucide-react';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { Checkbox } from '@/components/ui/checkbox';
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogDescription,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from '@/components/ui/select';
import { useAppStore } from '@/lib/store';
import { FAILURE_CATEGORY_CONFIG } from '@/types';
import type { Failure, FailureCategory } from '@/types';

// ============ ثوابت ============
const FILTER_TABS: Array<{ value: 'all' | FailureCategory; label: string }> = [
  { value: 'all', label: 'الكل' },
  { value: 'technical', label: 'تقنية' },
  { value: 'design', label: 'تصميم' },
  { value: 'management', label: 'إدارة' },
  { value: 'personal', label: 'شخصي' },
];

// ============ نموذج ============
interface FailureForm {
  title: string;
  date: string;
  category: FailureCategory;
  problem: string;
  rootCause: string;
  solution: string;
  timeSpentHours: number;
  lessonsLearned: string;
  relatedProjectId: string;
  showInPortfolio: boolean;
}

const emptyForm: FailureForm = {
  title: '',
  date: '',
  category: 'technical',
  problem: '',
  rootCause: '',
  solution: '',
  timeSpentHours: 0,
  lessonsLearned: '',
  relatedProjectId: '',
  showInPortfolio: false,
};

function toArabicNum(n: number) {
  return n.toLocaleString('ar-SA');
}

// ============ المكون الرئيسي ============
export function FailuresSection() {
  const { failures, addFailure, updateFailure, deleteFailure, projects } = useAppStore();
  const [activeFilter, setActiveFilter] = useState<'all' | FailureCategory>('all');
  const [dialogOpen, setDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingItem, setEditingItem] = useState<Failure | null>(null);
  const [form, setForm] = useState<FailureForm>(emptyForm);
  const [deleteConfirm, setDeleteConfirm] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [expandedId, setExpandedId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    if (activeFilter === 'all') return failures;
    return failures.filter((f) => f.category === activeFilter);
  }, [failures, activeFilter]);

  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    const total = failures.length;
    const solved = failures.filter((f) => f.solution.trim().length > 0).length;
    const totalHours = failures.reduce((s, f) => s + f.timeSpentHours, 0);
    return { total, solved, totalHours };
  }, [failures]);

  const openAdd = () => {
    setEditingItem(null);
    setForm(emptyForm);
    setDialogOpen(true);
  };

  const openEdit = (item: Failure) => {
    setEditingItem(item);
    setForm({
      title: item.title,
      date: item.date,
      category: item.category,
      problem: item.problem,
      rootCause: item.rootCause,
      solution: item.solution,
      timeSpentHours: item.timeSpentHours,
      lessonsLearned: item.lessonsLearned,
      relatedProjectId: item.relatedProjectId || '',
      showInPortfolio: item.showInPortfolio,
    });
    setExpandedId(null);
    setDialogOpen(true);
  };

  const handleSave = () => {
    if (!form.title.trim()) return;
    const data = {
      ...form,
      relatedProjectId: form.relatedProjectId || undefined,
    };
    if (editingItem) {
      updateFailure(editingItem.id, data);
    } else {
      addFailure(data);
    }
    setDialogOpen(false);
    setForm(emptyForm);
    setEditingItem(null);
  };

  const handleDelete = (id: string) => {
    deleteFailure(id);
    setDeleteConfirm(null);
    setExpandedId(null);
  };

  const formatDate = (dateStr: string) => {
    if (!dateStr) return '—';
    try {
      const [y, m] = dateStr.split('-');
      const monthNames = ['يناير', 'فبراير', 'مارس', 'أبريل', 'مايو', 'يونيو', 'يوليو', 'أغسطس', 'سبتمبر', 'أكتوبر', 'نوفمبر', 'ديسمبر'];
      return `${monthNames[parseInt(m) - 1]} ${y}`;
    } catch {
      return dateStr;
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* ============ الترويسة ============ */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground flex items-center gap-2">
            <Flame className="w-6 h-6 text-orange-500" />
            أرشيف الإخفاقات
          </h2>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm mt-1">وثّق أخطاءك وتعلّم منها — الشركات تحب هذا</p>
        </div>
        <Button onClick={openAdd} className="gap-2 bg-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-800 text-white">
          <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
          إخفاق جديد
        </Button>
      </div>

      {/* ============ إحصائيات ============ */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
        <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
          <CardContent className="p-4 text-center">
            <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">{toArabicNum(stats.total)}</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">إجمالي الإخفاقات</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
        <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
          <CardContent className="p-4 text-center">
            <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-emerald-600">{toArabicNum(stats.solved)}</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">تم حلها</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
        <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
          <CardContent className="p-4 text-center">
            <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">{toArabicNum(stats.totalHours)}h</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">إجمالي الساعات</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>

      {/* ============ فلتر ============ */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        {FILTER_TABS.map((tab) => {
          const count = tab.value === 'all'
            ? failures.length
            : failures.filter((f) => f.category === tab.value).length;
          const isActive = activeFilter === tab.value;
          return (
            <Button
              key={tab.value}
              variant={isActive ? 'default' : 'outline'}
              size="sm"
              onClick={() => setActiveFilter(tab.value)}
              className={isActive
                ? 'bg-gray-900 text-white hover:bg-gray-800'
                : 'border-border text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted'
              }
            >
              {tab.value !== 'all' && (
                <span className="ml-1">{FAILURE_CATEGORY_CONFIG[tab.value].icon}</span>
              )}
              {tab.label}
              <Badge variant="secondary" className={`mr-1.5 text-[10px] px-1.5 ${isActive ? 'bg-white/20 text-white' : 'bg-muted text-muted-foreground'}`}>
                {count}
              </Badge>
            </Button>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* ============ قائمة الإخفاقات ============ */}
      {filtered.length === 0 ? (
        <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 16 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} className="text-center py-16">
          <div className="text-5xl mb-3 opacity-40">🔥</div>
          <h3 className="text-base font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">
            {failures.length === 0 ? 'لا توجد إخفاقات بعد' : 'لا توجد إخفاقات في هذه الفئة'}
          </h3>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-4">الفشل هو بداية النجاح</p>
          <Button onClick={openAdd} variant="outline" className="gap-2">
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
            توثيق إخفاق
          </Button>
        </motion.div>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <AnimatePresence mode="popLayout">
            {filtered.map((item, index) => {
              const cfg = FAILURE_CATEGORY_CONFIG[item.category];
              const isExpanded = expandedId === item.id;
              return (
                <motion.div
                  key={item.id}
                  layout
                  initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }}
                  animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                  exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -8 }}
                  transition={{ delay: index * 0.03 }}
                >
                  <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
                    <CardContent className="p-4">
                      {/* الرأس */}
                      <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                        <div className={`w-10 h-10 rounded-lg ${cfg.color} flex items-center justify-center text-lg shrink-0`}>
                          {cfg.icon}
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                          <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                            <div className="min-w-0">
                              <h3 className="font-medium text-sm text-foreground">{item.title}</h3>
                              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-1.5 flex-wrap">
                                <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{formatDate(item.date)}</span>
                                <Badge variant="secondary" className={`text-[10px] ${cfg.color}`}>
                                  {cfg.label}
                                </Badge>
                                {item.timeSpentHours > 0 && (
                                  <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-[10px] bg-muted text-muted-foreground">
                                    <Clock className="w-3 h-3 ml-1" />
                                    {item.timeSpentHours}h
                                  </Badge>
                                )}
                              </div>
                            </div>
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5 shrink-0">
                              <button
                                onClick={() => updateFailure(item.id, { showInPortfolio: !item.showInPortfolio })}
                                className="p-1.5 rounded-md hover:bg-muted transition-colors"
                                title={item.showInPortfolio ? 'إخفاء من البورتفوليو' : 'إظهار بالبورتفوليو'}
                              >
                                {item.showInPortfolio
                                  ? <Eye className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-500" />
                                  : <EyeOff className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-muted-foreground" />
                                }
                              </button>
                              <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground" onClick={() => openEdit(item)}>
                                <Pencil className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              </Button>
                              <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7 text-muted-foreground hover:text-red-500" onClick={() => setDeleteConfirm(item.id)}>
                                <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              </Button>
                            </div>
                          </div>

                          {/* زر التوسيع */}
                          <button
                            onClick={() => setExpandedId(isExpanded ? null : item.id)}
                            className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors"
                          >
                            {isExpanded ? <ChevronUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> : <ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                            التفاصيل
                          </button>

                          {/* التفاصيل الموسعة */}
                          <AnimatePresence>
                            {isExpanded && (
                              <motion.div
                                initial={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
                                animate={{ opacity: 1, height: 'auto' }}
                                exit={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
                                className="mt-3 space-y-3 border-t border-border pt-3"
                              >
                                {item.problem && (
                                  <div>
                                    <p className="text-xs font-medium text-red-500 mb-1">❓ المشكلة:</p>
                                    <p className="text-sm text-foreground bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-900/10 rounded-lg p-3">{item.problem}</p>
                                  </div>
                                )}
                                {item.rootCause && (
                                  <div>
                                    <p className="text-xs font-medium text-amber-600 mb-1">🔍 السبب الجذري:</p>
                                    <p className="text-sm text-foreground bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-900/10 rounded-lg p-3">{item.rootCause}</p>
                                  </div>
                                )}
                                {item.solution && (
                                  <div>
                                    <p className="text-xs font-medium text-emerald-600 mb-1">✅ الحل:</p>
                                    <p className="text-sm text-foreground bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-900/10 rounded-lg p-3">{item.solution}</p>
                                  </div>
                                )}
                                {item.lessonsLearned && (
                                  <div>
                                    <p className="text-xs font-medium text-blue-600 mb-1">💡 ما تعلمت:</p>
                                    <p className="text-sm text-foreground bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-900/10 rounded-lg p-3">{item.lessonsLearned}</p>
                                  </div>
                                )}
                                {item.relatedProjectId && (() => {
                                  const proj = projects.find((p) => p.id === item.relatedProjectId);
                                  return proj ? (
                                    <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-[10px] bg-muted text-muted-foreground">
                                      🔗 {proj.title}
                                    </Badge>
                                  ) : null;
                                })()}
                              </motion.div>
                            )}
                          </AnimatePresence>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {/* تأكيد الحذف */}
                      <AnimatePresence>
                        {deleteConfirm === item.id && (
                          <motion.div
                            initial={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
                            animate={{ opacity: 1, height: 'auto' }}
                            exit={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
                            className="mt-3 pt-3 border-t border-border"
                          >
                            <p className="text-xs text-red-500 mb-2">هل تريد حذف هذا الإخفاق؟</p>
                            <div className="flex gap-2">
                              <Button size="sm" variant="destructive" className="h-7 text-xs" onClick={() => handleDelete(item.id)}>حذف</Button>
                              <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="h-7 text-xs" onClick={() => setDeleteConfirm(null)}>إلغاء</Button>
                            </div>
                          </motion.div>
                        )}
                      </AnimatePresence>
                    </CardContent>
                  </Card>
                </motion.div>
              );
            })}
          </AnimatePresence>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ============ حوار إضافة/تعديل ============ */}
      <Dialog open={dialogOpen} onOpenChange={setDialogOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="max-w-lg" dir="rtl">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>{editingItem ? 'تعديل الإخفاق' : 'توثيق إخفاق جديد'}</DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>{editingItem ? 'قم بتعديل بيانات الإخفاق' : 'سجّل إخفاقك وتعلّم منه'}</DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>

          <div className="space-y-4 max-h-[60vh] overflow-y-auto">
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="f-title">العنوان</Label>
              <Input id="f-title" placeholder="مثال: فشل اتصال Firebase في مشروع BMS" value={form.title} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, title: e.target.value })} className="border-border" />
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>التاريخ</Label>
                <Input type="month" value={form.date} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, date: e.target.value })} className="border-border" />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>التصنيف</Label>
                <Select value={form.category} onValueChange={(val) => setForm({ ...form, category: val as FailureCategory })}>
                  <SelectTrigger className="border-border"><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectContent>
                    {Object.entries(FAILURE_CATEGORY_CONFIG).map(([key, val]) => (
                      <SelectItem key={key} value={key}>{val.icon} {val.label}</SelectItem>
                    ))}
                  </SelectContent>
                </Select>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="f-problem">المشكلة</Label>
              <Textarea id="f-problem" placeholder="ماذا حدث بالتحديد؟" value={form.problem} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, problem: e.target.value })} rows={3} className="border-border" />
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="f-cause">السبب الجذري</Label>
              <Textarea id="f-cause" placeholder="ليش حصلت المشكلة؟" value={form.rootCause} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, rootCause: e.target.value })} rows={2} className="border-border" />
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="f-solution">الحل</Label>
              <Textarea id="f-solution" placeholder="كيف حلّيت المشكلة؟" value={form.solution} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, solution: e.target.value })} rows={2} className="border-border" />
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="f-hours">الوقت المستهلك (ساعات)</Label>
                <Input id="f-hours" type="number" min="0" value={form.timeSpentHours} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, timeSpentHours: parseInt(e.target.value) || 0 })} className="border-border" />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>المشروع المرتبط</Label>
                <Select value={form.relatedProjectId} onValueChange={(val) => setForm({ ...form, relatedProjectId: val })}>
                  <SelectTrigger className="border-border">
                    <SelectValue placeholder="اختياري" />
                  </SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectContent>
                    <SelectItem value="none">بدون</SelectItem>
                    {projects.map((p) => (
                      <SelectItem key={p.id} value={p.id}>{p.title}</SelectItem>
                    ))}
                  </SelectContent>
                </Select>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="f-lessons">ماذا تعلمت؟</Label>
              <Textarea id="f-lessons" placeholder="أهم درس من هذا الفشل..." value={form.lessonsLearned} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, lessonsLearned: e.target.value })} rows={2} className="border-border" />
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Checkbox checked={form.showInPortfolio} onCheckedChange={(checked) => setForm({ ...form, showInPortfolio: !!checked })} />
              <Label className="text-sm cursor-pointer" onClick={() => setForm({ ...form, showInPortfolio: !form.showInPortfolio })}>
                إظهار بالبورتفوليو (الشركات تحب هذا)
              </Label>
            </div>
          </div>

          <DialogFooter>
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setDialogOpen(false)} className="border-border">إلغاء</Button>
            <Button onClick={handleSave} disabled={!form.title.trim()} className="bg-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-800 text-white gap-2">
              {editingItem ? <><Pencil className="w-4 h-4" />حفظ</> : <><Plus className="w-4 h-4" />إضافة</>}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState, useMemo } from 'react';

import {
  Target,

} from 'lucide-react';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';

import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { Checkbox } from '@/components/ui/checkbox';

  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,

import {

  SelectValue,
} from '@/components/ui/select';
import { useAppStore } from '@/lib/store';
import { VISION_CATEGORIES, TIMEFRAME_CONFIG } from '@/types';
import type { VisionItem, Timeframe, GoalSubTask } from '@/types';

// ============ ثوابت ============

const ALL_STATUSES: VisionItem['status'][] = ['not-started', 'in-progress', 'completed', 'cancelled'];

const STATUS_LABELS: Record<VisionItem['status'], string> = {
  'not-started': 'لم يبدأ',
  'in-progress': 'قيد التنفيذ',
  'completed': 'مكتمل',
  'cancelled': 'ملغى',
};

const STATUS_COLORS: Record<VisionItem['status'], string> = {
  'not-started': 'bg-muted text-muted-foreground',
  'in-progress': 'bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-900/30 dark:text-amber-400',
  'completed': 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-900/30 dark:text-emerald-400',
  'cancelled': 'bg-red-50 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-900/30 dark:text-red-400',
};

const FILTER_TABS: Array<{ value: 'all' | Timeframe; label: string; icon: string }> = [
  { value: 'all', label: 'الكل', icon: '📋' },
  { value: 'short', label: 'قصير المدى', icon: '⚡' },
  { value: 'medium', label: 'متوسط المدى', icon: '📅' },
  { value: 'long', label: 'بعيد المدى', icon: '🚀' },
];

// ============ نموذج ============
interface VisionForm {
  title: string;
  description: string;
  category: VisionItem['category'];
  timeframe: Timeframe;
  startDate: string;
  deadline: string;
  progress: number;
  status: VisionItem['status'];
  subTasks: GoalSubTask[];
  showInPortfolio: boolean;
}

const emptyForm: VisionForm = {
  title: '',
  description: '',
  category: 'career',
  timeframe: 'short',
  startDate: '',
  deadline: '',
  progress: 0,
  status: 'not-started',
  subTasks: [],
  showInPortfolio: false,
};

// ============ المكون الرئيسي ============
export function VisionSection() {
  const { visionItems, addVisionItem, updateVisionItem, deleteVisionItem, toggleSubTask } = useAppStore();
  const [activeFilter, setActiveFilter] = useState<'all' | Timeframe>('all');
  const [dialogOpen, setDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingItem, setEditingItem] = useState<VisionItem | null>(null);
  const [form, setForm] = useState<VisionForm>(emptyForm);
  const [deleteConfirm, setDeleteConfirm] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // ============ تصفية ============
  const filteredItems = useMemo(() => {
    if (activeFilter === 'all') return visionItems;
    return visionItems.filter((v) => v.timeframe === activeFilter);
  }, [visionItems, activeFilter]);

  // ============ إحصائيات ============
  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    const total = visionItems.length;
    const completed = visionItems.filter((v) => v.status === 'completed').length;
    const avgProgress =
      total > 0
        ? Math.round(visionItems.reduce((sum, v) => sum + v.progress, 0) / total)
        : 0;
    return { total, completed, avgProgress };
  }, [visionItems]);

  // ============ صيغة التاريخ ============
  const formatDate = (dateStr: string) => {
    if (!dateStr) return '—';
    try {
      return new Date(dateStr).toLocaleDateString('ar-SA', {
        year: 'numeric',
        month: 'short',
        day: 'numeric',
      });
    } catch {
      return dateStr;
    }
  };

  // ============ فتح الحوار ============
  const openAdd = () => {
    setEditingItem(null);
    setForm(emptyForm);
    setDialogOpen(true);
  };

  const openEdit = (item: VisionItem) => {
    setEditingItem(item);
    setForm({
      title: item.title,
      description: item.description,
      category: item.category,
      timeframe: item.timeframe,
      startDate: item.startDate,
      deadline: item.deadline,
      progress: item.progress,
      status: item.status,
      subTasks: [...item.subTasks],
      showInPortfolio: item.showInPortfolio,
    });
    setDialogOpen(true);
  };

  // ============ الحفظ ============
  const handleSave = () => {
    if (!form.title.trim()) return;
    if (editingItem) {
      updateVisionItem(editingItem.id, form);
    } else {
      addVisionItem(form);
    }
    setDialogOpen(false);
    setForm(emptyForm);
    setEditingItem(null);
  };

  // ============ الحذف ============
  const handleDelete = (id: string) => {
    deleteVisionItem(id);
    setDeleteConfirm(null);
  };

  // ============ الخطوات الفرعية في النموذج ============
  const addSubTaskToForm = () => {
    setForm({
      ...form,
      subTasks: [...form.subTasks, { id: crypto.randomUUID(), text: '', completed: false }],
    });
  };

  const removeSubTaskFromForm = (subTaskId: string) => {
    setForm({
      ...form,
      subTasks: form.subTasks.filter((st) => st.id !== subTaskId),
    });
  };

  const updateSubTaskInForm = (subTaskId: string, text: string) => {
    setForm({
      ...form,
      subTasks: form.subTasks.map((st) => (st.id === subTaskId ? { ...st, text } : st)),
    });
  };

  // ============ حساب نسبة الخطوات الفرعية في البطاقة ============
  const getSubTaskStats = (item: VisionItem) => {
    const total = item.subTasks.length;
    if (total === 0) return null;
    const completedCount = item.subTasks.filter((st) => st.completed).length;
    const percent = Math.round((completedCount / total) * 100);
    return { total, completedCount, percent };
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* ============ الترويسة ============ */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground flex items-center gap-2">
            <Target className="w-6 h-6 text-emerald-500" />
            الرؤية والأهداف
          </h2>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm mt-1">خطط لمستقبلك وحقق أهدافك</p>
        </div>
        <Button onClick={openAdd} className="gap-2 bg-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-800 text-white">
          <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
          هدف جديد
        </Button>
      </div>

      {/* ============ إحصائيات ============ */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
        <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
          <CardContent className="p-4 text-center">
            <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">{stats.total}</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">إجمالي الأهداف</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
        <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
          <CardContent className="p-4 text-center">
            <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-emerald-600">{stats.completed}</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">مكتمل</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
        <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
          <CardContent className="p-4 text-center">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1">
              <TrendingUp className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-500" />
              <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-amber-600">{stats.avgProgress}٪</p>
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">نسبة الإنجاز</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>

      {/* ============ فلتر الإطارات الزمنية ============ */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        {FILTER_TABS.map((tab) => {
          const count =
            tab.value === 'all'
              ? visionItems.length
              : visionItems.filter((v) => v.timeframe === tab.value).length;
          const isActive = activeFilter === tab.value;
          return (
            <Button
              key={tab.value}
              variant={isActive ? 'default' : 'outline'}
              size="sm"
              onClick={() => setActiveFilter(tab.value)}
              className={
                isActive
                  ? 'bg-gray-900 text-white hover:bg-gray-800'
                  : 'border-border text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted'
              }
            >
              <span className="ml-1">{tab.icon}</span>
              {tab.label}
              <Badge
                variant="secondary"
                className={`mr-1.5 text-[10px] px-1.5 ${
                  isActive ? 'bg-white/20 text-white' : 'bg-muted text-muted-foreground'
                }`}
              >
                {count}
              </Badge>
            </Button>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* ============ قائمة الأهداف ============ */}
      {filteredItems.length === 0 ? (
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 16 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          className="text-center py-16"
        >
          <div className="text-5xl mb-3 opacity-40">🎯</div>
          <h3 className="text-base font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">
            {visionItems.length === 0 ? 'لا توجد أهداف بعد' : 'لا توجد أهداف في هذا الإطار الزمني'}
          </h3>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-4">ابدأ بإضافة أهدافك المستقبلية</p>
          <Button onClick={openAdd} variant="outline" className="gap-2">
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
            إضافة هدف
          </Button>
        </motion.div>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <AnimatePresence mode="popLayout">
            {filteredItems.map((item, index) => {
              const subTaskStats = getSubTaskStats(item);
              const isCompleted = item.status === 'completed';
              const isCancelled = item.status === 'cancelled';

              return (
                <motion.div
                  key={item.id}
                  layout
                  initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }}
                  animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                  exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -8 }}
                  transition={{ delay: index * 0.03 }}
                >
                  <Card
                    className={`border bg-background transition-colors ${
                      isCompleted
                        ? 'border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50/30 dark:border-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-950/20'
                        : isCancelled
                          ? 'border-red-200 bg-red-50/20 dark:border-red-800 dark:bg-red-950/10 opacity-70'
                          : 'border-border hover:border-border'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <CardContent className="p-4">
                      <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                        {/* الأيقونة */}
                        <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg bg-muted flex items-center justify-center text-lg shrink-0 mt-0.5">
                          {VISION_CATEGORIES[item.category].icon}
                        </div>

                        {/* المحتوى */}
                        <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                          <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                            <div className="min-w-0">
                              <h3
                                className={`font-medium text-sm text-foreground ${
                                  isCompleted ? 'line-through text-muted-foreground' : ''
                                }`}
                              >
                                {item.title}
                              </h3>
                              {item.description && (
                                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1 line-clamp-2">
                                  {item.description}
                                </p>
                              )}
                            </div>
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5 shrink-0">
                              <Button
                                variant="ghost"
                                size="icon"
                                className="h-7 w-7 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
                                onClick={() => openEdit(item)}
                              >
                                <Pencil className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              </Button>
                              <Button
                                variant="ghost"
                                size="icon"
                                className="h-7 w-7 text-muted-foreground hover:text-red-500"
                                onClick={() => setDeleteConfirm(item.id)}
                              >
                                <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              </Button>
                            </div>
                          </div>

                          {/* الشارات */}
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-2.5 flex-wrap">
                            {/* شارة الإطار الزمني */}
                            <Badge
                              variant="secondary"
                              className={`text-[10px] ${TIMEFRAME_CONFIG[item.timeframe].color}`}
                            >
                              {TIMEFRAME_CONFIG[item.timeframe].icon}{' '}
                              {TIMEFRAME_CONFIG[item.timeframe].label}
                            </Badge>

                            {/* شارة الفئة */}
                            <Badge
                              variant="secondary"
                              className="text-[10px] bg-muted text-muted-foreground"
                            >
                              {VISION_CATEGORIES[item.category].icon}{' '}
                              {VISION_CATEGORIES[item.category].label}
                            </Badge>

                            {/* شارة الحالة */}
                            <Badge
                              variant="secondary"
                              className={`text-[10px] ${STATUS_COLORS[item.status]}`}
                            >
                              {STATUS_LABELS[item.status]}
                            </Badge>
                          </div>

                          {/* شريط التقدم */}
                          <div className="mt-3">
                            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1">
                              <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">التقدم</span>
                              <span className="text-[10px] font-medium text-foreground">{item.progress}٪</span>
                            </div>
                            <Progress
                              value={item.progress}
                              className="h-1.5"
                            />
                          </div>

                          {/* الخطوات الفرعية */}
                          {item.subTasks.length > 0 && (
                            <div className="mt-3 pt-3 border-t border-border/50">
                              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                                {item.subTasks.map((st) => (
                                  <button
                                    key={st.id}
                                    onClick={() => toggleSubTask(item.id, st.id)}
                                    className="flex items-center gap-2 w-full text-right group"
                                  >
                                    {st.completed ? (
                                      <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-500 shrink-0" />
                                    ) : (
                                      <Circle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-muted-foreground/50 shrink-0 group-hover:text-muted-foreground" />
                                    )}
                                    <span
                                      className={`text-xs transition-colors ${
                                        st.completed
                                          ? 'line-through text-muted-foreground'
                                          : 'text-foreground'
                                      }`}
                                    >
                                      {st.text || 'خطوة بدون اسم'}
                                    </span>
                                  </button>
                                ))}
                              </div>
                              {/* ملخص الخطوات */}
                              {subTaskStats && (
                                <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mt-2 font-medium">
                                  {subTaskStats.completedCount} من {subTaskStats.total} — {subTaskStats.percent}٪
                                </p>
                              )}
                            </div>
                          )}

                          {/* الفترة الزمنية */}
                          {(item.startDate || item.deadline) && (
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mt-2.5 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                              <Calendar className="w-3 h-3" />
                              <span>
                                {item.startDate && item.deadline
                                  ? `من ${formatDate(item.startDate)} إلى ${formatDate(item.deadline)}`
                                  : item.startDate
                                    ? `من ${formatDate(item.startDate)}`
                                    : `إلى ${formatDate(item.deadline)}`}
                              </span>
                            </div>
                          )}

                          {/* إظهار في المعرض */}
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-2.5">
                            <button
                              onClick={() => updateVisionItem(item.id, { showInPortfolio: !item.showInPortfolio })}
                              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors"
                            >
                              {item.showInPortfolio ? (
                                <Eye className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-500" />
                              ) : (
                                <EyeOff className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              )}
                              {item.showInPortfolio ? 'ظاهر في المعرض' : 'مخفي عن المعرض'}
                            </button>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {/* تأكيد الحذف */}
                      <AnimatePresence>
                        {deleteConfirm === item.id && (
                          <motion.div
                            initial={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
                            animate={{ opacity: 1, height: 'auto' }}
                            exit={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
                            className="mt-3 pt-3 border-t border-border"
                          >
                            <p className="text-xs text-red-500 mb-2">هل تريد حذف هذا الهدف؟</p>
                            <div className="flex gap-2">
                              <Button
                                size="sm"
                                variant="destructive"
                                className="h-7 text-xs"
                                onClick={() => handleDelete(item.id)}
                              >
                                حذف
                              </Button>
                              <Button
                                size="sm"
                                variant="outline"
                                className="h-7 text-xs"
                                onClick={() => setDeleteConfirm(null)}
                              >
                                إلغاء
                              </Button>
                            </div>
                          </motion.div>
                        )}
                      </AnimatePresence>
                    </CardContent>
                  </Card>
                </motion.div>
              );
            })}
          </AnimatePresence>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ============ حوار إضافة/تعديل ============ */}
      <Dialog open={dialogOpen} onOpenChange={setDialogOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="max-w-lg max-h-[85vh] overflow-y-auto" dir="rtl">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>
              {editingItem ? 'تعديل الهدف' : 'إضافة هدف جديد'}
            </DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>
              {editingItem ? 'قم بتعديل بيانات الهدف' : 'أدخل بيانات الهدف الجديد'}
            </DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>

          <div className="space-y-4">
            {/* العنوان */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="vision-title">العنوان</Label>
              <Input
                id="vision-title"
                placeholder="مثال: تعلم React"
                value={form.title}
                onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, title: e.target.value })}
                className="border-border"
              />
            </div>

            {/* الوصف */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="vision-desc">الوصف</Label>
              <Textarea
                id="vision-desc"
                placeholder="وصف مختصر للهدف..."
                value={form.description}
                onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, description: e.target.value })}
                rows={3}
                className="border-border"
              />
            </div>

            {/* الفئة + الإطار الزمني */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>الفئة</Label>
                <Select
                  value={form.category}
                  onValueChange={(val) =>
                    setForm({ ...form, category: val as VisionItem['category'] })
                  }
                >
                  <SelectTrigger className="border-border">
                    <SelectValue />
                  </SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectContent>
                    {Object.entries(VISION_CATEGORIES).map(([key, val]) => (
                      <SelectItem key={key} value={key}>
                        {val.icon} {val.label}
                      </SelectItem>
                    ))}
                  </SelectContent>
                </Select>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>الإطار الزمني</Label>
                <Select
                  value={form.timeframe}
                  onValueChange={(val) =>
                    setForm({ ...form, timeframe: val as Timeframe })
                  }
                >
                  <SelectTrigger className="border-border">
                    <SelectValue />
                  </SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectContent>
                    {Object.entries(TIMEFRAME_CONFIG).map(([key, val]) => (
                      <SelectItem key={key} value={key}>
                        {val.icon} {val.label}
                      </SelectItem>
                    ))}
                  </SelectContent>
                </Select>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* تاريخ البداية + الموعد النهائي */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="vision-start">تاريخ البداية</Label>
                <Input
                  id="vision-start"
                  type="date"
                  value={form.startDate}
                  onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, startDate: e.target.value })}
                  className="border-border"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="vision-deadline">الموعد النهائي</Label>
                <Input
                  id="vision-deadline"
                  type="date"
                  value={form.deadline}
                  onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, deadline: e.target.value })}
                  className="border-border"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* التقدم */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <Label>نسبة التقدم</Label>
                <span className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">{form.progress}٪</span>
              </div>
              <Slider
                value={[form.progress]}
                min={0}
                max={100}
                step={1}
                onValueChange={([val]) => setForm({ ...form, progress: val })}
              />
              <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                يتحدث تلقائياً عند إكمال الخطوات الفرعية، لكن يمكنك تعديله يدوياً
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* الحالة */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>الحالة</Label>
              <Select
                value={form.status}
                onValueChange={(val) =>
                  setForm({ ...form, status: val as VisionItem['status'] })
                }
              >
                <SelectTrigger className="border-border">
                  <SelectValue />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  {ALL_STATUSES.map((s) => (
                    <SelectItem key={s} value={s}>
                      {STATUS_LABELS[s]}
                    </SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>

            {/* الخطوات الفرعية */}
            <div className="space-y-3">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <Label>الخطوات الفرعية</Label>
                {form.subTasks.length > 0 && (
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                    {form.subTasks.filter((st) => st.completed).length} من {form.subTasks.length}
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>

              {form.subTasks.length > 0 && (
                <div className="space-y-2 max-h-48 overflow-y-auto">
                  {form.subTasks.map((st) => (
                    <div key={st.id} className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <Checkbox
                        checked={st.completed}
                        onCheckedChange={() => {
                          setForm({
                            ...form,
                            subTasks: form.subTasks.map((s) =>
                              s.id === st.id ? { ...s, completed: !s.completed } : s
                            ),
                          });
                        }}
                      />
                      <Input
                        value={st.text}
                        onChange={(e) => updateSubTaskInForm(st.id, e.target.value)}
                        placeholder="وصف الخطوة..."
                        className="border-border text-xs h-8"
                      />
                      <Button
                        type="button"
                        variant="ghost"
                        size="icon"
                        className="h-8 w-8 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground hover:text-red-500"
                        onClick={() => removeSubTaskFromForm(st.id)}
                      >
                        <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      </Button>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}

              <Button
                type="button"
                variant="outline"
                size="sm"
                className="w-full gap-2 border-dashed border-border text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
                onClick={addSubTaskToForm}
              >
                <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                إضافة خطوة
              </Button>
            </div>

            {/* إظهار في المعرض */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Checkbox
                id="vision-show-portfolio"
                checked={form.showInPortfolio}
                onCheckedChange={(checked) =>
                  setForm({ ...form, showInPortfolio: checked === true })
                }
              />
              <Label htmlFor="vision-show-portfolio" className="text-sm cursor-pointer">
                إظهار في المعرض
              </Label>
            </div>
          </div>

          <DialogFooter>
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setDialogOpen(false)} className="border-border">
              إلغاء
            </Button>
            <Button
              onClick={handleSave}
              disabled={!form.title.trim()}
              className="bg-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-800 text-white gap-2"
            >
              {editingItem ? (
                <>
                  <Pencil className="w-4 h-4" />
                  حفظ التعديلات
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
                  إضافة
                </>
              )}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </div>
  );
}
```

# 24. اللغات

- **الكود (ID)**: `languages`
- **المجموعة**: 1001
- **الملف**: `src/components/sections/languages.tsx`
- **عدد الأسطر**: 330

## 📝 الكود الكامل

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { Globe, Plus, Pencil, Trash2, Eye, EyeOff } from 'lucide-react';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { Checkbox } from '@/components/ui/checkbox';
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogDescription,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from '@/components/ui/select';
import { useAppStore } from '@/lib/store';
import { LANGUAGE_LEVEL_CONFIG } from '@/types';
import type { Language, LanguageLevel } from '@/types';

// ============ نموذج ============
interface LanguageForm {
  name: string;
  level: LanguageLevel;
  score: string;
  scoreType: string;
  startDate: string;
  notes: string;
  showInPortfolio: boolean;
}

const emptyForm: LanguageForm = {
  name: '',
  level: 'beginner',
  score: '',
  scoreType: '',
  startDate: '',
  notes: '',
  showInPortfolio: false,
};

// ============ المكون الرئيسي ============
export function LanguagesSection() {
  const { languages, addLanguage, updateLanguage, deleteLanguage } = useAppStore();
  const [dialogOpen, setDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingItem, setEditingItem] = useState<Language | null>(null);
  const [form, setForm] = useState<LanguageForm>(emptyForm);
  const [deleteConfirm, setDeleteConfirm] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    const total = languages.length;
    const fluent = languages.filter((l) => l.level === 'fluent' || l.level === 'native').length;
    return { total, fluent };
  }, [languages]);

  const openAdd = () => {
    setEditingItem(null);
    setForm(emptyForm);
    setDialogOpen(true);
  };

  const openEdit = (item: Language) => {
    setEditingItem(item);
    setForm({
      name: item.name,
      level: item.level,
      score: item.score?.toString() || '',
      scoreType: item.scoreType || '',
      startDate: item.startDate,
      notes: item.notes,
      showInPortfolio: item.showInPortfolio,
    });
    setDialogOpen(true);
  };

  const handleSave = () => {
    if (!form.name.trim()) return;
    const data = {
      name: form.name.trim(),
      level: form.level,
      score: form.score ? parseFloat(form.score) : undefined,
      scoreType: form.scoreType.trim() || undefined,
      startDate: form.startDate,
      notes: form.notes,
      showInPortfolio: form.showInPortfolio,
    };
    if (editingItem) {
      updateLanguage(editingItem.id, data);
    } else {
      addLanguage(data);
    }
    setDialogOpen(false);
    setForm(emptyForm);
    setEditingItem(null);
  };

  const handleDelete = (id: string) => {
    deleteLanguage(id);
    setDeleteConfirm(null);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* ============ الترويسة ============ */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground flex items-center gap-2">
            <Globe className="w-6 h-6 text-teal-500" />
            اللغات
          </h2>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm mt-1">لغاتك ومستواك فيها</p>
        </div>
        <Button onClick={openAdd} className="gap-2 bg-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-800 text-white">
          <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
          لغة جديدة
        </Button>
      </div>

      {/* ============ إحصائيات ============ */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
        <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
          <CardContent className="p-4 text-center">
            <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">{stats.total}</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">إجمالي اللغات</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
        <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
          <CardContent className="p-4 text-center">
            <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-emerald-600">{stats.fluent}</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">طلاقة / لغة أم</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
        <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
          <CardContent className="p-4 text-center">
            <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">
              {languages.length > 0
                ? Math.round(languages.reduce((s, l) => s + LANGUAGE_LEVEL_CONFIG[l.level].percent, 0) / languages.length)
                : 0}%
            </p>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">المتوسط العام</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>

      {/* ============ شبكة اللغات ============ */}
      {languages.length === 0 ? (
        <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 16 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} className="text-center py-16">
          <div className="text-5xl mb-3 opacity-40">🌍</div>
          <h3 className="text-base font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">لا توجد لغات بعد</h3>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-4">أضف اللغات التي تعرفها</p>
          <Button onClick={openAdd} variant="outline" className="gap-2">
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
            إضافة لغة
          </Button>
        </motion.div>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
          <AnimatePresence mode="popLayout">
            {languages.map((lang, index) => {
              const cfg = LANGUAGE_LEVEL_CONFIG[lang.level];
              return (
                <motion.div
                  key={lang.id}
                  layout
                  initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.96 }}
                  animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
                  exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.96 }}
                  transition={{ delay: index * 0.03 }}
                >
                  <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
                    <CardContent className="p-4">
                      {/* الرأس */}
                      <div className="flex items-start justify-between mb-3">
                        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                          <h3 className="font-bold text-lg text-foreground">{lang.name}</h3>
                          <Badge variant="secondary" className={`text-[10px] mt-1 ${cfg.color} text-white`}>
                            {cfg.label}
                          </Badge>
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5">
                          <button
                            onClick={() => updateLanguage(lang.id, { showInPortfolio: !lang.showInPortfolio })}
                            className="p-1.5 rounded-md hover:bg-muted transition-colors"
                          >
                            {lang.showInPortfolio
                              ? <Eye className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-500" />
                              : <EyeOff className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-muted-foreground" />
                            }
                          </button>
                          <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground" onClick={() => openEdit(lang)}>
                            <Pencil className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </Button>
                          <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7 text-muted-foreground hover:text-red-500" onClick={() => setDeleteConfirm(lang.id)}>
                            <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </Button>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {/* شريط التقدم */}
                      <div className="space-y-1.5 mb-3">
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                          <span className="text-muted-foreground">المستوى</span>
                          <span className="font-medium text-foreground">{cfg.percent}%</span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="h-2.5 bg-muted rounded-full overflow-hidden">
                          <motion.div
                            initial={{ width: 0 }}
                            animate={{ width: `${cfg.percent}%` }}
                            transition={{ duration: 0.5, ease: 'easeOut' }}
                            className={`h-full rounded-full ${cfg.color}`}
                          />
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {/* الدرجة */}
                      {lang.score && (
                        <div className="text-sm text-foreground mb-2">
                          <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-[10px] bg-muted text-muted-foreground">
                            {lang.scoreType || 'اختبار'}: {lang.score}
                          </Badge>
                        </div>
                      )}

                      {/* الملاحظات */}
                      {lang.notes && (
                        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground line-clamp-2">{lang.notes}</p>
                      )}

                      {/* تأكيد الحذف */}
                      <AnimatePresence>
                        {deleteConfirm === lang.id && (
                          <motion.div
                            initial={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
                            animate={{ opacity: 1, height: 'auto' }}
                            exit={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
                            className="mt-3 pt-3 border-t border-border"
                          >
                            <p className="text-xs text-red-500 mb-2">هل تريد حذف هذه اللغة؟</p>
                            <div className="flex gap-2">
                              <Button size="sm" variant="destructive" className="h-7 text-xs" onClick={() => handleDelete(lang.id)}>حذف</Button>
                              <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="h-7 text-xs" onClick={() => setDeleteConfirm(null)}>إلغاء</Button>
                            </div>
                          </motion.div>
                        )}
                      </AnimatePresence>
                    </CardContent>
                  </Card>
                </motion.div>
              );
            })}
          </AnimatePresence>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ============ حوار إضافة/تعديل ============ */}
      <Dialog open={dialogOpen} onOpenChange={setDialogOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="max-w-md" dir="rtl">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>{editingItem ? 'تعديل اللغة' : 'إضافة لغة جديدة'}</DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>{editingItem ? 'قم بتعديل بيانات اللغة' : 'أدخل بيانات اللغة'}</DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>

          <div className="space-y-4">
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="lang-name">اسم اللغة</Label>
              <Input id="lang-name" placeholder="مثال: الإنجليزية" value={form.name} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, name: e.target.value })} className="border-border" />
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>المستوى</Label>
              <Select value={form.level} onValueChange={(val) => setForm({ ...form, level: val as LanguageLevel })}>
                <SelectTrigger className="border-border"><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  {Object.entries(LANGUAGE_LEVEL_CONFIG).map(([key, val]) => (
                    <SelectItem key={key} value={key}>{val.label}</SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="lang-score">الدرجة (اختياري)</Label>
                <Input id="lang-score" type="number" step="0.1" placeholder="6.5" value={form.score} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, score: e.target.value })} className="border-border" />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="lang-score-type">نوع الاختبار</Label>
                <Input id="lang-score-type" placeholder="IELTS, TOEFL..." value={form.scoreType} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, scoreType: e.target.value })} className="border-border" />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>تاريخ البداية</Label>
              <Input type="month" value={form.startDate} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, startDate: e.target.value })} className="border-border" />
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="lang-notes">ملاحظات</Label>
              <Textarea id="lang-notes" placeholder="أي ملاحظات إضافية..." value={form.notes} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, notes: e.target.value })} rows={2} className="border-border" />
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Checkbox checked={form.showInPortfolio} onCheckedChange={(checked) => setForm({ ...form, showInPortfolio: !!checked })} />
              <Label className="text-sm cursor-pointer" onClick={() => setForm({ ...form, showInPortfolio: !form.showInPortfolio })}>
                إظهار بالبورتفوليو
              </Label>
            </div>
          </div>

          <DialogFooter>
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setDialogOpen(false)} className="border-border">إلغاء</Button>
            <Button onClick={handleSave} disabled={!form.name.trim()} className="bg-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-800 text-white gap-2">
              {editingItem ? <><Pencil className="w-4 h-4" />حفظ</> : <><Plus className="w-4 h-4" />إضافة</>}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState, useMemo, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import {
  Award, Plus, Pencil, Trash2, ExternalLink, Download,
  FileText, Upload, X, Eye,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { Switch } from '@/components/ui/switch';
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogDescription,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from '@/components/ui/select';
import { useAppStore } from '@/lib/store';
import { CERTIFICATE_TYPE_CONFIG } from '@/types';
import type { Certificate, CertificateType } from '@/types';

// ============ ثوابت ============
type FilterValue = 'all' | CertificateType;

const FILTER_TABS: Array<{ value: FilterValue; label: string }> = [
  { value: 'all', label: 'الكل' },
  { value: 'academic', label: 'أكاديمي' },
  { value: 'professional', label: 'مهني' },
  { value: 'course', label: 'دورة' },
  { value: 'award', label: 'جائزة' },
  { value: 'competition', label: 'مسابقة' },
  { value: 'other', label: 'أخرى' },
];

function formatDate(dateStr: string): string {
  try {
    const d = new Date(dateStr);
    return d.toLocaleDateString('ar-PS', {
      year: 'numeric',
      month: 'long',
      day: 'numeric',
    });
  } catch {
    return dateStr;
  }
}

function getExpiryStatus(expiryDate?: string): { label: string; color: string } | null {
  if (!expiryDate) return null;
  const now = new Date();
  const expiry = new Date(expiryDate);
  const diff = expiry.getTime() - now.getTime();
  const daysLeft = Math.ceil(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));

  if (daysLeft < 0) return { label: 'منتهية', color: 'bg-red-100 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-900/30 dark:text-red-400' };
  if (daysLeft <= 30) return { label: `تنتهي قريباً (${daysLeft} يوم)`, color: 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-900/30 dark:text-amber-400' };
  if (daysLeft <= 90) return { label: `صالحة (${daysLeft} يوم)`, color: 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-900/30 dark:text-emerald-400' };
  return { label: 'صالحة', color: 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-900/30 dark:text-emerald-400' };
}

// ============ نموذج ============
interface CertificateForm {
  title: string;
  description: string;
  type: CertificateType;
  issuer: string;
  date: string;
  expiryDate: string;
  credentialId: string;
  credentialUrl: string;
  fileUrl: string;
  skills: string[];
  showInPortfolio: boolean;
  skillInput: string;
}

const emptyForm: CertificateForm = {
  title: '',
  description: '',
  type: 'course',
  issuer: '',
  date: '',
  expiryDate: '',
  credentialId: '',
  credentialUrl: '',
  fileUrl: '',
  skills: [],
  showInPortfolio: true,
  skillInput: '',
};

// ============ المكون الرئيسي ============
export function CertificatesSection() {
  const { certificates, addCertificate, updateCertificate, deleteCertificate } = useAppStore();
  const [activeFilter, setActiveFilter] = useState<FilterValue>('all');
  const [dialogOpen, setDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [detailOpen, setDetailOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingCert, setEditingCert] = useState<Certificate | null>(null);
  const [selectedCert, setSelectedCert] = useState<Certificate | null>(null);
  const [form, setForm] = useState<CertificateForm>(emptyForm);
  const [deleteConfirm, setDeleteConfirm] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  // ========== الفلتر والإحصائيات ==========
  const filteredCertificates = useMemo(() => {
    const sorted = [...certificates].sort(
      (a, b) => new Date(b.date).getTime() - new Date(a.date).getTime()
    );
    if (activeFilter === 'all') return sorted;
    return sorted.filter((c) => c.type === activeFilter);
  }, [certificates, activeFilter]);

  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    const total = certificates.length;
    const byType = Object.fromEntries(
      (Object.keys(CERTIFICATE_TYPE_CONFIG) as CertificateType[]).map((key) => [
        key,
        certificates.filter((c) => c.type === key).length,
      ])
    );
    const portfolioCount = certificates.filter((c) => c.showInPortfolio).length;
    return { total, byType, portfolioCount };
  }, [certificates]);

  // ========== وظائف ==========
  const openAdd = () => {
    setEditingCert(null);
    setForm(emptyForm);
    setDialogOpen(true);
  };

  const openEdit = (cert: Certificate) => {
    setEditingCert(cert);
    setForm({
      title: cert.title,
      description: cert.description,
      type: cert.type,
      issuer: cert.issuer,
      date: cert.date,
      expiryDate: cert.expiryDate || '',
      credentialId: cert.credentialId || '',
      credentialUrl: cert.credentialUrl || '',
      fileUrl: cert.fileUrl || '',
      skills: [...cert.skills],
      showInPortfolio: cert.showInPortfolio,
      skillInput: '',
    });
    setDialogOpen(true);
  };

  const openDetail = (cert: Certificate) => {
    setSelectedCert(cert);
    setDetailOpen(true);
  };

  const handleSave = () => {
    if (!form.title.trim() || !form.issuer.trim() || !form.date) return;

    const data = {
      title: form.title.trim(),
      description: form.description.trim(),
      type: form.type,
      issuer: form.issuer.trim(),
      date: form.date,
      expiryDate: form.expiryDate || undefined,
      credentialId: form.credentialId.trim() || undefined,
      credentialUrl: form.credentialUrl.trim() || undefined,
      fileUrl: form.fileUrl || undefined,
      skills: form.skills,
      showInPortfolio: form.showInPortfolio,
    };

    if (editingCert) {
      updateCertificate(editingCert.id, data);
    } else {
      addCertificate(data);
    }
    setDialogOpen(false);
    setForm(emptyForm);
    setEditingCert(null);
  };

  const handleDelete = (id: string) => {
    deleteCertificate(id);
    setDeleteConfirm(null);
  };

  const handlePortfolioToggle = (id: string, value: boolean) => {
    updateCertificate(id, { showInPortfolio: value });
  };

  // ========== المهارات ==========
  const addSkill = useCallback((e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      e.preventDefault();
      const skill = form.skillInput.trim();
      if (skill && !form.skills.includes(skill)) {
        setForm((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          skills: [...prev.skills, skill],
          skillInput: '',
        }));
      }
    }
  }, [form.skills, form.skillInput]);

  const removeSkill = (skill: string) => {
    setForm((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      skills: prev.skills.filter((s) => s !== skill),
    }));
  };

  // ========== رفع الملف ==========
  const handleFileUpload = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;

    setUploading(true);
    try {
      const formData = new FormData();
      formData.append('file', file);
      const res = await fetch('/api/upload', { method: 'POST', body: formData });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.url) {
        setForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, fileUrl: data.url }));
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Upload error:', err);
    } finally {
      setUploading(false);
      if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = '';
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* ============ الترويسة ============ */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground flex items-center gap-2">
            <Award className="w-6 h-6 text-amber-500" />
            الشهادات والإنجازات
          </h2>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm mt-1">تتبع شهاداتك وإنجازاتك المهنية والأكاديمية</p>
        </div>
        <Button onClick={openAdd} className="gap-2 bg-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-800 text-white">
          <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
          شهادة جديدة
        </Button>
      </div>

      {/* ============ الإحصائيات ============ */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
        <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
          <CardContent className="p-4 text-center">
            <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">{stats.total}</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">إجمالي الشهادات</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
        <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
          <CardContent className="p-4 text-center">
            <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-amber-600">
              {stats.byType.award + stats.byType.competition}
            </p>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">جوائز ومسابقات</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
        <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
          <CardContent className="p-4 text-center">
            <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-emerald-600">{stats.byType.course}</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">دورات تدريبية</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
        <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
          <CardContent className="p-4 text-center">
            <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">{stats.portfolioCount}</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">في المعرض</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>

      {/* ============ فلتر الأنواع ============ */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        {FILTER_TABS.map((tab) => {
          const count =
            tab.value === 'all'
              ? certificates.length
              : certificates.filter((c) => c.type === tab.value).length;
          const isActive = activeFilter === tab.value;
          return (
            <Button
              key={tab.value}
              variant={isActive ? 'default' : 'outline'}
              size="sm"
              onClick={() => setActiveFilter(tab.value)}
              className={
                isActive
                  ? 'bg-gray-900 text-white hover:bg-gray-800'
                  : 'border-border text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted'
              }
            >
              {tab.value !== 'all' && (
                <span className="ml-1">{CERTIFICATE_TYPE_CONFIG[tab.value as CertificateType].icon}</span>
              )}
              {tab.label}
              <Badge
                variant="secondary"
                className={`mr-1.5 text-[10px] px-1.5 ${
                  isActive ? 'bg-white/20 text-white' : 'bg-muted text-muted-foreground'
                }`}
              >
                {count}
              </Badge>
            </Button>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* ============ قائمة الشهادات ============ */}
      {filteredCertificates.length === 0 ? (
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 16 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          className="text-center py-16"
        >
          <div className="text-5xl mb-3 opacity-40">🏅</div>
          <h3 className="text-base font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">
            {certificates.length === 0
              ? 'لم تضف أي شهادات بعد — سجّل إنجازاتك وشهاداتك'
              : 'لا توجد شهادات في هذا التصنيف'}
          </h3>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-4">ابدأ بإضافة شهاداتك وإنجازاتك</p>
          <Button onClick={openAdd} variant="outline" className="gap-2">
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
            إضافة شهادة
          </Button>
        </motion.div>
      ) : (
        <div className="relative space-y-3">
          {/* خط زمني */}
          <div className="absolute right-[19px] top-4 bottom-4 w-px bg-border" />

          <AnimatePresence mode="popLayout">
            {filteredCertificates.map((cert, index) => {
              const typeConfig = CERTIFICATE_TYPE_CONFIG[cert.type];
              const expiryStatus = getExpiryStatus(cert.expiryDate);

              return (
                <motion.div
                  key={cert.id}
                  layout
                  initial={{ opacity: 0, x: 20 }}
                  animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }}
                  exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -20 }}
                  transition={{ delay: index * 0.03 }}
                  className="relative pr-10"
                >
                  {/* نقطة الخط الزمني */}
                  <div className="absolute right-2.5 top-6 w-3.5 h-3.5 rounded-full border-2 border-background bg-muted-foreground/30 z-10" />

                  <Card
                    className="border border-border bg-background hover:border-foreground/20 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                    onClick={() => openDetail(cert)}
                  >
                    <CardContent className="p-4">
                      {/* الرأس */}
                      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                        <div className="flex items-start gap-3 min-w-0 flex-1">

                          <div className="min-w-0">
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                              <h3 className="font-medium text-sm text-foreground truncate">

                              {expiryStatus && (
                                <Badge
                                  variant="secondary"
                                  className={`text-[10px] shrink-0 ${expiryStatus.color}`}
```
