```tsx
                                  {expiryStatus.label}
                                </Badge>
                              )}
                            </div>
                            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1 truncate">
                              {cert.issuer}
                            </p>
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        {/* أزرار التحكم */}
                        <div
                          className="flex items-center gap-0.5 shrink-0"
                          onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                        >
                          <Button
                            variant="ghost"
                            size="icon"
                            className="h-7 w-7 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
                            onClick={() => openEdit(cert)}
                          >
                            <Pencil className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </Button>
                          <Button
                            variant="ghost"
                            size="icon"
                            className="h-7 w-7 text-muted-foreground hover:text-red-500"
                            onClick={() => setDeleteConfirm(cert.id)}
                          >
                            <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </Button>
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mr-1">
                            <Switch
                              checked={cert.showInPortfolio}
                              onCheckedChange={(val) => handlePortfolioToggle(cert.id, val)}
                              className="scale-75 origin-right"
                            />
                            <Eye className="w-3 h-3 text-muted-foreground" />
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {/* التاريخ والمهارات */}
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mt-2.5 flex-wrap">
                        <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">

                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 flex-wrap">

                                {skill}

                                +{cert.skills.length - 4}

                        )}
                        {cert.fileUrl && (
                          <FileText className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-muted-foreground" />
                        )}
                      </div>

                      {/* تأكيد الحذف */}
                      <AnimatePresence>
                        {deleteConfirm === cert.id && (
                          <motion.div
                            initial={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
                            animate={{ opacity: 1, height: 'auto' }}
                            exit={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
                            className="mt-3 pt-3 border-t border-border"
                            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
                          >
                            <p className="text-xs text-red-500 mb-2">هل تريد حذف هذه الشهادة؟</p>
                            <div className="flex gap-2">
                              <Button
                                size="sm"
                                variant="destructive"
                                className="h-7 text-xs"
                                onClick={() => handleDelete(cert.id)}
                              >
                                حذف
                              </Button>
                              <Button
                                size="sm"
                                variant="outline"
                                className="h-7 text-xs"
                                onClick={() => setDeleteConfirm(null)}
                              >
                                إلغاء
                              </Button>
                            </div>
                          </motion.div>
                        )}
                      </AnimatePresence>
                    </CardContent>
                  </Card>
                </motion.div>
              );
            })}
          </AnimatePresence>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ============ حوار إضافة/تعديل ============ */}
      <Dialog open={dialogOpen} onOpenChange={setDialogOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="max-w-lg max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto" dir="rtl">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>
              {editingCert ? 'تعديل الشهادة' : 'إضافة شهادة جديدة'}
            </DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>
              {editingCert ? 'قم بتعديل بيانات الشهادة' : 'أدخل بيانات الشهادة أو الإنجاز الجديد'}
            </DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>

          <div className="space-y-4">
            {/* العنوان */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="cert-title">عنوان الشهادة *</Label>
              <Input
                id="cert-title"
                placeholder="مثال: شهادة JavaScript المتقدم"
                value={form.title}
                onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, title: e.target.value })}
                className="border-border"
              />
            </div>

            {/* الوصف */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="cert-desc">الوصف</Label>
              <Textarea
                id="cert-desc"
                placeholder="وصف مختصر للشهادة أو الإنجاز"
                value={form.description}

                className="border-border min-h-[80px] resize-none"

                >

                  <SelectContent>
                    {(Object.entries(CERTIFICATE_TYPE_CONFIG) as [CertificateType, { label: string; icon: string }][]).map(
                      ([key, config]) => (
                        <SelectItem key={key} value={key}>
                          {config.icon} {config.label}

                      )
                    )}
                  </SelectContent>
                </Select>
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="cert-issuer">الجهة المانحة *</Label>
                <Input
                  id="cert-issuer"
                  placeholder="مثال: Coursera, Google"
                  value={form.issuer}
                  onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, issuer: e.target.value })}
                  className="border-border"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* التواريخ */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="cert-date">تاريخ الحصول *</Label>
                <Input
                  id="cert-date"
                  type="date"
                  value={form.date}
                  onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, date: e.target.value })}
                  className="border-border"
                />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="cert-expiry">تاريخ الانتهاء</Label>
                <Input
                  id="cert-expiry"
                  type="date"
                  value={form.expiryDate}
                  onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, expiryDate: e.target.value })}
                  className="border-border"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* رقم الشهادة والرابط */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="cert-cred-id">رقم الشهادة</Label>
                <Input
                  id="cert-cred-id"
                  placeholder="رقم التعريف"
                  value={form.credentialId}
                  onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, credentialId: e.target.value })}
                  className="border-border"
                  dir="ltr"
                />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="cert-cred-url">رابط التحقق</Label>
                <Input
                  id="cert-cred-url"
                  placeholder="https://..."
                  value={form.credentialUrl}
                  onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, credentialUrl: e.target.value })}
                  className="border-border"
                  dir="ltr"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* رفع ملف */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>ملف الشهادة</Label>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <input
                  ref={fileInputRef}
                  type="file"
                  accept="image/*,.pdf"
                  className="hidden"
                  onChange={handleFileUpload}
                />
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  variant="outline"
                  size="sm"
                  className="gap-2 border-border"
                  onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
                  disabled={uploading}
                >
                  {uploading ? (
                    <span className="animate-spin">⏳</span>
                  ) : (
                    <Upload className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  )}
                  {uploading ? 'جاري الرفع...' : form.fileUrl ? 'تغيير الملف' : 'رفع ملف'}
                </Button>
                {form.fileUrl && (
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <FileText className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                    <span className="text-xs text-emerald-600 truncate max-w-[150px]">تم الرفع</span>
                    <Button
                      type="button"
                      variant="ghost"
                      size="icon"
                      className="h-6 w-6 text-muted-foreground hover:text-red-500"
                      onClick={() => setForm({ ...form, fileUrl: '' })}
                    >
                      <X className="w-3 h-3" />
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* المهارات المكتسبة */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>المهارات المكتسبة</Label>
              <Input
                placeholder="اكتب المهارة ثم اضغط Enter"
                value={form.skillInput}
                onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, skillInput: e.target.value })}
                onKeyDown={addSkill}
                className="border-border"
              />
              {form.skills.length > 0 && (
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 mt-2">
                  {form.skills.map((skill) => (
                    <Badge
                      key={skill}
                      variant="secondary"
                      className="text-xs bg-primary/10 text-primary gap-1 pl-1"
                    >
                      {skill}
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        className="hover:bg-primary/20 rounded-full p-0.5 transition-colors"
                        onClick={() => removeSkill(skill)}
                      >
                        <X className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
                      </button>
                    </Badge>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* إظهار في المعرض */}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between py-1">
              <Label>إظهار في المعرض</Label>
              <Switch
                checked={form.showInPortfolio}
                onCheckedChange={(val) => setForm({ ...form, showInPortfolio: val })}
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <DialogFooter>
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              onClick={() => setDialogOpen(false)}
              className="border-border"
            >
              إلغاء
            </Button>
            <Button
              onClick={handleSave}
              disabled={!form.title.trim() || !form.issuer.trim() || !form.date}
              className="bg-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-800 text-white gap-2"
            >
              {editingCert ? (
                <>
                  <Pencil className="w-4 h-4" />
                  حفظ التعديلات
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
                  إضافة
                </>
              )}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>

      {/* ============ حوار التفاصيل ============ */}
      <Dialog open={detailOpen} onOpenChange={setDetailOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="max-w-lg max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto" dir="rtl">
          {selectedCert && (
            <>
              <DialogHeader>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                  <span className="text-3xl">{CERTIFICATE_TYPE_CONFIG[selectedCert.type].icon}</span>
                  <div>
                    <DialogTitle className="text-lg">{selectedCert.title}</DialogTitle>
                    <DialogDescription className="mt-1">
                      {CERTIFICATE_TYPE_CONFIG[selectedCert.type].label} — {selectedCert.issuer}
                    </DialogDescription>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </DialogHeader>

              <div className="space-y-4 mt-2">
                {/* الوصف */}
                {selectedCert.description && (
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">الوصف</p>
                    <p className="text-sm text-foreground leading-relaxed">{selectedCert.description}</p>
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* تفاصيل */}
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">تاريخ الحصول</p>
                    <p className="text-sm text-foreground">{formatDate(selectedCert.date)}</p>
                  </div>
                  {selectedCert.expiryDate && (
                    <div>
                      <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">تاريخ الانتهاء</p>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <p className="text-sm text-foreground">{formatDate(selectedCert.expiryDate)}</p>
                        {getExpiryStatus(selectedCert.expiryDate) && (
                          <Badge
                            variant="secondary"
                            className={`text-[10px] ${getExpiryStatus(selectedCert.expiryDate)!.color}`}
                          >
                            {getExpiryStatus(selectedCert.expiryDate)!.label}
                          </Badge>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* رقم الشهادة */}
                {selectedCert.credentialId && (
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">رقم الشهادة</p>
                    <p className="text-sm text-foreground font-mono" dir="ltr">{selectedCert.credentialId}</p>
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* روابط */}
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                  {selectedCert.credentialUrl && (
                    <a
                      href={selectedCert.credentialUrl}
                      target="_blank"
                      rel="noopener noreferrer"
                      className="inline-flex"
                    >
                      <Button
                        variant="outline"
                        size="sm"
                        className="gap-2 border-border text-xs"
                      >
                        <ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        رابط التحقق
                      </Button>
                    </a>
                  )}
                  {selectedCert.fileUrl && (
                    <a
                      href={selectedCert.fileUrl}
                      download
                      target="_blank"
                      rel="noopener noreferrer"
                      className="inline-flex"
                    >
                      <Button
                        variant="outline"
                        size="sm"
                        className="gap-2 border-border text-xs"
                      >
                        <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        تحميل الملف
                      </Button>
                    </a>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* المهارات */}
                {selectedCert.skills.length > 0 && (
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-2">المهارات المكتسبة</p>
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                      {selectedCert.skills.map((skill) => (
                        <Badge
                          key={skill}
                          variant="secondary"
                          className="text-xs bg-primary/10 text-primary"
                        >
                          {skill}
                        </Badge>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* حالة المعرض */}
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-2 border-t border-border">
                  <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    {selectedCert.showInPortfolio ? '✅ ظاهرة في المعرض' : '🔒 مخفية عن المعرض'}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <DialogFooter className="gap-2">
                <Button
                  variant="outline"
                  className="gap-2 border-border"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setDetailOpen(false);
                    openEdit(selectedCert);
                  }}
                >
                  <Pencil className="w-4 h-4" />
                  تعديل
                </Button>
                <Button
                  variant="outline"
                  className="gap-2 border-border"
                  onClick={() => setDetailOpen(false)}
                >
                  إغلاق
                </Button>
              </DialogFooter>
            </>
          )}
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## 📝 الكود الكامل

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState, useMemo, useCallback } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import {
  Users,
  Plus,
  Pencil,
  Trash2,
  Clock,
  Building,
  ExternalLink,
  Upload,
  X,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { Switch } from '@/components/ui/switch';
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogDescription,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from '@/components/ui/select';
import { useAppStore } from '@/lib/store';
import { ACTIVITY_TYPE_CONFIG } from '@/types';
import type { VolunteerActivity, ActivityType } from '@/types';

// ============ ثوابت ============
const FILTER_TABS: Array<{ value: 'all' | ActivityType; label: string; icon: string }> = [
  { value: 'all', label: 'الكل', icon: '' },
  { value: 'volunteer', label: 'تطوع', icon: '🤝' },
  { value: 'club', label: 'نادي', icon: '🏛️' },
  { value: 'event', label: 'فعالية', icon: '🎪' },
  { value: 'workshop', label: 'ورشة', icon: '🔧' },
  { value: 'community', label: 'خدمة مجتمع', icon: '🌍' },
  { value: 'other', label: 'أخرى', icon: '📋' },
];

// ============ نموذج ============
interface ActivityForm {
  title: string;
  description: string;
  type: ActivityType;
  organization: string;
  role: string;
  startDate: string;
  endDate: string;
  hoursSpent: number;
  skills: string[];
  images: string[];
  links: { label: string; url: string }[];
  showInPortfolio: boolean;
}

const emptyForm: ActivityForm = {
  title: '',
  description: '',
  type: 'volunteer',
  organization: '',
  role: '',
  startDate: '',
  endDate: '',
  hoursSpent: 0,
  skills: [],
  images: [],
  links: [],
  showInPortfolio: true,
};

// ============ المكون الرئيسي ============
export function ActivitiesSection() {
  const {
    volunteerActivities,
    addVolunteerActivity,
    updateVolunteerActivity,
    deleteVolunteerActivity,
  } = useAppStore();

  const [activeFilter, setActiveFilter] = useState<'all' | ActivityType>('all');
  const [addDialogOpen, setAddDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [detailItem, setDetailItem] = useState<VolunteerActivity | null>(null);
  const [editingItem, setEditingItem] = useState<VolunteerActivity | null>(null);
  const [form, setForm] = useState<ActivityForm>(emptyForm);
  const [deleteConfirm, setDeleteConfirm] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);
  const [skillInput, setSkillInput] = useState('');
  const [linkLabel, setLinkLabel] = useState('');
  const [linkUrl, setLinkUrl] = useState('');

  // ============ computed ============
  const filteredItems = useMemo(() => {
    if (activeFilter === 'all') return volunteerActivities;
    return volunteerActivities.filter((a) => a.type === activeFilter);
  }, [volunteerActivities, activeFilter]);

  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    const total = volunteerActivities.length;
    const totalHours = volunteerActivities.reduce((sum, a) => sum + (a.hoursSpent || 0), 0);
    const organizations = new Set(volunteerActivities.map((a) => a.organization).filter(Boolean)).size;
    return { total, totalHours, organizations };
  }, [volunteerActivities]);

  // ============ handlers ============
  const openAdd = () => {
    setEditingItem(null);
    setForm(emptyForm);
    setSkillInput('');
    setLinkLabel('');
    setLinkUrl('');
    setAddDialogOpen(true);
  };

  const openEdit = (item: VolunteerActivity) => {
    setEditingItem(item);
    setForm({
      title: item.title,
      description: item.description,
      type: item.type,
      organization: item.organization,
      role: item.role,
      startDate: item.startDate,
      endDate: item.endDate || '',
      hoursSpent: item.hoursSpent,
      skills: [...item.skills],
      images: [...item.images],
      links: item.links.map((l) => ({ ...l })),
      showInPortfolio: item.showInPortfolio,
    });
    setSkillInput('');
    setLinkLabel('');
    setLinkUrl('');
    setAddDialogOpen(true);
  };

  const handleSave = () => {
    if (!form.title.trim()) return;
    const payload = {
      title: form.title.trim(),
      description: form.description.trim(),
      type: form.type,
      organization: form.organization.trim(),
      role: form.role.trim(),
      startDate: form.startDate,
      endDate: form.endDate || undefined,
      hoursSpent: form.hoursSpent,
      skills: form.skills,
      images: form.images,
      links: form.links,
      showInPortfolio: form.showInPortfolio,
    };
    if (editingItem) {
      updateVolunteerActivity(editingItem.id, payload);
    } else {
      addVolunteerActivity(payload);
    }
    setAddDialogOpen(false);
    setForm(emptyForm);
    setEditingItem(null);
  };

  const handleDelete = (id: string) => {
    deleteVolunteerActivity(id);
    setDeleteConfirm(null);
  };

  const togglePortfolio = (id: string, current: boolean) => {
    updateVolunteerActivity(id, { showInPortfolio: !current });
  };

  // ============ skills ============
  const addSkill = useCallback(() => {
    const skill = skillInput.trim();
    if (skill && !form.skills.includes(skill)) {
      setForm((f) => ({ ...f, skills: [...f.skills, skill] }));
    }
    setSkillInput('');
  }, [skillInput, form.skills]);

  const removeSkill = useCallback((skill: string) => {
    setForm((f) => ({ ...f, skills: f.skills.filter((s) => s !== skill) }));
  }, []);

  // ============ links ============
  const addLink = useCallback(() => {
    if (linkLabel.trim() && linkUrl.trim()) {
      setForm((f) => ({
        ...f,
        links: [...f.links, { label: linkLabel.trim(), url: linkUrl.trim() }],
      }));
      setLinkLabel('');
      setLinkUrl('');
    }
  }, [linkLabel, linkUrl]);

  const removeLink = useCallback((index: number) => {
    setForm((f) => ({
      ...f,
      links: f.links.filter((_, i) => i !== index),
    }));
  }, []);

  // ============ image upload ============
  const handleImageUpload = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const files = e.target.files;
    if (!files || files.length === 0) return;
    setUploading(true);
    try {
      for (const file of Array.from(files)) {
        const formData = new FormData();
        formData.append('file', file);
        const res = await fetch('/api/upload', {
          method: 'POST',
          body: formData,
        });
        if (res.ok) {
          const data = await res.json();
          if (data.url) {
            setForm((f) => ({ ...f, images: [...f.images, data.url] }));
          }
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Upload failed:', err);
    }
    setUploading(false);
    e.target.value = '';
  };

  const removeImage = useCallback((imageUrl: string) => {
    setForm((f) => ({ ...f, images: f.images.filter((i) => i !== imageUrl) }));
  }, []);

  // ============ helpers ============
  const formatDate = (dateStr: string) => {
    if (!dateStr) return '';
    try {
      return new Date(dateStr).toLocaleDateString('ar-SA', {
        year: 'numeric',
        month: 'short',
        day: 'numeric',
      });
    } catch {
      return dateStr;
    }
  };

  const formatDateRange = (start: string, end?: string) => {
    if (!start) return '—';
    const s = formatDate(start);
    if (!end) return s;
    return `${s} — ${formatDate(end)}`;
  };

  // ============ render ============
  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* ============ الترويسة ============ */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground flex items-center gap-2">
            <Users className="w-6 h-6 text-emerald-500" />
            التطوع والأنشطة
          </h2>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm mt-1">تطوعك وأنشطتك اللامنهجية</p>
        </div>
        <Button onClick={openAdd} className="gap-2 bg-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-800 text-white">
          <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
          نشاط جديد
        </Button>
      </div>

      {/* ============ إحصائيات ============ */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
        <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
          <CardContent className="p-4 text-center">
            <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">{stats.total}</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">إجمالي الأنشطة</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
        <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
          <CardContent className="p-4 text-center">
            <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-emerald-600">{stats.totalHours}</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">ساعة تطوع</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
        <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
          <CardContent className="p-4 text-center">
            <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-amber-600">{stats.organizations}</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">منظمة</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>

      {/* ============ فلتر الفئات ============ */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        {FILTER_TABS.map((tab) => {
          const count =
            tab.value === 'all'
              ? volunteerActivities.length
              : volunteerActivities.filter((a) => a.type === tab.value).length;
          const isActive = activeFilter === tab.value;
          return (
            <Button
              key={tab.value}
              variant={isActive ? 'default' : 'outline'}
              size="sm"
              onClick={() => setActiveFilter(tab.value)}
              className={
                isActive
                  ? 'bg-gray-900 text-white hover:bg-gray-800'
                  : 'border-border text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted'
              }
            >
              {tab.icon && <span className="ml-1">{tab.icon}</span>}
              {tab.label}
              <Badge
                variant="secondary"
                className={`mr-1.5 text-[10px] px-1.5 ${
                  isActive ? 'bg-white/20 text-white' : 'bg-muted text-muted-foreground'
                }`}
              >
                {count}
              </Badge>
            </Button>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* ============ قائمة الأنشطة ============ */}
      {filteredItems.length === 0 ? (
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 16 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          className="text-center py-16"
        >
          <div className="text-5xl mb-3 opacity-40">🤝</div>
          <h3 className="text-base font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">
            {volunteerActivities.length === 0
              ? 'لم تضف أي أنشطة بعد — سجّل تطوعك وأنشطتك اللامنهجية'
              : 'لا توجد أنشطة في هذه الفئة'}
          </h3>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-4">
            الأنشطة اللامنهجية مهمة جداً لسيرتك الذاتية
          </p>
          <Button onClick={openAdd} variant="outline" className="gap-2">
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
            إضافة نشاط
          </Button>
        </motion.div>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <AnimatePresence mode="popLayout">
            {filteredItems.map((item, index) => (
              <motion.div
                key={item.id}
                layout
                initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }}
                animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -8 }}
                transition={{ delay: index * 0.03 }}
              >
                <Card
                  className="border bg-background transition-colors hover:border-border cursor-pointer"
                  onClick={() => setDetailItem(item)}
                >
                  <CardContent className="p-4">
                    <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                      {/* أيقونة النوع */}
                      <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg bg-muted flex items-center justify-center text-lg shrink-0 mt-0.5">
                        {ACTIVITY_TYPE_CONFIG[item.type].icon}
                      </div>

                      {/* المحتوى */}
                      <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                          <div className="min-w-0">
                            <h3 className="font-medium text-sm text-foreground">
                              {item.title}
                            </h3>
                            {item.organization && (
                              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5 flex items-center gap-1">
                                <Building className="w-3 h-3" />
                                {item.organization}
                              </p>
                            )}
                          </div>
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5 shrink-0">
                            <Button
                              variant="ghost"
                              size="icon"
                              className="h-7 w-7 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
                              onClick={(e) => {
                                e.stopPropagation();
                                openEdit(item);
                              }}
                            >
                              <Pencil className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                            </Button>
                            <Button
                              variant="ghost"
                              size="icon"
                              className="h-7 w-7 text-muted-foreground hover:text-red-500"
                              onClick={(e) => {
                                e.stopPropagation();
                                setDeleteConfirm(item.id);
                              }}
                            >
                              <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                            </Button>
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        {/* التفاصيل */}
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mt-2.5 flex-wrap">
                          {/* نوع النشاط */}
                          <Badge
                            variant="secondary"
                            className="text-[10px] bg-muted text-muted-foreground"
                          >
                            {ACTIVITY_TYPE_CONFIG[item.type].icon}{' '}
                            {ACTIVITY_TYPE_CONFIG[item.type].label}
                          </Badge>

                          {/* الدور */}
                          {item.role && (
                            <Badge
                              variant="secondary"
                              className="text-[10px] bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-900/30 dark:text-emerald-400"
                            >
                              {item.role}
                            </Badge>
                          )}

                          {/* التاريخ */}
                          {item.startDate && (
                            <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                              <Clock className="w-3 h-3" />
                              {formatDateRange(item.startDate, item.endDate)}
                            </span>
                          )}

                          {/* الساعات */}
                          {item.hoursSpent > 0 && (
                            <Badge
                              variant="secondary"
                              className="text-[10px] bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-900/30 dark:text-amber-400"
                            >
                              <Clock className="w-3 h-3 ml-0.5" />
                              {item.hoursSpent} ساعة
                            </Badge>
                          )}

                          {/* Portfolio toggle */}
                          <div
                            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mr-auto"
                            onClick={(e) => {
                              e.stopPropagation();
                              togglePortfolio(item.id, item.showInPortfolio);
                            }}
                          >
                            <Switch
                              checked={item.showInPortfolio}
                              className="scale-75"
                            />
                            <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">المعرض</span>
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        {/* المهارات */}
                        {item.skills.length > 0 && (
                          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1 mt-2">
                            {item.skills.slice(0, 4).map((skill) => (
                              <Badge
                                key={skill}
                                variant="secondary"
                                className="text-[10px] bg-muted text-muted-foreground"
                              >
                                {skill}
                              </Badge>
                            ))}
                            {item.skills.length > 4 && (
                              <Badge
                                variant="secondary"
                                className="text-[10px] bg-muted text-muted-foreground"
                              >
                                +{item.skills.length - 4}
                              </Badge>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* تأكيد الحذف */}
                    <AnimatePresence>
                      {deleteConfirm === item.id && (
                        <motion.div
                          initial={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
                          animate={{ opacity: 1, height: 'auto' }}
                          exit={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
                          className="mt-3 pt-3 border-t border-border"
                        >
                          <p className="text-xs text-red-500 mb-2">هل تريد حذف هذا النشاط؟</p>
                          <div className="flex gap-2">
                            <Button
                              size="sm"
                              variant="destructive"
                              className="h-7 text-xs"
                              onClick={(e) => {
                                e.stopPropagation();
                                handleDelete(item.id);
                              }}
                            >
                              حذف
                            </Button>
                            <Button
                              size="sm"
                              variant="outline"
                              className="h-7 text-xs"
                              onClick={(e) => {
                                e.stopPropagation();
                                setDeleteConfirm(null);
                              }}
                            >
                              إلغاء
                            </Button>
                          </div>
                        </motion.div>
                      )}
                    </AnimatePresence>
                  </CardContent>
                </Card>
              </motion.div>
            ))}
          </AnimatePresence>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ============ حوار التفاصيل ============ */}
      <Dialog open={!!detailItem} onOpenChange={(open) => !open && setDetailItem(null)}>
        <DialogContent className="max-w-lg" dir="rtl">
          {detailItem && (
            <>
              <DialogHeader>
                <DialogTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <span>{ACTIVITY_TYPE_CONFIG[detailItem.type].icon}</span>
                  {detailItem.title}
                </DialogTitle>
                <DialogDescription>
                  {ACTIVITY_TYPE_CONFIG[detailItem.type].label} — {detailItem.organization || 'بدون منظمة'}
                </DialogDescription>
              </DialogHeader>

              <div className="space-y-4 max-h-[60vh] overflow-y-auto">
                {/* الوصف */}
                {detailItem.description && (
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-sm text-foreground leading-relaxed">
                      {detailItem.description}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* تفاصيل سريعة */}
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                  {detailItem.role && (
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-muted/50">
                      <Users className="w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                      <div>
                        <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">الدور</p>
                        <p className="text-xs font-medium text-foreground">{detailItem.role}</p>
                      </div>

                  )}
                  {detailItem.hoursSpent > 0 && (
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-muted/50">
                      <Clock className="w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                      <div>
                        <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">الساعات</p>
                        <p className="text-xs font-medium text-foreground">{detailItem.hoursSpent} ساعة</p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}
                  {detailItem.organization && (
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-muted/50">
                      <Building className="w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                      <div>
                        <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">المنظمة</p>
                        <p className="text-xs font-medium text-foreground">{detailItem.organization}</p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}
                  {detailItem.startDate && (
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-muted/50">
                      <Clock className="w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                      <div>
                        <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">الفترة</p>
                        <p className="text-xs font-medium text-foreground">
                          {formatDateRange(detailItem.startDate, detailItem.endDate)}

                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* المهارات */}
                {detailItem.skills.length > 0 && (
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-2">المهارات المكتسبة</p>
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                      {detailItem.skills.map((skill) => (
                        <Badge
                          key={skill}
                          variant="secondary"
                          className="text-xs bg-muted text-foreground"
                        >
                          {skill}
                        </Badge>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* الصور */}
                {detailItem.images.length > 0 && (
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-2">الصور</p>
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
                      {detailItem.images.map((img, idx) => (
                        <div
                          key={idx}
                          className="aspect-square rounded-lg overflow-hidden border border-border bg-muted"
                        >
                          <img
                            src={img}
                            alt={`${detailItem.title} - ${idx + 1}`}

                      ))}

                  </div>
                )}

                {/* الروابط */}
                {detailItem.links.length > 0 && (
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-2">الروابط</p>

                      {detailItem.links.map((link, idx) => (
                        <a
                          key={idx}

                <Button
                  variant="outline"

        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>

      {/* ============ حوار إضافة/تعديل ============ */}
      <Dialog open={addDialogOpen} onOpenChange={setAddDialogOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="max-w-lg" dir="rtl">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>
              {editingItem ? 'تعديل النشاط' : 'إضافة نشاط جديد'}
            </DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>
              {editingItem ? 'قم بتعديل بيانات النشاط' : 'سجّل نشاطك التطوعي أو اللامنهجي'}
            </DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>

          <div className="space-y-4 max-h-[65vh] overflow-y-auto pr-1">
            {/* العنوان */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="act-title">العنوان *</Label>
              <Input
                id="act-title"
                placeholder="مثال: التطوع في ماراثون غزة"
                value={form.title}
                onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, title: e.target.value })}
                className="border-border"
              />
            </div>

            {/* الوصف */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="act-desc">الوصف</Label>
              <Textarea
                id="act-desc"
                placeholder="وصف مختصر للنشاط وما تعلمته منه..."
                value={form.description}
                onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, description: e.target.value })}
                rows={3}
                className="border-border"
              />
            </div>

            {/* النوع + الدور */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>النوع</Label>
                <Select
                  value={form.type}
                  onValueChange={(val) =>
                    setForm({ ...form, type: val as ActivityType })
                  }
                >
                  <SelectTrigger className="border-border">
                    <SelectValue />
                  </SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectContent>
                    {Object.entries(ACTIVITY_TYPE_CONFIG).map(([key, val]) => (
                      <SelectItem key={key} value={key}>
                        {val.icon} {val.label}

                    ))}
                  </SelectContent>
                </Select>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="act-role">الدور</Label>
                <Input
                  id="act-role"
                  placeholder="مثال: منظم، متطوع"

                  onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, role: e.target.value })}

                />
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* المنظمة */}
            <div className="space-y-2">

              <Input
                id="act-org"
                placeholder="مثال: الهلال الأحمر الفلسطيني"

              />
            </div>

            {/* التواريخ + الساعات */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="act-start">تاريخ البداية</Label>
                <Input
                  id="act-start"
                  type="date"
                  value={form.startDate}
                  onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, startDate: e.target.value })}
                  className="border-border"
                />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="act-end">تاريخ النهاية</Label>
                <Input
                  id="act-end"
                  type="date"
                  value={form.endDate}
                  onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, endDate: e.target.value })}
                  className="border-border"

              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="act-hours">الساعات</Label>
                <Input
                  id="act-hours"
                  type="number"
                  min={0}
                  placeholder="0"
                  value={form.hoursSpent || ''}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setForm({ ...form, hoursSpent: Number(e.target.value) || 0 })
                  }
                  className="border-border"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* المهارات */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>المهارات المكتسبة</Label>
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                <Input
                  placeholder="اكتب مهارة ثم اضغط Enter"
                  value={skillInput}
                  onChange={(e) => setSkillInput(e.target.value)}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                      e.preventDefault();
                      addSkill();
                    }
                  }}
                  className="border-border flex-1"
                />
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  variant="outline"
                  size="icon"
                  className="shrink-0 border-border"
                  onClick={addSkill}
                >
                  <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
                </Button>
              </div>
              {form.skills.length > 0 && (
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 mt-2">
                  {form.skills.map((skill) => (
                    <Badge
                      key={skill}

                      className="text-xs bg-muted text-foreground gap-1 pr-1"
                    >
                      {skill}
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => removeSkill(skill)}
                        className="hover:text-red-500 transition-colors"
                      >
                        <X className="w-3 h-3" />
                      </button>
                    </Badge>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* رفع الصور */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>الصور</Label>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <label className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 border border-dashed border-border rounded-lg cursor-pointer hover:bg-muted/50 transition-colors text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                  <Upload className="w-4 h-4" />
                  {uploading ? 'جاري الرفع...' : 'اختر صور'}
                  <input
                    type="file"
                    accept="image/*"
                    multiple
                    className="hidden"
                    onChange={handleImageUpload}
                    disabled={uploading}
                  />
                </label>
              </div>
              {form.images.length > 0 && (
                <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-2 mt-2">
                  {form.images.map((img, idx) => (
                    <div
                      key={idx}
                      className="relative aspect-square rounded-lg overflow-hidden border border-border bg-muted group"
                    >
                      <img
                        src={img}
                        alt={`صورة ${idx + 1}`}
                        className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                      />
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => removeImage(img)}
                        className="absolute top-1 left-1 w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-red-500 text-white flex items-center justify-center opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity"
                      >
                        <X className="w-3 h-3" />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* الروابط */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>الروابط</Label>
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                <Input
                  placeholder="عنوان الرابط"
                  value={linkLabel}
                  onChange={(e) => setLinkLabel(e.target.value)}
                  className="border-border flex-1"
                />
                <Input
                  placeholder="https://..."
                  value={linkUrl}
                  onChange={(e) => setLinkUrl(e.target.value)}
                  className="border-border flex-1"
                  onKeyDown={(e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                      e.preventDefault();
                      addLink();
                    }
                  }}
                />
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  variant="outline"
                  size="icon"
                  className="shrink-0 border-border"
                  onClick={addLink}
                >
                  <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
                </Button>
              </div>
              {form.links.length > 0 && (
                <div className="space-y-1.5 mt-2">
                  {form.links.map((link, idx) => (
                    <div
                      key={idx}
                      className="flex items-center gap-2 p-2 rounded-lg bg-muted/50"
                    >
                      <ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-muted-foreground shrink-0" />
                      <span className="text-xs text-foreground truncate flex-1">
                        {link.label}
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground truncate max-w-[120px]">
                        {link.url}
                      </span>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => removeLink(idx)}
                        className="hover:text-red-500 transition-colors shrink-0"
                      >
                        <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* عرض في المعرض */}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-2 border-t border-border">
              <div>
                <Label className="text-sm">عرض في المعرض العام</Label>
                <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
                  سيظهر في صفحة السيرة الذاتية العامة
                </p>
              </div>
              <Switch
                checked={form.showInPortfolio}
                onCheckedChange={(checked) => setForm({ ...form, showInPortfolio: checked })}
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <DialogFooter>
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setAddDialogOpen(false)} className="border-border">
              إلغاء
            </Button>
            <Button
              onClick={handleSave}
              disabled={!form.title.trim()}
              className="bg-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-800 text-white gap-2"
            >
              {editingItem ? (
                <>
                  <Pencil className="w-4 h-4" />
                  حفظ التعديلات
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
                  إضافة
                </>
              )}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState, useMemo, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';

import {
  Briefcase,

  Trash2,

  ExternalLink,
  Upload,

} from 'lucide-react';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';

import {

  DialogTitle,
```
