```tsx
  DialogDescription,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from '@/components/ui/select';
import { useAppStore } from '@/lib/store';
import { EXPERIENCE_TYPE_CONFIG } from '@/types';
import type { WorkExperience, ExperienceType } from '@/types';

// ============ ثوابت ============
const FILTER_TABS: Array<{ value: 'all' | ExperienceType; label: string }> = [
  { value: 'all', label: 'الكل' },
  { value: 'internship', label: 'تدريب' },
  { value: 'part-time', label: 'دوام جزئي' },
  { value: 'freelance', label: 'عمل حر' },
  { value: 'full-time', label: 'دوام كامل' },
  { value: 'contract', label: 'عقد' },
];

// ============ نموذج ============
interface ExperienceForm {
  title: string;
  company: string;
  description: string;
  type: ExperienceType;
  location: string;
  startDate: string;
  endDate: string;
  isCurrent: boolean;
  skills: string[];
  achievements: string[];
  images: string[];
  links: { label: string; url: string }[];
  showInPortfolio: boolean;
}

const emptyForm: ExperienceForm = {
  title: '',
  company: '',
  description: '',
  type: 'full-time',
  location: '',
  startDate: '',
  endDate: '',
  isCurrent: false,
  skills: [],
  achievements: [],
  images: [],
  links: [],
  showInPortfolio: true,
};

// ============ تنسيق التاريخ ============
function formatDate(dateStr: string) {
  if (!dateStr) return '—';
  try {
    return new Date(dateStr).toLocaleDateString('ar-PS', {
      year: 'numeric',
      month: 'short',
      day: 'numeric',
    });
  } catch {
    return dateStr;
  }
}

// ============ المكون الرئيسي ============
export function ExperienceSection() {
  const {
    workExperiences,
    addWorkExperience,
    updateWorkExperience,
    deleteWorkExperience,
  } = useAppStore();

  // --- حالة العرض ---
  const [activeFilter, setActiveFilter] = useState<'all' | ExperienceType>('all');
  const [dialogOpen, setDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [detailOpen, setDetailOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingItem, setEditingItem] = useState<WorkExperience | null>(null);
  const [selectedItem, setSelectedItem] = useState<WorkExperience | null>(null);
  const [form, setForm] = useState<ExperienceForm>(emptyForm);
  const [deleteConfirm, setDeleteConfirm] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // --- حالة النموذج ---
  const [skillInput, setSkillInput] = useState('');
  const [achievementsText, setAchievementsText] = useState('');
  const [linkLabel, setLinkLabel] = useState('');
  const [linkUrl, setLinkUrl] = useState('');
  const [imageUrlInput, setImageUrlInput] = useState('');
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);

  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  // ============ البيانات المحسوبة ============
  const filteredItems = useMemo(() => {
    const sorted = [...workExperiences].sort((a, b) => {
      // الأحدث أولاً
      const dateA = a.isCurrent ? Date.now() : new Date(a.startDate).getTime();
      const dateB = b.isCurrent ? Date.now() : new Date(b.startDate).getTime();
      return dateB - dateA;
    });
    if (activeFilter === 'all') return sorted;
    return sorted.filter((e) => e.type === activeFilter);
  }, [workExperiences, activeFilter]);

  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    const total = workExperiences.length;
    const currentJobs = workExperiences.filter((e) => e.isCurrent).length;
    const uniqueCompanies = new Set(workExperiences.map((e) => e.company.trim())).size;
    return { total, currentJobs, uniqueCompanies };
  }, [workExperiences]);

  // ============ معالجات ============
  const openAdd = () => {
    setEditingItem(null);
    setForm(emptyForm);
    setSkillInput('');
    setAchievementsText('');
    setLinkLabel('');
    setLinkUrl('');
    setImageUrlInput('');
    setDialogOpen(true);
  };

  const openEdit = (item: WorkExperience) => {
    setEditingItem(item);
    setForm({
      title: item.title,
      company: item.company,
      description: item.description,
      type: item.type,
      location: item.location,
      startDate: item.startDate,
      endDate: item.endDate || '',
      isCurrent: item.isCurrent,
      skills: [...item.skills],
      achievements: [...item.achievements],
      images: [...item.images],
      links: item.links.map((l) => ({ ...l })),
      showInPortfolio: item.showInPortfolio,
    });
    setSkillInput('');
    setAchievementsText(item.achievements.join('\n'));
    setLinkLabel('');
    setLinkUrl('');
    setImageUrlInput('');
    setDialogOpen(true);
  };

  const openDetail = (item: WorkExperience) => {
    setSelectedItem(item);
    setDetailOpen(true);
  };

  const handleSave = () => {
    if (!form.title.trim() || !form.company.trim()) return;

    const achievements = achievementsText
      .split('\n')
      .map((a) => a.trim())
      .filter((a) => a.length > 0);

    const data = {
      title: form.title.trim(),
      company: form.company.trim(),
      description: form.description.trim(),
      type: form.type,
      location: form.location.trim(),
      startDate: form.startDate,
      endDate: form.isCurrent ? '' : form.endDate,
      isCurrent: form.isCurrent,
      skills: form.skills,
      achievements,
      images: form.images,
      links: form.links.filter((l) => l.label.trim() && l.url.trim()),
      showInPortfolio: form.showInPortfolio,
    };

    if (editingItem) {
      updateWorkExperience(editingItem.id, data);
    } else {
      addWorkExperience(data);
    }

    setDialogOpen(false);
    setForm(emptyForm);
    setEditingItem(null);
    setSkillInput('');
    setAchievementsText('');
    setLinkLabel('');
    setLinkUrl('');
    setImageUrlInput('');
  };

  const handleDelete = (id: string) => {
    deleteWorkExperience(id);
    setDeleteConfirm(null);
  };

  const togglePortfolio = (item: WorkExperience, e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    updateWorkExperience(item.id, { showInPortfolio: !item.showInPortfolio });
  };

  // --- المهارات ---
  const addSkill = (value: string) => {
    const trimmed = value.trim();
    if (trimmed && !form.skills.includes(trimmed)) {
      setForm({ ...form, skills: [...form.skills, trimmed] });
    }
    setSkillInput('');
  };

  const removeSkill = (skill: string) => {
    setForm({ ...form, skills: form.skills.filter((s) => s !== skill) });
  };

  // --- الروابط ---
  const addLink = () => {
    if (linkLabel.trim() && linkUrl.trim()) {
      setForm({
        ...form,
        links: [...form.links, { label: linkLabel.trim(), url: linkUrl.trim() }],
      });
      setLinkLabel('');
      setLinkUrl('');
    }
  };

  const removeLink = (index: number) => {
    setForm({ ...form, links: form.links.filter((_, i) => i !== index) });
  };

  // --- الصور ---
  const uploadImage = useCallback(
    async (file: File) => {
      setUploading(true);
      try {
        const formData = new FormData();
        formData.append('file', file);
        formData.append('projectId', 'experience');
        const res = await fetch('/api/upload', { method: 'POST', body: formData });
        const data = await res.json();
        if (data.url) {
          setForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, images: [...prev.images, data.url] }));
        }
      } catch {
        // صامت
      } finally {
        setUploading(false);
      }
    },
    []
  );

  const handleFileChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (file) {
      uploadImage(file);
      e.target.value = '';
    }
  };

  const addImageUrl = () => {
    if (imageUrlInput.trim()) {
      setForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, images: [...prev.images, imageUrlInput.trim()] }));
      setImageUrlInput('');
    }
  };

  const removeImage = (url: string) => {
    setForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, images: prev.images.filter((i) => i !== url) }));
    fetch('/api/upload', {
      method: 'DELETE',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ url }),
    }).catch(() => {});
  };

  // ============ نطاق التاريخ ============
  const dateRangeText = (item: WorkExperience) => {
    const start = formatDate(item.startDate);
    if (item.isCurrent) {
      return `من ${start} — حالياً`;
    }
    const end = formatDate(item.endDate || '');
    return `من ${start} إلى ${end}`;
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* ============ الترويسة ============ */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground flex items-center gap-2">
            <Briefcase className="w-6 h-6 text-emerald-500" />
            الخبرات العملية
          </h2>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm mt-1">سجّل تدريباتك وخبراتك المهنية</p>
        </div>
        <Button onClick={openAdd} className="gap-2 bg-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-800 text-white">
          <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
          خبرة جديدة
        </Button>
      </div>

      {/* ============ الإحصائيات ============ */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
        <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
          <CardContent className="p-4 text-center">
            <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">{stats.total}</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">إجمالي الخبرات</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
        <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
          <CardContent className="p-4 text-center">
            <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-emerald-600">{stats.currentJobs}</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">وظائف حالية</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
        <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
          <CardContent className="p-4 text-center">
            <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-amber-600">{stats.uniqueCompanies}</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">شركات مختلفة</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>

      {/* ============ فلتر الأنواع ============ */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        {FILTER_TABS.map((tab) => {
          const count =
            tab.value === 'all'
              ? workExperiences.length
              : workExperiences.filter((e) => e.type === tab.value).length;
          const isActive = activeFilter === tab.value;
          return (
            <Button
              key={tab.value}
              variant={isActive ? 'default' : 'outline'}
              size="sm"
              onClick={() => setActiveFilter(tab.value)}
              className={
                isActive
                  ? 'bg-gray-900 text-white hover:bg-gray-800'
                  : 'border-border text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted'
              }
            >
              {tab.value !== 'all' && (
                <span className="ml-1">{EXPERIENCE_TYPE_CONFIG[tab.value as ExperienceType].icon}</span>
              )}
              {tab.label}
              <Badge
                variant="secondary"
                className={`mr-1.5 text-[10px] px-1.5 ${
                  isActive ? 'bg-white/20 text-white' : 'bg-muted text-muted-foreground'
                }`}
              >
                {count}
              </Badge>
            </Button>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* ============ قائمة الخبرات (Timeline) ============ */}
      {filteredItems.length === 0 ? (
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 16 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          className="text-center py-16"
        >
          <div className="text-5xl mb-3 opacity-40">💼</div>
          <h3 className="text-base font-medium text-muted-foreground mb-1">
            {workExperiences.length === 0
              ? 'لم تضف أي خبرات عمل بعد — سجّل تدريباتك وخبراتك'
              : 'لا توجد خبرات في هذا النوع'}
          </h3>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-4">
            أضف خبراتك العملية لتحسين سيرتك الذاتية
          </p>
          <Button onClick={openAdd} variant="outline" className="gap-2">
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
            إضافة خبرة
          </Button>
        </motion.div>
      ) : (
        <div className="relative">
          {/* الخط العمودي للـ Timeline (على اليمين في RTL) */}
          <div className="absolute right-[19px] top-0 bottom-0 w-0.5 bg-border" />

          <div className="space-y-4">
            <AnimatePresence mode="popLayout">
              {filteredItems.map((item, index) => (
                <motion.div
                  key={item.id}
                  layout
                  initial={{ opacity: 0, x: 16 }}
                  animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }}
                  exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -16 }}
                  transition={{ delay: index * 0.04 }}
                  className="relative pr-10"
                >
                  {/* نقطة Timeline */}
                  <div
                    className={`absolute right-0 top-5 w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full border-2 border-background z-10 ${
                      item.isCurrent ? 'bg-emerald-500 ring-4 ring-emerald-100 dark:ring-emerald-900/30' : 'bg-muted-foreground/50'
                    }`}
                  />

                  <Card
                    className={`border bg-background transition-all cursor-pointer hover:shadow-md ${
                      item.isCurrent
                        ? 'border-emerald-200 dark:border-emerald-800 bg-emerald-50/30 dark:bg-emerald-950/10'
                        : 'border-border hover:border-muted-foreground/30'
                    }`}
                    onClick={() => openDetail(item)}
                  >
                    <CardContent className="p-4">
                      <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                        {/* أيقونة النوع */}
                        <div
                          className={`w-10 h-10 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center text-lg shrink-0 mt-0.5 ${
                            item.isCurrent ? 'bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-900/30' : 'bg-muted'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {EXPERIENCE_TYPE_CONFIG[item.type].icon}
                        </div>

                        {/* المحتوى */}
                        <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                          {/* الصف الأول: العنوان + أزرار */}
                          <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                            <div className="min-w-0">
                              <h3 className="font-bold text-sm text-foreground">{item.title}</h3>
                              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mt-0.5">
                                <Building className="w-3 h-3 text-muted-foreground shrink-0" />
                                <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{item.company}</span>
                              </div>
                            </div>
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5 shrink-0">
                              <button
                                onClick={(e) => togglePortfolio(item, e)}
                                className="p-1 rounded hover:bg-muted transition-colors"
                                title={item.showInPortfolio ? 'إخفاء من المعرض' : 'إظهار في المعرض'}
                              >
                                {item.showInPortfolio ? (
                                  <Eye className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                                ) : (
                                  <EyeOff className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-muted-foreground" />
                                )}
                              </button>
                              <Button
                                variant="ghost"
                                size="icon"
                                className="h-7 w-7 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
                                onClick={(e) => {
                                  e.stopPropagation();
                                  openEdit(item);
                                }}
                              >
                                <Pencil className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              </Button>
                              <Button
                                variant="ghost"
                                size="icon"
                                className="h-7 w-7 text-muted-foreground hover:text-red-500"
                                onClick={(e) => {
                                  e.stopPropagation();
                                  setDeleteConfirm(item.id);
                                }}
                              >
                                <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              </Button>
                            </div>
                          </div>

                          {/* الصف الثاني: الموقع + التاريخ + النوع */}
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mt-2 flex-wrap">
                            {item.location && (
                              <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                                <MapPin className="w-3 h-3" />
                                {item.location}
                              </span>
                            )}
                            <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                              <Calendar className="w-3 h-3" />
                              {dateRangeText(item)}
                            </span>
                            <Badge
                              variant="secondary"
                              className="text-[10px] bg-muted text-muted-foreground"
                            >
                              {EXPERIENCE_TYPE_CONFIG[item.type].icon}{' '}
                              {EXPERIENCE_TYPE_CONFIG[item.type].label}
                            </Badge>
                            {item.isCurrent && (
                              <Badge className="text-[10px] bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-900/40 dark:text-emerald-400 border-0">
                                يعمل هنا حالياً
                              </Badge>
                            )}
                          </div>

                          {/* الصف الثالث: المهارات */}
                          {item.skills.length > 0 && (
                            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 mt-2.5">
                              {item.skills.slice(0, 5).map((skill) => (
                                <Badge
                                  key={skill}
                                  variant="secondary"
                                  className="text-[10px] bg-primary/5 text-primary dark:bg-primary/10"
                                >
                                  {skill}
                                </Badge>
                              ))}
                              {item.skills.length > 5 && (
                                <Badge
                                  variant="secondary"
                                  className="text-[10px] bg-muted text-muted-foreground"
                                >
                                  +{item.skills.length - 5}
                                </Badge>
                              )}
                            </div>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {/* تأكيد الحذف */}
                      <AnimatePresence>
                        {deleteConfirm === item.id && (
                          <motion.div
                            initial={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
                            animate={{ opacity: 1, height: 'auto' }}
                            exit={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
                            className="mt-3 pt-3 border-t border-border"
                          >
                            <p className="text-xs text-red-500 mb-2">هل تريد حذف هذه الخبرة؟</p>
                            <div className="flex gap-2">
                              <Button
                                size="sm"
                                variant="destructive"
                                className="h-7 text-xs"
                                onClick={() => handleDelete(item.id)}
                              >
                                حذف
                              </Button>
                              <Button
                                size="sm"
                                variant="outline"
                                className="h-7 text-xs"
                                onClick={() => setDeleteConfirm(null)}
                              >
                                إلغاء
                              </Button>
                            </div>
                          </motion.div>
                        )}
                      </AnimatePresence>
                    </CardContent>
                  </Card>
                </motion.div>
              ))}
            </AnimatePresence>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ============ حوار التفاصيل ============ */}
      <Dialog open={detailOpen} onOpenChange={setDetailOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="max-w-lg max-h-[85vh] overflow-y-auto" dir="rtl">
          {selectedItem && (
            <>
              <DialogHeader>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <span className="text-xl">{EXPERIENCE_TYPE_CONFIG[selectedItem.type].icon}</span>
                  <DialogTitle className="text-lg">{selectedItem.title}</DialogTitle>
                </div>
                <DialogDescription className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Building className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  {selectedItem.company}
                </DialogDescription>
              </DialogHeader>

              <div className="space-y-4">
                {/* النوع + الحالة */}
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                  <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-xs">
                    {EXPERIENCE_TYPE_CONFIG[selectedItem.type].icon}{' '}
                    {EXPERIENCE_TYPE_CONFIG[selectedItem.type].label}
                  </Badge>
                  {selectedItem.isCurrent && (
                    <Badge className="text-xs bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-900/40 dark:text-emerald-400 border-0">
                      يعمل هنا حالياً
                    </Badge>
                  )}
                  <Badge variant="outline" className="text-xs">
                    {selectedItem.showInPortfolio ? '👁️ يظهر في المعرض' : '🚫 مخفي من المعرض'}
                  </Badge>
                </div>

                {/* الموقع */}
                {selectedItem.location && (
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                    <MapPin className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
                    {selectedItem.location}
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* التاريخ */}
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                  <Calendar className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
                  {dateRangeText(selectedItem)}
                </div>

                {/* الوصف */}
                {selectedItem.description && (
                  <div>
                    <h4 className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground mb-1.5">الوصف</h4>
                    <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap">
                      {selectedItem.description}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* المهارات */}
                {selectedItem.skills.length > 0 && (
                  <div>
                    <h4 className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground mb-1.5">المهارات</h4>
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                      {selectedItem.skills.map((skill) => (
                        <Badge
                          key={skill}
                          variant="secondary"
                          className="text-xs bg-primary/5 text-primary dark:bg-primary/10"
                        >
                          {skill}
                        </Badge>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* الإنجازات */}
                {selectedItem.achievements.length > 0 && (
                  <div>
                    <h4 className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground mb-1.5">الإنجازات</h4>
                    <ol className="space-y-1.5">
                      {selectedItem.achievements.map((achievement, i) => (
                        <li key={i} className="flex gap-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                          <span className="text-emerald-600 font-bold shrink-0">{i + 1}.</span>
                          <span>{achievement}</span>
                        </li>
                      ))}
                    </ol>
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* الروابط */}
                {selectedItem.links.length > 0 && (
                  <div>
                    <h4 className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground mb-1.5">الروابط</h4>
                    <div className="space-y-1.5">
                      {selectedItem.links.map((link, i) => (
                        <a
                          key={i}
                          href={link.url}
                          target="_blank"
                          rel="noopener noreferrer"
                          className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-primary hover:underline"
                        >
                          <ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0" />
                          {link.label}
                        </a>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* الصور */}
                {selectedItem.images.length > 0 && (
                  <div>
                    <h4 className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground mb-1.5">الصور</h4>
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                      {selectedItem.images.map((img, i) => (
                        <div
                          key={i}
                          className="aspect-video rounded-lg overflow-hidden border border-border bg-muted"
                        >
                          <img
                            src={img}
                            alt={`${selectedItem.title} - ${i + 1}`}
                            className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                          />
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              <DialogFooter className="gap-2 sm:gap-0">
                <Button
                  variant="outline"
                  className="gap-2 border-border"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setDetailOpen(false);
                    openEdit(selectedItem);
                  }}
                >
                  <Pencil className="w-4 h-4" />
                  تعديل
                </Button>
                <Button
                  variant="destructive"
                  className="gap-2"
                  onClick={() => {
                    handleDelete(selectedItem.id);
                    setDetailOpen(false);
                  }}
                >
                  <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                  حذف
                </Button>
              </DialogFooter>
            </>
          )}
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>

      {/* ============ حوار إضافة/تعديل ============ */}
      <Dialog open={dialogOpen} onOpenChange={setDialogOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="max-w-lg max-h-[85vh] overflow-y-auto" dir="rtl">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>
              {editingItem ? 'تعديل الخبرة' : 'إضافة خبرة جديدة'}
            </DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>
              {editingItem ? 'قم بتعديل بيانات الخبرة العملية' : 'أدخل بيانات الخبرة الجديدة'}
            </DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>

          <div className="space-y-4">
            {/* المسمى الوظيفي */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="exp-title">المسمى الوظيفي *</Label>
              <Input
                id="exp-title"
                placeholder="مثال: مطور واجهات أمامية"
                value={form.title}
                onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, title: e.target.value })}
                className="border-border"
              />
            </div>

            {/* الشركة */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="exp-company">اسم الشركة *</Label>
              <Input
                id="exp-company"
                placeholder="مثال: شركة تقنية"
                value={form.company}
                onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, company: e.target.value })}
                className="border-border"
              />
            </div>

            {/* النوع + الموقع */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>النوع</Label>
                <Select
                  value={form.type}
                  onValueChange={(val) => setForm({ ...form, type: val as ExperienceType })}
                >
                  <SelectTrigger className="border-border">
                    <SelectValue />
                  </SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectContent>
                    {(Object.entries(EXPERIENCE_TYPE_CONFIG) as [ExperienceType, { label: string; icon: string }][]).map(

              <Switch

              <Textarea
                id="exp-achievements"
                placeholder={`حسّنت أداء التطبيق بنسبة 30%\nقُدت فريقاً من 5 مطورين\nأنجزت المشروع قبل الموعد النهائي`}
                value={achievementsText}
                onChange={(e) => setAchievementsText(e.target.value)}
                rows={4}
                className="border-border"
              />
            </div>

                  onChange={(e) => setImageUrlInput(e.target.value)}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                      e.preventDefault();
                      addImageUrl();
                    }
                  }}
                  className="border-border flex-1"
                />
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  variant="outline"
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={addImageUrl}
                  className="shrink-0 border-border"
                >
                  إضافة
                </Button>
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  variant="outline"
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
                  disabled={uploading}
                  className="shrink-0 border-emerald-200 text-emerald-700 hover:bg-emerald-50"
                >
                  <Upload className="w-4 h-4" />
                  {uploading ? '...' : ''}
                </Button>
                <input
                  ref={fileInputRef}
                  type="file"
                  accept="image/*"
                  onChange={handleFileChange}
                  className="hidden"
                />
              </div>
              {form.images.length > 0 && (
                <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 mt-2">
                  {form.images.map((img, i) => (
                    <div key={i} className="relative group aspect-video rounded-lg overflow-hidden border border-border bg-muted">
                      <img
                        src={img}
                        alt={`صورة ${i + 1}`}
                        className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                      />
                      <button
                        onClick={() => removeImage(img)}
                        className="absolute top-1 left-1 bg-red-500 text-white rounded-full p-0.5 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity"
                      >
                        <X className="w-3 h-3" />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* الروابط */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>الروابط</Label>
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                <Input
                  placeholder="عنوان الرابط"
                  value={linkLabel}
                  onChange={(e) => setLinkLabel(e.target.value)}
                  className="border-border flex-1"
                />
                <Input
                  placeholder="https://..."
                  value={linkUrl}
                  onChange={(e) => setLinkUrl(e.target.value)}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
                      e.preventDefault();
                      addLink();
                    }
                  }}
                  className="border-border flex-1"
                />
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  variant="outline"
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={addLink}
                  className="shrink-0 border-border"
                >
                  <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
                </Button>
              </div>
              {form.links.length > 0 && (
                <div className="space-y-1.5 mt-2">
                  {form.links.map((link, i) => (
                    <div
                      key={i}
                      className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs bg-muted rounded-md px-2.5 py-1.5"
                    >
                      <ExternalLink className="w-3 h-3 text-muted-foreground shrink-0" />
                      <span className="truncate flex-1">{link.label}</span>
                      <span className="truncate text-muted-foreground max-w-[120px] hidden sm:inline">
                        {link.url}
                      </span>
                      <button
                        onClick={() => removeLink(i)}
                        className="hover:text-red-500 transition-colors shrink-0"
                      >
                        <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* إظهار في المعرض */}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <Label htmlFor="exp-portfolio" className="text-sm cursor-pointer">
                إظهار في المعرض العام
              </Label>
              <Switch
                id="exp-portfolio"
                checked={form.showInPortfolio}
                onCheckedChange={(checked) =>
                  setForm({ ...form, showInPortfolio: checked })
                }
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <DialogFooter>
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setDialogOpen(false)} className="border-border">
              إلغاء
            </Button>
            <Button
              onClick={handleSave}
              disabled={!form.title.trim() || !form.company.trim()}
              className="bg-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-800 text-white gap-2"
            >
              {editingItem ? (
                <>
                  <Pencil className="w-4 h-4" />
                  حفظ التعديلات
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
                  إضافة
                </>
              )}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { useMemo } from 'react';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import {
  BarChart3, TrendingUp, Award, Clock, FolderKanban, Medal,
  GraduationCap, MapPin, Globe, Image, Video, FileText,
  Trophy, AlertTriangle, Target, Zap, BookOpen, Briefcase,
  Heart, Lightbulb, CheckCircle2, Star,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { useAppStore } from '@/lib/store';

// ============ تنسيق الأرقام بالعربية ============
function toArabicNum(n: number): string {
  return n.toLocaleString('ar-SA');
}

function formatHours(totalMinutes: number): string {
  const hrs = Math.floor(totalMinutes / 60);
  const mins = Math.round((totalMinutes % 60));
  return mins > 0 ? `${toArabicNum(hrs)}h ${toArabicNum(mins)}m` : `${toArabicNum(hrs)}h`;
}

// ============ أنيميشن ============
const cardVariants = {
  hidden: { opacity: 0, y: 16 },
  visible: (i: number) => ({
    opacity: 1,
    y: 0,
    transition: { delay: i * 0.06, duration: 0.35, ease: 'easeOut' as const },
  }),
};

const sectionVariants = {
  hidden: { opacity: 0, y: 20 },
  visible: {
    opacity: 1,
    y: 0,
    transition: { delay: 0.1, duration: 0.5, ease: 'easeOut' as const },
  },
};

// ============ المكون الرئيسي ============
export function AnalyticsSection() {
  const {
    projects,
    skills,
    visionItems,
    tasks,
    transactions,
    habits,
    journalEntries,
    certificates,
    workSessions,
    places,
    volunteerActivities,
    workExperiences,
    mediaItems,
    universitySemesters,
    achievements,
    failures,
    languages,
  } = useAppStore();

  // ============ Section 1: General Stats ============
  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    // 1. المشاريع
    const projectTotal = projects.length;
    const projectActive = projects.filter((p) => p.status === 'in-progress').length;
    const projectCompleted = projects.filter((p) => p.status === 'completed').length;

    // 2. ساعات العمل
    const totalWorkMinutes = workSessions.reduce((s, w) => s + w.durationMinutes, 0);

    // 3. الشهادات
    const certCount = certificates.length;

    // 4. المهارات
    const skillCount = skills.length;

    // 5. ساعات التطوع
    const volunteerHours = volunteerActivities.reduce((s, v) => s + v.hoursSpent, 0);

    // 6. الأماكن — unique cities
    const uniqueCities = new Set(places.map((p) => p.city)).size;

    // 7. اللغات
    const langCount = languages.length;

    // 8. الملفات
    const mediaCount = mediaItems.length;

    // 9. الصور
    const imageCount = mediaItems.filter((m) => m.type === 'image').length;

    // 10. الفيديوهات
    const videoCount = mediaItems.filter((m) => m.type === 'video').length;

    // 11. الإنجازات
    const achievementCount = achievements.length;

    // 12. الإخفاقات
    const failureCount = failures.length;

    // 13. نسبة الأهداف
    const avgGoalProgress =
      visionItems.length > 0
        ? Math.round(visionItems.reduce((s, v) => s + v.progress, 0) / visionItems.length)
        : 0;

    // 14. أكثر سنة إنتاجية
    let mostProductiveYear = '—';
    if (achievements.length > 0) {
      const yearCounts: Record<string, number> = {};
      for (const a of achievements) {
        const year = a.date.substring(0, 4);
        yearCounts[year] = (yearCounts[year] || 0) + 1;
      }
      let maxCount = 0;
      let maxYear = '';
      for (const [year, count] of Object.entries(yearCounts)) {
        if (count > maxCount) {
          maxCount = count;
          maxYear = year;
        }
      }
      mostProductiveYear = maxYear ? toArabicNum(parseInt(maxYear)) : '—';
    }

    // 15. أكثر مهارة تطورت
    let topEvolvedSkill = '—';
    if (skills.length > 0) {
      let maxDiff = 0;
      for (const skill of skills) {
        if (skill.evolution.length >= 2) {
          const sorted = [...skill.evolution].sort((a, b) => a.year - b.year);
          const diff = sorted[sorted.length - 1].level - sorted[0].level;
          if (diff > maxDiff) {
            maxDiff = diff;
            topEvolvedSkill = skill.name;
          }
        }
      }
    }

    // 16. المعدل التراكمي
    let cumulativeGpa = 0;
    if (universitySemesters.length > 0) {
      let totalWeighted = 0;
      let totalCredits = 0;
      for (const sem of universitySemesters) {
        for (const c of sem.courses) {
          totalWeighted += (c.grade / c.maxGrade) * c.credits;
          totalCredits += c.credits;
        }
      }
      cumulativeGpa = totalCredits > 0 ? (totalWeighted / totalCredits) * 100 : 0;
    }

    return {
      projectTotal,
      projectActive,
      projectCompleted,
      totalWorkMinutes,
      certCount,
      skillCount,
      volunteerHours,
      uniqueCities,
      langCount,
      mediaCount,
      imageCount,
      videoCount,
      achievementCount,
      failureCount,
      avgGoalProgress,
      mostProductiveYear,
      topEvolvedSkill,
      cumulativeGpa,
    };
  }, [
    projects, workSessions, certificates, skills, volunteerActivities,
    places, languages, mediaItems, achievements, failures,
    visionItems, universitySemesters,

  // ============ Section 2: Career Readiness Score ============
  const careerScore = useMemo(() => {
    let score = 0;
    const missing: { label: string; suggestion: string }[] = [];

    // Has completed projects: +15
    const hasCompletedProjects = stats.projectCompleted > 0;
    if (hasCompletedProjects) score += 15;
    else missing.push({ label: 'مشاريع مكتملة', suggestion: 'أضف مشاريع مكتملة لتعزيز سيرتك المهنية' });

    // Has 3+ skills: +10
    const hasSkills = stats.skillCount >= 3;
    if (hasSkills) score += 10;

    // Has work experiences: +15

    // Has achievements: +10
    const hasAchievements = stats.achievementCount > 0;

    else missing.push({ label: 'إنجازات', suggestion: 'وثّق إنجازاتك ومشاركاتك' });

    // Has 2+ languages: +10
    const hasLanguages = stats.langCount >= 2;
    if (hasLanguages) score += 10;
    else missing.push({ label: 'لغتين على الأقل', suggestion: 'أضف لغاتك ومستواك فيها' });

    // Has 10+ volunteer hours: +10
    const hasVolunteer = stats.volunteerHours >= 10;
    if (hasVolunteer) score += 10;
    else missing.push({ label: '١٠+ ساعات تطوع', suggestion: 'شارك في أنشطة تطوعية لتعزيز ملفك' });

    // Has a portfolio (always true): +5
    score += 5;

    // Has failures documented: +5
    const hasFailures = stats.failureCount > 0;
    if (hasFailures) score += 5;
    else missing.push({ label: 'توثيق الإخفاقات', suggestion: 'وثّق إخفاقاتك والدروس المستفادة — يُظهر عقلية النمو' });

    // Has university data: +5
    const hasUniversity = universitySemesters.length > 0;
    if (hasUniversity) score += 5;
    else missing.push({ label: 'بيانات جامعية', suggestion: 'أضف فصولك الجامعية لحساب المعدل التراكمي' });

    return { score, missing };
  }, [stats, workExperiences, universitySemesters]);

  const scoreColor =
    careerScore.score >= 80
      ? 'text-emerald-500'
      : careerScore.score >= 50
        ? 'text-amber-500'
        : 'text-red-500';

    careerScore.score >= 80
      ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 border-emerald-500/20'
      : careerScore.score >= 50
        ? 'bg-amber-500/10 border-amber-500/20'
        : 'bg-red-500/10 border-red-500/20';

  const scoreRingColor =

      : careerScore.score >= 50
        ? '#f59e0b'

  // ============ Section 3: Suggestions ============
  const suggestions = useMemo(() => {

      items.push({ icon: '🚀', text: 'أضف مشاريع مكتملة لتعزيز سيرتك' });

}
```

## 📝 الكود الكامل

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { Award, Plus, Trash2, Pencil, X, Save } from 'lucide-react';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { Progress } from '@/components/ui/progress';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogTrigger, DialogFooter, DialogClose } from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@/components/ui/select';
import { useAppStore } from '@/lib/store';
import { SCHOLARSHIP_STATUS_LABELS, SCHOLARSHIP_STATUS_COLORS, type Scholarship, type ScholarshipRequirement } from '@/types';
import { v4 as uuid } from 'uuid';

const DEFAULT_REQUIREMENTS = [
  'جواز سفر',
  'صور شخصية',
  'كشف درجات',
  'رسالة تحفيزية',
  'توصيات',
  'اختبار لغة',
  'أوراق إضافية',
];

const STATUS_ORDER: Scholarship['status'][] = ['not-started', 'preparing', 'submitted', 'accepted', 'rejected'];

interface ScholarshipForm {
  name: string;
  university: string;
  country: string;
  status: Scholarship['status'];
  requirements: ScholarshipRequirement[];
  notes: string;
}

const emptyForm: ScholarshipForm = {
  name: '',
  university: '',
  country: '',
  status: 'not-started',
  requirements: DEFAULT_REQUIREMENTS.map((label) => ({ id: uuid(), label, completed: false })),
  notes: '',
};

export function ScholarshipSection() {
  const { scholarships, addScholarship, updateScholarship, deleteScholarship, toggleRequirement } = useAppStore();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingId, setEditingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [form, setForm] = useState<ScholarshipForm>(emptyForm);
  const [newReq, setNewReq] = useState('');

  const handleOpen = () => {
    setForm(emptyForm);
    setEditingId(null);
    setOpen(true);
  };

  const handleEdit = (sch: Scholarship) => {
    setForm({
      name: sch.name,
      university: sch.university,
      country: sch.country,
      status: sch.status,
      requirements: [...sch.requirements],
      notes: sch.notes,
    });
    setEditingId(sch.id);
    setOpen(true);
  };

  const handleSave = () => {
    if (!form.name.trim()) return;
    const data = {
      name: form.name.trim(),
      university: form.university.trim(),
      country: form.country.trim(),
      status: form.status,
      requirements: form.requirements,
      notes: form.notes.trim(),
    };
    if (editingId) {
      updateScholarship(editingId, data);
    } else {
      addScholarship(data);
    }
    setOpen(false);
  };

  const cycleStatus = (sch: Scholarship) => {
    const idx = STATUS_ORDER.indexOf(sch.status);
    const next = STATUS_ORDER[(idx + 1) % STATUS_ORDER.length];
    updateScholarship(sch.id, { status: next });
  };

  const addRequirement = () => {
    if (!newReq.trim()) return;
    setForm((f) => ({
      ...f,
      requirements: [...f.requirements, { id: uuid(), label: newReq.trim(), completed: false }],
    }));
    setNewReq('');
  };

  const removeRequirement = (id: string) => {
    setForm((f) => ({
      ...f,
      requirements: f.requirements.filter((r) => r.id !== id),
    }));
  };

  const getProgress = (reqs: ScholarshipRequirement[]) => {
    if (reqs.length === 0) return 0;
    return Math.round((reqs.filter((r) => r.completed).length / reqs.length) * 100);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-purple-100 dark:bg-purple-900/30 flex items-center justify-center">
            <Award className="w-5 h-5 text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-lg font-bold text-foreground">المنحة</h1>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">تتبع طلبات المنح الدراسية</p>
          </div>
        </div>
```

```tsx
                    </td>

}
```

```tsx
'use client';
// الخزنة الآمنة — Secure Vault UI — تشفير client-side بـ AES-256-GCM (Web Crypto API)

import { useState, useRef, useEffect, useMemo, useCallback } from 'react';
import {
  Lock, Unlock, Key, Eye, EyeOff, Copy, Plus, Trash2, Pencil, Search,
  RefreshCw, Shield, AlertTriangle, Check, ExternalLink, Loader2,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogFooter, DialogDescription } from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import {
  AlertDialog, AlertDialogAction, AlertDialogCancel, AlertDialogContent,
  AlertDialogDescription, AlertDialogFooter, AlertDialogHeader, AlertDialogTitle,
} from '@/components/ui/alert-dialog';
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@/components/ui/select';
import { Progress } from '@/components/ui/progress';
import { useAppStore } from '@/lib/store';
import { toast } from '@/hooks/use-toast';
import {
  deriveKey, encryptText, decryptText, generatePassword, checkPasswordStrength, copyToClipboard,
} from '@/lib/encryption';
import type { VaultItem } from '@/types';
import { VAULT_CATEGORIES } from '@/types';

const AUTO_LOCK_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000;
type VaultState = 'loading' | 'setup' | 'locked' | 'unlocked';
type VaultCategory = VaultItem['category'];
type DecryptedFields = { username: string; password: string; notes: string };
type KeyRef = React.MutableRefObject<CryptoKey | null>;

function PasswordStrengthBar({ password }: { password: string }) {
  const info = useMemo(() => checkPasswordStrength(password), [password]);
  if (!password) return null;
  return (
    <div className="space-y-1">
      <Progress value={(info.score / 5) * 100} className="h-1.5" />
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
        <span className={info.color}>{info.label}</span>
        <span className="text-muted-foreground">{info.score}/5</span>
      </div>
      {info.suggestions.length > 0 && (
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{info.suggestions.slice(0, 2).join(' · ')}</p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function LoadingView() {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center justify-center min-h-[60vh]">
      <div className="text-center space-y-3">
        <Loader2 className="w-10 h-10 animate-spin mx-auto text-primary" />
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">جارٍ تحميل الخزنة الآمنة...</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function AuthView({ mode, onSubmit }: {
  mode: 'setup' | 'locked';
  onSubmit: (pw: string, salt: string) => Promise<void>;
}) {
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [confirm, setConfirm] = useState('');
  const [showPw, setShowPw] = useState(false);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const isSetup = mode === 'setup';
  const matches = password.length > 0 && password === confirm;
  const canSubmit = isSetup ? (password.length >= 12 && matches && !busy) : (!!password && !busy);

  const submit = async () => {
    if (isSetup) {
      if (password.length < 12) { toast({ title: 'كلمة المرور قصيرة جداً', description: 'يجب أن تكون 12 حرفاً على الأقل', variant: 'destructive' }); return; }
      if (password !== confirm) { toast({ title: 'كلمتا المرور غير متطابقتين', variant: 'destructive' }); return; }
    } else if (!password) { toast({ title: 'أدخل كلمة المرور', variant: 'destructive' }); return; }
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const endpoint = isSetup ? '/api/master-password/setup' : '/api/master-password/verify';
      const res = await fetch(endpoint, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ masterPassword: password }),
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok || !data.success) throw new Error(data.error || 'فشلت العملية');
      await onSubmit(password, data.salt);
      toast({ title: isSetup ? 'تم إعداد الخزنة' : 'تم فتح الخزنة',
        description: isSetup ? 'احفظ كلمة المرور في مكان آمن — لا يمكن استعادتها!' : 'مرحباً بك' });
      setPassword(''); setConfirm('');
    } catch (e) {
      toast({ title: isSetup ? 'فشل الإعداد' : 'فشل فتح الخزنة',
        description: e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'خطأ غير متوقع', variant: 'destructive' });
    } finally { setBusy(false); }
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex items-center justify-center min-h-[70vh] p-4">
      <Card className="w-full max-w-md">
        <CardHeader className="text-center space-y-3">
          <div className={`mx-auto w-14 h-14 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center ${isSetup ? 'bg-primary/10' : 'bg-muted'}`}>
            {isSetup ? <Shield className="w-7 h-7 text-primary" /> : <Lock className="w-7 h-7 text-muted-foreground" />}
          </div>
          <CardTitle className="text-xl">{isSetup ? 'إعداد الخزنة الآمنة' : 'الخزنة مؤمنة'}</CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>
            {isSetup
              ? 'أنشئ كلمة مرور رئيسية لتشفير بياناتك محلياً. لا يمكن استعادتها أبداً.'
              : 'أدخل كلمة المرور الرئيسية لفتح الخزنة وفك التشفير'}
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="space-y-4">
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <Label htmlFor="auth-pw">كلمة المرور الرئيسية</Label>
            <div className="relative">
              <Key className="w-4 h-4 absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" />
              <Input id="auth-pw" type={showPw ? 'text' : 'password'} value={password}
                onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
                onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && (!isSetup || matches) && submit()}
                className="pr-10 pl-10" placeholder={isSetup ? '12 حرفاً على الأقل' : '••••••••••••'}
                autoComplete={isSetup ? 'new-password' : 'current-password'} dir="ltr" autoFocus={!isSetup} />
              <Button type="button" variant="ghost" size="icon"
                className="absolute left-1 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 h-8 w-8" onClick={() => setShowPw(!showPw)}>
                {showPw ? <EyeOff className="w-4 h-4" /> : <Eye className="w-4 h-4" />}
              </Button>
            </div>
            {isSetup && <PasswordStrengthBar password={password} />}
          </div>
          {isSetup && (
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="auth-confirm">تأكيد كلمة المرور</Label>
              <Input id="auth-confirm" type={showPw ? 'text' : 'password'} value={confirm}
                onChange={(e) => setConfirm(e.target.value)}
                onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && matches && submit()}
                placeholder="أعد كتابة كلمة المرور" autoComplete="new-password" dir="ltr" />
              {confirm.length > 0 && (
                <p className={`text-xs flex items-center gap-1 ${matches ? 'text-emerald-500' : 'text-destructive'}`}>
                  {matches ? <Check className="w-3 h-3" /> : <AlertTriangle className="w-3 h-3" />}
                  {matches ? 'متطابقة' : 'غير متطابقة'}
                </p>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
          {isSetup && (
            <div className="flex items-start gap-2 p-3 rounded-md bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-900/20 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800">
              <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              <p className="text-xs text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300 leading-relaxed">
                تحذير: كلمة المرور هذه لا يمكن استعادتها أبداً. إذا فقدتها، لن تتمكن من فك تشفير بياناتك.
              </p>
            </div>
          )}
          <Button onClick={submit} disabled={!canSubmit} className="w-full gap-2">
            {busy ? <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" /> : isSetup ? <Shield className="w-4 h-4" /> : <Unlock className="w-4 h-4" />}
            {isSetup ? 'إعداد الخزنة' : 'فتح الخزنة'}
          </Button>
          {!isSetup && (
            <p className="text-xs text-center text-muted-foreground">
              سيتم قفل الخزنة تلقائياً بعد 5 دقائق من عدم النشاط
            </p>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

function VaultItemCard({ item, decrypted, onEdit, onDelete, bumpActivity }: {
  item: VaultItem; decrypted: DecryptedFields;
  onEdit: () => void; onDelete: () => void; bumpActivity: () => void;
}) {
  const [showPw, setShowPw] = useState(false);
  const cat = VAULT_CATEGORIES.find((c) => c.id === item.category) || VAULT_CATEGORIES[3];

  const handleCopy = async (text: string, label: string) => {
    bumpActivity();
    const ok = await copyToClipboard(text);
    toast({ title: ok ? `تم نسخ ${label}` : 'فشل النسخ', variant: ok ? 'default' : 'destructive' });
  };
  const fmt = (d: string) => { try { return new Date(d).toLocaleDateString('ar', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short' }); } catch { return ''; } };
  const renderField = (label: string, value: string, mono?: boolean) => {
    const isPw = label === 'كلمة المرور';
    const copyLabel = label === 'المستخدم' ? 'اسم المستخدم' : label;
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
        <span className="text-muted-foreground w-20 shrink-0 text-xs">{label}:</span>
        <code className={`flex-1 truncate bg-muted px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs ${mono ? 'font-mono' : ''}`} dir="ltr">
          {isPw && !showPw ? '••••••••••••' : value}
        </code>
        {isPw && (
          <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7 shrink-0"
            onClick={() => { setShowPw(!showPw); bumpActivity(); }} aria-label={showPw ? 'إخفاء' : 'إظهار'}>
            {showPw ? <EyeOff className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> : <Eye className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
          </Button>
        )}
        <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7 shrink-0"
          onClick={() => handleCopy(value, copyLabel)} aria-label={`نسخ ${label}`}>
          <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
        </Button>
      </div>
    );
  };
  return (
    <Card className="hover:shadow-md transition-shadow">
      <CardContent className="p-4 space-y-3">
        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
            <span className="text-xl shrink-0">{cat.icon}</span>
            <div className="min-w-0">
              <h3 className="font-semibold text-foreground truncate">{item.title}</h3>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mt-0.5">
                <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-xs">{cat.label}</Badge>
                <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{fmt(item.updatedAt)}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0">
            <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-8 w-8" onClick={onEdit} aria-label="تعديل"><Pencil className="w-4 h-4" /></Button>
            <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-8 w-8 text-destructive" onClick={onDelete} aria-label="حذف"><Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" /></Button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-2 text-sm">
          {decrypted.username && renderField('المستخدم', decrypted.username)}
          {decrypted.password && renderField('كلمة المرور', decrypted.password, true)}
          {item.url && (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="text-muted-foreground w-20 shrink-0 text-xs">الرابط:</span>
              <a href={item.url.startsWith('http') ? item.url : `https://${item.url}`}
                target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer"
                className="flex-1 truncate text-primary hover:underline text-xs flex items-center gap-1"
                dir="ltr" onClick={bumpActivity}>
                {item.url}<ExternalLink className="w-3 h-3 shrink-0" />
              </a>
            </div>
          )}
          {decrypted.notes && (
            <div className="pt-1">
              <span className="text-muted-foreground text-xs">ملاحظات:</span>
              <p className="text-xs text-foreground/80 whitespace-pre-wrap mt-1 line-clamp-3">{decrypted.notes}</p>
            </div>
          )}
          {item.tags.length > 0 && (
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1 pt-1">
              {item.tags.map((t) => <Badge key={t} variant="outline" className="text-xs font-normal">{t}</Badge>)}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

function VaultItemDialog({ open, onOpenChange, editing, keyRef, bumpActivity }: {
  open: boolean; onOpenChange: (o: boolean) => void;
  editing: VaultItem | null; keyRef: KeyRef; bumpActivity: () => void;
}) {
  const { addVaultItem, updateVaultItem } = useAppStore();
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    title: '', category: 'website' as VaultCategory,
    username: '', password: '', url: '', notes: '', tags: [] as string[],
  });
  const [tagInput, setTagInput] = useState('');
  const [showPw, setShowPw] = useState(false);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [showGen, setShowGen] = useState(false);
  const [genLen, setGenLen] = useState(16);
  const set = (patch: Partial<typeof form>) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, ...patch }));

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    bumpActivity();
    if (editing) {
      (async () => {
        const key = keyRef.current;
        if (!key) return;
        const [username, password, notes] = await Promise.all([
          decryptText(editing.encryptedUsername, key),
          decryptText(editing.encryptedPassword, key),
          decryptText(editing.encryptedNotes, key),
        ]);
        set({ title: editing.title, category: editing.category, username, password,
          url: editing.url, notes, tags: [...(editing.tags || [])] });
      })();
    } else {
      set({ title: '', category: 'website', username: '', password: '', url: '', notes: '', tags: [] });
    }
    setTagInput(''); setShowPw(false); setShowGen(false);
  }, [open, editing, keyRef, bumpActivity]);

  const addTag = () => {
    const t = tagInput.trim();
    if (t && !form.tags.includes(t)) set({ tags: [...form.tags, t] });
    setTagInput('');
  };

  const handleGenerate = () => {
    const pw = generatePassword(genLen);
    set({ password: pw }); setShowPw(true); bumpActivity();
    toast({ title: 'تم توليد كلمة مرور قوية', description: `${genLen} حرفاً` });
  };

  const save = async () => {
    if (!form.title.trim()) { toast({ title: 'العنوان مطلوب', variant: 'destructive' }); return; }
    const key = keyRef.current;
    if (!key) { toast({ title: 'المفتاح غير متاح — أعد فتح الخزنة', variant: 'destructive' }); return; }
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const [encryptedUsername, encryptedPassword, encryptedNotes] = await Promise.all([
        encryptText(form.username, key), encryptText(form.password, key), encryptText(form.notes, key),
      ]);
      const now = new Date().toISOString();
      const payload = {
        title: form.title.trim(), category: form.category,
        encryptedUsername, encryptedPassword, encryptedNotes,
        url: form.url.trim(), tags: form.tags, lastChanged: now,
      };
      if (editing) { updateVaultItem(editing.id, payload); toast({ title: 'تم تحديث العنصر' }); }
      else { addVaultItem(payload); toast({ title: 'تم إضافة العنصر' }); }
      onOpenChange(false);
    } catch (e) {
      toast({ title: 'فشل الحفظ', description: e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'خطأ', variant: 'destructive' });
    } finally { setBusy(false); }
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-lg max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Shield className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
            {editing ? 'تعديل عنصر' : 'إضافة عنصر جديد'}
          </DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>يتم تشفير اسم المستخدم وكلمة المرور والملاحظات محلياً قبل الإرسال</DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>

        <div className="space-y-3">
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label htmlFor="v-title">العنوان *</Label>
            <Input id="v-title" value={form.title} onChange={(e) => set({ title: e.target.value })} placeholder="مثال: حساب GitHub" />
          </div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label>الفئة</Label>
              <Select value={form.category} onValueChange={(v) => set({ category: v as VaultCategory })}>
                <SelectTrigger><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  {VAULT_CATEGORIES.map((c) => <SelectItem key={c.id} value={c.id}>{c.icon} {c.label}</SelectItem>)}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="v-url">الرابط</Label>
              <Input id="v-url" value={form.url} onChange={(e) => set({ url: e.target.value })} placeholder="https://..." dir="ltr" />
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label htmlFor="v-username">اسم المستخدم / البريد</Label>
            <Input id="v-username" value={form.username} onChange={(e) => set({ username: e.target.value })} placeholder="user@example.com" dir="ltr" />
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <Label htmlFor="v-password">كلمة المرور</Label>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                <Button type="button" variant="ghost" size="sm" className="h-7 gap-1 text-xs" onClick={() => setShowGen(!showGen)}><RefreshCw className="w-3 h-3" /> توليد</Button>
                <Button type="button" variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7" onClick={() => setShowPw(!showPw)} aria-label={showPw ? 'إخفاء' : 'إظهار'}>{showPw ? <EyeOff className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> : <Eye className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}</Button>
              </div>
            </div>
            <Input id="v-password" type={showPw ? 'text' : 'password'} value={form.password}
              onChange={(e) => set({ password: e.target.value })} placeholder="••••••••" dir="ltr" className="font-mono" />
            {showGen && (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 p-2 rounded-md bg-muted text-xs">
                <span>الطول:</span>
                <Input type="number" min={8} max={64} value={genLen}
                  onChange={(e) => setGenLen(Math.max(8, Math.min(64, Number(e.target.value))))} className="h-7 w-16" />
                <Button type="button" size="sm" className="h-7 gap-1" onClick={handleGenerate}><RefreshCw className="w-3 h-3" /> توليد الآن</Button>
              </div>
            )}
            <PasswordStrengthBar password={form.password} />
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label htmlFor="v-notes">ملاحظات (مشفّرة)</Label>
            <Textarea id="v-notes" value={form.notes} onChange={(e) => set({ notes: e.target.value })} placeholder="ملاحظات إضافية..." rows={3} />
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label>الوسوم</Label>
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <Input value={tagInput} onChange={(e) => setTagInput(e.target.value)}
                onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); addTag(); } }} placeholder="أضف وسماً..." />
              <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={addTag}>إضافة</Button>
            </div>
            {form.tags.length > 0 && (
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1 mt-1">
                {form.tags.map((t) => (
                  <Badge key={t} variant="secondary" className="gap-1">{t}
                    <button type="button" onClick={() => set({ tags: form.tags.filter((x) => x !== t) })}
                      className="hover:text-destructive px-0.5" aria-label={`حذف الوسم ${t}`}>×</button>
                  </Badge>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        <DialogFooter>
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}>إلغاء</Button>
          <Button onClick={save} disabled={busy || !form.title.trim()} className="gap-2">
            {busy ? <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" /> : <Check className="w-4 h-4" />}
            {editing ? 'حفظ التعديلات' : 'إضافة'}
          </Button>
        </DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

function UnlockedView({ keyRef, onLock, bumpActivity }: {
  keyRef: KeyRef; onLock: () => void; bumpActivity: () => void;
}) {
  const { vaultItems, deleteVaultItem } = useAppStore();
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [catFilter, setCatFilter] = useState<string>('all');
  const [dialogOpen, setDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<VaultItem | null>(null);
  const [deleteTarget, setDeleteTarget] = useState<VaultItem | null>(null);
  const [decryptedMap, setDecryptedMap] = useState<Record<string, DecryptedFields>>({});

  useEffect(() => {
    const key = keyRef.current;
    if (!key) return;
    let cancelled = false;
    (async () => {
      const entries = await Promise.all(vaultItems.map(async (it) => {
        const [username, password, notes] = await Promise.all([
          decryptText(it.encryptedUsername, key),
          decryptText(it.encryptedPassword, key),
          decryptText(it.encryptedNotes, key),
        ]);
        return [it.id, { username, password, notes }] as const;
      }));
      if (!cancelled) setDecryptedMap(Object.fromEntries(entries));
    })();
    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, [vaultItems, keyRef]);

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    const q = search.trim().toLowerCase();
    return vaultItems
      .filter((it) => catFilter === 'all' || it.category === catFilter)
      .filter((it) => {
        if (!q) return true;
        const dec = decryptedMap[it.id];
        return it.title.toLowerCase().includes(q) || it.url.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          (it.tags || []).some((t) => t.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
          (dec?.username || '').toLowerCase().includes(q);
      })
      .sort((a, b) => new Date(b.updatedAt).getTime() - new Date(a.updatedAt).getTime());
  }, [vaultItems, search, catFilter, decryptedMap]);

  const openNew = () => { setEditing(null); setDialogOpen(true); bumpActivity(); };
  const openEdit = (it: VaultItem) => { setEditing(it); setDialogOpen(true); bumpActivity(); };
  const confirmDelete = () => {
    if (!deleteTarget) return;
    deleteVaultItem(deleteTarget.id);
    toast({ title: 'تم حذف العنصر' });
    setDeleteTarget(null);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6" onMouseDown={bumpActivity} onKeyDown={bumpActivity}>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between flex-wrap gap-3">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground flex items-center gap-2">
            <Shield className="w-6 h-6 text-primary" /> الخزنة الآمنة
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-1">
            {vaultItems.length} عنصراً مشفّراً · التشفير يتم في المتصفح
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Button onClick={openNew} className="gap-2"><Plus className="w-4 h-4" /> عنصر جديد</Button>
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={onLock} className="gap-2"><Lock className="w-4 h-4" /> قفل</Button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
        <div className="relative flex-1 min-w-[200px]">
          <Search className="w-4 h-4 absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" />
          <Input value={search}
            onChange={(e) => { setSearch(e.target.value); bumpActivity(); }}
            placeholder="ابحث في العناوين والروابط والوسوم..." className="pr-10" />
        </div>
        <Select value={catFilter} onValueChange={(v) => { setCatFilter(v); bumpActivity(); }}>
          <SelectTrigger className="w-[160px]"><SelectValue placeholder="كل الفئات" /></SelectTrigger>
          <SelectContent>
            <SelectItem value="all">كل الفئات</SelectItem>
            {VAULT_CATEGORIES.map((c) => <SelectItem key={c.id} value={c.id}>{c.icon} {c.label}</SelectItem>)}
          </SelectContent>
        </Select>
      </div>
      {filtered.length === 0 ? (
        <Card>
          <CardContent className="py-12 text-center space-y-3">
            <div className="mx-auto w-14 h-14 rounded-full bg-muted flex items-center justify-center">
              <Shield className="w-7 h-7 text-muted-foreground" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <p className="font-medium text-foreground">{vaultItems.length === 0 ? 'الخزنة فارغة' : 'لا توجد نتائج'}</p>
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-1">{vaultItems.length === 0 ? 'أضف أول عنصر مشفّر لبدء الاستخدام' : 'جرّب تعديل البحث أو الفلتر'}</p>
            </div>
            {vaultItems.length === 0 && (
              <Button onClick={openNew} className="gap-2"><Plus className="w-4 h-4" /> إضافة عنصر</Button>
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
          {filtered.map((it) => (
            <VaultItemCard key={it.id} item={it}
              decrypted={decryptedMap[it.id] || { username: '', password: '', notes: '' }}
              onEdit={() => openEdit(it)} onDelete={() => setDeleteTarget(it)} bumpActivity={bumpActivity} />
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      <VaultItemDialog open={dialogOpen} onOpenChange={setDialogOpen} editing={editing}
        keyRef={keyRef} bumpActivity={bumpActivity} />

      <AlertDialog open={!!deleteTarget} onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setDeleteTarget(null)}>
        <AlertDialogContent>
          <AlertDialogHeader>
            <AlertDialogTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5 text-destructive" /> تأكيد الحذف
            </AlertDialogTitle>
            <AlertDialogDescription>
              هل أنت متأكد من حذف &laquo;{deleteTarget?.title}&raquo;؟ لا يمكن التراجع عن هذا الإجراء.
            </AlertDialogDescription>
          </AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogFooter>
            <AlertDialogCancel>إلغاء</AlertDialogCancel>
            <AlertDialogAction onClick={confirmDelete}
              className="bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground hover:bg-destructive/90">حذف</AlertDialogAction>
          </AlertDialogFooter>
        </AlertDialogContent>
      </AlertDialog>
    </div>
  );
}

export function VaultSection() {
  const [state, setState] = useState<VaultState>('loading');
  const keyRef = useRef<CryptoKey | null>(null); // المفتاح في ref لتجنّب إعادة الرسم
  const lastActivityRef = useRef<number>(Date.now());

  const bumpActivity = useCallback(() => { lastActivityRef.current = Date.now(); }, []);

  const lockVault = useCallback(() => {
    keyRef.current = null;
    setState('locked');
    toast({ title: 'تم قفل الخزنة', description: 'تم مسح مفتاح التشفير من الذاكرة' });
  }, []);

  const unlock = useCallback(async (masterPassword: string, salt: string) => {
    const key = await deriveKey(masterPassword, salt);
    keyRef.current = key;
    lastActivityRef.current = Date.now();
    setState('unlocked');
  }, []);

  // قفل تلقائي بعد 5 دقائق من عدم النشاط
  useEffect(() => {
    if (state !== 'unlocked') return;
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      if (Date.now() - lastActivityRef.current >= AUTO_LOCK_MS) lockVault();
    }, 15_000);
    const events = ['mousedown', 'keydown', 'touchstart', 'scroll'];
    events.forEach((e) => window.addEventListener(e, bumpActivity, { passive: true }));
    return () => {
      clearInterval(timer);
      events.forEach((e) => window.removeEventListener(e, bumpActivity));
    };
  }, [state, lockVault, bumpActivity]);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    fetch('/api/master-password/status')
      .then((r) => r.json())
      .then((data) => { if (!cancelled) setState(data.isSet ? 'locked' : 'setup'); })
      .catch(() => { if (!cancelled) setState('locked'); });
    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, []);

  if (state === 'loading') return <LoadingView />;
  if (state === 'setup') return <AuthView mode="setup" onSubmit={unlock} />;
  if (state === 'locked') return <AuthView mode="locked" onSubmit={unlock} />;
  return <UnlockedView keyRef={keyRef} onLock={lockVault} bumpActivity={bumpActivity} />;
}
```
