```tsx
import {
  deriveKey, encryptFile, decryptFile,
} from '@/lib/encryption';

const MAX_FILE_SIZE = 10 * 1024 * 1024; // 10MB (Base64 doubles the size, so 5MB original → ~7MB encrypted → ~10MB in DB)

function formatSize(bytes: number): string {
  if (bytes < 1024) return `${bytes} B`;
  if (bytes < 1024 * 1024) return `${(bytes / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB`;
  return `${(bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)} MB`;
}

function formatDate(dateStr: string): string {
  try {
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('ar-SA', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' }).format(new Date(dateStr));
  } catch {
    return dateStr;
  }
}

export function SecureDocumentsSection() {
  const { secureDocuments, addSecureDocument, deleteSecureDocument } = useAppStore();
  const keyRef = useRef<CryptoKey | null>(null);
  const [isUnlocked, setIsUnlocked] = useState(false);
  const [masterPw, setMasterPw] = useState('');
  const [unlockLoading, setUnlockLoading] = useState(false);
  const [unlockError, setUnlockError] = useState('');

  // Upload dialog
  const [uploadOpen, setUploadOpen] = useState(false);
  const [uploadForm, setUploadForm] = useState({ title: '', category: 'other' as SecureDocument['category'] });
  const [selectedFile, setSelectedFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [uploadLoading, setUploadLoading] = useState(false);

  // Delete confirmation
  const [deleteId, setDeleteId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Download loading
  const [downloadingId, setDownloadingId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Auto-lock after 5 minutes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isUnlocked) return;
    let timeout: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>;
    const resetTimer = () => {
      clearTimeout(timeout);
      timeout = setTimeout(() => {
        keyRef.current = null;
        setIsUnlocked(false);
        setMasterPw('');
        toast({ title: 'تم القفل', description: 'تم قفل الوثائق الحساسة تلقائياً' });
      }, 5 * 60 * 1000);
    };
    const events = ['mousedown', 'keydown', 'touchstart', 'scroll'];
    events.forEach((e) => window.addEventListener(e, resetTimer));
    resetTimer();
    return () => {
      clearTimeout(timeout);
      events.forEach((e) => window.removeEventListener(e, resetTimer));
    };
  }, [isUnlocked]);

  const handleUnlock = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!masterPw.trim()) return;
    setUnlockLoading(true);
    setUnlockError('');
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/master-password/verify', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ masterPassword: masterPw }),
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok) {
        setUnlockError(data.error || 'كلمة المرور غير صحيحة');
        setUnlockLoading(false);
        return;
      }
      const key = await deriveKey(masterPw, data.salt);
      keyRef.current = key;
      setMasterPw('');
      setIsUnlocked(true);
    } catch {
      setUnlockError('فشل الاتصال بالخادم');
    }
    setUnlockLoading(false);
  }, [masterPw]);

  const handleLock = useCallback(() => {
    keyRef.current = null;
    setIsUnlocked(false);
    setMasterPw('');
  }, []);

  const handleFileSelect = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    if (file.size > MAX_FILE_SIZE) {
      toast({ title: 'خطأ', description: `الحد الأقصى ${formatSize(MAX_FILE_SIZE)}`, variant: 'destructive' });
      return;
    }
    setSelectedFile(file);
    if (!uploadForm.title) {
      setUploadForm({ ...uploadForm, title: file.name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, '') });
    }
  };

  const handleUpload = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!selectedFile || !uploadForm.title.trim() || !keyRef.current) return;
    setUploadLoading(true);
    try {
      const arrayBuffer = await selectedFile.arrayBuffer();
      const encrypted = await encryptFile(arrayBuffer, keyRef.current);
      addSecureDocument({
        title: uploadForm.title,
        category: uploadForm.category,
        encryptedFile: encrypted,
        fileName: selectedFile.name,
        mimeType: selectedFile.type || 'application/octet-stream',
        originalSize: selectedFile.size,
        encryptedNotes: '',
        tags: [],
      });
      toast({ title: 'تم', description: `تم رفع وتشفير "${selectedFile.name}" بنجاح` });
      setUploadOpen(false);
      setSelectedFile(null);
      setUploadForm({ title: '', category: 'other' });
    } catch {
      toast({ title: 'خطأ', description: 'فشل التشفير', variant: 'destructive' });
    }
    setUploadLoading(false);
  }, [selectedFile, uploadForm, addSecureDocument]);

  const handleDownload = useCallback(async (doc: SecureDocument) => {
    if (!keyRef.current) return;
    setDownloadingId(doc.id);
    try {
      const decrypted = await decryptFile(doc.encryptedFile, keyRef.current);
      const blob = new Blob([decrypted], { type: doc.mimeType });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = url;
      a.download = doc.fileName;
      document.body.appendChild(a);
      a.click();
      document.body.removeChild(a);
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      toast({ title: 'تم', description: `تم تحميل "${doc.fileName}"` });
    } catch {
      toast({ title: 'خطأ', description: 'فشل فك التشفير', variant: 'destructive' });
    }
    setDownloadingId(null);
  }, []);

  const handleDelete = useCallback(() => {
    if (!deleteId) return;
    deleteSecureDocument(deleteId);
    toast({ title: 'تم الحذف', description: 'تم حذف الوثيقة' });
    setDeleteId(null);
  }, [deleteId, deleteSecureDocument]);

  // ============ Locked View ============
  if (!isUnlocked) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-4">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-red-100 dark:bg-red-900/30 flex items-center justify-center">
            <Shield className="w-5 h-5 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-lg font-bold text-foreground">الوثائق الحساسة</h1>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{secureDocuments.length} وثيقة مشفّرة</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
          <CardContent className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-20 text-center">
            <motion.div
              initial={{ scale: 0.8, opacity: 0 }}
              animate={{ scale: 1, opacity: 1 }}
              transition={{ duration: 0.4 }}
              className="w-20 h-20 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-red-500 to-rose-600 flex items-center justify-center mb-4 shadow-lg shadow-red-500/20"
            >
              <Lock className="w-10 h-10 text-white" />
            </motion.div>
            <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-foreground mb-2">الوثائق مقفلة</h2>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-6 max-w-xs">
              أدخل كلمة المرور الرئيسية لفك تشفير الوثائق الحساسة
            </p>
            <div className="w-full max-w-xs space-y-3">
              <Input
                type="password"
                value={masterPw}
                onChange={(e) => setMasterPw(e.target.value)}
                onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && handleUnlock()}
                placeholder="كلمة المرور الرئيسية"
                dir="ltr"
                autoFocus
                className="text-center"
              />
              {unlockError && (
                <p className="text-sm text-destructive">{unlockError}</p>
              )}
              <Button
                onClick={handleUnlock}
                disabled={unlockLoading || !masterPw.trim()}
                className="w-full gap-2"
              >
                {unlockLoading ? (
                  <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
                ) : (
                  <Unlock className="w-4 h-4" />
                )}
                فتح
              </Button>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // ============ Unlocked View ============
  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-900/30 flex items-center justify-center">
            <Shield className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-lg font-bold text-foreground">الوثائق الحساسة</h1>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              {secureDocuments.length} وثيقة · 🔓 مفتوح
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <Button size="sm" onClick={() => setUploadOpen(true)} className="gap-1.5">
            <Upload className="w-4 h-4" />
            رفع وثيقة
          </Button>
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={handleLock} className="gap-1.5">
            <Lock className="w-4 h-4" />
            قفل
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Grid */}
      {secureDocuments.length === 0 ? (
        <Card>
          <CardContent className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-16 text-center">
            <FileText className="w-12 h-12 text-muted-foreground mb-3" />
            <p className="text-lg font-medium text-foreground">لا توجد وثائق بعد</p>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-1">ارفع وثيقة حساسة — ستُشفّر بـ AES-256</p>
            <Button onClick={() => setUploadOpen(true)} className="mt-4 gap-2">
              <Upload className="w-4 h-4" />
              رفع وثيقة
            </Button>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
          <AnimatePresence mode="popLayout">
            {secureDocuments.map((doc) => {
              const cat = DOCUMENT_CATEGORIES.find((c) => c.id === doc.category) || DOCUMENT_CATEGORIES[5];
              return (
                <motion.div
                  key={doc.id}
                  layout
                  initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }}
                  animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
                  exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }}
                  transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}
                >
                  <Card className="border border-border bg-background hover:shadow-md transition-shadow group">
                    <CardContent className="p-4">
                      <div className="flex items-start justify-between mb-3">
                        <div className={`w-12 h-12 rounded-xl ${cat.color} flex items-center justify-center text-2xl shrink-0`}>
                          {cat.icon}
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex gap-1 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">
                          <Button
                            variant="ghost"
                            size="icon"
                            className="h-8 w-8"
                            onClick={() => handleDownload(doc)}
                            disabled={downloadingId === doc.id}
                            title="تحميل + فك تشفير"
                          >
                            {downloadingId === doc.id ? (
                              <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
                            ) : (
                              <Download className="w-4 h-4" />
                            )}
                          </Button>
                          <Button
                            variant="ghost"
                            size="icon"
                            className="h-8 w-8 text-destructive"
                            onClick={() => setDeleteId(doc.id)}
                            title="حذف"
                          >
                            <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                          </Button>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <h3 className="font-bold text-foreground line-clamp-1 mb-1">{doc.title}</h3>
                      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-2">{cat.label}</p>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                        <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                          <FileCheck className="w-3 h-3" />
                          {formatSize(doc.originalSize)}
                        </span>
                        <span>·</span>
                        <span>{formatDate(doc.createdAt)}</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-1">
                        <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-[10px] gap-1">
                          <Lock className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
                          مشفّر
                        </Badge>
                      </div>
                    </CardContent>
                  </Card>
                </motion.div>
              );
            })}
          </AnimatePresence>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Upload Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={uploadOpen} onOpenChange={setUploadOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-[500px]">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Upload className="w-5 h-5" />
              رفع وثيقة حساسة
            </DialogTitle>
          </DialogHeader>
          <div className="space-y-4 py-2">
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>العنوان *</Label>
              <Input
                value={uploadForm.title}
                onChange={(e) => setUploadForm({ ...uploadForm, title: e.target.value })}
                placeholder="مثلاً: جواز السفر"
                autoFocus
              />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>النوع</Label>
              <Select
                value={uploadForm.category}
                onValueChange={(v) => setUploadForm({ ...uploadForm, category: v as SecureDocument['category'] })}
              >
                <SelectTrigger><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  {DOCUMENT_CATEGORIES.map((c) => (
                    <SelectItem key={c.id} value={c.id}>{c.icon} {c.label}</SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>الملف *</Label>
              <div className="border-2 border-dashed border-border rounded-lg p-4 text-center">
                {selectedFile ? (
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-1 min-w-0">
                      <FileCheck className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-500 shrink-0" />
                      <div className="text-left min-w-0">
                        <p className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground truncate">{selectedFile.name}</p>
                        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{formatSize(selectedFile.size)}</p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-8 w-8" onClick={() => setSelectedFile(null)}>
                      <X className="w-4 h-4" />
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div>
                    <Upload className="w-8 h-8 mx-auto mb-2 text-muted-foreground" />
                    <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-2">اسحب ملفاً أو اضغط للاختيار</p>
                    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">الحد الأقصى: {formatSize(MAX_FILE_SIZE)}</p>
                    <input
                      type="file"
                      onChange={handleFileSelect}
                      className="hidden"
                      id="file-upload"
                    />
                    <Button
                      variant="outline"
                      size="sm"
                      className="mt-2"
                      onClick={() => document.getElementById('file-upload')?.click()}
                    >
                      اختيار ملف
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-900/20 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800 rounded-lg p-3 flex items-start gap-2">
              <Lock className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              <p className="text-xs text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300">
                سيتم تشفير الملف بـ AES-256-GCM قبل الحفظ. لن يتمكن أحد من قراءته بدون كلمة المرور الرئيسية.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <DialogFooter>
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setUploadOpen(false)}>إلغاء</Button>
            <Button
              onClick={handleUpload}
              disabled={uploadLoading || !selectedFile || !uploadForm.title.trim()}
              className="gap-1.5"
            >
              {uploadLoading ? (
                <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
              ) : (
                <Lock className="w-4 h-4" />
              )}
              {uploadLoading ? 'جاري التشفير...' : 'تشفير ورفع'}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>

      {/* Delete Confirmation */}
      <AlertDialog open={!!deleteId} onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setDeleteId(null)}>
        <AlertDialogContent>
          <AlertDialogHeader>
            <AlertDialogTitle>تأكيد الحذف</AlertDialogTitle>
            <AlertDialogDescription>
              سيتم حذف الوثيقة نهائياً. لا يمكن التراجع عن هذا الإجراء.
            </AlertDialogDescription>
          </AlertDialogHeader>
          <div className="flex gap-2 justify-end">
            <AlertDialogCancel asChild>
              <Button variant="outline" size="sm">إلغاء</Button>
            </AlertDialogCancel>
            <AlertDialogAction asChild>
              <Button variant="destructive" size="sm" onClick={handleDelete}>حذف</Button>
            </AlertDialogAction>
          </div>
        </AlertDialogContent>
      </AlertDialog>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import {
  History, CheckCircle2, XCircle, Monitor, Smartphone, Globe,
  MapPin, Clock, Filter, RefreshCw,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from '@/components/ui/tabs';
import type { LoginHistoryEntry } from '@/types';

type FilterTab = 'all' | 'success' | 'failed';

export function LoginHistorySection() {
  const [history, setHistory] = useState<LoginHistoryEntry[]>([]);
  const [stats, setStats] = useState({ total: 0, successful: 0, failed: 0, uniqueIPs: 0, uniqueDevices: 0 });
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<FilterTab>('all');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  const loadHistory = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/login-history');
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.success) {
        setHistory(data.history || []);
        setStats(data.stats || { total: 0, successful: 0, failed: 0, uniqueIPs: 0, uniqueDevices: 0 });
      }
    } catch {
      // ignore
    }
    setLoading(false);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    const load = async () => {
      setLoading(true);
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/login-history');
        const data = await res.json();
        if (!cancelled && data.success) {
          setHistory(data.history || []);
          setStats(data.stats || { total: 0, successful: 0, failed: 0, uniqueIPs: 0, uniqueDevices: 0 });
        }
      } catch {
        // ignore
      }
      if (!cancelled) setLoading(false);
    };
    load();
    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, []);

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    if (filter === 'success') return history.filter((h) => h.success);
    if (filter === 'failed') return history.filter((h) => !h.success);
    return history;
  }, [history, filter]);

  const formatTimestamp = (ts: string) => {
    try {
      const d = new Date(ts);
      return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('ar-SA', {
        year: 'numeric',
        month: 'short',
        day: 'numeric',
        hour: '2-digit',
        minute: '2-digit',
      }).format(d);
    } catch {
      return ts;
    }
  };

  const toArabicNum = (n: number) => n.toLocaleString('ar-SA');

  const getDeviceIcon = (deviceInfo: string) => {
    if (deviceInfo.includes('Android') || deviceInfo.includes('iOS') || deviceInfo.includes('iPhone')) {
      return <Smartphone className="w-4 h-4" />;
    }
    return <Monitor className="w-4 h-4" />;
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-900/40 flex items-center justify-center">
            <History className="w-5 h-5 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-lg font-bold text-foreground">سجل الدخول</h1>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              {toArabicNum(stats.total)} محاولة · {toArabicNum(stats.successful)} ناجحة · {toArabicNum(stats.failed)} فاشلة
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={loadHistory} disabled={loading} className="gap-1.5">
          <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${loading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
          تحديث
        </Button>
      </div>

      {/* Stats */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
        <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
          <CardContent className="p-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-500" />
              <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">ناجحة</span>
            </div>
            <p className="text-xl font-bold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">{toArabicNum(stats.successful)}</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
        <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
          <CardContent className="p-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
              <XCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-red-500" />
              <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">فاشلة</span>
            </div>
            <p className="text-xl font-bold text-red-600 dark:text-red-400">{toArabicNum(stats.failed)}</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
        <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
          <CardContent className="p-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
              <Globe className="w-4 h-4 text-sky-500" />
              <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">عناوين IP</span>
            </div>
            <p className="text-xl font-bold text-sky-600 dark:text-sky-400">{toArabicNum(stats.uniqueIPs)}</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
        <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
          <CardContent className="p-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
              <Monitor className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-500" />
              <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">أجهزة</span>
            </div>
            <p className="text-xl font-bold text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400">{toArabicNum(stats.uniqueDevices)}</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>

      {/* Filter */}
      <Tabs value={filter} onValueChange={(v) => setFilter(v as FilterTab)}>
        <TabsList>
          <TabsTrigger value="all">الكل ({toArabicNum(stats.total)})</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="success">ناجحة ({toArabicNum(stats.successful)})</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="failed">فاشلة ({toArabicNum(stats.failed)})</TabsTrigger>
        </TabsList>
      </Tabs>

      {/* Timeline */}
      {filtered.length === 0 ? (
        <Card>
          <CardContent className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-16 text-center">
            <History className="w-12 h-12 text-muted-foreground mb-3" />
            <p className="text-lg font-medium text-foreground">لا توجد سجلات بعد</p>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-1">ستظهر هنا كل محاولات الدخول</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <AnimatePresence mode="popLayout">
            {filtered.map((entry, index) => (
              <motion.div
                key={entry.id}
                layout
                initial={{ opacity: 0, x: -20 }}
                animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }}
                exit={{ opacity: 0, x: 20 }}
                transition={{ delay: Math.min(index * 0.03, 0.3) }}
              >
                <Card className={`border bg-background ${entry.success ? 'border-border' : 'border-red-200 dark:border-red-900/50'}`}>
                  <CardContent className="p-3 flex items-center gap-3">
                    {/* Status icon */}
                    <div className={`w-9 h-9 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 ${
                      entry.success
                        ? 'bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-900/20'
                        : 'bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-900/20'
                    }`}>
                      {entry.success ? (
                        <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
                      ) : (
                        <XCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400" />
                      )}
                    </div>

                    {/* Info */}
                    <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                        <Badge variant={entry.success ? 'secondary' : 'destructive'} className="text-[10px]">
                          {entry.success ? '✅ ناجح' : '❌ فاشل'}
                        </Badge>
                        {entry.deviceInfo && (
                          <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1">
                            {getDeviceIcon(entry.deviceInfo)}
                            {entry.deviceInfo}
                          </span>
                        )}
                        {entry.ipAddress && entry.ipAddress !== 'localhost' && (
                          <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1">
                            <Globe className="w-3 h-3" />
                            {entry.ipAddress}
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      {entry.failureReason && !entry.success && (
                        <p className="text-xs text-red-500 mt-1">{entry.failureReason}</p>
                      )}
                      {index === 0 && entry.success && (
                        <p className="text-[10px] text-emerald-500 mt-1">🟢 آخر دخول</p>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    {/* Timestamp */}
                    <div className="text-left shrink-0">
                      <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1">
                        <Clock className="w-3 h-3" />
                        {formatTimestamp(entry.timestamp)}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </CardContent>
                </Card>
              </motion.div>
            ))}
          </AnimatePresence>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

// ============================================
// الأجهزة الموثوقة — Trusted Devices (المرحلة 10)
// إدارة الأجهزة المسموح لها بالدخول للموقع
// ============================================

import { useState, useEffect, useMemo, useCallback } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import {
  Smartphone, Laptop, Monitor, Tablet, ShieldCheck, ShieldAlert,
  Clock, RefreshCw, Trash2, CheckCircle2, XCircle, AlertTriangle,
  Crown, Wifi, Eye, Cpu, Fingerprint, Sparkles, Ban,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import {
  AlertDialog,
  AlertDialogAction,
  AlertDialogCancel,
  AlertDialogContent,
  AlertDialogDescription,
  AlertDialogFooter,
  AlertDialogHeader,
  AlertDialogTitle,
  AlertDialogTrigger,
} from '@/components/ui/alert-dialog';
import {
  Tooltip,
  TooltipContent,
  TooltipProvider,
  TooltipTrigger,
} from '@/components/ui/tooltip';
import { useAppStore } from '@/lib/store';
import { toast } from '@/hooks/use-toast';
import { generateFingerprint, getDeviceInfo } from '@/lib/device-fingerprint';
import type { TrustedDevice, DeviceApprovalRequest } from '@/types';

// ============ Helpers ============

function deviceIcon(type: string) {
  switch (type) {
    case 'phone': return <Smartphone className="w-5 h-5" />;
    case 'laptop': return <Laptop className="w-5 h-5" />;
    case 'desktop': return <Monitor className="w-5 h-5" />;
    case 'tablet': return <Tablet className="w-5 h-5" />;
    default: return <Monitor className="w-5 h-5" />;
  }
}

function formatLastSeen(iso: string): string {
  try {
    const date = new Date(iso);
    const now = new Date();
    const diffMs = now.getTime() - date.getTime();
    const diffMin = Math.floor(diffMs / 60000);
    const diffHrs = Math.floor(diffMin / 60);
    const diffDays = Math.floor(diffHrs / 24);

    if (diffMin < 1) return 'الآن';
    if (diffMin < 60) return `قبل ${diffMin} دقيقة`;
    if (diffHrs < 24) return `قبل ${diffHrs} ساعة`;
    if (diffDays < 30) return `قبل ${diffDays} يوم`;
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('ar-SA', { dateStyle: 'medium' }).format(date);
  } catch {
    return '—';
  }
}

function formatExpiry(expiresAt: string): { text: string; danger: boolean } {
  try {
    const ms = new Date(expiresAt).getTime() - Date.now();
    if (ms <= 0) return { text: 'انتهى', danger: true };
    const min = Math.floor(ms / 60000);
    const sec = Math.floor((ms % 60000) / 1000);
    return {
      text: `${min}:${sec.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`,
      danger: ms < 60000,
    };
  } catch {
    return { text: '—', danger: false };
  }
}

// ============ مكوّن عدّاد تنازلي ============
function CountdownBadge({ expiresAt }: { expiresAt: string }) {
  const [, force] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    const t = setInterval(() => force((n) => n + 1), 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(t);
  }, []);
  const { text, danger } = formatExpiry(expiresAt);
  return (
    <Badge variant={danger ? 'destructive' : 'secondary'} className="font-mono tabular-nums">
      <Clock className="w-3 h-3 ml-1" />
      {text}
    </Badge>
  );
}

// ============ مكوّن بطاقة جهاز ============
function DeviceCard({
  device,
  onRevoke,
}: {
  device: TrustedDevice;
  onRevoke: (id: string) => void;
}) {
  return (
    <motion.div
      layout

    >

          <div className="flex items-start gap-3">

                  <Badge variant="default" className="bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-600 text-white">
                    <Crown className="w-3 h-3 ml-1" />
                    الجهاز الأساسي
                  </Badge>
                )}
                {!device.isActive && (
                  <Badge variant="destructive">

                    معطّل
                  </Badge>
                )}
              </div>
              <div className="mt-1.5 space-y-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <Wifi className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>{device.browser || 'غير معروف'} على {device.os || 'غير معروف'}</span>
                </div>
                {device.ipAddress && (
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <Globe2Icon />

                  </div>
                )}
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>آخر دخول: {formatLastSeen(device.lastLogin)}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="flex-shrink-0">
              {device.isPrimary ? (
                <TooltipProvider>
                  <Tooltip>
                    <TooltipTrigger asChild>
                      <span>
                        <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" disabled className="h-8 w-8 opacity-40 cursor-not-allowed">
                          <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                        </Button>
                      </span>
                    </TooltipTrigger>
                    <TooltipContent>
                      <p>الجهاز الأساسي لا يمكن إلغاؤه</p>
                    </TooltipContent>
                  </Tooltip>
                </TooltipProvider>
              ) : (
                <AlertDialog>
                  <AlertDialogTrigger asChild>
                    <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-8 w-8 hover:bg-destructive/10 hover:text-destructive">
                      <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                    </Button>
                  </AlertDialogTrigger>
                  <AlertDialogContent>
                    <AlertDialogHeader>
                      <AlertDialogTitle>إلغاء الثقة بهذا الجهاز؟</AlertDialogTitle>
                      <AlertDialogDescription>
                        سيتم حذف «{device.deviceName}» من قائمة الأجهزة الموثوقة.
                        أي محاولة دخول قادمة منه ستحتاج إلى تأصيل جديد من الجهاز الأساسي.
                      </AlertDialogDescription>
                    </AlertDialogHeader>
                    <AlertDialogFooter>
                      <AlertDialogCancel>تراجع</AlertDialogCancel>
                      <AlertDialogAction
                        onClick={() => onRevoke(device.id)}
                        className="bg-destructive hover:bg-destructive/90 text-destructive-foreground"
                      >
                        نعم، ألغِ الثقة
                      </AlertDialogAction>
                    </AlertDialogFooter>
                  </AlertDialogContent>
                </AlertDialog>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </motion.div>
  );
}

function Globe2Icon() {
  return <span className="inline-block w-3.5 h-3.5 text-muted-foreground/70">🌐</span>;
}

// ============ مكوّن بطاقة طلب تأصيل ============
function ApprovalCard({
  req,
  onApprove,
  onReject,
}: {
  req: DeviceApprovalRequest;
  onApprove: (id: string) => void;
  onReject: (id: string) => void;
}) {
  const info = req.deviceInfo;
  return (
    <motion.div
      layout
      initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
      exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.9 }}
      transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}
    >
      <Card className="border-amber-500/40 bg-amber-500/5 overflow-hidden">
        <CardContent className="p-4">
          <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
            <div className="p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400">
              <Fingerprint className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                <h4 className="font-semibold text-sm truncate">
                  {info?.deviceName || 'جهاز غير معروف'}
                </h4>

              </div>
              <div className="mt-1.5 space-y-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <Wifi className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>{info?.browser || 'غير معروف'} على {info?.os || 'غير معروف'}</span>

                    <span>الدقة: {info.screen}</span>
                  </div>
                )}

                  {req.approvalCode}

// ============ المكوّن الرئيسي ============
export function TrustedDevicesSection() {
  const {
    trustedDevices,
    deviceApprovalRequests,
    currentDeviceStatus,
    loadTrustedDevices,
    loadDeviceApprovals,
    approveDevice,
    rejectDevice,
    revokeDevice,
    cleanupInactiveDevices,
    registerCurrentDevice,
    setCurrentDeviceStatus,
  } = useAppStore();

  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [currentFingerprint, setCurrentFingerprint] = useState<string>('');
  const [currentInfo, setCurrentInfo] = useState<{ browser: string; os: string; deviceType: string } | null>(null);

  // تحميل الجهاز الحالي + قوائم الأجهزة
  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    (async () => {
      try {
        const fp = await generateFingerprint();
        const info = getDeviceInfo();
        if (cancelled) return;
        setCurrentFingerprint(fp);
        setCurrentInfo({ browser: info.browser, os: info.os, deviceType: info.deviceType });
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('[TrustedDevices] fingerprint failed:', e);
      }
      loadTrustedDevices();
      loadDeviceApprovals();
    })();
    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, [loadTrustedDevices, loadDeviceApprovals]);

  // تحديث دوري للطلبات المعلقة كل 15 ثانية
  useEffect(() => {
    const t = setInterval(() => {
      loadDeviceApprovals();
    }, 15000);
    return () => clearInterval(t);
  }, [loadDeviceApprovals]);

  const handleRefresh = useCallback(async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    await Promise.all([loadTrustedDevices(), loadDeviceApprovals()]);
    setBusy(false);
    toast({ title: 'تم التحديث' });
  }, [loadTrustedDevices, loadDeviceApprovals]);

  const handleApprove = useCallback(async (id: string) => {
    setBusy(true);
    const ok = await approveDevice(id);
    setBusy(false);
    if (ok) {
      toast({ title: 'تمت الموافقة على الجهاز', description: 'يمكن للجهاز الآن الدخول بحرية' });
      await loadDeviceApprovals();
    } else {
      toast({ title: 'فشلت الموافقة', variant: 'destructive' });
    }
  }, [approveDevice, loadDeviceApprovals]);

  const handleReject = useCallback(async (id: string) => {
    setBusy(true);
    const ok = await rejectDevice(id);
    setBusy(false);
    if (ok) {
      toast({ title: 'تم رفض الطلب' });
      await loadDeviceApprovals();
    } else {
      toast({ title: 'فشل الرفض', variant: 'destructive' });
    }
  }, [rejectDevice, loadDeviceApprovals]);

  const handleRevoke = useCallback(async (id: string) => {
    setBusy(true);
    const ok = await revokeDevice(id);
    setBusy(false);
    if (ok) {
      toast({ title: 'تم إلغاء الثقة بالجهاز' });
      await loadTrustedDevices();
    } else {
      toast({ title: 'فشل الإلغاء', variant: 'destructive' });
    }
  }, [revokeDevice, loadTrustedDevices]);

  const handleCleanup = useCallback(async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    const count = await cleanupInactiveDevices();
    setBusy(false);
    if (count > 0) {
      toast({ title: `تم تعطيل ${count} جهاز غير نشط` });
    } else {
      toast({ title: 'لا توجد أجهزة تحتاج تعطيل' });
    }
  }, [cleanupInactiveDevices]);

  const handleRegister = useCallback(async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    const result = await registerCurrentDevice();
    setBusy(false);
    if (result.status === 'trusted') {
      setCurrentDeviceStatus('trusted');
      toast({ title: 'هذا الجهاز موثوق بالفعل' });
    } else if (result.status === 'new') {
      setCurrentDeviceStatus('new');
      toast({
        title: 'الجهاز غير موثوق',
        description: result.warning || 'يلزم تأصيل من الجهاز الأساسي',
        variant: 'destructive',
      });
    } else if (result.warning) {
      toast({ title: 'تنبيه', description: result.warning, variant: 'destructive' });
    }
  }, [registerCurrentDevice, setCurrentDeviceStatus]);

  // إحصائيات
  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    const total = trustedDevices.length;
    const active = trustedDevices.filter((d) => d.isActive).length;
    const primary = trustedDevices.find((d) => d.isPrimary);
    const lastActivity = trustedDevices.reduce<string>((max, d) => (d.lastLogin > max ? d.lastLogin : max), '');
    return { total, active, primary, lastActivity, pending: deviceApprovalRequests.length };
  }, [trustedDevices, deviceApprovalRequests]);

  const isCurrentTrusted = useMemo(() => {
    if (!currentFingerprint) return false;
    const found = trustedDevices.find((d) => d.fingerprint === currentFingerprint);
    return !!found && found.isActive;
  }, [trustedDevices, currentFingerprint]);

  const pendingOnly = useMemo(
    () => deviceApprovalRequests.filter((r) => r.status === 'pending'),
    [deviceApprovalRequests]
  );

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 pb-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 flex-wrap">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2">
            <ShieldCheck className="w-6 h-6 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
            الأجهزة الموثوقة
          </h2>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm mt-1">
            إدارة الأجهزة المسموح لها بالدخول إلى MiMo Portfolio
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={handleRefresh} disabled={busy}>
            <RefreshCw className={`w-4 h-4 ml-2 ${busy ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
            تحديث
          </Button>
          <AlertDialog>
            <AlertDialogTrigger asChild>
              <Button variant="outline" size="sm" disabled={busy}>
                <Ban className="w-4 h-4 ml-2" />
                تنظيف الأجهزة غير النشطة
              </Button>
            </AlertDialogTrigger>
            <AlertDialogContent>
              <AlertDialogHeader>
                <AlertDialogTitle>تعطيل الأجهزة غير النشطة؟</AlertDialogTitle>
                <AlertDialogDescription>
                  سيتم تعطيل أي جهاز (عدا الأساسي) لم يسجل دخولاً منذ 90 يوماً.
                  يمكن إعادة تفعيلها بإعادة تأصيلها من الجهاز الأساسي.
                </AlertDialogDescription>
              </AlertDialogHeader>
              <AlertDialogFooter>
                <AlertDialogCancel>إلغاء</AlertDialogCancel>
                <AlertDialogAction onClick={handleCleanup}>نعم، نظّف</AlertDialogAction>
              </AlertDialogFooter>
            </AlertDialogContent>
          </AlertDialog>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Stats */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
        <Card>
          <CardContent className="p-4 flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">
              <Smartphone className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">إجمالي الأجهزة</p>
              <p className="text-2xl font-bold tabular-nums">{stats.total}</p>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
        <Card>
          <CardContent className="p-4 flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-sky-500/15 text-sky-600 dark:text-sky-400">
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">الأجهزة النشطة</p>
              <p className="text-2xl font-bold tabular-nums">{stats.active}</p>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
        <Card>
          <CardContent className="p-4 flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400">
              <Clock className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">طلبات معلقة</p>
              <p className="text-2xl font-bold tabular-nums">{stats.pending}</p>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
        <Card>
          <CardContent className="p-4 flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-purple-500/15 text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400">
              <Eye className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div className="min-w-0">
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">آخر نشاط</p>
              <p className="text-sm font-bold truncate">
                {stats.lastActivity ? formatLastSeen(stats.lastActivity) : '—'}
              </p>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>

      {/* الجهاز الحالي */}
      <Card className={isCurrentTrusted ? 'border-emerald-500/30' : 'border-amber-500/30'}>
        <CardHeader className="pb-3">
          <CardTitle className="text-base flex items-center gap-2">
            <Cpu className="w-4 h-4" />
            هذا الجهاز
          </CardTitle>
          <CardDescription className="text-xs">
            معلومات الجهاز الذي تستخدمه الآن
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="space-y-3">
          {currentInfo && (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 flex-wrap text-sm">
              <Badge variant="outline" className="gap-1">
                {deviceIcon(currentInfo.deviceType)}
                {currentInfo.browser} على {currentInfo.os}
              </Badge>
              {currentFingerprint && (
                <TooltipProvider>
                  <Tooltip>
                    <TooltipTrigger asChild>
                      <Badge variant="outline" className="font-mono text-xs gap-1">
                        <Fingerprint className="w-3 h-3" />
                        {currentFingerprint.substring(0, 12)}…
                      </Badge>
                    </TooltipTrigger>
                    <TooltipContent>
                      <p className="font-mono text-xs">{currentFingerprint}</p>
                    </TooltipContent>
                  </Tooltip>
                </TooltipProvider>
              )}
              {isCurrentTrusted ? (
                <Badge variant="default" className="bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-600 text-white">
                  <ShieldCheck className="w-3 h-3 ml-1" />
                  موثوق
                </Badge>
              ) : (
                <Badge variant="destructive">
                  <ShieldAlert className="w-3 h-3 ml-1" />
                  غير موثوق
                </Badge>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
          {!isCurrentTrusted && (
            <div className="flex items-start gap-2 p-3 rounded-md bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-500/20">
              <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              <div className="flex-1">
                <p className="text-xs text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-200">
                  هذا الجهاز غير موثوق بعد. لتسجيله كجهاز موثوق، يجب أن يكون هناك جهاز أساسي موجود مسبقاً، وسيتم إرسال كود تأصيل للجهاز الأساسي.
                </p>
                <Button
                  size="sm"
                  variant="outline"
                  className="mt-2 border-amber-500/40 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300 hover:bg-amber-500/10"
                  onClick={handleRegister}
                  disabled={busy}
                >
                  <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5 ml-1" />
                  تسجيل هذا الجهاز
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
          {currentDeviceStatus === 'new' && (
            <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              إذا كان لديك جهاز أساسي آخر، افتح «الأجهزة الموثوقة» عليه وأدخل كود التأصيل الذي يظهر هنا.
            </div>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* طلبات التأصيل المعلقة */}
      {pendingOnly.length > 0 && (
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3">
            <AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400" />
            <h3 className="font-bold">طلبات بانتظار الموافقة ({pendingOnly.length})</h3>
          </div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <AnimatePresence mode="popLayout">
              {pendingOnly.map((req) => (
                <ApprovalCard
                  key={req.id}
                  req={req}
                  onApprove={handleApprove}
                  onReject={handleReject}
                />
              ))}
            </AnimatePresence>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* قائمة الأجهزة الموثوقة */}
      <div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3">
          <ShieldCheck className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
          <h3 className="font-bold">الأجهزة الموثوقة ({trustedDevices.length})</h3>
        </div>
        {trustedDevices.length === 0 ? (
          <Card className="border-dashed">
            <CardContent className="py-12 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center">
              <Smartphone className="w-12 h-12 text-muted-foreground/40 mb-3" />
              <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm">
                لا توجد أجهزة مسجلة بعد
              </p>
              <p className="text-muted-foreground/70 text-xs mt-1">
                سيتم تسجيل أول جهاز يدخل كـ«الجهاز الأساسي» تلقائياً
              </p>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        ) : (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <AnimatePresence mode="popLayout">
              {trustedDevices.map((device) => (
                <DeviceCard key={device.id} device={device} onRevoke={handleRevoke} />
              ))}
            </AnimatePresence>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* معلومات أمنية */}
      <Card className="bg-muted/30 border-dashed">
        <CardContent className="p-4 text-xs text-muted-foreground space-y-2">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-medium text-foreground">
            <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4" />
            كيف يعمل نظام الأجهزة الموثوقة؟
          </div>
          <ul className="space-y-1 list-disc pr-5">
            <li>أول جهاز يدخل الموقع بعد الإعداد يصبح <b>الجهاز الأساسي</b> تلقائياً.</li>
            <li>أي جهاز جديد يحتاج إلى <b>كود تأصيل من 6 أرقام</b> يُولّد ويُرسل للجهاز الأساسي عبر Push Notification.</li>
            <li>الكود ينتهي خلال <b>5 دقائق</b> فقط لأسباب أمنية.</li>
            <li>الأجهزة غير النشطة لمدة <b>90 يوماً</b> تُعطّل تلقائياً عند تشغيل «التنظيف».</li>
            <li>الجهاز الأساسي لا يمكن إلغاؤه — هو الضامن للوصول الدائم.</li>
            <li>البصمة تُولّد من: User Agent + اللغة + المنطقة الزمنية + دقة الشاشة + المعالج.</li>
          </ul>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

// طلبات التوظيف — Job Applications UI

import { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  Briefcase, Plus, Pencil, Trash2, Search, MapPin, DollarSign,
  Calendar, ExternalLink, Building2,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogFooter, DialogDescription } from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import {
  AlertDialog, AlertDialogAction, AlertDialogCancel, AlertDialogContent,
  AlertDialogDescription, AlertDialogFooter, AlertDialogHeader, AlertDialogTitle,
} from '@/components/ui/alert-dialog';
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@/components/ui/select';
import {
  DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuTrigger, DropdownMenuLabel, DropdownMenuSeparator,
} from '@/components/ui/dropdown-menu';
import { useAppStore } from '@/lib/store';
import { toast } from '@/hooks/use-toast';
import { JOB_STATUS_CONFIG } from '@/types';
import type { JobApplication } from '@/types';

type JobStatus = JobApplication['status'];

const WORK_TYPES: Array<{ value: string; label: string }> = [
  { value: 'remote', label: 'عن بُعد' },
  { value: 'onsite', label: 'حضوري' },
  { value: 'hybrid', label: 'هجين' },
];

const STATUS_VALUES = Object.keys(JOB_STATUS_CONFIG) as JobStatus[];

const today = () => new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

function fmtDate(s: string): string {
  if (!s) return '';
  try { return new Date(s).toLocaleDateString('ar', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' }); }
  catch { return s; }
}
function fmtSalary(n: number): string {
  if (!n || n <= 0) return '';
  return n.toLocaleString('en-US');
}
function workTypeLabel(v: string): string {
  return WORK_TYPES.find(t => t.value === v)?.label || v || '';
}

interface JobForm {
  jobTitle: string; company: string; location: string; workType: string;
  salaryMin: string; salaryMax: string; applicationDate: string;
  applicationUrl: string; contactPerson: string; contactEmail: string; notes: string;
}
const emptyForm: JobForm = {
  jobTitle: '', company: '', location: '', workType: 'remote',
  salaryMin: '', salaryMax: '', applicationDate: '', applicationUrl: '',
  contactPerson: '', contactEmail: '', notes: '',
};

// ============ Application Card ============
function JobAppCard({ app, onEdit, onDelete, onStatusChange }: {
  app: JobApplication;
  onEdit: () => void;
  onDelete: () => void;
  onStatusChange: (s: JobStatus) => void;
}) {
  const cfg = JOB_STATUS_CONFIG[app.status] || JOB_STATUS_CONFIG.applied;
  const hasSalary = (app.salaryMin > 0 || app.salaryMax > 0);
  return (
    <Card className="group relative overflow-hidden transition-all hover:shadow-md hover:border-primary/40">
      <CardContent className="p-4 space-y-3">
        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
          <div className="flex items-start gap-3 min-w-0 flex-1">
            <div className="mt-0.5 flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-primary/10 text-primary">
              <Building2 className="h-5 w-5" />
            </div>
            <div className="min-w-0 space-y-1">
              <h3 className="font-semibold leading-tight line-clamp-1">{app.jobTitle || 'بدون عنوان'}</h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground line-clamp-1 flex items-center gap-1">
                <Briefcase className="h-3 w-3 shrink-0" />{app.company || 'بدون شركة'}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="flex gap-0.5 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity shrink-0">
            <Button size="icon" variant="ghost" className="h-7 w-7" onClick={onEdit} aria-label="تعديل"><Pencil className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /></Button>
            <Button size="icon" variant="ghost" className="h-7 w-7 text-destructive" onClick={onDelete} aria-label="حذف"><Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /></Button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
          <DropdownMenu>
            <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
              <Button variant="outline" size="sm" className={`h-7 text-xs ${cfg.color}`}>
                <span className="ml-1">{cfg.icon}</span>{cfg.label}
              </Button>
            </DropdownMenuTrigger>
            <DropdownMenuContent align="start">
              <DropdownMenuLabel>تغيير الحالة</DropdownMenuLabel>
              <DropdownMenuSeparator />
              {STATUS_VALUES.map(s => (
                <DropdownMenuItem key={s} onClick={() => onStatusChange(s)}>
                  <span className="ml-2">{JOB_STATUS_CONFIG[s].icon}</span>
                  <span className={app.status === s ? 'font-bold' : ''}>{JOB_STATUS_CONFIG[s].label}</span>
                </DropdownMenuItem>
              ))}
            </DropdownMenuContent>
          </DropdownMenu>
          {app.applicationUrl && (
            <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" className="h-7 text-xs" onClick={() => window.open(app.applicationUrl, '_blank')} aria-label="رابط الوظيفة">
              <ExternalLink className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-1 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
          {app.location && <span className="flex items-center gap-1"><MapPin className="h-3 w-3" />{app.location}</span>}
          {app.workType && <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-[10px]">{workTypeLabel(app.workType)}</Badge>}
          {app.applicationDate && <span className="flex items-center gap-1"><Calendar className="h-3 w-3" />{fmtDate(app.applicationDate)}</span>}
        </div>

        {hasSalary && (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">
            <DollarSign className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            <span className="font-medium tabular-nums" dir="ltr">
              {app.salaryMin > 0 ? fmtSalary(app.salaryMin) : '—'}
              {app.salaryMin > 0 && app.salaryMax > 0 && ' - '}
              {app.salaryMax > 0 ? fmtSalary(app.salaryMax) : ''}
            </span>
          </div>
        )}

        {app.notes && <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground line-clamp-2 pt-1 border-t">{app.notes}</p>}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

export function JobApplicationsSection() {
  const { jobApplications, addJobApplication, updateJobApplication, deleteJobApplication } = useAppStore();
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [statusFilter, setStatusFilter] = useState<string>('all');
  const [dialogOpen, setDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingId, setEditingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [form, setForm] = useState<JobForm>(emptyForm);
  const [deleteId, setDeleteId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    const total = jobApplications.length;
    const interview = jobApplications.filter(j => j.status === 'interview').length;
    const offer = jobApplications.filter(j => j.status === 'offered' || j.status === 'accepted').length;
    const accepted = jobApplications.filter(j => j.status === 'accepted').length;
    const decided = jobApplications.filter(j => j.status === 'accepted' || j.status === 'rejected').length;
    const rate = decided > 0 ? Math.round((accepted / decided) * 100) : 0;
    return { total, interview, offer, rate };
  }, [jobApplications]);

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    const q = search.trim().toLowerCase();
    return jobApplications.filter(j => {
      if (statusFilter !== 'all' && j.status !== statusFilter) return false;
      if (!q) return true;
      return [j.jobTitle, j.company, j.location, j.contactPerson, j.contactEmail, j.notes, j.workType]
        .some(x => x?.toLowerCase().includes(q));
    });
  }, [jobApplications, search, statusFilter]);

  const openAdd = () => { setForm({ ...emptyForm, applicationDate: today() }); setEditingId(null); setDialogOpen(true); };
  const openEdit = (j: JobApplication) => {
    setForm({
      jobTitle: j.jobTitle, company: j.company, location: j.location, workType: j.workType || 'remote',
      salaryMin: j.salaryMin ? String(j.salaryMin) : '', salaryMax: j.salaryMax ? String(j.salaryMax) : '',
      applicationDate: j.applicationDate || '', applicationUrl: j.applicationUrl,
      contactPerson: j.contactPerson, contactEmail: j.contactEmail, notes: j.notes,
    });
    setEditingId(j.id); setDialogOpen(true);
  };

  const save = () => {
    if (!form.jobTitle.trim()) { toast({ title: 'المسمى الوظيفي مطلوب', variant: 'destructive' }); return; }
    if (!form.company.trim()) { toast({ title: 'اسم الشركة مطلوب', variant: 'destructive' }); return; }
    const sMin = parseInt(form.salaryMin, 10);
    const sMax = parseInt(form.salaryMax, 10);
    const data = {
      jobTitle: form.jobTitle.trim(), company: form.company.trim(),
      location: form.location.trim(), workType: form.workType,
      salaryMin: isNaN(sMin) ? 0 : sMin, salaryMax: isNaN(sMax) ? 0 : sMax,
      jobDescription: '', applicationDate: form.applicationDate,
      status: 'applied' as JobStatus, interviewDate: '', interviewType: '', interviewNotes: '',
      offerDetails: '', rejectionReason: '', applicationUrl: form.applicationUrl.trim(),
      resumeVersion: '', contactPerson: form.contactPerson.trim(), contactEmail: form.contactEmail.trim(),
      notes: form.notes.trim(), tags: [] as string[],
    };
    if (editingId) {
      // Preserve status-related fields when editing — only update the form fields
      const existing = jobApplications.find(j => j.id === editingId);
      const merged = {
        ...data,
        status: existing?.status || 'applied',
        interviewDate: existing?.interviewDate || '',
        interviewType: existing?.interviewType || '',
        interviewNotes: existing?.interviewNotes || '',
        offerDetails: existing?.offerDetails || '',
        rejectionReason: existing?.rejectionReason || '',
        jobDescription: existing?.jobDescription || '',
        resumeVersion: existing?.resumeVersion || '',
        tags: existing?.tags || [],
      };
      updateJobApplication(editingId, merged);
      toast({ title: 'تم تحديث الطلب' });
    } else {
      addJobApplication(data);
      toast({ title: 'تمت إضافة الطلب' });
    }
    setDialogOpen(false);
  };

  const confirmDelete = () => {
    if (!deleteId) return;
    deleteJobApplication(deleteId);
    setDeleteId(null);
    toast({ title: 'تم حذف الطلب' });
  };

  const changeStatus = (id: string, s: JobStatus) => {
    updateJobApplication(id, { status: s });
    toast({ title: `تم تغيير الحالة إلى: ${JOB_STATUS_CONFIG[s].label}` });
  };

  const set = <K extends keyof JobForm>(k: K, v: JobForm[K]) => setForm(f => ({ ...f, [k]: v }));
  const renderField = (label: string, input: React.ReactNode, className = '') => (
    <div className={`space-y-1.5 ${className}`}><Label>{label}</Label>{input}</div>
  );

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 flex-wrap">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2"><Briefcase className="h-5 w-5" />طلبات التوظيف</h2>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{jobApplications.length} طلب · معدّل القبول {stats.rate}%</p>
        </div>
        <Button onClick={openAdd}><Plus className="h-4 w-4 ml-1" />طلب جديد</Button>
      </div>

      {/* Stats */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
        <Card><CardContent className="p-4">
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">إجمالي الطلبات</p>
          <p className="text-2xl font-bold tabular-nums">{stats.total}</p>
        </CardContent></Card>
        <Card><CardContent className="p-4">
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">مقابلات</p>
          <p className="text-2xl font-bold tabular-nums text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400">{stats.interview}</p>
        </CardContent></Card>
        <Card><CardContent className="p-4">
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">عروض</p>
          <p className="text-2xl font-bold tabular-nums text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">{stats.offer}</p>
        </CardContent></Card>
        <Card><CardContent className="p-4">
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">معدّل القبول</p>
          <p className="text-2xl font-bold tabular-nums text-primary">{stats.rate}%</p>
        </CardContent></Card>
      </div>

      {/* Toolbar */}
      <div className="flex gap-2 flex-wrap">
        <div className="relative flex-1 min-w-[200px]">
          <Search className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
          <Input placeholder="ابحث بالمسمى أو الشركة أو الموقع..." value={search} onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)} className="pr-9" />
        </div>
        <Select value={statusFilter} onValueChange={setStatusFilter}>
          <SelectTrigger className="w-[180px]"><SelectValue placeholder="كل الحالات" /></SelectTrigger>
          <SelectContent>
            <SelectItem value="all">كل الحالات</SelectItem>
            {STATUS_VALUES.map(s => <SelectItem key={s} value={s}>{JOB_STATUS_CONFIG[s].label}</SelectItem>)}
          </SelectContent>
        </Select>
      </div>

      {/* List */}
      {filtered.length === 0 ? (
        <Card><CardContent className="p-10 text-center text-muted-foreground">
          <Briefcase className="h-10 w-10 mx-auto mb-2 opacity-40" />
          {jobApplications.length === 0 ? 'لا توجد طلبات بعد. ابدأ بإضافة طلب جديد.' : 'لا توجد نتائج مطابقة.'}
        </CardContent></Card>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
          {filtered.map(j => (
            <JobAppCard
              key={j.id} app={j}
              onEdit={() => openEdit(j)}
              onDelete={() => setDeleteId(j.id)}
              onStatusChange={(s) => changeStatus(j.id, s)}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Add / Edit Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={dialogOpen} onOpenChange={setDialogOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="max-w-2xl max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>{editingId ? 'تعديل الطلب' : 'إضافة طلب توظيف'}</DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>أدخل تفاصيل الوظيفة ومعلومات التقديم.</DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            {renderField('المسمى الوظيفي *', <Input value={form.jobTitle} onChange={(e) => set('jobTitle', e.target.value)} placeholder="مطوّر واجهات أمامية" />)}
            {renderField('الشركة *', <Input value={form.company} onChange={(e) => set('company', e.target.value)} placeholder="Google" />)}
            {renderField('الموقع', <Input value={form.location} onChange={(e) => set('location', e.target.value)} placeholder="دبي، الإمارات" />)}
            {renderField('نوع العمل',
              <Select value={form.workType} onValueChange={(v) => set('workType', v)}>
                <SelectTrigger><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  {WORK_TYPES.map(t => <SelectItem key={t.value} value={t.value}>{t.label}</SelectItem>)}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>)}
            {renderField('الراتب الأدنى', <Input type="number" min={0} dir="ltr" value={form.salaryMin} onChange={(e) => set('salaryMin', e.target.value)} placeholder="0" />)}
            {renderField('الراتب الأعلى', <Input type="number" min={0} dir="ltr" value={form.salaryMax} onChange={(e) => set('salaryMax', e.target.value)} placeholder="0" />)}
            {renderField('تاريخ التقديم', <Input type="date" value={form.applicationDate} onChange={(e) => set('applicationDate', e.target.value)} />)}
            {renderField('رابط الوظيفة', <Input type="url" dir="ltr" value={form.applicationUrl} onChange={(e) => set('applicationUrl', e.target.value)} placeholder="https://..." />)}
            {renderField('الشخص المسؤول', <Input value={form.contactPerson} onChange={(e) => set('contactPerson', e.target.value)} placeholder="محمد أحمد" />)}
            {renderField('البريد الإلكتروني', <Input type="email" dir="ltr" value={form.contactEmail} onChange={(e) => set('contactEmail', e.target.value)} placeholder="hr@company.com" />)}
            {renderField('ملاحظات', <Textarea rows={3} value={form.notes} onChange={(e) => set('notes', e.target.value)} placeholder="ملاحظات حول الطلب..." />, 'sm:col-span-2')}
          </div>
          <DialogFooter>
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setDialogOpen(false)}>إلغاء</Button>
            <Button onClick={save}>{editingId ? 'حفظ' : 'إضافة'}</Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>

      {/* Delete confirm */}
      <AlertDialog open={!!deleteId} onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setDeleteId(null)}>
        <AlertDialogContent>
          <AlertDialogHeader>
            <AlertDialogTitle>تأكيد الحذف</AlertDialogTitle>
            <AlertDialogDescription>سيتم حذف الطلب نهائياً. لا يمكن التراجع عن هذا الإجراء.</AlertDialogDescription>
          </AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogFooter>
            <AlertDialogCancel>إلغاء</AlertDialogCancel>
            <AlertDialogAction onClick={confirmDelete} className="bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground hover:bg-destructive/90">حذف</AlertDialogAction>
          </AlertDialogFooter>
        </AlertDialogContent>
      </AlertDialog>
    </div>
  );
}
```
