```tsx
'use client';

// شبكة العلاقات — Networking UI

import { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  Users, Plus, Pencil, Trash2, Search, Mail, Phone, Linkedin,
  Star, Calendar, AlertCircle,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from '@/components/ui/alert';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogFooter, DialogDescription } from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import {
  AlertDialog, AlertDialogAction, AlertDialogCancel, AlertDialogContent,
  AlertDialogDescription, AlertDialogFooter, AlertDialogHeader, AlertDialogTitle,
} from '@/components/ui/alert-dialog';
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@/components/ui/select';
import { useAppStore } from '@/lib/store';
import { toast } from '@/hooks/use-toast';
import type { Contact } from '@/types';

const today = () => new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

function fmtDate(s: string): string {
  if (!s) return '';
  try { return new Date(s).toLocaleDateString('ar', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' }); }
  catch { return s; }
}
function daysSince(s: string): number | null {
  if (!s) return null;
  try {
    const d = new Date(s);
    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return null;
    return Math.floor((Date.now() - d.getTime()) / 86400000);
  } catch { return null; }
}

interface ContactForm {
  name: string; title: string; company: string; email: string; phone: string;
  linkedIn: string; metAt: string; metDate: string; lastContact: string;
  nextFollowUp: string; relationshipStrength: number; notes: string;
}
const emptyForm: ContactForm = {
  name: '', title: '', company: '', email: '', phone: '', linkedIn: '',
  metAt: '', metDate: '', lastContact: '', nextFollowUp: '',
  relationshipStrength: 3, notes: '',
};

// ============ Star rating input ============
function StarInput({ value, onChange }: { value: number; onChange: (v: number) => void }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-1" dir="ltr">
      {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((n) => (
        <button key={n} type="button" onClick={() => onChange(value === n ? 0 : n)} aria-label={`${n} نجوم`}>
          <Star className={`h-6 w-6 transition-colors ${n <= value ? 'fill-amber-400 text-amber-400' : 'text-muted-foreground/40 hover:text-amber-400'}`} />
        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

function Stars({ value }: { value: number }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5" dir="ltr" aria-label={`${value} من 5`}>
      {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((n) => (
        <Star key={n} className={`h-3.5 w-3.5 ${n <= value ? 'fill-amber-400 text-amber-400' : 'text-muted-foreground/30'}`} />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

// ============ Contact Card ============
function ContactCard({ contact, onEdit, onDelete, onReachOut }: {
  contact: Contact;
  onEdit: () => void;
  onDelete: () => void;
  onReachOut: () => void;
}) {
  const days = daysSince(contact.lastContact);
  const stale = days !== null && days > 30;
  return (
    <Card className="group relative overflow-hidden transition-all hover:shadow-md hover:border-primary/40">
      <CardContent className="p-4 space-y-3">
        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
          <div className="flex items-start gap-3 min-w-0 flex-1">
            <div className="mt-0.5 flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-primary/10 text-primary font-semibold">
              {contact.name ? contact.name.charAt(0) : <Users className="h-5 w-5" />}
            </div>
            <div className="min-w-0 space-y-1">
              <h3 className="font-semibold leading-tight line-clamp-1">{contact.name || 'بدون اسم'}</h3>
              {contact.title && <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground line-clamp-1">{contact.title}</p>}
              {contact.company && <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-[10px]">{contact.company}</Badge>}
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="flex gap-0.5 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity shrink-0">
            <Button size="icon" variant="ghost" className="h-7 w-7" onClick={onEdit} aria-label="تعديل"><Pencil className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /></Button>
            <Button size="icon" variant="ghost" className="h-7 w-7 text-destructive" onClick={onDelete} aria-label="حذف"><Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /></Button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <Stars value={contact.relationshipStrength} />
          {contact.nextFollowUp && (
            <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[10px] gap-1"><Calendar className="h-3 w-3" />{fmtDate(contact.nextFollowUp)}</Badge>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          {contact.email && <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 truncate"><Mail className="h-3 w-3 shrink-0" /><span className="truncate" dir="ltr">{contact.email}</span></div>}
          {contact.phone && <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 truncate"><Phone className="h-3 w-3 shrink-0" /><span className="truncate" dir="ltr">{contact.phone}</span></div>}
          {contact.linkedIn && <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 truncate"><Linkedin className="h-3 w-3 shrink-0" /><span className="truncate" dir="ltr">{contact.linkedIn}</span></div>}
        </div>

        {stale && (
          <Alert className="py-2 px-3 border-red-200 bg-red-50/50 dark:border-red-900/40 dark:bg-red-950/20">
            <AlertCircle className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400" />
            <AlertDescription className="text-xs text-red-700 dark:text-red-300">
              آخر تواصل مع {contact.name || 'هذا الشخص'} كان قبل {days} يوم
            </AlertDescription>
          </Alert>
        )}

        {contact.notes && <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground line-clamp-2 pt-1 border-t">{contact.notes}</p>}

        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 pt-1 border-t">
          <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1">
            <Calendar className="h-3 w-3" />{contact.lastContact ? `آخر تواصل: ${fmtDate(contact.lastContact)}` : 'لا يوجد تواصل سابق'}
          </span>
          <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="h-7 text-xs" onClick={onReachOut} disabled={!contact.email && !contact.linkedIn}>
            <Mail className="h-3 w-3 ml-1" />تواصل
          </Button>
        </div>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

export function NetworkingSection() {
  const { contacts, addContact, updateContact, deleteContact } = useAppStore();
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [companyFilter, setCompanyFilter] = useState<string>('all');
  const [dialogOpen, setDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingId, setEditingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [form, setForm] = useState<ContactForm>(emptyForm);
  const [deleteId, setDeleteId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const companies = useMemo(() => {
    const set = new Set<string>();
    contacts.forEach(c => c.company && set.add(c.company));
    return Array.from(set).sort();
  }, [contacts]);

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    const q = search.trim().toLowerCase();
    return contacts.filter(c => {
      if (companyFilter !== 'all' && c.company !== companyFilter) return false;
      if (!q) return true;
      return [c.name, c.title, c.company, c.email, c.phone, c.linkedIn, c.metAt, c.notes]
        .some(x => x?.toLowerCase().includes(q));
    });
  }, [contacts, search, companyFilter]);

  const staleCount = useMemo(() => {
    return contacts.filter(c => {
      const d = daysSince(c.lastContact);
      return d !== null && d > 30;
    }).length;
  }, [contacts]);

  const openAdd = () => { setForm({ ...emptyForm, lastContact: today() }); setEditingId(null); setDialogOpen(true); };
  const openEdit = (c: Contact) => {
    setForm({
      name: c.name, title: c.title, company: c.company, email: c.email, phone: c.phone,
      linkedIn: c.linkedIn, metAt: c.metAt, metDate: c.metDate, lastContact: c.lastContact,
      nextFollowUp: c.nextFollowUp, relationshipStrength: c.relationshipStrength, notes: c.notes,
    });
    setEditingId(c.id); setDialogOpen(true);
  };

  const save = () => {
    if (!form.name.trim()) { toast({ title: 'الاسم مطلوب', variant: 'destructive' }); return; }
    const data = {
      name: form.name.trim(), title: form.title.trim(), company: form.company.trim(),
      email: form.email.trim(), phone: form.phone.trim(), linkedIn: form.linkedIn.trim(),
      metAt: form.metAt.trim(), metDate: form.metDate, lastContact: form.lastContact,
      nextFollowUp: form.nextFollowUp, relationshipStrength: form.relationshipStrength,
      notes: form.notes.trim(), tags: [] as string[],
    };
    if (editingId) { updateContact(editingId, data); toast({ title: 'تم تحديث جهة الاتصال' }); }
    else { addContact(data); toast({ title: 'تمت إضافة جهة الاتصال' }); }
    setDialogOpen(false);
  };

  const confirmDelete = () => {
    if (!deleteId) return;
    deleteContact(deleteId);
    setDeleteId(null);
    toast({ title: 'تم حذف جهة الاتصال' });
  };

  const reachOut = (c: Contact) => {
    if (c.email) {
      const subject = encodeURIComponent('متابعة التواصل');
      window.open(`mailto:${c.email}?subject=${subject}`, '_blank');
    } else if (c.linkedIn) {
      const url = c.linkedIn.startsWith('http') ? c.linkedIn : `https://${c.linkedIn}`;
      window.open(url, '_blank');
    } else {
      return;
    }
    updateContact(c.id, { lastContact: today() });
    toast({ title: 'تم تسجيل التواصل' });
  };

  const set = <K extends keyof ContactForm>(k: K, v: ContactForm[K]) => setForm(f => ({ ...f, [k]: v }));
  const renderField = (label: string, input: React.ReactNode, className = '') => (
    <div className={`space-y-1.5 ${className}`}><Label>{label}</Label>{input}</div>
  );

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 flex-wrap">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2"><Users className="h-5 w-5" />شبكة العلاقات</h2>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{contacts.length} جهة اتصال · {companies.length} شركة</p>
        </div>
        <Button onClick={openAdd}><Plus className="h-4 w-4 ml-1" />إضافة جهة اتصال</Button>
      </div>

      {/* Stale alert */}
      {staleCount > 0 && (
        <Alert className="border-amber-200 bg-amber-50/50 dark:border-amber-900/40 dark:bg-amber-950/20">
          <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400" />
          <AlertDescription className="text-sm text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-200">
            لديك {staleCount} جهة اتصال لم تتواصل معها منذ أكثر من 30 يوماً. حان وقت المتابعة!
          </AlertDescription>
        </Alert>
      )}

      {/* Toolbar */}
      <div className="flex gap-2 flex-wrap">
        <div className="relative flex-1 min-w-[200px]">
          <Search className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
          <Input placeholder="ابحث بالاسم أو الشركة أو البريد..." value={search} onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)} className="pr-9" />
        </div>
        <Select value={companyFilter} onValueChange={setCompanyFilter}>
          <SelectTrigger className="w-[180px]"><SelectValue placeholder="كل الشركات" /></SelectTrigger>
          <SelectContent>
            <SelectItem value="all">كل الشركات</SelectItem>
            {companies.map(c => <SelectItem key={c} value={c}>{c}</SelectItem>)}
          </SelectContent>
        </Select>
      </div>

      {/* Grid */}
      {filtered.length === 0 ? (
        <Card><CardContent className="p-10 text-center text-muted-foreground">
          <Users className="h-10 w-10 mx-auto mb-2 opacity-40" />
          {contacts.length === 0 ? 'لا توجد جهات اتصال بعد. ابدأ بإضافة جهة جديدة.' : 'لا توجد نتائج مطابقة.'}
        </CardContent></Card>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
          {filtered.map(c => (
            <ContactCard
              key={c.id} contact={c}
              onEdit={() => openEdit(c)}
              onDelete={() => setDeleteId(c.id)}
              onReachOut={() => reachOut(c)}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Add / Edit Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={dialogOpen} onOpenChange={setDialogOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="max-w-2xl max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>{editingId ? 'تعديل جهة الاتصال' : 'إضافة جهة اتصال'}</DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>أدخل بيانات جهة الاتصال ومعلومات العلاقة.</DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            {renderField('الاسم *', <Input value={form.name} onChange={(e) => set('name', e.target.value)} placeholder="محمد أحمد" />)}
            {renderField('المسمى', <Input value={form.title} onChange={(e) => set('title', e.target.value)} placeholder="مدير منتج" />)}
            {renderField('الشركة', <Input value={form.company} onChange={(e) => set('company', e.target.value)} placeholder="Google" />)}
            {renderField('البريد الإلكتروني', <Input type="email" dir="ltr" value={form.email} onChange={(e) => set('email', e.target.value)} placeholder="name@company.com" />)}
            {renderField('رقم الهاتف', <Input dir="ltr" value={form.phone} onChange={(e) => set('phone', e.target.value)} placeholder="+970..." />)}
            {renderField('لينكدإن', <Input dir="ltr" value={form.linkedIn} onChange={(e) => set('linkedIn', e.target.value)} placeholder="linkedin.com/in/..." />)}
            {renderField('مكان اللقاء', <Input value={form.metAt} onChange={(e) => set('metAt', e.target.value)} placeholder="مؤتمر GITEX" />)}
            {renderField('تاريخ اللقاء', <Input type="date" value={form.metDate} onChange={(e) => set('metDate', e.target.value)} />)}
            {renderField('آخر تواصل', <Input type="date" value={form.lastContact} onChange={(e) => set('lastContact', e.target.value)} />)}
            {renderField('المتابعة التالية', <Input type="date" value={form.nextFollowUp} onChange={(e) => set('nextFollowUp', e.target.value)} />)}
            <div className="space-y-1.5 sm:col-span-2">
              <Label>قوة العلاقة</Label>
              <StarInput value={form.relationshipStrength} onChange={(v) => set('relationshipStrength', v)} />
            </div>
            {renderField('ملاحظات', <Textarea rows={3} value={form.notes} onChange={(e) => set('notes', e.target.value)} placeholder="ملاحظات حول جهة الاتصال..." />, 'sm:col-span-2')}
          </div>
          <DialogFooter>
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setDialogOpen(false)}>إلغاء</Button>
            <Button onClick={save}>{editingId ? 'حفظ' : 'إضافة'}</Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>

      {/* Delete confirm */}
      <AlertDialog open={!!deleteId} onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setDeleteId(null)}>
        <AlertDialogContent>
          <AlertDialogHeader>
            <AlertDialogTitle>تأكيد الحذف</AlertDialogTitle>
            <AlertDialogDescription>سيتم حذف جهة الاتصال نهائياً. لا يمكن التراجع عن هذا الإجراء.</AlertDialogDescription>
          </AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogFooter>
            <AlertDialogCancel>إلغاء</AlertDialogCancel>
            <AlertDialogAction onClick={confirmDelete} className="bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground hover:bg-destructive/90">حذف</AlertDialogAction>
          </AlertDialogFooter>
        </AlertDialogContent>
      </AlertDialog>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

// سجل المقابلات — Interview Tracker UI

import { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  Mic, Plus, Pencil, Trash2, Search, Star, CheckCircle2, XCircle,
  Calendar, User, ChevronDown,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogFooter, DialogDescription } from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import {
  AlertDialog, AlertDialogAction, AlertDialogCancel, AlertDialogContent,
  AlertDialogDescription, AlertDialogFooter, AlertDialogHeader, AlertDialogTitle,
} from '@/components/ui/alert-dialog';
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@/components/ui/select';
import { useAppStore } from '@/lib/store';
import { toast } from '@/hooks/use-toast';
import type { InterviewRecord, JobApplication } from '@/types';

type Outcome = InterviewRecord['outcome'];

const INTERVIEW_TYPES: Array<{ value: string; label: string }> = [
  { value: 'phone', label: 'هاتفية' },
  { value: 'video', label: 'مرئية' },
  { value: 'onsite', label: 'حضورية' },
];

const OUTCOMES: Array<{ value: Outcome; label: string; cls: string; icon: typeof CheckCircle2 }> = [
  { value: 'passed', label: 'ناجحة', cls: 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-900/30 dark:text-emerald-400', icon: CheckCircle2 },
  { value: 'failed', label: 'فاشلة', cls: 'bg-red-100 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-900/30 dark:text-red-400', icon: XCircle },
  { value: 'pending', label: 'قيد الانتظار', cls: 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-900/30 dark:text-amber-400', icon: Calendar },
];

function typeLabel(v: string): string {
  return INTERVIEW_TYPES.find(t => t.value === v)?.label || v || '';
}
function outcomeMeta(v: Outcome) {
  return OUTCOMES.find(o => o.value === v) || OUTCOMES[2];
}
function fmtDate(s: string): string {
  if (!s) return '';
  try { return new Date(s).toLocaleDateString('ar', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' }); }
  catch { return s; }
}
const today = () => new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

// ============ Star rating input ============
function StarInput({ value, onChange }: { value: number; onChange: (v: number) => void }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-1" dir="ltr">
      {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((n) => (
        <button key={n} type="button" onClick={() => onChange(value === n ? 0 : n)} aria-label={`${n} نجوم`}>
          <Star className={`h-6 w-6 transition-colors ${n <= value ? 'fill-amber-400 text-amber-400' : 'text-muted-foreground/40 hover:text-amber-400'}`} />
        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}
function Stars({ value }: { value: number }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5" dir="ltr" aria-label={`${value} من 5`}>
      {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((n) => (
        <Star key={n} className={`h-3.5 w-3.5 ${n <= value ? 'fill-amber-400 text-amber-400' : 'text-muted-foreground/30'}`} />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

interface InterviewForm {
  jobApplicationId: string; interviewDate: string; interviewType: string;
  interviewer: string; overallRating: number; outcome: Outcome; notes: string;
}
const emptyForm: InterviewForm = {
  jobApplicationId: '', interviewDate: today(), interviewType: 'phone',
  interviewer: '', overallRating: 0, outcome: 'pending', notes: '',
};

function jobAppLabel(app?: JobApplication): string {
  if (!app) return '— غير مرتبط —';
  return `${app.jobTitle}${app.company ? ' · ' + app.company : ''}`;
}

// ============ Interview Card ============
function InterviewCardView({ rec, app, onEdit, onDelete }: {
  rec: InterviewRecord;
  app?: JobApplication;
  onEdit: () => void;
  onDelete: () => void;
}) {
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(false);
  const outcome = outcomeMeta(rec.outcome);
  const OutcomeIcon = outcome.icon;
  const hasDetail = rec.questionsAsked.length > 0 || rec.strengths.length > 0 || rec.weaknesses.length > 0 || rec.improvements.length > 0;
  return (
    <Card className="group relative overflow-hidden transition-all hover:shadow-md hover:border-primary/40">
      <CardContent className="p-4 space-y-3">
        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
          <div className="flex items-start gap-3 min-w-0 flex-1">
            <div className="mt-0.5 flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-primary/10 text-primary">
              <Mic className="h-5 w-5" />
            </div>
            <div className="min-w-0 space-y-1">
              <h3 className="font-semibold leading-tight line-clamp-1">{app ? `${app.jobTitle}` : 'مقابلة غير مرتبطة'}</h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground line-clamp-1">{app?.company || '—'}</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="flex gap-0.5 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity shrink-0">
            <Button size="icon" variant="ghost" className="h-7 w-7" onClick={onEdit} aria-label="تعديل"><Pencil className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /></Button>
            <Button size="icon" variant="ghost" className="h-7 w-7 text-destructive" onClick={onDelete} aria-label="حذف"><Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /></Button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
          <Stars value={rec.overallRating} />
          <Badge className={`text-[10px] ${outcome.cls}`}><OutcomeIcon className="h-3 w-3 ml-1" />{outcome.label}</Badge>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-1 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
          {rec.interviewDate && <span className="flex items-center gap-1"><Calendar className="h-3 w-3" />{fmtDate(rec.interviewDate)}</span>}
          <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-[10px]">{typeLabel(rec.interviewType)}</Badge>
          {rec.interviewer && <span className="flex items-center gap-1"><User className="h-3 w-3" />{rec.interviewer}</span>}
        </div>

        {rec.notes && <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground line-clamp-2 pt-1 border-t">{rec.notes}</p>}

        {hasDetail && (
          <>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setExpanded(e => !e)}
              className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-primary hover:underline"
              aria-expanded={expanded}
            >
              <ChevronDown className={`h-3.5 w-3.5 transition-transform ${expanded ? 'rotate-180' : ''}`} />
              عرض التفاصيل
            </button>
            {expanded && (
              <div className="space-y-3 pt-2 border-t text-xs">
                {rec.questionsAsked.length > 0 && (
                  <div className="space-y-1.5">
                    <p className="font-medium text-muted-foreground">الأسئلة المطروحة</p>
                    <div className="space-y-1.5 max-h-48 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
                      {rec.questionsAsked.map((q, i) => (
                        <div key={i} className="rounded-md bg-muted/40 p-2 space-y-1">
                          <p className="font-medium leading-tight">{i + 1}. {q.question}</p>
                          {q.myAnswer && <p className="text-muted-foreground leading-tight"><span className="font-medium">إجابتي:</span> {q.myAnswer}</p>}
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1"><span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">التقييم:</span><Stars value={q.rating} /></div>
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
                {rec.strengths.length > 0 && (
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <p className="font-medium text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">نقاط القوة</p>
                    <ul className="space-y-0.5 list-disc pr-4 text-muted-foreground">
                      {rec.strengths.map((s, i) => <li key={i} className="leading-tight">{s}</li>)}
                    </ul>
                  </div>
                )}
                {rec.weaknesses.length > 0 && (
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <p className="font-medium text-red-600 dark:text-red-400">نقاط الضعف</p>
                    <ul className="space-y-0.5 list-disc pr-4 text-muted-foreground">
                      {rec.weaknesses.map((s, i) => <li key={i} className="leading-tight">{s}</li>)}
                    </ul>
                  </div>
                )}
                {rec.improvements.length > 0 && (
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <p className="font-medium text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400">تحسينات مقترحة</p>
                    <ul className="space-y-0.5 list-disc pr-4 text-muted-foreground">
                      {rec.improvements.map((s, i) => <li key={i} className="leading-tight">{s}</li>)}
                    </ul>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

export function InterviewTrackerSection() {
  const { interviewRecords, addInterviewRecord, updateInterviewRecord, deleteInterviewRecord, jobApplications } = useAppStore();
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [outcomeFilter, setOutcomeFilter] = useState<string>('all');
  const [dialogOpen, setDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingId, setEditingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [form, setForm] = useState<InterviewForm>(emptyForm);
  const [deleteId, setDeleteId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    const total = interviewRecords.length;
    const passed = interviewRecords.filter(r => r.outcome === 'passed').length;
    const decided = interviewRecords.filter(r => r.outcome === 'passed' || r.outcome === 'failed').length;
    const passRate = decided > 0 ? Math.round((passed / decided) * 100) : 0;
    const avgRating = total > 0 ? (interviewRecords.reduce((sum, r) => sum + (r.overallRating || 0), 0) / total) : 0;
    return { total, passRate, avgRating: Math.round(avgRating * 10) / 10 };
  }, [interviewRecords]);

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    const q = search.trim().toLowerCase();
    return interviewRecords.filter(r => {
      if (outcomeFilter !== 'all' && r.outcome !== outcomeFilter) return false;
      if (!q) return true;
      const app = jobApplications.find(a => a.id === r.jobApplicationId);
      return [r.interviewer, r.interviewType, r.notes, app?.jobTitle, app?.company].some(x => x?.toLowerCase().includes(q));
    });
  }, [interviewRecords, jobApplications, search, outcomeFilter]);

  const openAdd = () => { setForm({ ...emptyForm, interviewDate: today() }); setEditingId(null); setDialogOpen(true); };
  const openEdit = (r: InterviewRecord) => {
    setForm({
      jobApplicationId: r.jobApplicationId, interviewDate: r.interviewDate,
      interviewType: r.interviewType || 'phone', interviewer: r.interviewer,
      overallRating: r.overallRating, outcome: r.outcome, notes: r.notes,
    });
    setEditingId(r.id); setDialogOpen(true);
  };

  const save = () => {
    if (!form.interviewDate) { toast({ title: 'تاريخ المقابلة مطلوب', variant: 'destructive' }); return; }
    const data = {
      jobApplicationId: form.jobApplicationId, interviewDate: form.interviewDate,
      interviewType: form.interviewType, interviewer: form.interviewer.trim(),
      overallRating: form.overallRating, outcome: form.outcome, notes: form.notes.trim(),
    };
    if (editingId) {
      const existing = interviewRecords.find(r => r.id === editingId);
      updateInterviewRecord(editingId, {
        ...data,
        questionsAsked: existing?.questionsAsked || [],
        strengths: existing?.strengths || [],
        weaknesses: existing?.weaknesses || [],
        improvements: existing?.improvements || [],
      });
      toast({ title: 'تم تحديث المقابلة' });
    } else {
      addInterviewRecord({
        ...data, questionsAsked: [], strengths: [], weaknesses: [], improvements: [],
      });
      toast({ title: 'تمت إضافة المقابلة' });
    }
    setDialogOpen(false);
  };

  const confirmDelete = () => {
    if (!deleteId) return;
    deleteInterviewRecord(deleteId);
    setDeleteId(null);
    toast({ title: 'تم حذف المقابلة' });
  };

  const set = <K extends keyof InterviewForm>(k: K, v: InterviewForm[K]) => setForm(f => ({ ...f, [k]: v }));
  const renderField = (label: string, input: React.ReactNode, className = '') => (
    <div className={`space-y-1.5 ${className}`}><Label>{label}</Label>{input}</div>
  );

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 flex-wrap">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2"><Mic className="h-5 w-5" />سجل المقابلات</h2>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{stats.total} مقابلة · معدّل النجاح {stats.passRate}% · متوسط التقييم {stats.avgRating}/5</p>
        </div>
        <Button onClick={openAdd}><Plus className="h-4 w-4 ml-1" />مقابلة جديدة</Button>
      </div>

      {/* Stats */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
        <Card><CardContent className="p-4">
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">إجمالي المقابلات</p>
          <p className="text-2xl font-bold tabular-nums">{stats.total}</p>
        </CardContent></Card>
        <Card><CardContent className="p-4">
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">معدّل النجاح</p>
          <p className="text-2xl font-bold tabular-nums text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">{stats.passRate}%</p>
        </CardContent></Card>
        <Card><CardContent className="p-4">
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">متوسط التقييم</p>
          <p className="text-2xl font-bold tabular-nums text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400">{stats.avgRating}<span className="text-sm">/5</span></p>
        </CardContent></Card>
      </div>

      {/* Toolbar */}
      <div className="flex gap-2 flex-wrap">
        <div className="relative flex-1 min-w-[200px]">
          <Search className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
          <Input placeholder="ابحث بالمحاور أو الملاحظات أو الوظيفة..." value={search} onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)} className="pr-9" />
        </div>
        <Select value={outcomeFilter} onValueChange={setOutcomeFilter}>
          <SelectTrigger className="w-[180px]"><SelectValue placeholder="كل النتائج" /></SelectTrigger>
          <SelectContent>
            <SelectItem value="all">كل النتائج</SelectItem>
            {OUTCOMES.map(o => <SelectItem key={o.value} value={o.value}>{o.label}</SelectItem>)}
          </SelectContent>
        </Select>
      </div>

      {/* List */}
      {filtered.length === 0 ? (
        <Card><CardContent className="p-10 text-center text-muted-foreground">
          <Mic className="h-10 w-10 mx-auto mb-2 opacity-40" />
          {interviewRecords.length === 0 ? 'لا توجد مقابلات بعد. ابدأ بإضافة مقابلة جديدة.' : 'لا توجد نتائج مطابقة.'}
        </CardContent></Card>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
          {filtered.map(r => (
            <InterviewCardView
              key={r.id} rec={r}
              app={jobApplications.find(a => a.id === r.jobApplicationId)}
              onEdit={() => openEdit(r)}
              onDelete={() => setDeleteId(r.id)}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Add / Edit Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={dialogOpen} onOpenChange={setDialogOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="max-w-2xl max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>{editingId ? 'تعديل المقابلة' : 'إضافة مقابلة'}</DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>سجّل تفاصيل المقابلة والأداء العام.</DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            {renderField('طلب التوظيف المرتبط',
              <Select value={form.jobApplicationId} onValueChange={(v) => set('jobApplicationId', v)}>
                <SelectTrigger><SelectValue placeholder="— غير مرتبط —" /></SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent className="max-h-60">
                  <SelectItem value="none">— غير مرتبط —</SelectItem>
                  {jobApplications.map(a => <SelectItem key={a.id} value={a.id}>{a.jobTitle} · {a.company}</SelectItem>)}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>, 'sm:col-span-2')}
            {renderField('تاريخ المقابلة *', <Input type="date" value={form.interviewDate} onChange={(e) => set('interviewDate', e.target.value)} />)}
            {renderField('نوع المقابلة',
              <Select value={form.interviewType} onValueChange={(v) => set('interviewType', v)}>
                <SelectTrigger><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  {INTERVIEW_TYPES.map(t => <SelectItem key={t.value} value={t.value}>{t.label}</SelectItem>)}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>)}
            {renderField('اسم المحاور', <Input value={form.interviewer} onChange={(e) => set('interviewer', e.target.value)} placeholder="م. سارة أحمد" />)}
            {renderField('النتيجة',
              <Select value={form.outcome} onValueChange={(v) => set('outcome', v as Outcome)}>
                <SelectTrigger><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  {OUTCOMES.map(o => <SelectItem key={o.value} value={o.value}>{o.label}</SelectItem>)}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>)}
            <div className="space-y-1.5 sm:col-span-2">
              <Label>التقييم العام</Label>
              <StarInput value={form.overallRating} onChange={(v) => set('overallRating', v)} />
            </div>
            {renderField('ملاحظات', <Textarea rows={4} value={form.notes} onChange={(e) => set('notes', e.target.value)} placeholder="ملاحظات حول المقابلة..." />, 'sm:col-span-2')}
          </div>
          <DialogFooter>
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setDialogOpen(false)}>إلغاء</Button>
            <Button onClick={save}>{editingId ? 'حفظ' : 'إضافة'}</Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>

      {/* Delete confirm */}
      <AlertDialog open={!!deleteId} onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setDeleteId(null)}>
        <AlertDialogContent>
          <AlertDialogHeader>
            <AlertDialogTitle>تأكيد الحذف</AlertDialogTitle>
            <AlertDialogDescription>سيتم حذف سجل المقابلة نهائياً. لا يمكن التراجع عن هذا الإجراء.</AlertDialogDescription>
          </AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogFooter>
            <AlertDialogCancel>إلغاء</AlertDialogCancel>
            <AlertDialogAction onClick={confirmDelete} className="bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground hover:bg-destructive/90">حذف</AlertDialogAction>
          </AlertDialogFooter>
        </AlertDialogContent>
      </AlertDialog>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

// خطة التطور المهني — Career Plan UI

import { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  Target, Plus, Pencil, Trash2, TrendingUp, Award, CheckCircle2,
  Clock, Briefcase, ChevronDown,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Progress } from '@/components/ui/progress';
import { Slider } from '@/components/ui/slider';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogFooter, DialogDescription } from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import {
  AlertDialog, AlertDialogAction, AlertDialogCancel, AlertDialogContent,
  AlertDialogDescription, AlertDialogFooter, AlertDialogHeader, AlertDialogTitle,
} from '@/components/ui/alert-dialog';
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@/components/ui/select';
import { useAppStore } from '@/lib/store';
import { toast } from '@/hooks/use-toast';
import type { CareerGoal } from '@/types';

type Timeframe = CareerGoal['timeframe'];
type Category = CareerGoal['category'];
type GoalStatus = CareerGoal['status'];

const TIMEFRAMES: Array<{ value: Timeframe; label: string }> = [
  { value: '1year', label: 'سنة واحدة' },
  { value: '3years', label: '3 سنوات' },
  { value: '5years', label: '5 سنوات' },
];

const CATEGORIES: Array<{ value: Category; label: string; icon: typeof Target }> = [
  { value: 'skill', label: 'مهارة', icon: Target },
  { value: 'certification', label: 'شهادة', icon: Award },
  { value: 'position', label: 'منصب', icon: Briefcase },
  { value: 'salary', label: 'راتب', icon: TrendingUp },
  { value: 'learning', label: 'تعلّم', icon: CheckCircle2 },
];

const STATUSES: Array<{ value: GoalStatus; label: string; cls: string }> = [
  { value: 'not-started', label: 'لم يبدأ', cls: 'bg-muted text-muted-foreground' },
  { value: 'in-progress', label: 'قيد التنفيذ', cls: 'bg-sky-100 text-sky-700 dark:bg-sky-900/30 dark:text-sky-400' },
  { value: 'completed', label: 'مكتمل', cls: 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-900/30 dark:text-emerald-400' },
  { value: 'on-hold', label: 'متوقف', cls: 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-900/30 dark:text-amber-400' },
];

const CATEGORY_CLS: Record<Category, string> = {
  skill: 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-700 dark:bg-purple-900/30 dark:text-purple-400',
  certification: 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-900/30 dark:text-emerald-400',
  position: 'bg-sky-100 text-sky-700 dark:bg-sky-900/30 dark:text-sky-400',
  salary: 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-900/30 dark:text-amber-400',
  learning: 'bg-pink-100 text-pink-700 dark:bg-pink-900/30 dark:text-pink-400',
};

function catLabel(v: string): string { return CATEGORIES.find(c => c.value === v)?.label || v; }
function statusMeta(v: GoalStatus) { return STATUSES.find(s => s.value === v) || STATUSES[0]; }
function fmtDate(s: string): string {
  if (!s) return '';
  try { return new Date(s).toLocaleDateString('ar', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' }); }
  catch { return s; }
}

interface GoalForm {
  title: string; description: string; timeframe: Timeframe; category: Category;
  targetDate: string; progress: number; status: GoalStatus; notes: string;
}
const emptyForm: GoalForm = {
  title: '', description: '', timeframe: '1year', category: 'skill',
  targetDate: '', progress: 0, status: 'not-started', notes: '',
};

// ============ Goal Card ============
function GoalCard({ goal, onEdit, onDelete, onToggleMilestone }: {
  goal: CareerGoal;
  onEdit: () => void;
  onDelete: () => void;
  onToggleMilestone: (idx: number) => void;
}) {
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(false);
  const status = statusMeta(goal.status);
  const cat = CATEGORIES.find(c => c.value === goal.category);
  const CatIcon = cat?.icon || Target;
  const doneMilestones = goal.milestones.filter(m => m.completed).length;
  return (
    <Card className="group relative overflow-hidden transition-all hover:shadow-md hover:border-primary/40">
      <CardContent className="p-4 space-y-3">
        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
          <div className="flex items-start gap-2 min-w-0 flex-1">
            <div className="mt-0.5 flex h-8 w-8 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-primary/10 text-primary">
              <CatIcon className="h-4 w-4" />
            </div>
            <div className="min-w-0 space-y-1">
              <h3 className="font-semibold leading-tight line-clamp-2">{goal.title || 'بدون عنوان'}</h3>
              {goal.description && <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground line-clamp-2">{goal.description}</p>}
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="flex gap-0.5 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity shrink-0">
            <Button size="icon" variant="ghost" className="h-7 w-7" onClick={onEdit} aria-label="تعديل"><Pencil className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /></Button>
            <Button size="icon" variant="ghost" className="h-7 w-7 text-destructive" onClick={onDelete} aria-label="حذف"><Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /></Button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
          <Badge className={`text-[10px] ${CATEGORY_CLS[goal.category]}`}>{catLabel(goal.category)}</Badge>
          <Badge className={`text-[10px] ${status.cls}`}>{status.label}</Badge>
          {goal.targetDate && <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[10px] gap-1"><Clock className="h-3 w-3" />{fmtDate(goal.targetDate)}</Badge>}
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-1.5">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
            <span>التقدّم</span>
            <span className="tabular-nums">{goal.progress}%</span>
          </div>
          <Progress value={goal.progress} className="h-1.5" />
        </div>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setExpanded(e => !e)}
          className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-primary hover:underline"
          aria-expanded={expanded}
        >
          <ChevronDown className={`h-3.5 w-3.5 transition-transform ${expanded ? 'rotate-180' : ''}`} />
          {goal.milestones.length > 0
            ? `المعالم (${doneMilestones}/${goal.milestones.length})`
            : goal.requiredSkills.length > 0 || goal.requiredCertifications.length > 0
              ? 'عرض التفاصيل'
              : 'لا توجد تفاصيل'}
        </button>

        {expanded && (
          <div className="space-y-3 pt-2 border-t text-xs">
            {goal.milestones.length > 0 && (
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <p className="font-medium text-muted-foreground">المعالم</p>
                {goal.milestones.map((m, i) => (
                  <button
                    key={i} type="button"
                    onClick={() => onToggleMilestone(i)}
                    className="flex items-start gap-2 w-full text-right hover:bg-muted/40 rounded px-1.5 py-1"
                  >
                    <CheckCircle2 className={`h-4 w-4 shrink-0 mt-0.5 ${m.completed ? 'text-emerald-500 fill-emerald-100 dark:fill-emerald-950/30' : 'text-muted-foreground/40'}`} />
                    <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                      <p className={`leading-tight ${m.completed ? 'line-through text-muted-foreground' : ''}`}>{m.title}</p>
                      {m.date && <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{fmtDate(m.date)}</p>}
                    </div>
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
            {goal.requiredSkills.length > 0 && (
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <p className="font-medium text-muted-foreground">المهارات المطلوبة</p>
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
                  {goal.requiredSkills.map((s, i) => <Badge key={i} variant="secondary" className="text-[10px]">{s}</Badge>)}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
            {goal.requiredCertifications.length > 0 && (
              <div className="space-y-1.5">
                <p className="font-medium text-muted-foreground">الشهادات المطلوبة</p>
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
                  {goal.requiredCertifications.map((s, i) => (
                    <Badge key={i} variant="secondary" className="text-[10px] gap-1"><Award className="h-2.5 w-2.5" />{s}</Badge>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
            {goal.notes && <p className="text-muted-foreground pt-1 border-t">{goal.notes}</p>}
          </div>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

export function CareerPlanSection() {
  const { careerGoals, addCareerGoal, updateCareerGoal, deleteCareerGoal } = useAppStore();
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [dialogOpen, setDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingId, setEditingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [form, setForm] = useState<GoalForm>(emptyForm);
  const [deleteId, setDeleteId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    const total = careerGoals.length;
    const completed = careerGoals.filter(g => g.status === 'completed').length;
    const inProgress = careerGoals.filter(g => g.status === 'in-progress').length;
    const byCat: Record<string, number> = {};
    careerGoals.forEach(g => { byCat[g.category] = (byCat[g.category] || 0) + 1; });
    const topCat = Object.entries(byCat).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])[0];
    return { total, completed, inProgress, topCat: topCat ? `${catLabel(topCat[0])} (${topCat[1]})` : '—' };
  }, [careerGoals]);

  const columns = useMemo(() => {
    const q = search.trim().toLowerCase();
    return TIMEFRAMES.map(tf => ({
      tf,
      goals: careerGoals.filter(g => {
        if (g.timeframe !== tf.value) return false;
        if (!q) return true;
        return [g.title, g.description, g.notes].some(x => x?.toLowerCase().includes(q));
      }),
    }));
  }, [careerGoals, search]);

  const openAdd = () => { setForm({ ...emptyForm, targetDate: '' }); setEditingId(null); setDialogOpen(true); };
  const openEdit = (g: CareerGoal) => {
    setForm({
      title: g.title, description: g.description, timeframe: g.timeframe,
      category: g.category, targetDate: g.targetDate, progress: g.progress,
      status: g.status, notes: g.notes,
    });
    setEditingId(g.id); setDialogOpen(true);
  };

  const save = () => {
    if (!form.title.trim()) { toast({ title: 'العنوان مطلوب', variant: 'destructive' }); return; }
    const data = {
      title: form.title.trim(), description: form.description.trim(),
      timeframe: form.timeframe, category: form.category,
      targetDate: form.targetDate, progress: form.progress, status: form.status,
      notes: form.notes.trim(),
    };
    if (editingId) {
      // Preserve milestones/skills/certs — only edit form fields
      const existing = careerGoals.find(g => g.id === editingId);
      const merged = {
        ...data,
        requiredSkills: existing?.requiredSkills || [],
        requiredCertifications: existing?.requiredCertifications || [],
        milestones: existing?.milestones || [],
      };
      updateCareerGoal(editingId, merged);
      toast({ title: 'تم تحديث الهدف' });
    } else {
      addCareerGoal({ ...data, requiredSkills: [], requiredCertifications: [], milestones: [] });
      toast({ title: 'تمت إضافة الهدف' });
    }
    setDialogOpen(false);
  };

  const confirmDelete = () => {
    if (!deleteId) return;
    deleteCareerGoal(deleteId);
    setDeleteId(null);
    toast({ title: 'تم حذف الهدف' });
  };

  const toggleMilestone = (goalId: string, idx: number) => {
    const g = careerGoals.find(x => x.id === goalId);
    if (!g) return;
    const milestones = g.milestones.map((m, i) => i === idx ? { ...m, completed: !m.completed } : m);
    const progress = milestones.length > 0
      ? Math.round((milestones.filter(m => m.completed).length / milestones.length) * 100)
      : g.progress;
    updateCareerGoal(goalId, { milestones, progress });
  };

  const set = <K extends keyof GoalForm>(k: K, v: GoalForm[K]) => setForm(f => ({ ...f, [k]: v }));
  const renderField = (label: string, input: React.ReactNode, className = '') => (
    <div className={`space-y-1.5 ${className}`}><Label>{label}</Label>{input}</div>
  );

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 flex-wrap">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2"><Target className="h-5 w-5" />خطة التطور المهني</h2>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{stats.total} هدف · {stats.completed} مكتمل · {stats.inProgress} قيد التنفيذ</p>
        </div>
        <Button onClick={openAdd}><Plus className="h-4 w-4 ml-1" />هدف جديد</Button>
      </div>

      {/* Stats */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
        <Card><CardContent className="p-4">
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">إجمالي الأهداف</p>
          <p className="text-2xl font-bold tabular-nums">{stats.total}</p>
        </CardContent></Card>
        <Card><CardContent className="p-4">
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">مكتملة</p>
          <p className="text-2xl font-bold tabular-nums text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">{stats.completed}</p>
        </CardContent></Card>
        <Card><CardContent className="p-4">
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">قيد التنفيذ</p>
          <p className="text-2xl font-bold tabular-nums text-sky-600 dark:text-sky-400">{stats.inProgress}</p>
        </CardContent></Card>
        <Card><CardContent className="p-4">
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">أكثر فئة</p>
          <p className="text-base font-bold truncate">{stats.topCat}</p>
        </CardContent></Card>
      </div>

      {/* Search */}
      <div className="relative">
        <Target className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
        <Input placeholder="ابحث في الأهداف..." value={search} onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)} className="pr-9" />
      </div>

      {/* 3 columns by timeframe */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
        {columns.map(col => (
          <div key={col.tf.value} className="space-y-3">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between sticky top-0 bg-background/80 backdrop-blur-sm py-1 z-10">
              <h3 className="font-semibold text-sm flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <Clock className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />{col.tf.label}
              </h3>
              <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-[10px]">{col.goals.length}</Badge>
            </div>
            {col.goals.length === 0 ? (
              <Card className="border-dashed"><CardContent className="p-6 text-center text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                لا توجد أهداف في هذه الفترة
              </CardContent></Card>
            ) : (
              <div className="space-y-3">
                {col.goals.map(g => (
                  <GoalCard
                    key={g.id} goal={g}
                    onEdit={() => openEdit(g)}
                    onDelete={() => setDeleteId(g.id)}
                    onToggleMilestone={(i) => toggleMilestone(g.id, i)}
                  />
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Add / Edit Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={dialogOpen} onOpenChange={setDialogOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="max-w-2xl max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>{editingId ? 'تعديل الهدف' : 'إضافة هدف مهني'}</DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>حدّد هدفك المهني والإطار الزمني لتحقيقه.</DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            {renderField('العنوان *', <Input value={form.title} onChange={(e) => set('title', e.target.value)} placeholder="إتقان React المتقدم" />, 'sm:col-span-2')}
            {renderField('الوصف', <Textarea rows={2} value={form.description} onChange={(e) => set('description', e.target.value)} placeholder="وصف مختصر للهدف..." />, 'sm:col-span-2')}
            {renderField('الإطار الزمني',
              <Select value={form.timeframe} onValueChange={(v) => set('timeframe', v as Timeframe)}>
                <SelectTrigger><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  {TIMEFRAMES.map(t => <SelectItem key={t.value} value={t.value}>{t.label}</SelectItem>)}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>)}
            {renderField('الفئة',
              <Select value={form.category} onValueChange={(v) => set('category', v as Category)}>
                <SelectTrigger><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  {CATEGORIES.map(c => {
                    const Icon = c.icon;
                    return <SelectItem key={c.value} value={c.value}><span className="flex items-center gap-1.5"><Icon className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />{c.label}</span></SelectItem>;
                  })}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>)}
            {renderField('الحالة',
              <Select value={form.status} onValueChange={(v) => set('status', v as GoalStatus)}>
                <SelectTrigger><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  {STATUSES.map(s => <SelectItem key={s.value} value={s.value}>{s.label}</SelectItem>)}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>)}
            {renderField('التاريخ المستهدف', <Input type="date" value={form.targetDate} onChange={(e) => set('targetDate', e.target.value)} />)}
            <div className="space-y-1.5 sm:col-span-2">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <Label>التقدّم: {form.progress}%</Label>
              </div>
              <Slider value={[form.progress]} min={0} max={100} step={5} onValueChange={(v) => set('progress', v[0] ?? 0)} />
            </div>
            {renderField('ملاحظات', <Textarea rows={3} value={form.notes} onChange={(e) => set('notes', e.target.value)} placeholder="ملاحظات إضافية..." />, 'sm:col-span-2')}
          </div>
          <DialogFooter>
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setDialogOpen(false)}>إلغاء</Button>
            <Button onClick={save}>{editingId ? 'حفظ' : 'إضافة'}</Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>

      {/* Delete confirm */}
      <AlertDialog open={!!deleteId} onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setDeleteId(null)}>
        <AlertDialogContent>
          <AlertDialogHeader>
            <AlertDialogTitle>تأكيد الحذف</AlertDialogTitle>
            <AlertDialogDescription>سيتم حذف الهدف نهائياً. لا يمكن التراجع عن هذا الإجراء.</AlertDialogDescription>
          </AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogFooter>
            <AlertDialogCancel>إلغاء</AlertDialogCancel>
            <AlertDialogAction onClick={confirmDelete} className="bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground hover:bg-destructive/90">حذف</AlertDialogAction>
          </AlertDialogFooter>
        </AlertDialogContent>
      </AlertDialog>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## 📝 الكود الكامل

```tsx
'use client';

// عروض العمل — Salary Tracker UI

import { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  DollarSign, Plus, Pencil, Trash2, Search, TrendingUp, Calendar,
  Check, X, GitCompare, ChevronDown, Building2,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogFooter, DialogDescription } from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import {
  AlertDialog, AlertDialogAction, AlertDialogCancel, AlertDialogContent,
  AlertDialogDescription, AlertDialogFooter, AlertDialogHeader, AlertDialogTitle,
} from '@/components/ui/alert-dialog';
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@/components/ui/select';
import { useAppStore } from '@/lib/store';
import { toast } from '@/hooks/use-toast';
import type { JobOffer, JobApplication } from '@/types';

type OfferStatus = JobOffer['status'];

const CURRENCIES = ['USD', 'EUR', 'SAR', 'AED', 'local'];

const STATUSES: Array<{ value: OfferStatus; label: string; cls: string }> = [
  { value: 'pending', label: 'قيد الانتظار', cls: 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-900/30 dark:text-amber-400' },
  { value: 'negotiating', label: 'قيد التفاوض', cls: 'bg-sky-100 text-sky-700 dark:bg-sky-900/30 dark:text-sky-400' },
  { value: 'accepted', label: 'مقبول', cls: 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-900/30 dark:text-emerald-400' },
  { value: 'rejected', label: 'مرفوض', cls: 'bg-red-100 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-900/30 dark:text-red-400' },
];

const today = () => new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

function statusMeta(v: OfferStatus) { return STATUSES.find(s => s.value === v) || STATUSES[0]; }
function fmtDate(s: string): string {
  if (!s) return '';
  try { return new Date(s).toLocaleDateString('ar', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' }); }
  catch { return s; }
}
function fmtMoney(n: number, cur: string): string {
  if (!n || n <= 0) return '—';
  return `${n.toLocaleString('en-US')} ${cur === 'local' ? '' : cur}`.trim();
}

interface OfferForm {
  jobApplicationId: string; company: string; position: string;
  baseSalary: string; currency: string; totalCompensation: string;
  offerDate: string; expiryDate: string; startDate: string;
  status: OfferStatus; negotiationNotes: string;
}
const emptyForm: OfferForm = {
  jobApplicationId: '', company: '', position: '', baseSalary: '', currency: 'USD',
  totalCompensation: '', offerDate: today(), expiryDate: '', startDate: '',
  status: 'pending', negotiationNotes: '',
};

function jobAppLabel(app?: JobApplication): string {
  if (!app) return '';
  return `${app.jobTitle}${app.company ? ' · ' + app.company : ''}`;
}

// ============ Offer Card ============
function OfferCard({ offer, app, onEdit, onDelete }: {
  offer: JobOffer;
  app?: JobApplication;
  onEdit: () => void;
  onDelete: () => void;
}) {
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(false);
  const status = statusMeta(offer.status);
  const hasDetail = offer.pros.length > 0 || offer.cons.length > 0 || offer.negotiationNotes.trim() !== '' || offer.benefits.trim() !== '';
  return (
    <Card className="group relative overflow-hidden transition-all hover:shadow-md hover:border-primary/40">
      <CardContent className="p-4 space-y-3">
        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
          <div className="flex items-start gap-3 min-w-0 flex-1">
            <div className="mt-0.5 flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-primary/10 text-primary">
              <Building2 className="h-5 w-5" />
            </div>
            <div className="min-w-0 space-y-1">
              <h3 className="font-semibold leading-tight line-clamp-1">{offer.position || 'بدون مسمى'}</h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground line-clamp-1">{offer.company || '—'}</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="flex gap-0.5 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity shrink-0">
            <Button size="icon" variant="ghost" className="h-7 w-7" onClick={onEdit} aria-label="تعديل"><Pencil className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /></Button>
            <Button size="icon" variant="ghost" className="h-7 w-7 text-destructive" onClick={onDelete} aria-label="حذف"><Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /></Button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
          <Badge className={`text-[10px] ${status.cls}`}>{status.label}</Badge>
          {offer.totalCompensation > 0 && (
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" dir="ltr">
              <TrendingUp className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />{fmtMoney(offer.totalCompensation, offer.currency)}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>

        {offer.baseSalary > 0 && (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm">
            <DollarSign className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
            <span className="font-bold tabular-nums" dir="ltr">{fmtMoney(offer.baseSalary, offer.currency)}</span>
            <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">/ سنة (أساسي)</span>
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-1 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
          {offer.offerDate && <span className="flex items-center gap-1"><Calendar className="h-3 w-3" />عرض: {fmtDate(offer.offerDate)}</span>}
          {offer.expiryDate && <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400"><Calendar className="h-3 w-3" />ينتهي: {fmtDate(offer.expiryDate)}</span>}
        </div>

        {hasDetail && (
          <>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setExpanded(e => !e)}
              className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-primary hover:underline"
              aria-expanded={expanded}
            >
              <ChevronDown className={`h-3.5 w-3.5 transition-transform ${expanded ? 'rotate-180' : ''}`} />
              عرض التفاصيل
            </button>
            {expanded && (
              <div className="space-y-3 pt-2 border-t text-xs">
                {offer.benefits.trim() && (
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <p className="font-medium text-muted-foreground">المزايا</p>
                    <p className="text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap">{offer.benefits}</p>
                  </div>
                )}
                {offer.pros.length > 0 && (
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <p className="font-medium text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 flex items-center gap-1"><Check className="h-3 w-3" />المزايا الإيجابية</p>
                    <ul className="space-y-0.5 list-disc pr-4 text-muted-foreground">
                      {offer.pros.map((s, i) => <li key={i} className="leading-tight">{s}</li>)}
                    </ul>
                  </div>
                )}
                {offer.cons.length > 0 && (
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <p className="font-medium text-red-600 dark:text-red-400 flex items-center gap-1"><X className="h-3 w-3" />العيوب</p>
                    <ul className="space-y-0.5 list-disc pr-4 text-muted-foreground">
                      {offer.cons.map((s, i) => <li key={i} className="leading-tight">{s}</li>)}
                    </ul>
                  </div>
                )}
                {offer.negotiationNotes.trim() && (
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <p className="font-medium text-muted-foreground">ملاحظات التفاوض</p>
                    <p className="text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap">{offer.negotiationNotes}</p>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

// ============ Comparison View ============
function ComparisonView({ offers, onClose }: { offers: JobOffer[]; onClose: () => void }) {
  const [a, b] = offers;
  const totalHigher = (a.totalCompensation || 0) >= (b.totalCompensation || 0) ? 'a' : 'b';
  const baseHigher = (a.baseSalary || 0) >= (b.baseSalary || 0) ? 'a' : 'b';
  const renderRow = (label: string, va: React.ReactNode, vb: React.ReactNode, higher?: 'a' | 'b' | null) => (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 py-2 border-b last:border-0 text-sm">
      <div className="text-muted-foreground text-xs">{label}</div>
      <div className={`font-medium ${higher === 'a' ? 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-bold' : ''}`}>{va}</div>
      <div className={`font-medium ${higher === 'b' ? 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 font-bold' : ''}`}>{vb}</div>
    </div>
  );
  return (
    <Dialog open onOpenChange={(o) => !o && onClose()}>
      <DialogContent className="max-w-2xl max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle className="flex items-center gap-2"><GitCompare className="h-5 w-5" />مقارنة العروض</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>مقارنة جنباً إلى جنب لأفضل عرضين.</DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 pb-2 border-b font-semibold">
            <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">المعيار</div>
            <div className="text-sm truncate">{a.position}<br /><span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground font-normal">{a.company}</span></div>
            <div className="text-sm truncate">{b.position}<br /><span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground font-normal">{b.company}</span></div>
          </div>
          {renderRow('الراتب الأساسي', fmtMoney(a.baseSalary, a.currency), fmtMoney(b.baseSalary, b.currency), baseHigher)}
          {renderRow('إجمالي التعويض', fmtMoney(a.totalCompensation, a.currency), fmtMoney(b.totalCompensation, b.currency), totalHigher)}
          {renderRow('العملة', a.currency, b.currency)}
          {renderRow('الحالة', statusMeta(a.status).label, statusMeta(b.status).label)}
          {renderRow('تاريخ العرض', fmtDate(a.offerDate) || '—', fmtDate(b.offerDate) || '—')}
          {renderRow('تاريخ الانتهاء', fmtDate(a.expiryDate) || '—', fmtDate(b.expiryDate) || '—')}
          {renderRow('تاريخ البدء', fmtDate(a.startDate) || '—', fmtDate(b.startDate) || '—')}
          {renderRow('المزايا الإيجابية', `${a.pros.length} بند`, `${b.pros.length} بند`)}
          {renderRow('العيوب', `${a.cons.length} بند`, `${b.cons.length} بند`)}
        </div>
        <DialogFooter>
          <Button onClick={onClose}>إغلاق</Button>
        </DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

export function SalaryTrackerSection() {
  const { jobOffers, addJobOffer, updateJobOffer, deleteJobOffer, jobApplications } = useAppStore();
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [dialogOpen, setDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingId, setEditingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [form, setForm] = useState<OfferForm>(emptyForm);
  const [deleteId, setDeleteId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [compareOpen, setCompareOpen] = useState(false);

  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    const total = jobOffers.length;
    const salaries = jobOffers.map(o => o.totalCompensation || o.baseSalary || 0).filter(n => n > 0);
    const highest = salaries.length > 0 ? Math.max(...salaries) : 0;
    const avg = salaries.length > 0 ? Math.round(salaries.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / salaries.length) : 0;
    return { total, highest, avg };
  }, [jobOffers]);

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    const q = search.trim().toLowerCase();
    return jobOffers.filter(o => {
      if (!q) return true;
      const app = jobApplications.find(a => a.id === o.jobApplicationId);
      return [o.company, o.position, o.benefits, o.negotiationNotes, app?.jobTitle].some(x => x?.toLowerCase().includes(q));
    });
  }, [jobOffers, jobApplications, search]);

  const topTwo = useMemo(() => {
    return [...jobOffers].sort((a, b) => (b.totalCompensation || b.baseSalary || 0) - (a.totalCompensation || a.baseSalary || 0)).slice(0, 2);
  }, [jobOffers]);

  const openAdd = () => { setForm({ ...emptyForm, offerDate: today() }); setEditingId(null); setDialogOpen(true); };
  const openEdit = (o: JobOffer) => {
    setForm({
      jobApplicationId: o.jobApplicationId, company: o.company, position: o.position,
      baseSalary: o.baseSalary ? String(o.baseSalary) : '', currency: o.currency || 'USD',
      totalCompensation: o.totalCompensation ? String(o.totalCompensation) : '',
      offerDate: o.offerDate, expiryDate: o.expiryDate, startDate: o.startDate,
      status: o.status, negotiationNotes: o.negotiationNotes,
    });
    setEditingId(o.id); setDialogOpen(true);
  };

  const save = () => {
    if (!form.company.trim()) { toast({ title: 'اسم الشركة مطلوب', variant: 'destructive' }); return; }
    if (!form.position.trim()) { toast({ title: 'المسمى الوظيفي مطلوب', variant: 'destructive' }); return; }
    const bs = parseInt(form.baseSalary, 10);
    const tc = parseInt(form.totalCompensation, 10);
    const data = {
      jobApplicationId: form.jobApplicationId, company: form.company.trim(), position: form.position.trim(),
      baseSalary: isNaN(bs) ? 0 : bs, currency: form.currency, benefits: '',
      totalCompensation: isNaN(tc) ? 0 : tc, offerDate: form.offerDate, expiryDate: form.expiryDate,
      startDate: form.startDate, status: form.status, negotiationNotes: form.negotiationNotes.trim(),
    };
    if (editingId) {
      const existing = jobOffers.find(o => o.id === editingId);
      updateJobOffer(editingId, { ...data, pros: existing?.pros || [], cons: existing?.cons || [] });
      toast({ title: 'تم تحديث العرض' });
    } else {
      addJobOffer({ ...data, pros: [], cons: [] });
      toast({ title: 'تمت إضافة العرض' });
    }
    setDialogOpen(false);
  };

  const confirmDelete = () => {
    if (!deleteId) return;
    deleteJobOffer(deleteId);
    setDeleteId(null);
    toast({ title: 'تم حذف العرض' });
  };

  const set = <K extends keyof OfferForm>(k: K, v: OfferForm[K]) => setForm(f => ({ ...f, [k]: v }));
  const renderField = (label: string, input: React.ReactNode, className = '') => (
    <div className={`space-y-1.5 ${className}`}><Label>{label}</Label>{input}</div>
  );

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 flex-wrap">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2"><DollarSign className="h-5 w-5" />عروض العمل</h2>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{stats.total} عرض · أعلى راتب {stats.highest > 0 ? stats.highest.toLocaleString('en-US') : '—'}</p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => {
            if (topTwo.length < 2) { toast({ title: 'تحتاج إلى عرضين على الأقل للمقارنة', variant: 'destructive' }); return; }
            setCompareOpen(true);
          }}><GitCompare className="h-4 w-4 ml-1" />مقارنة</Button>
          <Button onClick={openAdd}><Plus className="h-4 w-4 ml-1" />عرض جديد</Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Stats */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
        <Card><CardContent className="p-4">
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">إجمالي العروض</p>
          <p className="text-2xl font-bold tabular-nums">{stats.total}</p>
        </CardContent></Card>
        <Card><CardContent className="p-4">
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">أعلى راتب</p>
          <p className="text-xl font-bold tabular-nums text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" dir="ltr">{stats.highest > 0 ? stats.highest.toLocaleString('en-US') : '—'}</p>
        </CardContent></Card>
        <Card><CardContent className="p-4">
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">متوسط الرواتب</p>
          <p className="text-xl font-bold tabular-nums text-primary" dir="ltr">{stats.avg > 0 ? stats.avg.toLocaleString('en-US') : '—'}</p>
        </CardContent></Card>
      </div>

      {/* Search */}
      <div className="relative">
        <Search className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
        <Input placeholder="ابحث بالشركة أو المسمى أو المزايا..." value={search} onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)} className="pr-9" />
      </div>

      {/* List */}
      {filtered.length === 0 ? (
        <Card><CardContent className="p-10 text-center text-muted-foreground">
          <DollarSign className="h-10 w-10 mx-auto mb-2 opacity-40" />
          {jobOffers.length === 0 ? 'لا توجد عروض بعد. ابدأ بإضافة عرض جديد.' : 'لا توجد نتائج مطابقة.'}
        </CardContent></Card>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
          {filtered.map(o => (
            <OfferCard
              key={o.id} offer={o}
              app={jobApplications.find(a => a.id === o.jobApplicationId)}
              onEdit={() => openEdit(o)}
              onDelete={() => setDeleteId(o.id)}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Add / Edit Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={dialogOpen} onOpenChange={setDialogOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="max-w-2xl max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>{editingId ? 'تعديل العرض' : 'إضافة عرض عمل'}</DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>أدخل تفاصيل العرض والراتب والمزايا.</DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            {renderField('طلب التوظيف المرتبط',
              <Select value={form.jobApplicationId} onValueChange={(v) => set('jobApplicationId', v)}>
                <SelectTrigger><SelectValue placeholder="— غير مرتبط —" /></SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent className="max-h-60">
                  <SelectItem value="none">— غير مرتبط —</SelectItem>
                  {jobApplications.map(a => <SelectItem key={a.id} value={a.id}>{jobAppLabel(a)}</SelectItem>)}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>, 'sm:col-span-2')}
            {renderField('الشركة *', <Input value={form.company} onChange={(e) => set('company', e.target.value)} placeholder="Google" />)}
            {renderField('المسمى الوظيفي *', <Input value={form.position} onChange={(e) => set('position', e.target.value)} placeholder="مطوّر برمجيات" />)}
            {renderField('الراتب الأساسي', <Input type="number" min={0} dir="ltr" value={form.baseSalary} onChange={(e) => set('baseSalary', e.target.value)} placeholder="0" />)}
            {renderField('العملة',
              <Select value={form.currency} onValueChange={(v) => set('currency', v)}>
                <SelectTrigger><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  {CURRENCIES.map(c => <SelectItem key={c} value={c}>{c === 'local' ? 'محلية' : c}</SelectItem>)}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>)}
            {renderField('إجمالي التعويض', <Input type="number" min={0} dir="ltr" value={form.totalCompensation} onChange={(e) => set('totalCompensation', e.target.value)} placeholder="0" />)}
            {renderField('الحالة',
              <Select value={form.status} onValueChange={(v) => set('status', v as OfferStatus)}>
                <SelectTrigger><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  {STATUSES.map(s => <SelectItem key={s.value} value={s.value}>{s.label}</SelectItem>)}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>)}
            {renderField('تاريخ العرض', <Input type="date" value={form.offerDate} onChange={(e) => set('offerDate', e.target.value)} />)}
            {renderField('تاريخ الانتهاء', <Input type="date" value={form.expiryDate} onChange={(e) => set('expiryDate', e.target.value)} />)}
            {renderField('تاريخ البدء', <Input type="date" value={form.startDate} onChange={(e) => set('startDate', e.target.value)} />)}
            {renderField('ملاحظات التفاوض', <Textarea rows={3} value={form.negotiationNotes} onChange={(e) => set('negotiationNotes', e.target.value)} placeholder="ملاحظات التفاوض..." />, 'sm:col-span-2')}
          </div>
          <DialogFooter>
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setDialogOpen(false)}>إلغاء</Button>
            <Button onClick={save}>{editingId ? 'حفظ' : 'إضافة'}</Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>

      {/* Comparison */}
      {compareOpen && topTwo.length >= 2 && (
        <ComparisonView offers={topTwo} onClose={() => setCompareOpen(false)} />
      )}

      {/* Delete confirm */}
      <AlertDialog open={!!deleteId} onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setDeleteId(null)}>
        <AlertDialogContent>
          <AlertDialogHeader>
            <AlertDialogTitle>تأكيد الحذف</AlertDialogTitle>
            <AlertDialogDescription>سيتم حذف العرض نهائياً. لا يمكن التراجع عن هذا الإجراء.</AlertDialogDescription>
          </AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogFooter>
            <AlertDialogCancel>إلغاء</AlertDialogCancel>
            <AlertDialogAction onClick={confirmDelete} className="bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground hover:bg-destructive/90">حذف</AlertDialogAction>
          </AlertDialogFooter>
        </AlertDialogContent>
      </AlertDialog>
    </div>
  );
}
```
