## 📝 الكود الكامل

```tsx
'use client';

// ============================================
// MiMo Portfolio — AI Coach Section
// مساعد ذكي يربط بيانات محمد بنموذج GLM
// - واجهة محادثة مع اقتراحات سريعة
// - زر "تقرير أسبوعي" يستدعي /api/weekly-reports/generate
// - عرض آخر 5 رؤى AI تحت المحادثة
// ============================================

import { useState, useMemo, useRef, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import {
  Brain, Send, Sparkles, FileText, Loader2, Bot, User, TrendingUp,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { useAppStore } from '@/lib/store';
import { toast } from '@/hooks/use-toast';
import type { AIInsight } from '@/types';

// ============ اقتراحات سريعة ============
const QUICK_SUGGESTIONS: string[] = [
  'كيف أحسن إنتاجيتي؟',
  'شو أفضل مهارة أتعلمها؟',
  'حلل درجاتي',
  'قدم لي نصيحة مهنية',
];

// ============ ألوان فئات الرؤى ============
const INSIGHT_CATEGORY_CLS: Record<AIInsight['category'], string> = {
  productivity: 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-900/30 dark:text-emerald-400',
  academic: 'bg-sky-100 text-sky-700 dark:bg-sky-900/30 dark:text-sky-400',
  career: 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-700 dark:bg-purple-900/30 dark:text-purple-400',
  health: 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-700 dark:bg-rose-900/30 dark:text-rose-400',
  general: 'bg-muted text-muted-foreground',
};

const INSIGHT_CATEGORY_LABEL: Record<AIInsight['category'], string> = {
  productivity: 'إنتاجية',
  academic: 'أكاديمي',
  career: 'مهني',
  health: 'صحة',
  general: 'عام',
};

// ============ مؤشر الكتابة ============
function TypingIndicator() {
  return (
    <motion.div
      initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 5 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
      exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -5 }}
      className="flex items-start gap-2 px-1 py-2"
    >
      <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br from-emerald-500 to-teal-600 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
        <Bot className="w-4 h-4 text-white" />
      </div>
      <div className="bg-muted rounded-2xl rounded-tr-sm px-4 py-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <motion.span
            className="w-2 h-2 bg-muted-foreground/50 rounded-full"
            animate={{ y: [0, -4, 0] }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.6, repeat: Infinity, delay: 0 }}
          />
          <motion.span
            className="w-2 h-2 bg-muted-foreground/50 rounded-full"
            animate={{ y: [0, -4, 0] }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.6, repeat: Infinity, delay: 0.15 }}
          />
          <motion.span
            className="w-2 h-2 bg-muted-foreground/50 rounded-full"
            animate={{ y: [0, -4, 0] }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.6, repeat: Infinity, delay: 0.3 }}
          />
        </div>
      </div>
    </motion.div>
  );
}

// ============ بطاقة رؤية AI ============
function InsightCard({ insight }: { insight: AIInsight }) {
  const cat = INSIGHT_CATEGORY_CLS[insight.category] || INSIGHT_CATEGORY_CLS.general;
  const label = INSIGHT_CATEGORY_LABEL[insight.category] || 'عام';
  return (
    <Card className="overflow-hidden border-purple-200/60 dark:border-purple-900/30">
      <CardContent className="p-3 space-y-2">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 min-w-0">
            <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-purple-500 shrink-0" />
            <h4 className="text-xs font-semibold truncate">{insight.title || 'رؤية'}</h4>
          </div>
          <Badge variant="secondary" className={`text-[10px] shrink-0 ${cat}`}>{label}</Badge>
        </div>
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed line-clamp-3 whitespace-pre-wrap">
          {insight.content}
        </p>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

// ============ المكون الرئيسي ============
export function AICoachSection() {
  const aiConversations = useAppStore((s) => s.aiConversations);
  const addAIConversation = useAppStore((s) => s.addAIConversation);
  const aiInsights = useAppStore((s) => s.aiInsights);
  const addWeeklyReport = useAppStore((s) => s.addWeeklyReport);
  const setAIInsights = useAppStore((s) => s.setAIInsights);

  const [input, setInput] = useState('');
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [generatingReport, setGeneratingReport] = useState(false);
  const messagesEndRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const textareaRef = useRef<HTMLTextAreaElement>(null);

  // ترتيب الرسائل: من الأقدم إلى الأحدث (المتجر يخزّن الأحدث أولاً)
  const messages = useMemo(
    () => [...aiConversations].reverse().filter((m) => m.role !== 'system'),
    [aiConversations],
  );

  // آخر 5 رؤى
  const lastInsights = useMemo(() => aiInsights.slice(0, 5), [aiInsights]);

  // التمرير لأسفل عند وصول رسالة جديدة
  useEffect(() => {
    messagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'end' });
  }, [messages.length, isLoading]);

  // التركيز على حقل الإدخال
  useEffect(() => {
    textareaRef.current?.focus();
  }, []);

  // ============ إرسال رسالة ============
  const sendMessage = useCallback(async (text?: string) => {
    const msg = (text ?? input).trim();
    if (!msg || isLoading) return;

    // حفظ رسالة المستخدم في المتجر
    addAIConversation({ role: 'user', content: msg, context: 'coach' });
    setInput('');
    setIsLoading(true);

    try {
      // تجهيز التاريخ للإرسال (نأخذ آخر 10 رسائل قبل هذه)
      const history = messages.slice(-10).map((m) => ({ role: m.role, content: m.content }));
      const res = await fetch('/api/ai-coach/chat', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ message: msg, history }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error('فشل الاتصال');
      const data = await res.json();
      addAIConversation({ role: 'assistant', content: data.reply, context: 'coach' });
    } catch {
      addAIConversation({
        role: 'assistant',
        content: 'عذراً، حدث خطأ في الاتصال بالمساعد الذكي. حاول مرة أخرى. 🔄',
        context: 'coach',
      });
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  }, [input, isLoading, messages, addAIConversation]);

  const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
      e.preventDefault();
      sendMessage();
    }
  };

  // ============ توليد تقرير أسبوعي ============
  const generateReport = async () => {
    setGeneratingReport(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/weekly-reports/generate', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error('فشل التوليد');
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data?.report) {
        addWeeklyReport(data.report);
        toast({ title: 'تم توليد تقرير الأسبوع ✅' });
        // تحديث الرؤى من الخادم (الرؤية الإنتاجية تُحفظ مباشرة في DB)
        try {
          const insightsRes = await fetch('/api/data/aiInsights');
          if (insightsRes.ok) {
            const insights = await insightsRes.json();
            if (Array.isArray(insights)) {
              setAIInsights(insights as AIInsight[]);
            }
          }
        } catch {
          /* ignore — التحديث اختياري */
        }
      } else {
        toast({ title: 'تم توليد التقرير', description: 'تحقق من النتائج' });
      }
    } catch {
      toast({
        title: 'تعذّر توليد التقرير',
        description: 'حاول مرة أخرى لاحقاً',
        variant: 'destructive',
      });
    } finally {
      setGeneratingReport(false);
    }
  };

  // ============ تنسيق الوقت ============
  const fmtTime = (iso: string): string => {
    if (!iso) return '';
    try {
      return new Date(iso).toLocaleTimeString('ar', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
    } catch {
      return '';
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* ============ الرأس ============ */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 flex-wrap">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-emerald-500 to-teal-600 flex items-center justify-center">
            <Brain className="w-5 h-5 text-white" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2">
              المدرب الذكي
              <Badge className="bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-600 text-[10px] px-1.5">AI Coach</Badge>
            </h2>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">مساعدك المخصّص بناءً على بياناتك — نصائح عملية ومباشرة</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <Button onClick={generateReport} disabled={generatingReport} variant="outline">
          {generatingReport ? <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 ml-1 animate-spin" /> : <FileText className="h-4 w-4 ml-1" />}
          {generatingReport ? 'جارٍ التوليد...' : 'تقرير أسبوعي'}
        </Button>
      </div>

      {/* ============ شبكة المحادثة + الرؤى ============ */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
        {/* المحادثة */}
        <Card className="lg:col-span-2 flex flex-col h-[calc(100vh-14rem)] min-h-[500px]">
          <CardHeader className="pb-3 border-b border-border">
            <CardTitle className="text-sm flex items-center gap-2">
              <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-500" />
              محادثة مع المدرب
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>

          {/* منطقة الرسائل */}
          <CardContent className="flex-1 overflow-hidden p-0">
            <div className="h-full overflow-y-auto px-4 py-3 space-y-1">
              {messages.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-full text-center py-8">
                  <motion.div
                    initial={{ scale: 0.8, opacity: 0 }}
                    animate={{ scale: 1, opacity: 1 }}
                    transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 200 }}
                    className="space-y-4"
                  >
                    <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-emerald-500 to-teal-600 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto">
                      <Brain className="w-8 h-8 text-white" />
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold">مرحباً محمد! 👋</h3>
                      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-1 max-w-sm">
                        أنا مدربك الذكي. أستخدم بياناتك (المواد، الدرجات، المهارات، المشاريع) لتقديم نصائح عملية ومخصصة.
                      </p>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-2 mt-4 max-w-md">
                      {QUICK_SUGGESTIONS.map((s) => (
                        <button
                          key={s}
                          onClick={() => sendMessage(s)}
                          disabled={isLoading}
                          className="px-3 py-1.5 text-xs rounded-full border border-border hover:bg-muted hover:border-primary/40 transition-colors disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
                        >
                          {s}
                        </button>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </motion.div>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <>
                  {messages.map((message) => {
                    const isUser = message.role === 'user';
                    return (
                      <motion.div
                        key={message.id}
                        initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }}
                        animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                        transition={{ duration: 0.25 }}
                        className={`flex items-start gap-2 my-2 ${
                          isUser ? 'flex-row-reverse' : 'flex-row'
                        }`}
                      >
                        {/* أيقونة المرسل */}
                        <div
                          className={`w-8 h-8 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 ${
                            isUser
                              ? 'bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-950/30'
                              : 'bg-gradient-to-br from-emerald-500 to-teal-600'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {isUser ? (
                            <User className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />
                          ) : (
                            <Bot className="w-4 h-4 text-white" />
                          )}
                        </div>

                        {/* محتوى الرسالة */}
                        <div className={`flex flex-col max-w-[80%] ${isUser ? 'items-end' : 'items-start'}`}>
                          <div
                            className={`rounded-2xl px-4 py-2.5 text-sm leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap ${
                              isUser
                                ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white rounded-tl-sm'
                                : 'bg-muted rounded-tr-sm'
                            }`}
                          >
                            {message.content}
                          </div>
                          <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground/70 mt-1 px-1">
                            {fmtTime(message.createdAt)}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      </motion.div>
                    );
                  })}

                  {/* مؤشر الكتابة */}
                  <AnimatePresence>
                    {isLoading && <TypingIndicator />}
                  </AnimatePresence>

                  <div ref={messagesEndRef} />
                </>
              )}
            </div>
          </CardContent>

          {/* حقل الإدخال */}
          <div className="border-t border-border p-3 space-y-2">
            {/* الاقتراحات السريعة (تظهر فقط عند وجود رسائل) */}
            {messages.length > 0 && (
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                {QUICK_SUGGESTIONS.map((s) => (
                  <button
                    key={s}
                    onClick={() => sendMessage(s)}
                    disabled={isLoading}
                    className="px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] rounded-full bg-muted/60 hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground text-muted-foreground transition-colors disabled:opacity-50"
                  >
                    {s}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
            <div className="flex items-end gap-2">
              <Textarea
                ref={textareaRef}
                value={input}
                onChange={(e) => setInput(e.target.value)}
                onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
                placeholder="اكتب سؤالك... (Enter للإرسال، Shift+Enter لسطر جديد)"
                disabled={isLoading}
                className="min-h-[44px] max-h-32 resize-none text-sm rounded-xl"
                rows={1}
              />
              <Button
                onClick={() => sendMessage()}
                disabled={!input.trim() || isLoading}
                size="icon"
                className="h-10 w-10 rounded-xl shrink-0 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700"
                aria-label="إرسال"
              >
                {isLoading ? <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" /> : <Send className="w-4 h-4" />}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </Card>

        {/* الرؤى الجانبية */}
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <Card>
            <CardHeader className="pb-2">
              <CardTitle className="text-sm flex items-center gap-2">
                <TrendingUp className="w-4 h-4 text-purple-500" />
```

```tsx
'use client';

// التقارير الأسبوعية — Weekly Reports UI

import { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  FileText, BarChart3, TrendingUp, Clock, CheckCircle2, Sparkles,
  Download, Calendar, Trophy, AlertTriangle, Loader2,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogDescription, DialogFooter } from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { useAppStore } from '@/lib/store';
import { toast } from '@/hooks/use-toast';
import type { WeeklyReport } from '@/types';

function fmtDate(s: string): string {
  if (!s) return '';
  try { return new Date(s).toLocaleDateString('ar', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' }); }
  catch { return s; }
}

// ============ Productivity score color ============
function scoreColor(score: number): { text: string; bg: string; ring: string; bar: string } {
  if (score >= 80) return {
    text: 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400',
    bg: 'bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-900/30',
    ring: 'text-emerald-500',
    bar: 'bg-emerald-500',
  };
  if (score >= 60) return {
    text: 'text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400',
    bg: 'bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-900/30',
    ring: 'text-amber-500',
    bar: 'bg-amber-500',
  };
  return {
    text: 'text-red-600 dark:text-red-400',
    bg: 'bg-red-100 dark:bg-red-900/30',
    ring: 'text-red-500',
    bar: 'bg-red-500',
  };
}

// ============ Circular gauge ============
function ScoreGauge({ score, size = 120 }: { score: number; size?: number }) {
  const c = scoreColor(score);
  const stroke = 10;
  const r = (size - stroke) / 2;
  const circ = 2 * Math.PI * r;
  const offset = circ - (Math.min(100, Math.max(0, score)) / 100) * circ;
  return (
    <div className="relative inline-flex items-center justify-center" style={{ width: size, height: size }}>
      <svg width={size} height={size} className="-rotate-90">
        <circle cx={size / 2} cy={size / 2} r={r} fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={stroke} className="text-muted/40" />
        <circle
          cx={size / 2} cy={size / 2} r={r} fill="none"
          stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={stroke} strokeLinecap="round"
          strokeDasharray={circ} strokeDashoffset={offset}
          className={`${c.ring} transition-all duration-500`}
        />
      </svg>
      <div className="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center">
        <span className={`text-3xl font-bold tabular-nums ${c.text}`}>{score}</span>
        <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">من 100</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ============ Bar Chart ============
function ScoreChart({ reports }: { reports: WeeklyReport[] }) {
  const sorted = useMemo(() => [...reports].sort((a, b) => a.weekStart.localeCompare(b.weekStart)).slice(-12), [reports]);
  if (sorted.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <Card>
      <CardContent className="p-4 space-y-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <BarChart3 className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
          <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold">اتجاه درجة الإنتاجية</h3>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-end justify-between gap-1.5 h-32" dir="ltr">
          {sorted.map(r => {
            const c = scoreColor(r.productivityScore);
            const h = Math.max(4, (r.productivityScore / 100) * 100);
            return (
              <div key={r.id} className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center gap-1 group min-w-0">
                <span className="text-[9px] text-muted-foreground tabular-nums opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">{r.productivityScore}</span>
                <div
                  className={`w-full rounded-t ${c.bar} transition-all hover:opacity-80`}
                  style={{ height: `${h}%` }}
                  title={`${fmtDate(r.weekStart)}: ${r.productivityScore}`}
                />
                <span className="text-[8px] text-muted-foreground truncate w-full text-center">
                  {r.weekStart ? new Date(r.weekStart).toLocaleDateString('ar', { month: 'numeric', day: 'numeric' }) : ''}
                </span>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

// ============ Report Card ============
function ReportCard({ report, onClick }: { report: WeeklyReport; onClick: () => void }) {

export function WeeklyReportsSection() {
  const { weeklyReports, addWeeklyReport, aiInsights } = useAppStore();
  const [selectedId, setSelectedId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [generating, setGenerating] = useState(false);

  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    const total = weeklyReports.length;
    const avg = total > 0 ? Math.round(weeklyReports.reduce((s, r) => s + (r.productivityScore || 0), 0) / total) : 0;
    const best = total > 0 ? Math.max(...weeklyReports.map(r => r.productivityScore || 0)) : 0;
    const totalTasks = weeklyReports.reduce((s, r) => s + (r.tasksCompleted || 0), 0);
    return { total, avg, best, totalTasks };
  }, [weeklyReports]);

  const sortedReports = useMemo(() => {
    return [...weeklyReports].sort((a, b) => b.weekStart.localeCompare(a.weekStart));
  }, [weeklyReports]);

  const selected = useMemo(() => weeklyReports.find(r => r.id === selectedId) || null, [weeklyReports, selectedId]);

  const generate = async () => {
    setGenerating(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/weekly-reports/generate', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error('فشل التوليد');
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data?.report) {
        addWeeklyReport(data.report);
        toast({ title: 'تم توليد تقرير الأسبوع' });
      } else {
        toast({ title: 'تم توليد التقرير', description: 'تحقق من النتائج' });
      }
    } catch {
      toast({ title: 'تعذّر توليد التقرير', description: 'حاول مرة أخرى لاحقاً', variant: 'destructive' });
    } finally {
      setGenerating(false);
    }
  };

  const downloadReport = (r: WeeklyReport) => {
    const lines = [
      `تقرير الأسبوع: ${fmtDate(r.weekStart)} - ${fmtDate(r.weekEnd)}`,
      `درجة الإنتاجية: ${r.productivityScore}/100`,
      `المهام المكتملة: ${r.tasksCompleted}`,
      `المهام الجديدة: ${r.tasksCreated}`,
      `ساعات العمل: ${r.hoursWorked}`,
      `العادات المكتملة: ${r.habitsCompleted}`,
      '',
      'الإنجازات:',
      ...r.achievements.map((a, i) => `${i + 1}. ${a}`),
      '',
      'التحديات:',
      ...r.challenges.map((a, i) => `${i + 1}. ${a}`),
      '',
      'رؤى الذكاء الاصطناعي:',
      ...r.aiInsights.map((a, i) => `${i + 1}. ${a}`),
      '',
      r.goalsProgress ? `تقدّم الأهداف:\n${r.goalsProgress}` : '',
    ].filter(Boolean);
    const blob = new Blob([`\uFEFF${lines.join('\n')}`], { type: 'text/plain;charset=utf-8' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url;
    a.download = `weekly-report-${r.weekStart}.txt`;
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    toast({ title: 'تم تنزيل التقرير' });
  };

  const c = scoreColor(stats.avg);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 flex-wrap">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2"><FileText className="h-5 w-5" />التقارير الأسبوعية</h2>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{stats.total} تقرير · متوسط الإنتاجية {stats.avg}/100</p>
        </div>
        <Button onClick={generate} disabled={generating}>
          {generating ? <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 ml-1 animate-spin" /> : <Sparkles className="h-4 w-4 ml-1" />}
          {generating ? 'جارٍ التوليد...' : 'توليد تقرير الأسبوع'}
        </Button>
      </div>

      {/* Stats */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
        <Card><CardContent className="p-4">
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">إجمالي التقارير</p>
          <p className="text-2xl font-bold tabular-nums">{stats.total}</p>
        </CardContent></Card>
        <Card><CardContent className="p-4">
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">متوسط الإنتاجية</p>
          <p className={`text-2xl font-bold tabular-nums ${c.text}`}>{stats.avg}</p>
        </CardContent></Card>
        <Card><CardContent className="p-4">
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">أعلى درجة</p>
          <p className="text-2xl font-bold tabular-nums text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">{stats.best}</p>
        </CardContent></Card>
        <Card><CardContent className="p-4">
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">إجمالي المهام</p>
          <p className="text-2xl font-bold tabular-nums">{stats.totalTasks}</p>
        </CardContent></Card>
      </div>

      {/* Chart */}
      {weeklyReports.length > 0 && <ScoreChart reports={weeklyReports} />}

      {/* AI Insights banner */}
      {aiInsights.length > 0 && (
        <Card className="border-purple-200 dark:border-purple-900/40">
          <CardContent className="p-4 space-y-2">
            <p className="text-sm font-medium flex items-center gap-1"><Sparkles className="h-4 w-4 text-purple-500" />رؤى الذكاء الاصطناعي الأخيرة</p>
            <div className="space-y-1.5 max-h-40 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
              {aiInsights.slice(0, 3).map(ins => (
                <div key={ins.id} className="text-xs text-muted-foreground bg-purple-50 dark:bg-purple-950/20 rounded p-2">
                  <p className="font-medium text-foreground">{ins.title}</p>
                  <p className="leading-relaxed">{ins.content}</p>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}

      {/* Reports List */}
      {sortedReports.length === 0 ? (
        <Card><CardContent className="p-10 text-center text-muted-foreground">
          <FileText className="h-10 w-10 mx-auto mb-2 opacity-40" />
          لا توجد تقارير بعد. اضغط "توليد تقرير الأسبوع" لإنشاء أول تقرير.
        </CardContent></Card>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
          {sortedReports.map(r => (
            <ReportCard key={r.id} report={r} onClick={() => setSelectedId(r.id)} />
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Detail Dialog */}
      {selected && (
        <ReportDetail
          report={selected}
          onClose={() => setSelectedId(null)}
          onDownload={() => downloadReport(selected)}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## 📝 الكود الكامل

```tsx
'use client';

// ============================================
// MiMo Portfolio — Sentiment Analysis Section
// تحليل المزاج: مخطط زمني، اكتشاف التوتر، اقتراحات AI
// ============================================

import { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import {
  Heart, TrendingDown, Sparkles, Calendar, AlertCircle, Bot, Loader2,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { useAppStore } from '@/lib/store';
import { toast } from '@/hooks/use-toast';
import { MOOD_CONFIG, type JournalEntry } from '@/types';

// تحويل المزاج إلى قيمة رقمية للرسم
const MOOD_SCORE: Record<JournalEntry['mood'], number> = { excellent: 5, good: 4, okay: 3, sad: 2, terrible: 1 };
const MOOD_COLOR: Record<JournalEntry['mood'], string> = {
  excellent: 'bg-emerald-500', good: 'bg-lime-500', okay: 'bg-amber-500', sad: 'bg-orange-500', terrible: 'bg-red-500',
};

function buildLast30Days(): string[] {
  const days: string[] = [];
  const now = new Date();
  for (let i = 29; i >= 0; i--) {
    const d = new Date(now);
    d.setDate(d.getDate() - i);
    days.push(d.toISOString().split('T')[0]);
  }
  return days;
}

const fmtDay = (s: string) => { try { return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('ar-SA', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short' }).format(new Date(s + 'T12:00:00')); } catch { return s; } };
const fmtFullDate = (s: string) => { try { return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('ar-SA', { weekday: 'long', day: 'numeric', month: 'long' }).format(new Date(s + 'T12:00:00')); } catch { return s; } };

export function SentimentAnalysisSection() {
  const journalEntries = useAppStore((s) => s.journalEntries);
  const [insight, setInsight] = useState<string>('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  // خريطة: التاريخ → المدخل
  const entryByDate = useMemo(() => {
    const map: Record<string, JournalEntry> = {};
    for (const e of journalEntries) map[e.date] = e;
    return map;
  }, [journalEntries]);

  // آخر 30 يوماً
  const days = useMemo(() => buildLast30Days(), []);

  // سلسلة المزاج لكل يوم
  const moodSeries = useMemo(() => {
    return days.map((d) => ({
      date: d,
      entry: entryByDate[d] || null,
      mood: entryByDate[d]?.mood || null,
      score: entryByDate[d] ? MOOD_SCORE[entryByDate[d].mood] : null,
    }));
  }, [days, entryByDate]);

  // الإحصائيات
  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    const recorded = moodSeries.filter((d) => d.entry !== null);
    const scores = recorded.map((d) => d.score as number);
    const avg = scores.length ? scores.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / scores.length : 0;
    const sadDays = recorded.filter((d) => d.mood === 'sad' || d.mood === 'terrible').length;
    const happyDays = recorded.filter((d) => d.mood === 'excellent' || d.mood === 'good').length;

    // اكتشاف التوتر: سلاسل الأيام المنخفضة المتتالية (sad/terrible)
    let currentStreak = 0;
    let maxStreak = 0;
    const stressPeriods: Array<{ start: string; end: string; length: number }> = [];
    let streakStart = '';
    for (const d of moodSeries) {
      if (d.mood === 'sad' || d.mood === 'terrible') {
        if (currentStreak === 0) streakStart = d.date;
        currentStreak++;
        if (currentStreak > maxStreak) maxStreak = currentStreak;
      } else {
        if (currentStreak >= 2) {
          stressPeriods.push({ start: streakStart, end: moodSeries[moodSeries.findIndex((x) => x.date === streakStart) + currentStreak - 1]?.date || streakStart, length: currentStreak });
        }
        currentStreak = 0;
      }
    }
    if (currentStreak >= 2) {
      stressPeriods.push({ start: streakStart, end: days[days.length - 1], length: currentStreak });
    }

    const lastEntry = recorded[recorded.length - 1];
    return {
      recordedCount: recorded.length,
      avgScore: avg,
      sadDays, happyDays,
      maxStressStreak: maxStreak,
      stressPeriods,
      lastMood: lastEntry?.mood || null,
    };
  }, [moodSeries, days]);

  // متوسط المزاج → تسمية ولون
  const avgMoodLabel = useMemo(() => {
    const s = stats.avgScore;
    if (s === 0) return { label: 'لا توجد بيانات', cls: 'text-muted-foreground' };
    if (s >= 4.5) return { label: 'ممتاز', cls: 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400' };
    if (s >= 3.5) return { label: 'جيد', cls: 'text-lime-600 dark:text-lime-400' };
    if (s >= 2.5) return { label: 'عادي', cls: 'text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400' };
    if (s >= 1.5) return { label: 'متضايق', cls: 'text-orange-600 dark:text-orange-400' };
    return { label: 'حزين', cls: 'text-red-600 dark:text-red-400' };
  }, [stats.avgScore]);

  // استدعاء AI
  const fetchInsight = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    setInsight('');
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/ai-coach/chat', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ message: 'حلل مزاجي آخر 30 يوم', history: [] }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error('فشل الاتصال');
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.reply) {
        setInsight(data.reply as string);
      } else {
        toast({ title: 'لم يتم استلام رد', variant: 'destructive' });
      }
    } catch {
      toast({ title: 'فشل الاتصال بالمساعد الذكي', variant: 'destructive' });
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // قياسات الرسم
  const CHART_H = 140;
  const CHART_W = 600; // viewBox width — scales responsively
  const padX = 8;
  const padY = 12;
  const innerW = CHART_W - padX * 2;
  const innerH = CHART_H - padY * 2;
  const stepX = innerW / (days.length - 1);
  const scoreToY = (score: number) => padY + innerH - ((score - 1) / 4) * innerH;

  // نقاط المسار
  const linePoints = moodSeries
    .filter((d) => d.score !== null)
    .map((d, i) => {
      const xIndex = moodSeries.findIndex((m) => m.date === d.date);
      return { x: padX + xIndex * stepX, y: scoreToY(d.score as number), date: d.date, mood: d.mood as JournalEntry['mood'] };
    });

  // مسار SVG
  const pathD = linePoints.map((p, i) => `${i === 0 ? 'M' : 'L'}${p.x.toFixed(1)},${p.y.toFixed(1)}`).join(' ');

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between flex-wrap gap-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-rose-100 dark:bg-rose-900/30 flex items-center justify-center">
            <Heart className="w-5 h-5 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-foreground">تحليل المزاج</h2>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">آخر 30 يوماً · {stats.recordedCount} تسجيل</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <Button onClick={fetchInsight} disabled={loading} className="gap-2 bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-700">
          {loading ? <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" /> : <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4" />}
          {loading ? 'جارٍ التحليل...' : 'اقتراحات AI'}
        </Button>
      </div>

      {/* Stats row */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
        <Card className="border border-border"><CardContent className="p-3 text-center">
          <p className={`text-lg font-bold ${avgMoodLabel.cls}`}>{avgMoodLabel.label}</p>
          <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">متوسط المزاج</p>
        </CardContent></Card>
        <Card className="border border-border"><CardContent className="p-3 text-center">
          <p className="text-lg font-bold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">{stats.happyDays}</p>
          <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">أيام سعيدة</p>
        </CardContent></Card>
        <Card className="border border-border"><CardContent className="p-3 text-center">
          <p className="text-lg font-bold text-orange-600 dark:text-orange-400">{stats.sadDays}</p>
          <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">أيام متضايقة</p>
        </CardContent></Card>
        <Card className={`border ${stats.maxStressStreak >= 3 ? 'border-red-300 dark:border-red-900' : 'border-border'}`}>
          <CardContent className="p-3 text-center">
            <p className={`text-lg font-bold ${stats.maxStressStreak >= 3 ? 'text-red-600 dark:text-red-400' : 'text-foreground'}`}>{stats.maxStressStreak}</p>
            <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">أقصى توتر متتالٍ</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>

      {/* Mood timeline chart */}
      <Card className="border border-border">
        <CardContent className="p-4 space-y-3">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Calendar className="w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />
              <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground">الخط الزمني للمزاج</h3>
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
              {(['excellent', 'good', 'okay', 'sad', 'terrible'] as const).map((m) => (
                <span key={m} className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                  <span className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${MOOD_COLOR[m]}`} /> {MOOD_CONFIG[m].label}
                </span>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
          {linePoints.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="py-12 text-center">
              <Heart className="w-10 h-10 mx-auto mb-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-30" />
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">لا توجد بيانات مزاج في آخر 30 يوماً</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">سجّل يومياتك يومياً لرؤية التحليل</p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="w-full overflow-x-auto">
              <svg viewBox={`0 0 ${CHART_W} ${CHART_H}`} className="w-full h-32 min-w-[600px]" preserveAspectRatio="none">
                {/* شبكة أفقية */}
                {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((s) => (
                  <g key={s}>
                    <line x1={padX} y1={scoreToY(s)} x2={CHART_W - padX} y2={scoreToY(s)} stroke="currentColor" strokeOpacity="0.08" strokeDasharray="2 4" />
                  </g>
                ))}
                {/* مسار المزاج */}
                {pathD && <path d={pathD} fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" className="text-rose-400" />}
                {/* النقاط */}
                {linePoints.map((p) => (
                  <circle key={p.date} cx={p.x} cy={p.y} r="4" className={MOOD_COLOR[p.mood]}>
                    <title>{fmtFullDate(p.date)} — {MOOD_CONFIG[p.mood].label}</title>
                  </circle>
                ))}
              </svg>
            </div>
          )}
          {/* تسميات الأيام */}
          <div className="flex justify-between text-[10px] text-muted-foreground px-1">
            <span>{fmtDay(days[0])}</span>
            <span>{fmtDay(days[Math.floor(days.length / 2)])}</span>
            <span>{fmtDay(days[days.length - 1])}</span>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* Stress detection */}
      {stats.stressPeriods.length > 0 && (
        <Card className="border border-red-200 dark:border-red-900/50 bg-red-50/50 dark:bg-red-900/10">
          <CardContent className="p-4 space-y-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-red-500" />
              <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-red-700 dark:text-red-400">اكتشاف التوتر</h3>
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">رصد النظام فترات متتالية من المزاج المنخفض:</p>
            <div className="space-y-2 max-h-40 overflow-y-auto">
              {stats.stressPeriods.map((p, i) => (
                <div key={i} className="flex items-center justify-between p-2 rounded-md bg-white/60 dark:bg-black/20">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs">
                    <TrendingDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-red-500" />
                    <span className="text-foreground">{fmtDay(p.start)} ← {fmtDay(p.end)}</span>
                  </div>
                  <Badge variant="destructive" className="text-[10px]">{p.length} أيام متتالية</Badge>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}

      {/* AI Insight */}
      <AnimatePresence>
        {(insight || loading) && (
          <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0 }}>
            <Card className="border border-purple-200 dark:border-purple-900/30 bg-purple-50/30 dark:bg-purple-900/10">
              <CardContent className="p-4 space-y-3">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <div className="w-7 h-7 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br from-purple-500 to-pink-600 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                    <Bot className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-white" />
                  </div>
                  <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground">اقتراحات المساعد الذكي</h3>
                </div>
                {loading ? (
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground py-4">
                    <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" />
                    <span>يحلل المساعد مزاجك...</span>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="text-xs text-foreground leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap bg-white/60 dark:bg-black/20 rounded-md p-3">
                    {insight}
                  </div>
                )}
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </div>
  );
}
```

# 43. أسئلة وأجوبة

- **الكود (ID)**: `qa-system`

## 📝 الكود الكامل

```tsx
'use client';

// ============================================
// MiMo Portfolio — Q&A System Section
// نظام أسئلة وأجوبة: طرح سؤال → رد AI → حفظ + بحث
// ============================================

import { useState, useMemo, useRef, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import {
  HelpCircle, Send, Search, Sparkles, Save, Bot, User, Loader2, Trash2,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { useAppStore } from '@/lib/store';
import { toast } from '@/hooks/use-toast';
import type { AIConversationEntry } from '@/types';

// اقتراحات أسئلة جاهزة
const QUICK_QUESTIONS: string[] = [
  'ما هي أفضل طريقة لتنظيم وقتي الدراسي؟',
  'كيف أحسّن تركيزي أثناء المذاكرة؟',
  'ما المهارات المطلوبة في سوق العمل 2025؟',
  'كيف أبني سيرة ذاتية قوية؟',
  'ما نصائح للتعامل مع ضغط الامتحانات؟',
];

interface QA {
  questionId: string;
  question: string;
  answer: string;
  createdAt: string;
}

// تحويل قائمة aiConversations (context='qa') إلى أزواج Q&A
function groupQAs(entries: AIConversationEntry[]): QA[] {
  const qaEntries = entries.filter((e) => e.context === 'qa');
  // المتجر يخزّن الأحدث أولاً؛ نعكس للأقدم→الأحدث ثم نجمّع أزواج متتالية (user→assistant)
  const sorted = [...qaEntries].sort((a, b) => a.createdAt.localeCompare(b.createdAt));
  const pairs: QA[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < sorted.length; i++) {
    const cur = sorted[i];
    if (cur.role === 'user') {
      const next = sorted[i + 1];
      if (next && next.role === 'assistant') {
        pairs.push({
          questionId: cur.id,
          question: cur.content,
          answer: next.content,
          createdAt: cur.createdAt,
        });
        i++; // تخطّي المساعد
      } else {
        // سؤال بلا جواب
        pairs.push({ questionId: cur.id, question: cur.content, answer: '', createdAt: cur.createdAt });
      }
    }
  }
  // نعكس ليكون الأحدث أولاً
  return pairs.reverse();
}

const fmtTime = (iso: string): string => {
  if (!iso) return '';
  try { return new Date(iso).toLocaleString('ar', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }); }
  catch { return ''; }
};

export function QASystemSection() {
  const aiConversations = useAppStore((s) => s.aiConversations);
  const addAIConversation = useAppStore((s) => s.addAIConversation);

  const [question, setQuestion] = useState('');
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [pendingAnswer, setPendingAnswer] = useState<{ q: string; a: string } | null>(null);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const textareaRef = useRef<HTMLTextAreaElement>(null);

  // تجميع أزواج Q&A
  const allQAs = useMemo(() => groupQAs(aiConversations), [aiConversations]);

  // تصفية بالبحث
  const filteredQAs = useMemo(() => {
    if (!search.trim()) return allQAs;
    const q = search.trim().toLowerCase();
    return allQAs.filter((qa) => qa.question.toLowerCase().includes(q) || qa.answer.toLowerCase().includes(q));
  }, [allQAs, search]);

  useEffect(() => { textareaRef.current?.focus(); }, []);

  // طرح السؤال على AI
  const askAI = useCallback(async (text: string) => {
    if (!text.trim() || isLoading) return;
    setIsLoading(true);
    setPendingAnswer({ q: text.trim(), a: '' });
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/ai-coach/chat', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ message: text.trim(), history: [] }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error('فشل الاتصال');
      const data = await res.json();
      setPendingAnswer({ q: text.trim(), a: (data.reply as string) || 'لم يتم استلام رد.' });
    } catch {
      setPendingAnswer({ q: text.trim(), a: 'عذراً، حدث خطأ في الاتصال بالمساعد الذكي. 🔄' });
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  }, [isLoading]);

  // حفظ الزوج في المتجر
  const handleSave = useCallback((q: string, a: string) => {
    if (!q.trim()) return;
    addAIConversation({ role: 'user', content: q, context: 'qa' });
    if (a.trim()) {
      addAIConversation({ role: 'assistant', content: a, context: 'qa' });
    }
    setPendingAnswer(null);
    setQuestion('');
    toast({ title: 'تم حفظ السؤال والجواب ✅' });
  }, [addAIConversation]);

  const handleSendClick = () => {
    const text = question.trim();
    if (!text) return;
    setQuestion('');
    askAI(text);
  };

  const handleQuickClick = (q: string) => {
    setQuestion('');
    askAI(q);
  };

  const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
      e.preventDefault();
      handleSendClick();
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-sky-100 dark:bg-sky-900/30 flex items-center justify-center">
          <HelpCircle className="w-5 h-5 text-sky-600 dark:text-sky-400" />
        </div>
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-foreground">نظام الأسئلة والأجوبة</h2>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{allQAs.length} سؤال محفوظ · اسأل أي شيء</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
        {/* Left: Ask + Pending Answer */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-2 space-y-4">
          {/* Question input */}
          <Card className="border border-border">
            <CardContent className="p-4 space-y-3">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 text-sky-500" />
                <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground">اطرح سؤالك</h3>
              </div>
              <Textarea
                ref={textareaRef}
                value={question}
                onChange={(e) => setQuestion(e.target.value)}
                onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
                placeholder="اكتب سؤالك هنا... (Enter للإرسال، Shift+Enter لسطر جديد)"
                disabled={isLoading}
                className="min-h-[80px] resize-none text-sm"
              />
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
                <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">سيُرسل السؤال إلى المساعد الذكي</span>
                <Button onClick={handleSendClick} disabled={!question.trim() || isLoading} className="gap-1.5 bg-sky-600 hover:bg-sky-700">
                  {isLoading ? <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" /> : <Send className="w-4 h-4" />}
                  {isLoading ? 'جارٍ...' : 'إرسال'}
                </Button>
              </div>
              {/* Quick suggestions */}
              <div className="pt-2 border-t border-border">
                <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mb-2">أسئلة سريعة:</p>
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                  {QUICK_QUESTIONS.map((q) => (
                    <button
                      key={q}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => handleQuickClick(q)}
                      disabled={isLoading}
                      className="px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] rounded-full bg-muted/60 hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground text-muted-foreground transition-colors disabled:opacity-50 text-right"
                    >
                      {q}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          {/* Pending answer (live Q&A) */}
          <AnimatePresence>
            {pendingAnswer && (
              <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -8 }}>
                <Card className="border border-sky-200 dark:border-sky-900/40">
                  <CardContent className="p-4 space-y-3">
                    {/* السؤال */}
                    <div className="flex items-start gap-2">
                      <div className="w-7 h-7 rounded-full bg-sky-100 dark:bg-sky-900/30 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                        <User className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-sky-600 dark:text-sky-400" />
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex-1 bg-muted rounded-2xl rounded-tr-sm px-3 py-2 text-sm text-foreground whitespace-pre-wrap">
                        {pendingAnswer.q}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    {/* الجواب */}
                    <div className="flex items-start gap-2">
                      <div className="w-7 h-7 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br from-sky-500 to-indigo-600 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                        <Bot className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-white" />
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex-1 bg-sky-50 dark:bg-sky-900/20 border border-sky-100 dark:border-sky-900/40 rounded-2xl rounded-tl-sm px-3 py-2 text-sm text-foreground whitespace-pre-wrap min-h-[40px]">
                        {isLoading ? (
                          <span className="flex items-center gap-2 text-muted-foreground">
                            <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" /> يفكّر...
                          </span>
                        ) : pendingAnswer.a}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    {/* Actions */}
                    {!isLoading && pendingAnswer.a && (
                      <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 pt-1 border-t border-border">
                        <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" className="h-7 text-xs" onClick={() => setPendingAnswer(null)}>
                          تجاهل
                        </Button>
                        <Button size="sm" className="h-7 text-xs gap-1.5" onClick={() => handleSave(pendingAnswer.q, pendingAnswer.a)}>
                          <Save className="w-3 h-3" /> حفظ السؤال والجواب
                        </Button>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </CardContent>
                </Card>
              </motion.div>
            )}
          </AnimatePresence>
        </div>

        {/* Right: Saved Q&A list */}
        <div className="space-y-4">
          {/* Search */}
          <Card className="border border-border">
            <CardContent className="p-3">
              <div className="relative">
                <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground absolute top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 right-3 pointer-events-none" />
                <Input
                  placeholder="ابحث في الأسئلة المحفوظة..."
                  value={search}
                  onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
                  className="pr-9 text-xs h-9"
                />
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mt-2 px-1">
                <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{filteredQAs.length} نتيجة</span>
                {search && (
                  <button onClick={() => setSearch('')} className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground">مسح</button>
                )}
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          {/* List */}
          <Card className="border border-border">
            <CardContent className="p-0">
              <div className="max-h-[60vh] overflow-y-auto">
                {filteredQAs.length === 0 ? (
                  <div className="p-6 text-center">
                    <HelpCircle className="w-8 h-8 mx-auto mb-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-30" />
                    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      {allQAs.length === 0 ? 'لا توجد أسئلة محفوظة بعد' : 'لا توجد نتائج مطابقة'}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="divide-y divide-border">
                    <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
                      {filteredQAs.map((qa) => (
                        <motion.div
                          key={qa.questionId}
                          layout
                          initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
                          animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
                          exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -20 }}
                          className="p-3 hover:bg-muted/30 transition-colors"
                        >
                          <div className="flex items-start gap-2 mb-1.5">
                            <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-[9px] bg-sky-100 text-sky-700 dark:bg-sky-900/30 dark:text-sky-400 shrink-0">سؤال</Badge>
                            <p className="text-xs font-medium text-foreground flex-1 line-clamp-2">{qa.question}</p>
                          </div>
                          {qa.answer ? (
                            <div className="flex items-start gap-2">
                              <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-[9px] bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-900/30 dark:text-emerald-400 shrink-0">جواب</Badge>
                              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground flex-1 line-clamp-3 whitespace-pre-wrap">{qa.answer}</p>
                            </div>
                          ) : (
                            <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground/70 italic">بلا جواب</p>
                          )}
                          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mt-2 pt-1.5 border-t border-border/50">
                            <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{fmtTime(qa.createdAt)}</span>
                          </div>
                        </motion.div>
                      ))}
                    </AnimatePresence>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

// تتبع الصحة — Health Tracker Section

import { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { Heart, Plus, Trash2, Activity, Droplet, Moon, Zap } from 'lucide-react';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { Slider } from '@/components/ui/slider';
import {
  Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogFooter, DialogDescription,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { useAppStore } from '@/lib/store';
import { toast } from '@/hooks/use-toast';
import type { HealthEntry } from '@/types';

const MOOD_EMOJI = ['', '😞', '😕', '😐', '🙂', '😄'];
const MOOD_LABEL = ['', 'سيء جداً', 'سيء', 'عادي', 'جيد', 'ممتاز'];
const ENERGY_LABEL = ['', 'منهك', 'متعب', 'متوسط', 'نشيط', 'مفعم'];

const today = () => new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

function fmtDate(s: string): string {
  try {
    return new Date(s + 'T12:00:00').toLocaleDateString('ar', { weekday: 'short', day: 'numeric', month: 'short' });
  } catch { return s; }
}

interface HealthForm {
  date: string;
  exercise: string;
  exerciseDuration: string;
  sleepHours: string;
  waterIntake: string;
  meals: string;
  mood: number;
  energyLevel: number;
  notes: string;
}

const emptyForm: HealthForm = {
  date: today(),
  exercise: '',
  exerciseDuration: '30',
  sleepHours: '7',
  waterIntake: '6',
  meals: '',
  mood: 4,
  energyLevel: 4,
  notes: '',
};

// ============ Main ============
export function HealthTrackerSection() {
  const { healthEntries, addHealthEntry, updateHealthEntry, deleteHealthEntry } = useAppStore();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<HealthEntry | null>(null);
  const [form, setForm] = useState<HealthForm>(emptyForm);
  const [confirmDelete, setConfirmDelete] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const sorted = useMemo(
    () => [...healthEntries].sort((a, b) => b.date.localeCompare(a.date)),
    [healthEntries],
  );

  const weekStats = useMemo(() => {
    const now = new Date();
    const weekAgo = new Date(now);
    weekAgo.setDate(weekAgo.getDate() - 7);
    const recent = healthEntries.filter((e) => new Date(e.date) >= weekAgo);
    const n = recent.length || 1;
    const avgSleep = recent.reduce((s, e) => s + e.sleepHours, 0) / n;
    const avgWater = recent.reduce((s, e) => s + e.waterIntake, 0) / n;
    const avgMood = recent.reduce((s, e) => s + e.mood, 0) / n;
    const avgEnergy = recent.reduce((s, e) => s + e.energyLevel, 0) / n;
    return {
      count: recent.length,
      avgSleep,
      avgWater,
      avgMood,
      avgEnergy,
      moodTrend: recent.length > 1 ? recent[0].mood - recent[recent.length - 1].mood : 0,
    };
  }, [healthEntries]);

  // Streak — consecutive days with an entry ending today or yesterday
  const streak = useMemo(() => {
    if (healthEntries.length === 0) return 0;
    const dates = new Set(healthEntries.map((e) => e.date));
    let count = 0;
    const cursor = new Date();
    // Allow starting today or yesterday
    if (!dates.has(cursor.toISOString().slice(0, 10))) {
      cursor.setDate(cursor.getDate() - 1);
      if (!dates.has(cursor.toISOString().slice(0, 10))) return 0;
    }
    while (dates.has(cursor.toISOString().slice(0, 10))) {
      count++;
      cursor.setDate(cursor.getDate() - 1);
    }
    return count;
  }, [healthEntries]);

  // Last 7 days mini chart data (sleep + water)
  const chartData = useMemo(() => {
    const out: Array<{ date: string; sleep: number; water: number; label: string }> = [];
    for (let i = 6; i >= 0; i--) {
      const d = new Date();
      d.setDate(d.getDate() - i);
      const ds = d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
      const entry = healthEntries.find((e) => e.date === ds);
      out.push({
        date: ds,
        sleep: entry?.sleepHours || 0,
        water: entry?.waterIntake || 0,
        label: new Intl.DateTimeFormat('ar-SA', { weekday: 'narrow' }).format(d),
      });
    }
    return out;
  }, [healthEntries]);

  const openAdd = () => { setEditing(null); setForm(emptyForm); setOpen(true); };
  const openEdit = (e: HealthEntry) => {
    setEditing(e);
    setForm({
      date: e.date, exercise: e.exercise, exerciseDuration: String(e.exerciseDuration || ''),
      sleepHours: String(e.sleepHours || ''), waterIntake: String(e.waterIntake || ''),
      meals: (e.meals || []).join('، '), mood: e.mood, energyLevel: e.energyLevel, notes: e.notes,
    });
    setOpen(true);
  };

  const handleSave = () => {
    if (!form.date) { toast({ title: 'التاريخ مطلوب', variant: 'destructive' }); return; }
    const payload = {
      date: form.date,
      exercise: form.exercise.trim(),
      exerciseDuration: Number(form.exerciseDuration) || 0,
      sleepHours: Number(form.sleepHours) || 0,
      waterIntake: Number(form.waterIntake) || 0,
      meals: form.meals.split('،').map((m) => m.trim()).filter(Boolean),
      mood: form.mood,
      energyLevel: form.energyLevel,
      notes: form.notes.trim(),
    };
    if (editing) { updateHealthEntry(editing.id, payload); toast({ title: 'تم تحديث السجل' }); }
    else { addHealthEntry(payload); toast({ title: 'تمت إضافة السجل' }); }
    setOpen(false); setEditing(null); setForm(emptyForm);
  };

  const handleDelete = (id: string) => {
    deleteHealthEntry(id);
    setConfirmDelete(null);
    toast({ title: 'تم حذف السجل' });
  };

  const maxSleep = Math.max(...chartData.map((d) => d.sleep), 8);
  const maxWater = Math.max(...chartData.map((d) => d.water), 8);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-rose-100 dark:bg-rose-900/30 flex items-center justify-center">
            <Heart className="w-5 h-5 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-foreground">تتبع الصحة</h2>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{healthEntries.length} سجل · {streak} يوم متتالي</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <Button size="sm" className="gap-1.5" onClick={openAdd}>
          <Plus className="w-4 h-4" /> سجل اليوم
        </Button>
      </div>

      {/* Weekly Stats */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
        <Card className="border border-border">
          <CardContent className="p-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1">
              <Moon className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-500" />
              <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">متوسط</span>
            </div>
            <p className="text-xl font-bold text-foreground">{weekStats.avgSleep.toFixed(1)}<span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mr-1">س</span></p>
            <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">النوم أسبوعياً</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
        <Card className="border border-border">
          <CardContent className="p-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1">
              <Droplet className="w-4 h-4 text-sky-500" />
              <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">متوسط</span>
            </div>
            <p className="text-xl font-bold text-foreground">{weekStats.avgWater.toFixed(1)}<span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mr-1">كوب</span></p>
            <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">الماء أسبوعياً</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
        <Card className="border border-border">
          <CardContent className="p-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1">
              <span className="text-base">{MOOD_EMOJI[Math.round(weekStats.avgMood)] || '—'}</span>
              <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">اتجاه {weekStats.moodTrend > 0 ? '↑' : weekStats.moodTrend < 0 ? '↓' : '—'}</span>
            </div>
            <p className="text-xl font-bold text-foreground">{weekStats.avgMood.toFixed(1)}<span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mr-1">/5</span></p>
            <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">المزاج أسبوعياً</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
        <Card className="border border-border">
          <CardContent className="p-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1">
              <Zap className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-500" />
              <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">متوسط</span>
            </div>
            <p className="text-xl font-bold text-foreground">{weekStats.avgEnergy.toFixed(1)}<span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mr-1">/5</span></p>
            <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">الطاقة أسبوعياً</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>

      {/* Weekly Bar Charts */}
      <Card className="border border-border">
        <CardContent className="p-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3">
            <Activity className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-500" />
            <h3 className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">آخر 7 أيام</h3>
          </div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            {/* Sleep chart */}
            <div>
              <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mb-2">النوم (ساعات)</p>
              <div className="flex items-end justify-between gap-1 h-24">
                {chartData.map((d) => (
                  <div key={d.date} className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center gap-1 h-full justify-end">
                    <div className="w-full bg-indigo-500/80 dark:bg-indigo-400/80 rounded-t-sm transition-all" style={{ height: `${(d.sleep / maxSleep) * 100}%` }} title={`${d.sleep} س`} />
                    <span className="text-[9px] text-muted-foreground">{d.label}</span>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
            {/* Water chart */}
            <div>
              <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mb-2">الماء (أكواب)</p>
              <div className="flex items-end justify-between gap-1 h-24">
                {chartData.map((d) => (
                  <div key={d.date} className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center gap-1 h-full justify-end">
                    <div className="w-full bg-sky-500/80 dark:bg-sky-400/80 rounded-t-sm transition-all" style={{ height: `${(d.water / maxWater) * 100}%` }} title={`${d.water} كوب`} />
                    <span className="text-[9px] text-muted-foreground">{d.label}</span>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* Entries List */}
      {sorted.length === 0 ? (
        <Card className="border border-border">
          <CardContent className="p-8 text-center">
            <Heart className="w-10 h-10 mx-auto mb-3 text-muted-foreground opacity-40" />

      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
            {sorted.map((e) => (
              <motion.div
                key={e.id}
                layout
                initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }}
                animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -20 }}

                <Card className="border border-border hover:border-border/80 transition-colors">

      <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>

            <DialogDescription>{editing ? 'قم بتعديل بياناتك الصحية' : 'أدخل بياناتك الصحية لليوم'}</DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>
          <div className="space-y-4">

              <div className="space-y-2">

              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>المدة (د)</Label>
                <Input type="number" min={0} value={form.exerciseDuration} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, exerciseDuration: e.target.value })} />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>النوم (س)</Label>
                <Input type="number" min={0} step={0.5} value={form.sleepHours} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, sleepHours: e.target.value })} />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>الماء (كوب)</Label>
                <Input type="number" min={0} value={form.waterIntake} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, waterIntake: e.target.value })} />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>الوجبات</Label>
              <Input placeholder="افصل بين الوجبات بفاصلة ،" value={form.meals} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, meals: e.target.value })} />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>المزاج: {MOOD_LABEL[form.mood]} {MOOD_EMOJI[form.mood]}</Label>
              <Slider value={[form.mood]} min={1} max={5} step={1} onValueChange={(v) => setForm({ ...form, mood: v[0] })} />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>مستوى الطاقة: {ENERGY_LABEL[form.energyLevel]}</Label>
              <Slider value={[form.energyLevel]} min={1} max={5} step={1} onValueChange={(v) => setForm({ ...form, energyLevel: v[0] })} />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>ملاحظات</Label>
              <Textarea placeholder="كيف كان يومك؟" value={form.notes} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, notes: e.target.value })} className="min-h-[60px]" />
            </div>
          </div>
          <DialogFooter>
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>إلغاء</Button>
            <Button onClick={handleSave} disabled={!form.date}>{editing ? 'حفظ' : 'إضافة'}</Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </div>
  );
}
```
