```tsx
'use client';

// السجلات الطبية — Medical Records Section

import { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { Stethoscope, Plus, Pencil, Trash2, Search, Calendar, User, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import {
  Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogFooter, DialogDescription,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import {
  Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue,
} from '@/components/ui/select';
import { useAppStore } from '@/lib/store';
import { toast } from '@/hooks/use-toast';
import type { MedicalRecord } from '@/types';

const RECORD_TYPES: Array<{ value: string; label: string; cls: string }> = [
  { value: 'checkup', label: 'فحص دوري', cls: 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-900/30 dark:text-emerald-400' },
  { value: 'diagnosis', label: 'تشخيص', cls: 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-900/30 dark:text-amber-400' },
  { value: 'surgery', label: 'عملية', cls: 'bg-red-100 text-red-700 dark:bg-red-900/30 dark:text-red-400' },
  { value: 'test', label: 'تحليل', cls: 'bg-sky-100 text-sky-700 dark:bg-sky-900/30 dark:text-sky-400' },
  { value: 'vaccination', label: 'تطعيم', cls: 'bg-teal-100 text-teal-700 dark:bg-teal-900/30 dark:text-teal-400' },
  { value: 'prescription', label: 'وصفة', cls: 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-700 dark:bg-purple-900/30 dark:text-purple-400' },
  { value: 'other', label: 'أخرى', cls: 'bg-muted text-muted-foreground' },
];

const FILTER_TABS: Array<{ value: string; label: string }> = [
  { value: 'all', label: 'الكل' },
  ...RECORD_TYPES.map((t) => ({ value: t.value, label: t.label })),
];

const today = () => new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

function fmtDate(s: string): string {
  if (!s) return '';
  try { return new Date(s).toLocaleDateString('ar', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' }); }
  catch { return s; }
}

function typeMeta(v: string) {
  return RECORD_TYPES.find((t) => t.value === v) || RECORD_TYPES[RECORD_TYPES.length - 1];
}

interface MedForm {
  title: string; type: string; date: string;
  doctorName: string; hospital: string; diagnosis: string;
  notes: string; nextAppointment: string;
}
const emptyForm: MedForm = {
  title: '', type: 'checkup', date: today(),
  doctorName: '', hospital: '', diagnosis: '', notes: '', nextAppointment: '',
};

export function MedicalRecordsSection() {
  const { medicalRecords, addMedicalRecord, updateMedicalRecord, deleteMedicalRecord } = useAppStore();
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState('all');
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<MedicalRecord | null>(null);
  const [form, setForm] = useState<MedForm>(emptyForm);
  const [confirmDelete, setConfirmDelete] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    return [...medicalRecords]
      .filter((r) => filter === 'all' || r.type === filter)
      .filter((r) => !q ||
        r.title.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        r.doctorName.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        r.hospital.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        r.diagnosis.toLowerCase().includes(q))
      .sort((a, b) => b.date.localeCompare(a.date));
  }, [medicalRecords, filter, query]);

  // Upcoming appointments
  const upcoming = useMemo(() => {
    const t = today();
    return medicalRecords
      .filter((r) => r.nextAppointment && r.nextAppointment >= t)
      .sort((a, b) => a.nextAppointment.localeCompare(b.nextAppointment));
  }, [medicalRecords]);

  const openAdd = () => { setEditing(null); setForm(emptyForm); setOpen(true); };
  const openEdit = (r: MedicalRecord) => {
    setEditing(r);
    setForm({
      title: r.title, type: r.type, date: r.date, doctorName: r.doctorName,
      hospital: r.hospital, diagnosis: r.diagnosis, notes: r.notes,
      nextAppointment: r.nextAppointment,
    });
    setOpen(true);
  };

  const handleSave = () => {
    if (!form.title.trim()) { toast({ title: 'العنوان مطلوب', variant: 'destructive' }); return; }
    const payload = {
      title: form.title.trim(),
      type: form.type,
      date: form.date,
      doctorName: form.doctorName.trim(),
      hospital: form.hospital.trim(),
      diagnosis: form.diagnosis.trim(),
      prescriptions: [] as string[],
      testResults: [] as string[],
      fileUrl: '',
      notes: form.notes.trim(),
      nextAppointment: form.nextAppointment,
    };
    if (editing) { updateMedicalRecord(editing.id, payload); toast({ title: 'تم تحديث السجل' }); }
    else { addMedicalRecord(payload); toast({ title: 'تمت إضافة السجل' }); }
    setOpen(false); setEditing(null); setForm(emptyForm);
  };

  const handleDelete = (id: string) => {
    deleteMedicalRecord(id);
    setConfirmDelete(null);
    toast({ title: 'تم حذف السجل' });
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-teal-100 dark:bg-teal-900/30 flex items-center justify-center">
            <Stethoscope className="w-5 h-5 text-teal-600 dark:text-teal-400" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-foreground">السجلات الطبية</h2>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{medicalRecords.length} سجل طبي</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <Button size="sm" className="gap-1.5" onClick={openAdd}>
          <Plus className="w-4 h-4" /> سجل جديد
        </Button>
      </div>

      {/* Upcoming Appointments Alert */}
      {upcoming.length > 0 && (
        <Card className="border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-900/50 bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/20">
          <CardContent className="p-4">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
              <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400" />
              <h3 className="text-sm font-medium text-amber-900 dark:text-amber-200">مواعيد قادمة ({upcoming.length})</h3>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              {upcoming.slice(0, 3).map((r) => (
                <div key={r.id} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs">
                  <span className="text-foreground truncate">{r.title}</span>
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300 shrink-0">
                    <Calendar className="w-3 h-3" />{fmtDate(r.nextAppointment)}
                  </span>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}

      {/* Search + Filter */}
      <div className="space-y-3">
        <div className="relative">
          <Search className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />
          <Input placeholder="ابحث بالعنوان أو الطبيب أو المستشفى..." value={query} onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)} className="pr-9" />
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          {FILTER_TABS.map((tab) => {
            const count = tab.value === 'all'
              ? medicalRecords.length
              : medicalRecords.filter((r) => r.type === tab.value).length;
            const isActive = filter === tab.value;
            return (
              <Button key={tab.value} variant={isActive ? 'default' : 'outline'} size="sm"
                onClick={() => setFilter(tab.value)}
                className={isActive ? 'bg-gray-900 text-white hover:bg-gray-800' : 'border-border text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground'}>
                {tab.label}
                <Badge variant="secondary" className={`mr-1 text-[10px] px-1.5 ${isActive ? 'bg-white/20 text-white' : 'bg-muted text-muted-foreground'}`}>{count}</Badge>
              </Button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Records List */}
      {filtered.length === 0 ? (
        <Card className="border border-border">
          <CardContent className="p-8 text-center">
            <Stethoscope className="w-10 h-10 mx-auto mb-3 text-muted-foreground opacity-40" />
            <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm">{medicalRecords.length === 0 ? 'لا توجد سجلات طبية بعد' : 'لا توجد نتائج مطابقة'}</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-2">
          <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
            {filtered.map((r) => {
              const tm = typeMeta(r.type);
              return (
                <motion.div key={r.id} layout initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.96 }}>
                  <Card className="border border-border hover:border-border/80 transition-colors h-full">
                    <CardContent className="p-4 space-y-2">
                      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                          <h3 className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground line-clamp-1">{r.title}</h3>
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-0.5">
                            <Badge className={`text-[10px] ${tm.cls}`}>{tm.label}</Badge>
                            <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1">
                              <Calendar className="w-3 h-3" />{fmtDate(r.date)}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex gap-0.5 shrink-0">
                          <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground" onClick={() => openEdit(r)} aria-label="تعديل">
                            <Pencil className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </Button>
                          <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7 text-muted-foreground hover:text-red-500" onClick={() => setConfirmDelete(r.id)} aria-label="حذف">
                            <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </Button>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {r.diagnosis && (
                        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground line-clamp-2">
                          <span className="font-medium text-foreground">التشخيص: </span>{r.diagnosis}
                        </p>
                      )}

                      {(r.doctorName || r.hospital) && (
                        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-x-3 gap-y-1 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                          {r.doctorName && (
                            <span className="flex items-center gap-1"><User className="w-3 h-3" />{r.doctorName}</span>
                          )}
                          {r.hospital && <span className="line-clamp-1">🏥 {r.hospital}</span>}
                        </div>
                      )}

                      {r.prescriptions.length > 0 && (
                        <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground line-clamp-1">💊 {r.prescriptions.join('، ')}</p>
                      )}

                      {r.nextAppointment && (
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400">
                          <Calendar className="w-3 h-3" />الموعد القادم: {fmtDate(r.nextAppointment)}
                        </div>
                      )}

                      {r.notes && (
                        <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground line-clamp-2 border-t border-border pt-2">{r.notes}</p>
                      )}

                      <AnimatePresence>
                        {confirmDelete === r.id && (
                          <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, height: 'auto' }} exit={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
                            className="pt-2 border-t border-border">
                            <p className="text-xs text-red-500 mb-2">هل تريد حذف هذا السجل؟</p>
                            <div className="flex gap-2">
                              <Button size="sm" variant="destructive" className="h-7 text-xs" onClick={() => handleDelete(r.id)}>حذف</Button>
                              <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="h-7 text-xs" onClick={() => setConfirmDelete(null)}>إلغاء</Button>
                            </div>
                          </motion.div>
                        )}
                      </AnimatePresence>
                    </CardContent>
                  </Card>
                </motion.div>
              );
            })}
          </AnimatePresence>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Add/Edit Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="max-w-lg" dir="rtl">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>{editing ? 'تعديل السجل' : 'سجل طبي جديد'}</DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>{editing ? 'قم بتعديل بيانات السجل' : 'أدخل بيانات السجل الطبي'}</DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>العنوان *</Label>
              <Input placeholder="مثال: فحص الدم الشامل" value={form.title} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, title: e.target.value })} />
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>النوع</Label>
                <Select value={form.type} onValueChange={(v) => setForm({ ...form, type: v })}>
                  <SelectTrigger><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectContent>
                    {RECORD_TYPES.map((t) => <SelectItem key={t.value} value={t.value}>{t.label}</SelectItem>)}
                  </SelectContent>
                </Select>
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>التاريخ</Label>
                <Input type="date" value={form.date} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, date: e.target.value })} />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>اسم الطبيب</Label>
                <Input placeholder="د. ..." value={form.doctorName} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, doctorName: e.target.value })} />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>المستشفى/العيادة</Label>
                <Input placeholder="مثال: مستشفى الرعاية" value={form.hospital} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, hospital: e.target.value })} />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>التشخيص</Label>
              <Textarea placeholder="التشخيص الطبي..." value={form.diagnosis} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, diagnosis: e.target.value })} className="min-h-[60px]" />
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>الموعد القادم</Label>
                <Input type="date" value={form.nextAppointment} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, nextAppointment: e.target.value })} />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>ملاحظات</Label>
              <Textarea placeholder="ملاحظات إضافية..." value={form.notes} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, notes: e.target.value })} className="min-h-[60px]" />
            </div>
          </div>
          <DialogFooter>
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>إلغاء</Button>
            <Button onClick={handleSave} disabled={!form.title.trim()}>{editing ? 'حفظ' : 'إضافة'}</Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

// الأهداف الشخصية — Personal Goals Section

import { useState, useMemo } from 'react';

} from '@/components/ui/select';

const CATEGORIES: Array<{ value: string; label: string; cls: string }> = [

  { value: 'education', label: 'تعليمي', cls: 'bg-sky-100 text-sky-700 dark:bg-sky-900/30 dark:text-sky-400' },
  { value: 'health', label: 'صحي', cls: 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-700 dark:bg-rose-900/30 dark:text-rose-400' },
  { value: 'financial', label: 'مالي', cls: 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-900/30 dark:text-amber-400' },
  { value: 'personal', label: 'شخصي', cls: 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-700 dark:bg-purple-900/30 dark:text-purple-400' },
  { value: 'spiritual', label: 'روحاني', cls: 'bg-teal-100 text-teal-700 dark:bg-teal-900/30 dark:text-teal-400' },
];

const TIMEFRAMES: Array<{ value: string; label: string }> = [
  { value: 'short', label: 'قصير المدى (≤3 أشهر)' },
  { value: 'medium', label: 'متوسط المدى (3-12 شهر)' },
  { value: 'long', label: 'طويل المدى (>سنة)' },
];

const STATUS_CLS: Record<string, string> = {
  active: 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-900/30 dark:text-emerald-400',
  completed: 'bg-sky-100 text-sky-700 dark:bg-sky-900/30 dark:text-sky-400',
  paused: 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-900/30 dark:text-amber-400',
};

const FILTER_TABS: Array<{ value: string; label: string }> = [
  { value: 'all', label: 'الكل' },
  ...CATEGORIES.map((c) => ({ value: c.value, label: c.label })),
];

const today = () => new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

function fmtDate(s: string): string {
  if (!s) return '';
  try { return new Date(s).toLocaleDateString('ar', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' }); }
  catch { return s; }
}

function catMeta(v: string) {
  return CATEGORIES.find((c) => c.value === v) || CATEGORIES[4];
}

interface GoalForm {
  title: string; description: string; category: string;
  timeframe: string; targetDate: string; progress: number;
  notes: string;
}
const emptyForm: GoalForm = {
  title: '', description: '', category: 'personal',
  timeframe: 'short', targetDate: '', progress: 0, notes: '',
};

export function PersonalGoalsSection() {
  const { personalGoals, addPersonalGoal, updatePersonalGoal, deletePersonalGoal } = useAppStore();
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState('all');
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<PersonalGoal | null>(null);
  const [form, setForm] = useState<GoalForm>(emptyForm);
  const [confirmDelete, setConfirmDelete] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    return [...personalGoals]
      .filter((g) => filter === 'all' || g.category === filter)
      .filter((g) => !q || g.title.toLowerCase().includes(q) || g.description.toLowerCase().includes(q))
      .sort((a, b) => {
        // Active first, then by target date
        if (a.status !== b.status) return a.status === 'active' ? -1 : 1;
        return (a.targetDate || '9999').localeCompare(b.targetDate || '9999');
      });
  }, [personalGoals, filter, query]);

  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    const total = personalGoals.length;
    const completed = personalGoals.filter((g) => g.status === 'completed' || g.progress >= 100).length;
    const active = personalGoals.filter((g) => g.status === 'active').length;
    const avgProgress = total > 0 ? Math.round(personalGoals.reduce((s, g) => s + g.progress, 0) / total) : 0;
    return { total, completed, active, avgProgress };
  }, [personalGoals]);

      if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id); else next.add(id);
      return next;
    });
  };

  const openAdd = () => { setEditing(null); setForm(emptyForm); setOpen(true); };

    });
    setOpen(true);

  const handleSave = () => {
    if (!form.title.trim()) { toast({ title: 'العنوان مطلوب', variant: 'destructive' }); return; }
    const status = form.progress >= 100 ? 'completed' : 'active';
    const payload = {
      title: form.title.trim(),
      description: form.description.trim(),
      category: form.category,
      timeframe: form.timeframe,
      targetDate: form.targetDate,
      progress: form.progress,
      status,
      notes: form.notes.trim(),

    if (editing) { updatePersonalGoal(editing.id, payload); toast({ title: 'تم تحديث الهدف' }); }
    else {
      addPersonalGoal({ ...payload, milestones: [] });
      toast({ title: 'تمت إضافة الهدف' });
    }
    setOpen(false); setEditing(null); setForm(emptyForm);
  };

  const handleDelete = (id: string) => {
    deletePersonalGoal(id);
    setConfirmDelete(null);
    toast({ title: 'تم حذف الهدف' });
  };

  const toggleMilestone = (g: PersonalGoal, idx: number) => {
    const milestones = g.milestones.map((m, i) => i === idx ? { ...m, completed: !m.completed } : m);
    const completed = milestones.filter((m) => m.completed).length;
    const progress = milestones.length > 0 ? Math.round((completed / milestones.length) * 100) : g.progress;
    const status = progress >= 100 ? 'completed' : 'active';
    updatePersonalGoal(g.id, { milestones, progress, status });
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">

      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-900/30 flex items-center justify-center">
            <Target className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-foreground">الأهداف الشخصية</h2>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{stats.active} نشط · {stats.completed} مكتمل</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <Button size="sm" className="gap-1.5" onClick={openAdd}>
          <Plus className="w-4 h-4" /> هدف جديد
        </Button>
      </div>

      {/* Stats */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
        <Card className="border border-border"><CardContent className="p-4 text-center">
          <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">{stats.total}</p>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">إجمالي الأهداف</p>
        </CardContent></Card>
        <Card className="border border-border"><CardContent className="p-4 text-center">
          <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">{stats.completed}</p>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">مكتملة</p>
        </CardContent></Card>
        <Card className="border border-border"><CardContent className="p-4 text-center">
          <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">{stats.avgProgress}%</p>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">متوسط التقدم</p>
        </CardContent></Card>
      </div>

      {/* Search + Filter */}
      <div className="space-y-3">
        <div className="relative">
          <Search className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />
          <Input placeholder="ابحث عن هدف..." value={query} onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)} className="pr-9" />
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          {FILTER_TABS.map((tab) => {
            const count = tab.value === 'all' ? personalGoals.length : personalGoals.filter((g) => g.category === tab.value).length;
            const isActive = filter === tab.value;
            return (
              <Button key={tab.value} variant={isActive ? 'default' : 'outline'} size="sm"
                onClick={() => setFilter(tab.value)}
                className={isActive ? 'bg-gray-900 text-white hover:bg-gray-800' : 'border-border text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground'}>
                {tab.label}
                <Badge variant="secondary" className={`mr-1 text-[10px] px-1.5 ${isActive ? 'bg-white/20 text-white' : 'bg-muted text-muted-foreground'}`}>{count}</Badge>
              </Button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Goals Grid */}
      {filtered.length === 0 ? (
        <Card className="border border-border"><CardContent className="p-8 text-center">
          <Target className="w-10 h-10 mx-auto mb-3 text-muted-foreground opacity-40" />
          <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm">{personalGoals.length === 0 ? 'لا توجد أهداف بعد' : 'لا توجد نتائج مطابقة'}</p>
        </CardContent></Card>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-2">
          <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
            {filtered.map((g) => {
              const cm = catMeta(g.category);
              const isExpanded = expanded.has(g.id);
              const completedMs = g.milestones.filter((m) => m.completed).length;
              return (
                <motion.div key={g.id} layout initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.96 }}>
                  <Card className="border border-border hover:border-border/80 transition-colors h-full">
                    <CardContent className="p-4 space-y-3">
                      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                        <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                          <h3 className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground line-clamp-1">{g.title}</h3>
                          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 mt-1">
                            <Badge className={`text-[10px] ${cm.cls}`}>{cm.label}</Badge>
                            <Badge className={`text-[10px] ${STATUS_CLS[g.status] || 'bg-muted text-muted-foreground'}`}>
                              {g.status === 'completed' ? 'مكتمل' : g.status === 'paused' ? 'متوقف' : 'نشط'}
                            </Badge>
                            {g.targetDate && (
                              <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1">
                                <Clock className="w-3 h-3" />{fmtDate(g.targetDate)}
                              </span>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex gap-0.5 shrink-0">
                          <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground" onClick={() => openEdit(g)} aria-label="تعديل">
                            <Pencil className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </Button>
                          <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7 text-muted-foreground hover:text-red-500" onClick={() => setConfirmDelete(g.id)} aria-label="حذف">
                            <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </Button>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {g.description && <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground line-clamp-2">{g.description}</p>}

                      {/* Progress bar */}
                      <div>
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1">
                          <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">التقدم</span>
                          <span className="text-[11px] font-medium text-foreground">{g.progress}%</span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="h-2 bg-muted rounded-full overflow-hidden">
                          <motion.div
                            className={`h-full rounded-full ${g.progress >= 100 ? 'bg-emerald-500' : 'bg-primary'}`}
                            initial={{ width: 0 }} animate={{ width: `${g.progress}%` }} transition={{ duration: 0.4 }}
                          />
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {/* Expand for milestones */}
                      {g.milestones.length > 0 && (
                        <Collapsible open={isExpanded} onOpenChange={() => toggleExpand(g.id)}>
                          <CollapsibleTrigger asChild>
                            <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" className="w-full h-7 text-xs gap-1.5">
                              <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              المحطات ({completedMs}/{g.milestones.length})
                            </Button>
                          </CollapsibleTrigger>
                          <CollapsibleContent>
                            <div className="space-y-1.5 pt-2 border-t border-border mt-1">
                              {g.milestones.map((m, i) => (
                                <div key={i} className="flex items-center gap-2">
                                  <Checkbox
                                    id={`ms-${g.id}-${i}`} checked={m.completed}
                                    onCheckedChange={() => toggleMilestone(g, i)}
                                    className="data-[state=checked]:bg-emerald-500 data-[state=checked]:border-emerald-500"
                                  />
                                  <Label htmlFor={`ms-${g.id}-${i}`} className={`text-xs flex-1 cursor-pointer ${m.completed ? 'line-through text-muted-foreground' : 'text-foreground'}`}>
                                    {m.title}
                                  </Label>
                                  {m.date && <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{fmtDate(m.date)}</span>}
                                </div>
                              ))}
                            </div>
                          </CollapsibleContent>
                        </Collapsible>
                      )}

                      {g.notes && !isExpanded && <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground line-clamp-1">📝 {g.notes}</p>}

                      <AnimatePresence>
                        {confirmDelete === g.id && (
                          <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, height: 'auto' }} exit={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
                            className="pt-2 border-t border-border">
                            <p className="text-xs text-red-500 mb-2">هل تريد حذف هذا الهدف؟</p>
                            <div className="flex gap-2">
                              <Button size="sm" variant="destructive" className="h-7 text-xs" onClick={() => handleDelete(g.id)}>حذف</Button>
                              <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="h-7 text-xs" onClick={() => setConfirmDelete(null)}>إلغاء</Button>
                            </div>
                          </motion.div>
                        )}
                      </AnimatePresence>
                    </CardContent>
                  </Card>
                </motion.div>
              );
            })}
          </AnimatePresence>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Add/Edit Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="max-w-lg" dir="rtl">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>{editing ? 'تعديل الهدف' : 'هدف جديد'}</DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>{editing ? 'قم بتعديل بيانات الهدف' : 'حدد هدفاً جديداً لتحقيقه'}</DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>العنوان *</Label>
              <Input placeholder="مثال: تعلم لغة جديدة" value={form.title} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, title: e.target.value })} />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>الوصف</Label>
              <Textarea placeholder="وصف الهدف..." value={form.description} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, description: e.target.value })} className="min-h-[60px]" />
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>الفئة</Label>
                <Select value={form.category} onValueChange={(v) => setForm({ ...form, category: v })}>
                  <SelectTrigger><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectContent>
                    {CATEGORIES.map((c) => <SelectItem key={c.value} value={c.value}>{c.label}</SelectItem>)}
                  </SelectContent>
                </Select>
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>الإطار الزمني</Label>
                <Select value={form.timeframe} onValueChange={(v) => setForm({ ...form, timeframe: v })}>
                  <SelectTrigger><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectContent>
                    {TIMEFRAMES.map((t) => <SelectItem key={t.value} value={t.value}>{t.label}</SelectItem>)}
                  </SelectContent>
                </Select>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>التاريخ المستهدف</Label>
              <Input type="date" value={form.targetDate} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, targetDate: e.target.value })} />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>التقدم: {form.progress}%</Label>
              <Slider value={[form.progress]} min={0} max={100} step={5} onValueChange={(v) => setForm({ ...form, progress: v[0] })} />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>ملاحظات</Label>
              <Textarea placeholder="ملاحظات إضافية..." value={form.notes} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, notes: e.target.value })} className="min-h-[50px]" />
            </div>
          </div>
          <DialogFooter>
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>إلغاء</Button>
            <Button onClick={handleSave} disabled={!form.title.trim()}>{editing ? 'حفظ' : 'إضافة'}</Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

// تتبع القراءة — Reading Tracker Section

import { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { BookOpen, Plus, Pencil, Trash2, Search, Star, CheckCircle2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import {
  Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogFooter, DialogDescription,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import {
  Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue,
} from '@/components/ui/select';
import { useAppStore } from '@/lib/store';
import { toast } from '@/hooks/use-toast';
import type { ReadingItem } from '@/types';

const ITEM_TYPES: Array<{ value: string; label: string; emoji: string }> = [
  { value: 'book', label: 'كتاب', emoji: '📖' },
  { value: 'article', label: 'مقال', emoji: '📰' },
  { value: 'paper', label: 'بحث', emoji: '📄' },
  { value: 'documentation', label: 'توثيق', emoji: '📚' },
  { value: 'blog', label: 'مدونة', emoji: '✍️' },
  { value: 'other', label: 'أخرى', emoji: '🔖' },
];

const STATUSES: Array<{ value: string; label: string; cls: string }> = [
  { value: 'reading', label: 'قيد القراءة', cls: 'bg-sky-100 text-sky-700 dark:bg-sky-900/30 dark:text-sky-400' },
  { value: 'completed', label: 'مكتمل', cls: 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-900/30 dark:text-emerald-400' },
  { value: 'planned', label: 'مخطط', cls: 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-900/30 dark:text-amber-400' },
  { value: 'paused', label: 'متوقف', cls: 'bg-muted text-muted-foreground' },
];

const FILTER_TABS: Array<{ value: string; label: string }> = [
  { value: 'all', label: 'الكل' },
  ...ITEM_TYPES.map((t) => ({ value: t.value, label: t.label })),
];

const STATUS_TABS: Array<{ value: string; label: string }> = [
  { value: 'all', label: 'الكل' },
  ...STATUSES.map((s) => ({ value: s.value, label: s.label })),
];

const today = () => new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

function fmtDate(s: string): string {
  if (!s) return '';
  try { return new Date(s).toLocaleDateString('ar', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' }); }
  catch { return s; }
}

function typeMeta(v: string) { return ITEM_TYPES.find((t) => t.value === v) || ITEM_TYPES[5]; }
function statusMeta(v: string) { return STATUSES.find((s) => s.value === v) || STATUSES[0]; }

interface ReadForm {
  title: string; author: string; type: string; status: string;
  startDate: string; endDate: string; currentPage: string; totalPages: string;
  rating: number; notes: string; url: string;
}
const emptyForm: ReadForm = {
  title: '', author: '', type: 'book', status: 'planned',
  startDate: today(), endDate: '', currentPage: '0', totalPages: '0',
  rating: 0, notes: '', url: '',
};

function StarRating({ value, onChange, size = 14 }: { value: number; onChange?: (v: number) => void; size?: number }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5" dir="ltr">
      {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((n) => (
        <button key={n} type="button" disabled={!onChange}
          onClick={() => onChange?.(n === value ? 0 : n)}
          className={`${onChange ? 'cursor-pointer' : 'cursor-default'} ${n <= value ? 'text-amber-500' : 'text-muted-foreground/40'}`}
          aria-label={`${n} نجوم`}>
          <Star className={size === 14 ? 'w-3.5 h-3.5' : 'w-4 h-4'} fill={n <= value ? 'currentColor' : 'none'} />
        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

function FilterRow({ label, tabs, active, onChange, items }: {
  label: string; tabs: Array<{ value: string; label: string }>; active: string;
  onChange: (v: string) => void; items: ReadingItem[];
}) {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
      <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground ml-1">{label}:</span>
      {tabs.map((tab) => {
        const count = tab.value === 'all' ? items.length : items.filter((r) => r.type === tab.value || r.status === tab.value).length;
        const isActive = active === tab.value;
        return (
          <Button key={tab.value} variant={isActive ? 'default' : 'outline'} size="sm"
            onClick={() => onChange(tab.value)}
            className={`h-7 text-xs ${isActive ? 'bg-gray-900 text-white hover:bg-gray-800' : 'border-border text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground'}`}>
            {tab.label}
            <Badge variant="secondary" className={`mr-1 text-[10px] px-1.5 ${isActive ? 'bg-white/20 text-white' : 'bg-muted text-muted-foreground'}`}>{count}</Badge>
          </Button>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

export function ReadingTrackerSection() {
  const { readingItems, addReadingItem, updateReadingItem, deleteReadingItem } = useAppStore();
  const [filterType, setFilterType] = useState('all');
  const [filterStatus, setFilterStatus] = useState('all');
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<ReadingItem | null>(null);
  const [form, setForm] = useState<ReadForm>(emptyForm);
  const [confirmDelete, setConfirmDelete] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
    return [...readingItems]
      .filter((r) => filterType === 'all' || r.type === filterType)
      .filter((r) => filterStatus === 'all' || r.status === filterStatus)
      .filter((r) => !q || r.title.toLowerCase().includes(q) || r.author.toLowerCase().includes(q))
      .sort((a, b) => b.updatedAt.localeCompare(a.updatedAt));
  }, [readingItems, filterType, filterStatus, query]);

  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    const total = readingItems.length;
    const completed = readingItems.filter((r) => r.status === 'completed').length;
    const reading = readingItems.filter((r) => r.status === 'reading').length;
    const totalPages = readingItems.filter((r) => r.status === 'completed').reduce((s, r) => s + (r.totalPages || 0), 0);
    return { total, completed, reading, totalPages };
  }, [readingItems]);

  const openAdd = () => { setEditing(null); setForm(emptyForm); setOpen(true); };
  const openEdit = (r: ReadingItem) => {
    setEditing(r);
    setForm({
      title: r.title, author: r.author, type: r.type, status: r.status,
      startDate: r.startDate, endDate: r.endDate, currentPage: String(r.currentPage),
      totalPages: String(r.totalPages), rating: r.rating, notes: r.notes, url: r.url,
    });
    setOpen(true);
  };

  const handleSave = () => {
    if (!form.title.trim()) { toast({ title: 'العنوان مطلوب', variant: 'destructive' }); return; }
    const currentPage = Number(form.currentPage) || 0;
    const totalPages = Number(form.totalPages) || 0;
    const progress = totalPages > 0 ? Math.min(100, Math.round((currentPage / totalPages) * 100)) : 0;
    const status = form.status === 'completed' || (totalPages > 0 && currentPage >= totalPages && currentPage > 0) ? 'completed' : form.status;
    const endDate = status === 'completed' && !form.endDate ? today() : form.endDate;
    const payload = {
      title: form.title.trim(),
      author: form.author.trim(),
      type: form.type,
      status,
      startDate: form.startDate,
      endDate,
      currentPage,
      totalPages,
      progress,
      rating: form.rating,
      notes: form.notes.trim(),
      url: form.url.trim(),
      tags: [] as string[],
    };
    if (editing) { updateReadingItem(editing.id, payload); toast({ title: 'تم تحديث العنصر' }); }
    else { addReadingItem(payload); toast({ title: 'تمت إضافة العنصر' }); }
    setOpen(false); setEditing(null); setForm(emptyForm);
  };

  const handleDelete = (id: string) => {
    deleteReadingItem(id);
    setConfirmDelete(null);
    toast({ title: 'تم حذف العنصر' });
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-900/30 flex items-center justify-center">
            <BookOpen className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-foreground">تتبع القراءة</h2>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{stats.reading} قيد القراءة · {stats.completed} مكتمل</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <Button size="sm" className="gap-1.5" onClick={openAdd}>
          <Plus className="w-4 h-4" /> عنصر جديد
        </Button>
      </div>

      {/* Stats */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
        <Card className="border border-border"><CardContent className="p-4 text-center">
          <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">{stats.total}</p>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">إجمالي العناصر</p>
        </CardContent></Card>
        <Card className="border border-border"><CardContent className="p-4 text-center">
          <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">{stats.completed}</p>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">مكتمل</p>
        </CardContent></Card>
        <Card className="border border-border"><CardContent className="p-4 text-center">
          <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">{stats.totalPages}</p>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">صفحات مقروءة</p>
        </CardContent></Card>
      </div>

      {/* Search + Filters */}
      <div className="space-y-3">
        <div className="relative">
          <Search className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />
          <Input placeholder="ابحث بالعنوان أو المؤلف..." value={query} onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)} className="pr-9" />
        </div>
        <FilterRow label="النوع" tabs={FILTER_TABS} active={filterType} onChange={setFilterType} items={readingItems} />
        <FilterRow label="الحالة" tabs={STATUS_TABS} active={filterStatus} onChange={setFilterStatus} items={readingItems} />
      </div>

      {/* Reading Grid */}
      {filtered.length === 0 ? (
        <Card className="border border-border"><CardContent className="p-8 text-center">
          <BookOpen className="w-10 h-10 mx-auto mb-3 text-muted-foreground opacity-40" />
          <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm">{readingItems.length === 0 ? 'لا توجد عناصر للقراءة بعد' : 'لا توجد نتائج مطابقة'}</p>
        </CardContent></Card>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
          <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
            {filtered.map((r) => {
              const tm = typeMeta(r.type);
              const sm = statusMeta(r.status);
              return (
                <motion.div key={r.id} layout initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.96 }}>
                  <Card className="border border-border hover:border-border/80 transition-colors h-full flex flex-col">
                    <CardContent className="p-4 space-y-2 flex-1 flex flex-col">
                      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                        <div className="flex items-start gap-2 min-w-0 flex-1">
                          <span className="text-xl shrink-0">{tm.emoji}</span>
                          <div className="min-w-0">
                            <h3 className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground line-clamp-1">{r.title}</h3>
                            {r.author && <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground line-clamp-1">{r.author}</p>}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex gap-0.5 shrink-0">
                          <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground" onClick={() => openEdit(r)} aria-label="تعديل">
                            <Pencil className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </Button>
                          <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7 text-muted-foreground hover:text-red-500" onClick={() => setConfirmDelete(r.id)} aria-label="حذف">
                            <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </Button>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
                        <Badge className={`text-[10px] ${sm.cls}`}>{sm.label}</Badge>
                        <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-[10px] bg-muted text-muted-foreground">{tm.label}</Badge>
                        {r.rating > 0 && <StarRating value={r.rating} />}
                      </div>

                      {/* Progress */}
                      {r.totalPages > 0 && (
                        <div className="space-y-1 mt-auto">
                          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px]">
                            <span className="text-muted-foreground">{r.currentPage} / {r.totalPages} صفحة</span>
                            <span className="font-medium text-foreground">{r.progress}%</span>
                          </div>
                          <div className="h-1.5 bg-muted rounded-full overflow-hidden">
                            <motion.div
                              className={`h-full rounded-full ${r.progress >= 100 ? 'bg-emerald-500' : 'bg-primary'}`}
                              initial={{ width: 0 }} animate={{ width: `${r.progress}%` }} transition={{ duration: 0.4 }}
                            />
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      )}

                      {r.tags.length > 0 && (
                        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1 pt-1">
                          {r.tags.slice(0, 3).map((t, i) => (
                            <span key={i} className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-muted text-muted-foreground">#{t}</span>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      )}

                      {r.status === 'completed' && r.endDate && (
                        <p className="text-[10px] text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 flex items-center gap-1 pt-1 border-t border-border">
                          <CheckCircle2 className="w-3 h-3" />أُكمل في {fmtDate(r.endDate)}
                        </p>
                      )}

                      <AnimatePresence>
                        {confirmDelete === r.id && (
                          <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, height: 'auto' }} exit={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
                            className="pt-2 border-t border-border">
                            <p className="text-xs text-red-500 mb-2">هل تريد حذف هذا العنصر؟</p>
                            <div className="flex gap-2">
                              <Button size="sm" variant="destructive" className="h-7 text-xs" onClick={() => handleDelete(r.id)}>حذف</Button>
                              <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="h-7 text-xs" onClick={() => setConfirmDelete(null)}>إلغاء</Button>
                            </div>
                          </motion.div>
                        )}
                      </AnimatePresence>
                    </CardContent>
                  </Card>
                </motion.div>
              );
            })}
          </AnimatePresence>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Add/Edit Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="max-w-lg" dir="rtl">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>{editing ? 'تعديل العنصر' : 'عنصر قراءة جديد'}</DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>{editing ? 'قم بتعديل بيانات العنصر' : 'أضف كتاباً أو مقالاً لقائمة قراءتك'}</DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>العنوان *</Label>
              <Input placeholder="مثال: فن البرمجة" value={form.title} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, title: e.target.value })} />
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>المؤلف</Label>
                <Input placeholder="اسم المؤلف" value={form.author} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, author: e.target.value })} />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>النوع</Label>
                <Select value={form.type} onValueChange={(v) => setForm({ ...form, type: v })}>
                  <SelectTrigger><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectContent>
                    {ITEM_TYPES.map((t) => <SelectItem key={t.value} value={t.value}>{t.emoji} {t.label}</SelectItem>)}
                  </SelectContent>
                </Select>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>الحالة</Label>
                <Select value={form.status} onValueChange={(v) => setForm({ ...form, status: v })}>
                  <SelectTrigger><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectContent>
                    {STATUSES.map((s) => <SelectItem key={s.value} value={s.value}>{s.label}</SelectItem>)}
                  </SelectContent>
                </Select>
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>التقييم</Label>
                <div className="pt-2"><StarRating value={form.rating} onChange={(v) => setForm({ ...form, rating: v })} size={18} /></div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>الصفحة الحالية</Label>
                <Input type="number" min={0} value={form.currentPage} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, currentPage: e.target.value })} />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>إجمالي الصفحات</Label>
                <Input type="number" min={0} value={form.totalPages} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, totalPages: e.target.value })} />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>تاريخ البدء</Label>
                <Input type="date" value={form.startDate} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, startDate: e.target.value })} />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>تاريخ الانتهاء</Label>
                <Input type="date" value={form.endDate} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, endDate: e.target.value })} />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>الرابط</Label>
              <Input type="url" placeholder="https://..." value={form.url} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, url: e.target.value })} dir="ltr" />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>ملاحظات</Label>
              <Textarea placeholder="ملاحظاتك حول العنصر..." value={form.notes} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, notes: e.target.value })} className="min-h-[60px]" />
            </div>
          </div>
          <DialogFooter>
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>إلغاء</Button>
            <Button onClick={handleSave} disabled={!form.title.trim()}>{editing ? 'حفظ' : 'إضافة'}</Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </div>
  );
}
```

- **الملف**: `src/components/sections/finance-advanced.tsx`

## 📝 الكود الكامل

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { DollarSign, Plus, Trash2, Search, TrendingUp, TrendingDown, Wallet, PieChart, Pencil } from 'lucide-react';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogTrigger, DialogFooter, DialogClose } from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from '@/components/ui/select';
import { AlertDialog, AlertDialogAction, AlertDialogCancel, AlertDialogContent, AlertDialogDescription, AlertDialogFooter, AlertDialogHeader, AlertDialogTitle } from '@/components/ui/alert-dialog';
import { useAppStore } from '@/lib/store';
import { FINANCE_CATEGORIES, type Transaction, type Budget } from '@/types';

const MONTHS = [
  { id: 1, label: 'يناير' }, { id: 2, label: 'فبراير' }, { id: 3, label: 'مارس' }, { id: 4, label: 'أبريل' },
  { id: 5, label: 'مايو' }, { id: 6, label: 'يونيو' }, { id: 7, label: 'يوليو' }, { id: 8, label: 'أغسطس' },
  { id: 9, label: 'سبتمبر' }, { id: 10, label: 'أكتوبر' }, { id: 11, label: 'نوفمبر' }, { id: 12, label: 'ديسمبر' },
];

const toArabicNum = (n: number) => n.toLocaleString('ar-SA');
const BUDGET_CATEGORIES = FINANCE_CATEGORIES.filter((c) => c.id !== 'income');
const getCategoryInfo = (catId: string) => FINANCE_CATEGORIES.find((c) => c.id === catId) || { icon: '📦', label: catId, id: catId };
const formatArabicDate = (dateStr: string) => new Intl.DateTimeFormat('ar-SA', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' }).format(new Date(dateStr));

export function FinanceAdvancedSection() {
  const {
    transactions, budgets,
    addTransaction, updateTransaction, deleteTransaction,
    addBudget, updateBudget, deleteBudget,
  } = useAppStore();

  const now = new Date();
  const currentMonth = now.getMonth() + 1;
  const currentYear = now.getFullYear();

  // ===== Budget dialog =====
  const [budgetOpen, setBudgetOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editBudgetId, setEditBudgetId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [bMonth, setBMonth] = useState(currentMonth);
  const [bYear, setBYear] = useState(currentYear);
  const [bCategory, setBCategory] = useState('food');
  const [bBudgeted, setBBudgeted] = useState('');
  const [deleteBudgetId, setDeleteBudgetId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  // ===== Transaction dialog =====
  const [txOpen, setTxOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editTxId, setEditTxId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [tDesc, setTDesc] = useState('');
  const [tAmount, setTAmount] = useState('');
  const [tType, setTType] = useState<Transaction['type']>('expense');
  const [tCategory, setTCategory] = useState('food');
  const [deleteTxId, setDeleteTxId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  // ===== Filters =====
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [txTypeFilter, setTxTypeFilter] = useState<string>('all');
  const [txCatFilter, setTxCatFilter] = useState<string>('all');

  const currentBudgets = budgets.filter((b) => b.month === currentMonth && b.year === currentYear);
  const monthTransactions = transactions.filter((t) => {
    const d = new Date(t.createdAt);
    return d.getMonth() + 1 === currentMonth && d.getFullYear() === currentYear;
  });
  const actualByCategory: Record<string, number> = {};
  for (const t of monthTransactions) {
    if (t.type === 'expense') actualByCategory[t.category] = (actualByCategory[t.category] || 0) + t.amount;
  }
  const totalIncome = monthTransactions.filter((t) => t.type === 'income').reduce((s, t) => s + t.amount, 0);
  const totalExpenses = monthTransactions.filter((t) => t.type === 'expense').reduce((s, t) => s + t.amount, 0);
  const net = totalIncome - totalExpenses;
  const totalBudgeted = currentBudgets.reduce((s, b) => s + b.budgeted, 0);

  // Last 7 days expenses bar chart
  const last7Days = useMemo(() => {
    const days: { label: string; total: number }[] = [];
    for (let i = 6; i >= 0; i--) {
      const d = new Date(now);
      d.setDate(d.getDate() - i);
      const dateStr = d.toISOString().split('T')[0];
      const dayLabel = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('ar-SA', { weekday: 'short' }).format(d);
      const dayExpenses = transactions
        .filter((t) => t.type === 'expense' && t.createdAt.startsWith(dateStr))
        .reduce((s, t) => s + t.amount, 0);
      days.push({ label: dayLabel, total: dayExpenses });
    }
    return days;
  }, [transactions, now]);
  const maxExpense = Math.max(...last7Days.map((d) => d.total), 1);

  const filteredTx = useMemo(() => {
    const q = search.trim().toLowerCase();
    return [...transactions]
      .filter((t) => txTypeFilter === 'all' || t.type === txTypeFilter)
      .filter((t) => txCatFilter === 'all' || t.category === txCatFilter)
      .filter((t) => !q || t.description.toLowerCase().includes(q))
      .sort((a, b) => new Date(b.createdAt).getTime() - new Date(a.createdAt).getTime());
  }, [transactions, search, txTypeFilter, txCatFilter]);

  // ===== Budget + Transaction handlers =====
  const openBudgetCreate = () => {
    setEditBudgetId(null); setBMonth(currentMonth); setBYear(currentYear); setBCategory('food'); setBBudgeted('');
    setBudgetOpen(true);
  };
  const openBudgetEdit = (b: Budget) => {
    setEditBudgetId(b.id); setBMonth(b.month); setBYear(b.year); setBCategory(b.category); setBBudgeted(String(b.budgeted));
    setBudgetOpen(true);
  };
  const handleBudgetSave = () => {
    const budgeted = Number(bBudgeted);
    if (!Number.isFinite(budgeted) || budgeted < 0) return;
    const actual = actualByCategory[bCategory] || 0;
    if (editBudgetId) updateBudget(editBudgetId, { month: bMonth, year: bYear, category: bCategory, budgeted, actual });
    else addBudget({ month: bMonth, year: bYear, category: bCategory, budgeted, actual });
    setBudgetOpen(false);
  };
  const confirmDeleteBudget = () => { if (deleteBudgetId) { deleteBudget(deleteBudgetId); setDeleteBudgetId(null); } };
  const syncActual = (b: Budget) => {
    const actual = actualByCategory[b.category] || 0;
    if (b.actual !== actual) updateBudget(b.id, { actual });
  };

  const openTxCreate = () => {
    setEditTxId(null); setTDesc(''); setTAmount(''); setTType('expense'); setTCategory('food'); setTxOpen(true);
  };
  const openTxEdit = (t: Transaction) => {
    setEditTxId(t.id); setTDesc(t.description); setTAmount(String(t.amount)); setTType(t.type); setTCategory(t.category); setTxOpen(true);
  };
  const handleTxSave = () => {
    const amount = Number(tAmount);
    if (!tDesc.trim() || !Number.isFinite(amount) || amount <= 0) return;
    const payload = { description: tDesc.trim(), amount, type: tType, category: tCategory };
    if (editTxId) updateTransaction(editTxId, payload);
    else addTransaction(payload);
    setTxOpen(false);
  };
  const confirmDeleteTx = () => { if (deleteTxId) { deleteTransaction(deleteTxId); setDeleteTxId(null); } };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between flex-wrap gap-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-900/30 flex items-center justify-center">
            <Wallet className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-lg font-bold text-foreground">المالية المتقدمة</h1>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{MONTHS.find((m) => m.id === currentMonth)?.label} {toArabicNum(currentYear)}</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="gap-1.5" onClick={openBudgetCreate}><PieChart className="w-4 h-4" /> ميزانية</Button>
          <Dialog open={txOpen} onOpenChange={setTxOpen}>
            <DialogTrigger asChild>
              <Button size="sm" className="gap-1.5" onClick={openTxCreate}><Plus className="w-4 h-4" /> معاملة</Button>
            </DialogTrigger>
            <DialogContent>
              <DialogHeader><DialogTitle>{editTxId ? 'تعديل المعاملة' : 'معاملة جديدة'}</DialogTitle></DialogHeader>
              <div className="space-y-4 py-2">
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label>الوصف</Label>
                  <Input placeholder="مثال: غداء في المطعم" value={tDesc} onChange={(e) => setTDesc(e.target.value)} />
                </div>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                  <div className="space-y-2">
                    <Label>المبلغ</Label>
                    <Input type="number" placeholder="0.00" value={tAmount} onChange={(e) => setTAmount(e.target.value)} />
                  </div>
                  <div className="space-y-2">
                    <Label>النوع</Label>
                    <Select value={tType} onValueChange={(v) => setTType(v as Transaction['type'])}>
                      <SelectTrigger className="w-full"><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
                      <SelectContent>
                        <SelectItem value="expense">مصروف</SelectItem>
                        <SelectItem value="income">دخل</SelectItem>
                      </SelectContent>
                    </Select>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label>التصنيف</Label>
                  <Select value={tCategory} onValueChange={setTCategory}>
                    <SelectTrigger className="w-full"><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
                    <SelectContent>
                      {FINANCE_CATEGORIES.map((c) => (
                        <SelectItem key={c.id} value={c.id}><span className="flex items-center gap-2"><span>{c.icon}</span><span>{c.label}</span></span></SelectItem>
                      ))}
                    </SelectContent>
                  </Select>
                </div>
              </div>
              <DialogFooter>
                <DialogClose asChild><Button variant="outline">إلغاء</Button></DialogClose>
                <Button onClick={handleTxSave} disabled={!tDesc.trim() || !tAmount || Number(tAmount) <= 0}>{editTxId ? 'حفظ' : 'إضافة'}</Button>
              </DialogFooter>
            </DialogContent>
          </Dialog>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Summary Cards */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
        {[
          { icon: TrendingUp, color: 'text-emerald-500', valColor: 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400', label: 'الدخل', val: `${toArabicNum(totalIncome)} ₪` },
          { icon: TrendingDown, color: 'text-red-500', valColor: 'text-red-600 dark:text-red-400', label: 'المصروفات', val: `${toArabicNum(totalExpenses)} ₪` },
          { icon: DollarSign, color: net >= 0 ? 'text-emerald-500' : 'text-red-500', valColor: net >= 0 ? 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400' : 'text-red-600 dark:text-red-400', label: 'الصافي', val: `${net >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${toArabicNum(net)} ₪` },
          { icon: PieChart, color: 'text-violet-500', valColor: 'text-foreground', label: 'الميزانية', val: `${toArabicNum(totalBudgeted)} ₪` },
        ].map((s, i) => (
          <Card key={i} className="border border-border bg-background">
            <CardContent className="p-3">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mb-1">
                <s.icon className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${s.color}`} />
                <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{s.label}</span>
              </div>
              <p className={`text-sm font-bold ${s.valColor}`}>{s.val}</p>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Budget vs Actual cards */}
      {currentBudgets.length > 0 && (
        <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
          <CardContent className="p-4">
            <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground mb-3">الميزانية مقابل الفعلي</h3>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-2">
              {currentBudgets.map((b) => {
                const actual = actualByCategory[b.category] || 0;
                const ratio = b.budgeted > 0 ? Math.min((actual / b.budgeted) * 100, 100) : 0;
                const over = actual > b.budgeted && b.budgeted > 0;
                const cat = getCategoryInfo(b.category);
                return (
                  <div key={b.id} className="p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-muted/40" onMouseEnter={() => syncActual(b)}>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1.5">
                      <span className="text-base">{cat.icon}</span>
                      <span className="text-xs font-medium text-foreground flex-1">{cat.label}</span>
                      <span className={`text-xs font-bold ${over ? 'text-red-600 dark:text-red-400' : 'text-foreground'}`}>{toArabicNum(actual)} / {toArabicNum(b.budgeted)} ₪</span>
                      <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-6 w-6" onClick={() => openBudgetEdit(b)}><Pencil className="w-3 h-3" /></Button>
                      <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-6 w-6 text-muted-foreground hover:text-red-500" onClick={() => setDeleteBudgetId(b.id)}><Trash2 className="w-3 h-3" /></Button>
                    </div>
                    <div className="h-2 rounded-full bg-muted overflow-hidden">
                      <motion.div initial={{ width: 0 }} animate={{ width: `${ratio}%` }} transition={{ duration: 0.4 }} className={`h-full rounded-full ${over ? 'bg-red-500' : ratio > 80 ? 'bg-amber-500' : 'bg-emerald-500'}`} />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}

      {/* Last 7 days bar chart */}
      {last7Days.some((d) => d.total > 0) && (
        <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
          <CardContent className="p-4">
            <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground mb-3">مصروفات آخر ٧ أيام</h3>
            <div className="flex items-end gap-2 h-28">
              {last7Days.map((day, i) => {
                const h = Math.max((day.total / maxExpense) * 96, day.total > 0 ? 4 : 0);
                return (
                  <div key={i} className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center gap-1">
                    {day.total > 0 && <span className="text-[9px] text-muted-foreground">{toArabicNum(day.total)}</span>}
                    <div className="w-full flex items-end justify-center" style={{ height: '96px' }}>
                      <motion.div initial={{ height: 0 }} animate={{ height: `${h}px` }} transition={{ delay: i * 0.05, duration: 0.3 }} className={`w-full max-w-[32px] rounded-t-md ${day.total > 0 ? 'bg-red-400 dark:bg-red-500/70' : 'bg-muted'}`} />
                    </div>
                    <span className="text-[9px] text-muted-foreground">{day.label}</span>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}

      {/* Transaction list with filters */}
      <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
        <CardContent className="p-4">
          <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground mb-3">كل المعاملات</h3>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap mb-3">
            <div className="relative flex-1 min-w-[160px]">
              <Search className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />
              <Input placeholder="ابحث..." value={search} onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)} className="pr-9 h-9" />
            </div>
            <Select value={txTypeFilter} onValueChange={setTxTypeFilter}>
              <SelectTrigger className="w-28 h-9"><SelectValue placeholder="النوع" /></SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                <SelectItem value="all">كل الأنواع</SelectItem><SelectItem value="expense">مصروف</SelectItem><SelectItem value="income">دخل</SelectItem>
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
            <Select value={txCatFilter} onValueChange={setTxCatFilter}>
              <SelectTrigger className="w-32 h-9"><SelectValue placeholder="التصنيف" /></SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                <SelectItem value="all">كل التصنيفات</SelectItem>
                {FINANCE_CATEGORIES.map((c) => <SelectItem key={c.id} value={c.id}>{c.label}</SelectItem>)}
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
          </div>
          {filteredTx.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="text-center py-6 text-muted-foreground text-sm">
              <DollarSign className="w-8 h-8 mx-auto mb-2 opacity-40" /><p>لا توجد معاملات</p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="space-y-2 max-h-96 overflow-y-auto">
              <AnimatePresence mode="popLayout">
                {filteredTx.map((tx) => {
                  const cat = getCategoryInfo(tx.category);
                  return (
                    <motion.div key={tx.id} layout initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -20 }}
                      className="flex items-center gap-3 p-2.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-muted transition-colors">
                      <span className="text-xl">{cat.icon}</span>
                      <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                        <p className="text-sm text-foreground truncate">{tx.description}</p>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-0.5">
                          <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-[10px] bg-muted text-muted-foreground">{cat.label}</Badge>
                          <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{formatArabicDate(tx.createdAt)}</span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <span className={`text-sm font-bold shrink-0 ${tx.type === 'income' ? 'text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400' : 'text-red-600 dark:text-red-400'}`}>{tx.type === 'income' ? '+' : '-'}{toArabicNum(tx.amount)} ₪</span>
                      <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7" onClick={() => openTxEdit(tx)}><Pencil className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /></Button>
                      <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7 text-muted-foreground hover:text-red-500 shrink-0" onClick={() => setDeleteTxId(tx.id)}><Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /></Button>
                    </motion.div>
                  );
                })}
              </AnimatePresence>
            </div>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* Budget dialog */}
      <Dialog open={budgetOpen} onOpenChange={setBudgetOpen}>
        <DialogContent>
          <DialogHeader><DialogTitle>{editBudgetId ? 'تعديل الميزانية' : 'ميزانية جديدة'}</DialogTitle></DialogHeader>
          <div className="space-y-4 py-2">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>الشهر</Label>
                <Select value={String(bMonth)} onValueChange={(v) => setBMonth(Number(v))}>
                  <SelectTrigger className="w-full"><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectContent>
                    {MONTHS.map((m) => <SelectItem key={m.id} value={String(m.id)}>{m.label}</SelectItem>)}
                  </SelectContent>
                </Select>
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>السنة</Label>
                <Input type="number" value={bYear} onChange={(e) => setBYear(Number(e.target.value))} />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>التصنيف</Label>
              <Select value={bCategory} onValueChange={setBCategory}>
                <SelectTrigger className="w-full"><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  {BUDGET_CATEGORIES.map((c) => <SelectItem key={c.id} value={c.id}><span className="flex items-center gap-2"><span>{c.icon}</span><span>{c.label}</span></span></SelectItem>)}

      {/* Delete confirmations */}

          </AlertDialogFooter>
        </AlertDialogContent>
      </AlertDialog>
      <AlertDialog open={!!deleteBudgetId} onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setDeleteBudgetId(null)}>
        <AlertDialogContent>
          <AlertDialogHeader>
            <AlertDialogTitle>حذف الميزانية؟</AlertDialogTitle>

          </AlertDialogFooter>
        </AlertDialogContent>
      </AlertDialog>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
} from '@/components/ui/select';
import { TagInput } from '@/components/tag-input';
import { useAppStore } from '@/lib/store';

const TIME_CATEGORIES = [
  { id: 'study', label: 'دراسة', color: 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-900/30 dark:text-emerald-400' },
  { id: 'work', label: 'عمل', color: 'bg-sky-100 text-sky-700 dark:bg-sky-900/30 dark:text-sky-400' },
  { id: 'reading', label: 'قراءة', color: 'bg-violet-100 text-violet-700 dark:bg-violet-900/30 dark:text-violet-400' },
  { id: 'sport', label: 'رياضة', color: 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-700 dark:bg-rose-900/30 dark:text-rose-400' },
  { id: 'family', label: 'عائلة', color: 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-900/30 dark:text-amber-400' },
  { id: 'other', label: 'أخرى', color: 'bg-muted text-muted-foreground' },
] as const;

const toArabicNum = (n: number) => n.toLocaleString('ar-SA');

function formatDuration(ms: number): string {
  const totalSec = Math.floor(ms / 1000);
  const h = Math.floor(totalSec / 3600);
  const m = Math.floor((totalSec % 3600) / 60);
  const s = totalSec % 60;
  if (h > 0) return `${toArabicNum(h)} س ${toArabicNum(m)} د`;
  if (m > 0) return `${toArabicNum(m)} د ${toArabicNum(s)} ث`;
  return `${toArabicNum(s)} ث`;
}

function formatDurationShort(ms: number): string {
  const totalMin = Math.floor(ms / 60000);
  const h = Math.floor(totalMin / 60);
  const m = totalMin % 60;
  if (h > 0) return `${toArabicNum(h)}س ${toArabicNum(m)}د`;
  return `${toArabicNum(m)}د`;
}

function nowLocalInput(): string {
  const d = new Date();
  d.setSeconds(0, 0);
  const tzOffset = d.getTimezoneOffset() * 60000;
  return new Date(d.getTime() - tzOffset).toISOString().slice(0, 16);
}

function computeDuration(startISO: string, endISO: string): number {
  const s = new Date(startISO).getTime();
  const e = new Date(endISO).getTime();
  return Number.isFinite(s) && Number.isFinite(e) && e > s ? e - s : 0;
}

export function TimeTrackingSection() {
  const { timeEntries, addTimeEntry, deleteTimeEntry } = useAppStore();

  // ===== Live timer state =====
  const [liveRunning, setLiveRunning] = useState(false);
  const [liveStart, setLiveStart] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [liveDesc, setLiveDesc] = useState('');
  const [liveCategory, setLiveCategory] = useState<string>('study');
  const [liveTags, setLiveTags] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [liveElapsed, setLiveElapsed] = useState(0);
  const intervalRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!liveRunning) return;
    intervalRef.current = setInterval(() => {
      if (liveStart !== null) setLiveElapsed(Date.now() - liveStart);
    }, 1000);
    return () => {
      if (intervalRef.current) clearInterval(intervalRef.current);
    };
  }, [liveRunning, liveStart]);

  const handleStart = () => {
    setLiveStart(Date.now());
    setLiveElapsed(0);
    setLiveRunning(true);
  };

  const handleStop = () => {
    if (liveStart === null) {
      setLiveRunning(false);
      return;
    }
    const endTs = Date.now();
    const startISO = new Date(liveStart).toISOString();
    const endISO = new Date(endTs).toISOString();
    const duration = endTs - liveStart;
    if (duration >= 1000) {
      addTimeEntry({
        description: liveDesc.trim() || 'مؤقت سريع',
        startTime: startISO,
        endTime: endISO,
        duration,
        category: liveCategory,
        projectId: '',
        tags: liveTags,

    setLiveStart(null);
    setLiveElapsed(0);

    setLiveTags([]);

  const [mStart, setMStart] = useState(nowLocalInput());
  const [mEnd, setMEnd] = useState(nowLocalInput());
  const [mCat, setMCat] = useState('study');
  const [mTags, setMTags] = useState<string[]>([]);

  const handleManualAdd = () => {
    const startISO = new Date(mStart).toISOString();
    const endISO = new Date(mEnd).toISOString();
    const duration = computeDuration(startISO, endISO);
    if (!mDesc.trim() || duration <= 0) return;
    addTimeEntry({
      description: mDesc.trim(),
      startTime: startISO,
      endTime: endISO,
      duration,
      category: mCat,
      projectId: '',

    });

  };
```
