```tsx
  );

  const categoryTotals = useMemo(() => {
    const map: Record<string, number> = {};
    for (const e of todayEntries) {
      map[e.category] = (map[e.category] || 0) + e.duration;
    }
    return map;
  }, [todayEntries]);

  const todayTotal = todayEntries.reduce((s, e) => s + e.duration, 0);
  const maxCategoryTotal = Math.max(...Object.values(categoryTotals), 1);

  const getCategory = (id: string) =>
    TIME_CATEGORIES.find((c) => c.id === id) || TIME_CATEGORIES[TIME_CATEGORIES.length - 1];

  const formatTime = (iso: string) =>
    new Intl.DateTimeFormat('ar-SA', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }).format(new Date(iso));

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between flex-wrap gap-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-violet-100 dark:bg-violet-900/30 flex items-center justify-center">
            <Clock className="w-5 h-5 text-violet-600 dark:text-violet-400" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-lg font-bold text-foreground">تتبع الوقت</h1>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">سجّل وقتك واحسب إنتاجيتك اليومية</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
          <DialogTrigger asChild>
            <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="gap-1.5">
              <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />

            </Button>

          <DialogContent>
            <DialogHeader>

              </div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label>من</Label>
                  <Input type="datetime-local" value={mStart} onChange={(e) => setMStart(e.target.value)} />
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label>إلى</Label>
                  <Input type="datetime-local" value={mEnd} onChange={(e) => setMEnd(e.target.value)} />
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>التصنيف</Label>
                <Select value={mCat} onValueChange={setMCat}>
                  <SelectTrigger className="w-full"><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectContent>
                    {TIME_CATEGORIES.map((c) => (
                      <SelectItem key={c.id} value={c.id}>{c.label}</SelectItem>
                    ))}

                </Select>

              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>الوسوم</Label>
                <TagInput value={mTags} onChange={setMTags} />
              </div>
            </div>
            <DialogFooter>
              <DialogClose asChild><Button variant="outline">إلغاء</Button></DialogClose>
              <Button onClick={handleManualAdd} disabled={!mDesc.trim() || computeDuration(new Date(mStart).toISOString(), new Date(mEnd).toISOString()) <= 0}>إضافة</Button>
            </DialogFooter>
          </DialogContent>
        </Dialog>
      </div>

      {/* Live timer */}
      <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
        <CardContent className="p-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 flex-wrap">
            <div className={`w-12 h-12 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 ${liveRunning ? 'bg-rose-100 dark:bg-rose-900/30' : 'bg-violet-100 dark:bg-violet-900/30'}`}>

              />
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Select value={liveCategory} onValueChange={setLiveCategory} disabled={liveRunning}>
                <SelectTrigger className="w-32 h-9"><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  {TIME_CATEGORIES.map((c) => (
                    <SelectItem key={c.id} value={c.id}>{c.label}</SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>
            <div className="font-mono text-lg font-bold text-foreground tabular-nums min-w-[88px] text-center">
              {formatDuration(liveElapsed)}
            </div>
            {liveRunning ? (
              <Button onClick={handleStop} variant="destructive" size="sm" className="gap-1.5">
                <Square className="w-4 h-4" /> إيقاف وحفظ
              </Button>
            ) : (
              <Button onClick={handleStart} size="sm" className="gap-1.5 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700">
                <Play className="w-4 h-4" /> بدء
              </Button>
            )}
          </div>
          {liveTags.length > 0 || liveRunning ? (
            <div className="mt-3">
              <TagInput value={liveTags} onChange={setLiveTags} placeholder="أضف وسوماً..." />
            </div>
          ) : null}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* Daily summary + bar chart */}
      <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
        <CardContent className="p-4">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <BarChart3 className="w-4 h-4 text-violet-500" />
              <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground">ملخص اليوم</h3>
            </div>
            <Badge variant="secondary" className="bg-muted text-muted-foreground">
              {toArabicNum(todayEntries.length)} إدخال
            </Badge>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-4">
            <Clock className="w-5 h-5 text-violet-500" />
            <span className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">{formatDuration(todayTotal)}</span>
          </div>
          {Object.keys(categoryTotals).length === 0 ? (
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground text-center py-4">لا يوجد وقت مسجّل اليوم بعد.</p>
          ) : (
            <div className="space-y-2">
              {Object.entries(categoryTotals).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).map(([catId, total]) => {
                const cat = getCategory(catId);
                const pct = Math.max((total / maxCategoryTotal) * 100, 4);
                return (
                  <div key={catId} className="flex items-center gap-2">

                      />
                    </div>
                    <span className="text-xs font-medium text-foreground w-16 text-left tabular-nums">
                      {formatDurationShort(total)}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* Entries list */}
      <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
        <CardContent className="p-4">
          <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground mb-3">إدخالات اليوم</h3>

                  .map((e) => {

                        className="flex items-center gap-3 p-2.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-muted transition-colors"
                      >
```

- **الكود (ID)**: `okrs`
- **المجموعة**: 1001
- **الملف**: `src/components/sections/okrs.tsx`

## 📝 الكود الكامل

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { Target, Plus, Pencil, Trash2, TrendingUp, CheckCircle2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Progress } from '@/components/ui/progress';
import {
  Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogTrigger, DialogFooter, DialogClose,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import {
  Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue,
} from '@/components/ui/select';
import {
  AlertDialog, AlertDialogAction, AlertDialogCancel, AlertDialogContent, AlertDialogDescription,
  AlertDialogFooter, AlertDialogHeader, AlertDialogTitle,
} from '@/components/ui/alert-dialog';
import { useAppStore } from '@/lib/store';
import type { OKR } from '@/types';

const QUARTERS = ['Q1', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4', 'سابق'] as const;

const STATUS_CONFIG: Record<string, { label: string; color: string }> = {
  'on-track': { label: 'على المسار', color: 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-900/30 dark:text-emerald-400' },
  'at-risk': { label: 'في خطر', color: 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-900/30 dark:text-amber-400' },
  'behind': { label: 'متأخر', color: 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-700 dark:bg-rose-900/30 dark:text-rose-400' },
  'completed': { label: 'مكتمل', color: 'bg-sky-100 text-sky-700 dark:bg-sky-900/30 dark:text-sky-400' },
};

const toArabicNum = (n: number) => n.toLocaleString('ar-SA');

function calcProgress(keyResults: OKR['keyResults']): number {
  if (!keyResults || keyResults.length === 0) return 0;
  const ratios = keyResults.map((kr) => {
    if (kr.target <= 0) return 0;
    return Math.min(Math.max((kr.current / kr.target) * 100, 0), 100);
  });
  return Math.round(ratios.reduce((s, r) => s + r, 0) / ratios.length);
}

interface FormState {
  objective: string;
  quarter: string;
  status: string;
  keyResults: Array<{ title: string; metric: string; target: number; current: number }>;
}

const emptyForm: FormState = {
  objective: '',
  quarter: 'Q1',
  status: 'on-track',
  keyResults: [{ title: '', metric: '', target: 100, current: 0 }],
};

export function OKRsSection() {
  const { okrs, addOKR, updateOKR, deleteOKR } = useAppStore();
  const [filterQuarter, setFilterQuarter] = useState<string>('all');
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editId, setEditId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [form, setForm] = useState<FormState>(emptyForm);
  const [deleteId, setDeleteId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const filteredOkrs = useMemo(() => {
    const list = filterQuarter === 'all' ? okrs : okrs.filter((o) => o.quarter === filterQuarter);
    return [...list].sort((a, b) => new Date(b.createdAt).getTime() - new Date(a.createdAt).getTime());
  }, [okrs, filterQuarter]);

  const availableQuarters = useMemo(() => {
    const set = new Set<string>(okrs.map((o) => o.quarter));
    return QUARTERS.filter((q) => set.has(q));
  }, [okrs]);

  const overallProgress = useMemo(() => {
    if (okrs.length === 0) return 0;
    return Math.round(okrs.reduce((s, o) => s + calcProgress(o.keyResults), 0) / okrs.length);
  }, [okrs]);

  // ===== form helpers =====
  const updateKR = (idx: number, patch: Partial<FormState['keyResults'][number]>) => {
    setForm((f) => ({
      ...f,
      keyResults: f.keyResults.map((kr, i) => (i === idx ? { ...kr, ...patch } : kr)),
    }));
  };
  const addKR = () => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, keyResults: [...f.keyResults, { title: '', metric: '', target: 100, current: 0 }] }));
  const removeKR = (idx: number) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, keyResults: f.keyResults.filter((_, i) => i !== idx) }));

  const openCreate = () => { setEditId(null); setForm(emptyForm); setOpen(true); };
  const openEdit = (okr: OKR) => {
    setEditId(okr.id);
    setForm({
      objective: okr.objective,
      quarter: okr.quarter,
      status: okr.status || 'on-track',
      keyResults: okr.keyResults.length > 0
        ? okr.keyResults.map((kr) => ({ ...kr }))
        : [{ title: '', metric: '', target: 100, current: 0 }],
    });
    setOpen(true);
  };

  const handleSave = () => {
    if (!form.objective.trim()) return;
    const cleanedKRs = form.keyResults.filter((kr) => kr.title.trim());
    if (cleanedKRs.length === 0) return;
    const progress = calcProgress(cleanedKRs);
    if (editId) {
      updateOKR(editId, { objective: form.objective.trim(), quarter: form.quarter, status: form.status, keyResults: cleanedKRs, progress });
    } else {
      addOKR({ objective: form.objective.trim(), quarter: form.quarter, status: form.status, keyResults: cleanedKRs, progress });
    }
    setOpen(false);
  };

  const updateKRCurrent = (okrId: string, idx: number, value: number) => {
    const okr = okrs.find((o) => o.id === okrId);
    if (!okr) return;
    const newKRs = okr.keyResults.map((kr, i) => (i === idx ? { ...kr, current: Math.max(0, value) } : kr));
    updateOKR(okrId, { keyResults: newKRs, progress: calcProgress(newKRs) });
  };

  const confirmDelete = () => {
    if (deleteId) { deleteOKR(deleteId); setDeleteId(null); }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between flex-wrap gap-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-rose-100 dark:bg-rose-900/30 flex items-center justify-center">
            <Target className="w-5 h-5 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-lg font-bold text-foreground">الأهداف ونتائج المفاتيح</h1>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">تقدّمك العام: {toArabicNum(overallProgress)}٪</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <Button size="sm" className="gap-1.5" onClick={openCreate}>
          <Plus className="w-4 h-4" /> هدف جديد
        </Button>
      </div>

      {/* Quarter filter */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
        <Button
          size="sm" variant={filterQuarter === 'all' ? 'default' : 'outline'}
          onClick={() => setFilterQuarter('all')}
        >الكل</Button>
        {(availableQuarters.length > 0 ? availableQuarters : QUARTERS).map((q) => (
          <Button
            key={q} size="sm" variant={filterQuarter === q ? 'default' : 'outline'}
            onClick={() => setFilterQuarter(q)}
          >{q}</Button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* OKR list */}
      {filteredOkrs.length === 0 ? (
        <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
          <CardContent className="p-8 text-center text-muted-foreground text-sm">
            <Target className="w-10 h-10 mx-auto mb-2 opacity-40" />
            <p>لا توجد أهداف بعد — أضف أول OKR لك</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <AnimatePresence mode="popLayout">
            {filteredOkrs.map((okr) => {
              const prog = calcProgress(okr.keyResults);
              const statusCfg = STATUS_CONFIG[okr.status] || STATUS_CONFIG['on-track'];
              return (
                <motion.div
                  key={okr.id}
                  layout
                  initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }}
                  animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                  exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -20 }}
                >
                  <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
                    <CardContent className="p-4">
                      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3 mb-3 flex-wrap">
                        <div className="flex-1 min-w-[180px]">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap mb-1">
                            <Badge variant="secondary" className="bg-muted text-muted-foreground">{okr.quarter}</Badge>
                            <Badge variant="secondary" className={statusCfg.color}>{statusCfg.label}</Badge>
                          </div>
                          <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-foreground">{okr.objective}</h3>
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
                          <div className="text-center">
                            <div className="text-lg font-bold text-foreground tabular-nums">{toArabicNum(prog)}٪</div>
                            <div className="text-[9px] text-muted-foreground">التقدّم</div>
                          </div>
                          <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7" onClick={() => openEdit(okr)}>
                            <Pencil className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </Button>
                          <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7 text-muted-foreground hover:text-red-500" onClick={() => setDeleteId(okr.id)}>
                            <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </Button>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <Progress value={prog} className="h-2 mb-3" />
                      <div className="space-y-2">
                        {okr.keyResults.map((kr, idx) => {
                          const ratio = kr.target > 0 ? Math.min((kr.current / kr.target) * 100, 100) : 0;
                          const done = kr.current >= kr.target && kr.target > 0;
                          return (
                            <div key={idx} className="flex items-center gap-2 p-2 rounded-lg bg-muted/40">
                              <CheckCircle2 className={`w-4 h-4 shrink-0 ${done ? 'text-emerald-500' : 'text-muted-foreground'}`} />
                              <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                                <p className="text-xs text-foreground truncate">{kr.title}</p>
                                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-1">
                                  <div className="flex-1 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-muted overflow-hidden">
                                    <div className="h-full bg-rose-400 dark:bg-rose-500/70 rounded-full" style={{ width: `${ratio}%` }} />
                                  </div>
                                  {kr.metric && <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground shrink-0">{kr.metric}</span>}
                                </div>
                              </div>
                              <div className="flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0">
                                <Input
                                  type="number"
                                  value={kr.current}
                                  min={0}
                                  onChange={(e) => updateKRCurrent(okr.id, idx, Number(e.target.value))}
                                  className="h-7 w-16 text-xs text-center"
                                />
                                <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">/ {toArabicNum(kr.target)}</span>
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          );
                        })}
                      </div>
                    </CardContent>
                  </Card>
                </motion.div>
              );
            })}
          </AnimatePresence>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Add/Edit dialog */}
      <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="max-w-lg">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>{editId ? 'تعديل الهدف' : 'هدف جديد'}</DialogTitle>
          </DialogHeader>
          <div className="space-y-4 py-2 max-h-[60vh] overflow-y-auto">
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>الهدف (Objective)</Label>
              <Input placeholder="مثال: رفع المعدل التراكمي" value={form.objective} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, objective: e.target.value })} />
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>الربع</Label>
                <Select value={form.quarter} onValueChange={(v) => setForm({ ...form, quarter: v })}>
                  <SelectTrigger className="w-full"><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectContent>
                    {QUARTERS.map((q) => <SelectItem key={q} value={q}>{q}</SelectItem>)}
                  </SelectContent>
                </Select>
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>الحالة</Label>
                <Select value={form.status} onValueChange={(v) => setForm({ ...form, status: v })}>
                  <SelectTrigger className="w-full"><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectContent>
                    {Object.entries(STATUS_CONFIG).map(([k, v]) => <SelectItem key={k} value={k}>{v.label}</SelectItem>)}
                  </SelectContent>
                </Select>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <Label>النتائج المفاتيح (Key Results)</Label>
                <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" className="h-7 gap-1" onClick={addKR}>
                  <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> إضافة
                </Button>
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                {form.keyResults.map((kr, idx) => (
                  <div key={idx} className="p-2 rounded-lg border border-border bg-muted/30 space-y-2">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <Input
                        placeholder="عنوان النتيجة"
                        value={kr.title}
                        onChange={(e) => updateKR(idx, { title: e.target.value })}
                        className="h-8 text-xs"
                      />
                      {form.keyResults.length > 1 && (
                        <Button size="icon" variant="ghost" className="h-7 w-7 text-muted-foreground hover:text-red-500 shrink-0" onClick={() => removeKR(idx)}>
                          <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        </Button>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
                      <Input placeholder="المقياس (مثال: ساعة)" value={kr.metric} onChange={(e) => updateKR(idx, { metric: e.target.value })} className="h-8 text-xs" />
                      <div className="space-y-1">
                        <span className="text-[9px] text-muted-foreground">الهدف</span>
                        <Input type="number" value={kr.target} onChange={(e) => updateKR(idx, { target: Number(e.target.value) })} className="h-8 text-xs" />
                      </div>
                      <div className="space-y-1">
                        <span className="text-[9px] text-muted-foreground">الحالي</span>
                        <Input type="number" value={kr.current} onChange={(e) => updateKR(idx, { current: Number(e.target.value) })} className="h-8 text-xs" />
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <DialogFooter>
            <DialogClose asChild><Button variant="outline">إلغاء</Button></DialogClose>
            <Button onClick={handleSave} disabled={!form.objective.trim() || form.keyResults.every((k) => !k.title.trim())}>
              <TrendingUp className="w-4 h-4 ml-1" /> {editId ? 'حفظ' : 'إضافة'}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>

      {/* Delete confirm */}
      <AlertDialog open={!!deleteId} onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setDeleteId(null)}>
        <AlertDialogContent>
          <AlertDialogHeader>
            <AlertDialogTitle>حذف الهدف؟</AlertDialogTitle>
            <AlertDialogDescription>لا يمكن التراجع عن هذا الإجراء.</AlertDialogDescription>
          </AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogFooter>
            <AlertDialogCancel>إلغاء</AlertDialogCancel>
            <AlertDialogAction onClick={confirmDelete} className="bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-700">حذف</AlertDialogAction>
          </AlertDialogFooter>
        </AlertDialogContent>
      </AlertDialog>
    </div>
  );
}
```

# 51. سجل القرارات

- **الكود (ID)**: `decision-log`
- **المجموعة**: 1001
- **الملف**: `src/components/sections/decision-log.tsx`
- **عدد الأسطر**: 380

## 📝 الكود الكامل

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { GitBranch, Plus, Pencil, Trash2, Search, CheckCircle2, XCircle, Lightbulb } from 'lucide-react';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import {
  Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogTrigger, DialogFooter, DialogClose,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import {
  Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue,
} from '@/components/ui/select';
import {
  AlertDialog, AlertDialogAction, AlertDialogCancel, AlertDialogContent, AlertDialogDescription,
  AlertDialogFooter, AlertDialogHeader, AlertDialogTitle,
} from '@/components/ui/alert-dialog';
import { TagInput } from '@/components/tag-input';
import { useAppStore } from '@/lib/store';
import type { Decision } from '@/types';

const OUTCOME_CONFIG: Record<string, { label: string; color: string; icon: 'pending' | 'good' | 'bad' | 'neutral' }> = {
  pending: { label: 'قيد الانتظار', color: 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-900/30 dark:text-amber-400', icon: 'pending' },
  good: { label: 'جيد', color: 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-900/30 dark:text-emerald-400', icon: 'good' },
  bad: { label: 'سيء', color: 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-700 dark:bg-rose-900/30 dark:text-rose-400', icon: 'bad' },
  neutral: { label: 'محايد', color: 'bg-muted text-muted-foreground', icon: 'neutral' },
};

const toArabicNum = (n: number) => n.toLocaleString('ar-SA');
const formatDate = (iso: string) =>
  new Intl.DateTimeFormat('ar-SA', { year: 'numeric', month: 'short', day: 'numeric' }).format(new Date(iso));

interface FormState {
  title: string;
  context: string;
  options: string[];
  chosenOption: string;
  reasoning: string;
  outcome: string;
  lessonsLearned: string;
  date: string;
  tags: string[];
}

const emptyForm: FormState = {
  title: '',
  context: '',
  options: ['', ''],
  chosenOption: '',
  reasoning: '',
  outcome: 'pending',
  lessonsLearned: '',
  date: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
  tags: [],
};

export function DecisionLogSection() {
  const { decisions, addDecision, updateDecision, deleteDecision } = useAppStore();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editId, setEditId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [form, setForm] = useState<FormState>(emptyForm);
  const [deleteId, setDeleteId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [outcomeFilter, setOutcomeFilter] = useState<string>('all');

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    const q = search.trim().toLowerCase();
    return [...decisions]
      .filter((d) => outcomeFilter === 'all' || d.outcome === outcomeFilter)
      .filter((d) => {
        if (!q) return true;
        return (
          d.title.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          d.context.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          d.reasoning.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          d.tags.some((t) => t.toLowerCase().includes(q))
        );
      })
      .sort((a, b) => new Date(b.date).getTime() - new Date(a.date).getTime());
  }, [decisions, search, outcomeFilter]);

  const counts = useMemo(() => {
    const c: Record<string, number> = { pending: 0, good: 0, bad: 0, neutral: 0 };
    for (const d of decisions) c[d.outcome] = (c[d.outcome] || 0) + 1;
    return c;
  }, [decisions]);

  // ===== form helpers =====
  const updateOption = (idx: number, value: string) =>
    setForm((f) => ({ ...f, options: f.options.map((o, i) => (i === idx ? value : o)) }));
  const addOption = () => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, options: [...f.options, ''] }));
  const removeOption = (idx: number) =>
    setForm((f) => ({
      ...f,
      options: f.options.filter((_, i) => i !== idx),
      chosenOption: f.chosenOption === f.options[idx] ? '' : f.chosenOption,
    }));

  const openCreate = () => { setEditId(null); setForm(emptyForm); setOpen(true); };
  const openEdit = (d: Decision) => {
    setEditId(d.id);
    setForm({
      title: d.title,
      context: d.context,
      options: d.options.length > 0 ? [...d.options] : ['', ''],
      chosenOption: d.chosenOption,
      reasoning: d.reasoning,
      outcome: d.outcome,
      lessonsLearned: d.lessonsLearned,
      date: d.date,
      tags: d.tags,
    });
    setOpen(true);
  };

  const handleSave = () => {
    if (!form.title.trim()) return;
    const cleaned = form.options.map((o) => o.trim()).filter(Boolean);
    const payload = {
      title: form.title.trim(),
      context: form.context.trim(),
      options: cleaned,
      chosenOption: form.chosenOption.trim(),
      reasoning: form.reasoning.trim(),
      outcome: form.outcome,
      lessonsLearned: form.lessonsLearned.trim(),
      date: form.date,
      tags: form.tags,
    };
    if (editId) updateDecision(editId, payload);
    else addDecision(payload);
    setOpen(false);
  };

  const confirmDelete = () => {
    if (deleteId) { deleteDecision(deleteId); setDeleteId(null); }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between flex-wrap gap-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-900/30 flex items-center justify-center">
            <GitBranch className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-lg font-bold text-foreground">سجل القرارات</h1>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{toArabicNum(decisions.length)} قرار موثّق</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <Button size="sm" className="gap-1.5" onClick={openCreate}>
          <Plus className="w-4 h-4" /> قرار جديد
        </Button>
      </div>

      {/* Filters */}
      <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
        <CardContent className="p-3 space-y-2">
          <div className="relative">
            <Search className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />
            <Input
              placeholder="ابحث في القرارات..."
              value={search}
              onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
              className="pr-9"
            />
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
            <Button size="sm" variant={outcomeFilter === 'all' ? 'default' : 'outline'} onClick={() => setOutcomeFilter('all')}>
              الكل ({toArabicNum(decisions.length)})
            </Button>
            {Object.entries(OUTCOME_CONFIG).map(([k, cfg]) => (
              <Button
                key={k} size="sm" variant={outcomeFilter === k ? 'default' : 'outline'}
                onClick={() => setOutcomeFilter(k)}
                className="gap-1"
              >
                {cfg.label} ({toArabicNum(counts[k] || 0)})
              </Button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* Decision list */}
      {filtered.length === 0 ? (
        <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
          <CardContent className="p-8 text-center text-muted-foreground text-sm">
            <GitBranch className="w-10 h-10 mx-auto mb-2 opacity-40" />
            <p>{decisions.length === 0 ? 'لا توجد قرارات موثّقة بعد' : 'لا توجد نتائج مطابقة'}</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <AnimatePresence mode="popLayout">
            {filtered.map((d) => {
              const cfg = OUTCOME_CONFIG[d.outcome] || OUTCOME_CONFIG.pending;
              return (
                <motion.div key={d.id} layout initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -20 }}>
                  <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
                    <CardContent className="p-4">
                      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3 mb-2 flex-wrap">
                        <div className="flex-1 min-w-[180px]">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap mb-1">
                            <Badge variant="secondary" className={cfg.color}>
                              {cfg.icon === 'good' && <CheckCircle2 className="w-3 h-3 ml-1" />}
                              {cfg.icon === 'bad' && <XCircle className="w-3 h-3 ml-1" />}
                              {cfg.icon === 'pending' && <Lightbulb className="w-3 h-3 ml-1" />}
                              {cfg.label}
                            </Badge>
                            <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{formatDate(d.date)}</span>
                          </div>
                          <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-foreground">{d.title}</h3>
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0">
                          <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7" onClick={() => openEdit(d)}>
                            <Pencil className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </Button>
                          <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7 text-muted-foreground hover:text-red-500" onClick={() => setDeleteId(d.id)}>
                            <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </Button>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      {d.context && (
                        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-2 leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap">{d.context}</p>
                      )}
                      {d.options.length > 0 && (
                        <div className="mb-2">
                          <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">الخيارات:</span>
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap mt-1">
                            {d.options.map((opt, i) => (
                              <Badge
                                key={i}
                                variant="outline"
                                className={`text-[10px] ${opt === d.chosenOption ? 'border-emerald-400 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-900/20 dark:text-emerald-400' : ''}`}
                              >
                                {opt === d.chosenOption && <CheckCircle2 className="w-3 h-3 ml-1" />}
                                {opt}
                              </Badge>
                            ))}
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      )}
                      {d.chosenOption && (
                        <div className="mb-2 text-xs">
                          <span className="text-muted-foreground">الخيار المختار: </span>
                          <span className="font-medium text-foreground">{d.chosenOption}</span>
                        </div>
                      )}
                      {d.reasoning && (
                        <div className="mb-2 p-2 rounded-lg bg-muted/40">
                          <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">التفكير: </span>
                          <p className="text-xs text-foreground mt-0.5 whitespace-pre-wrap">{d.reasoning}</p>
                        </div>
                      )}
                      {d.lessonsLearned && (
                        <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-900/10 border border-amber-200 dark:border-amber-800/30">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 mb-0.5">
                            <Lightbulb className="w-3 h-3 text-amber-500" />
                            <span className="text-[10px] font-medium text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400">الدروس المستفادة</span>
                          </div>
                          <p className="text-xs text-foreground whitespace-pre-wrap">{d.lessonsLearned}</p>
                        </div>
                      )}
                      {d.tags.length > 0 && (
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1 flex-wrap mt-2">
                          {d.tags.map((t) => (
                            <Badge key={t} variant="secondary" className="text-[9px] bg-muted text-muted-foreground py-0">#{t}</Badge>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </CardContent>
                  </Card>
                </motion.div>
              );
            })}
          </AnimatePresence>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Add/Edit dialog */}
      <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="max-w-lg">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>{editId ? 'تعديل القرار' : 'قرار جديد'}</DialogTitle>
          </DialogHeader>
          <div className="space-y-4 py-2 max-h-[60vh] overflow-y-auto">
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>العنوان</Label>
              <Input placeholder="مثال: اختيار تخصص فرعي" value={form.title} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, title: e.target.value })} />
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>التاريخ</Label>
                <Input type="date" value={form.date} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, date: e.target.value })} />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>النتيجة</Label>
                <Select value={form.outcome} onValueChange={(v) => setForm({ ...form, outcome: v })}>
                  <SelectTrigger className="w-full"><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectContent>
                    {Object.entries(OUTCOME_CONFIG).map(([k, v]) => <SelectItem key={k} value={k}>{v.label}</SelectItem>)}
                  </SelectContent>
                </Select>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>السياق</Label>

          </AlertDialogFooter>
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { Bell, Plus, Pencil, Trash2, Clock, BellRing, BellOff } from 'lucide-react';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { Switch } from '@/components/ui/switch';
import {
  Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogFooter, DialogClose,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import {
  Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue,
} from '@/components/ui/select';
import {
  AlertDialog, AlertDialogAction, AlertDialogCancel, AlertDialogContent, AlertDialogDescription,
  AlertDialogFooter, AlertDialogHeader, AlertDialogTitle,
} from '@/components/ui/alert-dialog';
import { useAppStore } from '@/lib/store';
import type { SmartReminder } from '@/types';

const REMINDER_TYPES = [
  { id: 'task', label: 'مهمة', icon: '📋', color: 'bg-sky-100 text-sky-700 dark:bg-sky-900/30 dark:text-sky-400' },
  { id: 'habit', label: 'عادة', icon: '🔁', color: 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-900/30 dark:text-emerald-400' },
  { id: 'goal', label: 'هدف', icon: '🎯', color: 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-700 dark:bg-rose-900/30 dark:text-rose-400' },
  { id: 'finance', label: 'مالية', icon: '💰', color: 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 dark:bg-amber-900/30 dark:text-amber-400' },
  { id: 'study', label: 'دراسة', icon: '📚', color: 'bg-violet-100 text-violet-700 dark:bg-violet-900/30 dark:text-violet-400' },
  { id: 'general', label: 'عام', icon: '🔔', color: 'bg-muted text-muted-foreground' },
] as const;

const toArabicNum = (n: number) => n.toLocaleString('ar-SA');
const formatTime = (time: string) => {
  if (!time) return '';
  const [h, m] = time.split(':').map(Number);
  const d = new Date();
  d.setHours(h || 0, m || 0, 0, 0);
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('ar-SA', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }).format(d);
};

interface FormState {
  type: string;
  message: string;
  scheduledTime: string;
  isRecurring: boolean;
  triggerCondition: string;
}

const emptyForm: FormState = {
  type: 'general',
  message: '',
  scheduledTime: '08:00',
  isRecurring: false,
  triggerCondition: '',
};

export function SmartRemindersSection() {
  const { smartReminders, addSmartReminder, updateSmartReminder, deleteSmartReminder } = useAppStore();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editId, setEditId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [form, setForm] = useState<FormState>(emptyForm);
  const [deleteId, setDeleteId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [typeFilter, setTypeFilter] = useState<string>('all');

  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    const list = typeFilter === 'all' ? smartReminders : smartReminders.filter((r) => r.type === typeFilter);
    return [...list].sort((a, b) => {
      // active first, then by time
      if (a.isActive !== b.isActive) return a.isActive ? -1 : 1;
      return (a.scheduledTime || '').localeCompare(b.scheduledTime || '');
    });
  }, [smartReminders, typeFilter]);

  const activeCount = useMemo(() => smartReminders.filter((r) => r.isActive).length, [smartReminders]);

  const getType = (id: string) => REMINDER_TYPES.find((t) => t.id === id) || REMINDER_TYPES[REMINDER_TYPES.length - 1];

  const toggleActive = (r: SmartReminder) => updateSmartReminder(r.id, { isActive: !r.isActive });

  const openCreate = () => { setEditId(null); setForm(emptyForm); setOpen(true); };
  const openEdit = (r: SmartReminder) => {
    setEditId(r.id);
    setForm({
      type: r.type,
      message: r.message,
      scheduledTime: r.scheduledTime || '08:00',
      isRecurring: r.isRecurring,
      triggerCondition: r.triggerCondition,
    });
    setOpen(true);
  };

  const handleSave = () => {
    if (!form.message.trim()) return;
    const payload = {
      type: form.type,
      targetId: '',
      message: form.message.trim(),
      triggerCondition: form.triggerCondition.trim(),
      scheduledTime: form.scheduledTime,
      isRecurring: form.isRecurring,
      isActive: true,
    };
    if (editId) updateSmartReminder(editId, payload);
    else addSmartReminder(payload);
    setOpen(false);
  };

  const confirmDelete = () => { if (deleteId) { deleteSmartReminder(deleteId); setDeleteId(null); } };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between flex-wrap gap-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-amber-100 dark:bg-amber-900/30 flex items-center justify-center">
            <Bell className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-lg font-bold text-foreground">التذكيرات الذكية</h1>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              {toArabicNum(activeCount)} نشط من أصل {toArabicNum(smartReminders.length)}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <Button size="sm" className="gap-1.5" onClick={openCreate}>
          <Plus className="w-4 h-4" /> تذكير جديد
        </Button>
      </div>

      {/* Type filter */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
        <Button size="sm" variant={typeFilter === 'all' ? 'default' : 'outline'} onClick={() => setTypeFilter('all')}>
          الكل
        </Button>
        {REMINDER_TYPES.map((t) => (
          <Button key={t.id} size="sm" variant={typeFilter === t.id ? 'default' : 'outline'} onClick={() => setTypeFilter(t.id)} className="gap-1">
            <span>{t.icon}</span> {t.label}
          </Button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Reminder list */}
      {filtered.length === 0 ? (
        <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
          <CardContent className="p-8 text-center text-muted-foreground text-sm">
            <Bell className="w-10 h-10 mx-auto mb-2 opacity-40" />
            <p>{smartReminders.length === 0 ? 'لا توجد تذكيرات بعد' : 'لا توجد تذكيرات من هذا النوع'}</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <AnimatePresence mode="popLayout">
            {filtered.map((r) => {
              const type = getType(r.type);
              return (
                <motion.div
                  key={r.id}
                  layout
                  initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }}
                  animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                  exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -20 }}
                >
                  <Card className={`border bg-background transition-opacity ${r.isActive ? 'border-border opacity-100' : 'border-border opacity-60'}`}>
                    <CardContent className="p-3">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                        <div className={`w-10 h-10 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 text-lg ${type.color}`}>
                          {type.icon}
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap mb-0.5">
                            <Badge variant="secondary" className={`text-[10px] ${type.color}`}>{type.label}</Badge>
                            {r.scheduledTime && (
                              <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1">
                                <Clock className="w-3 h-3" /> {formatTime(r.scheduledTime)}
                              </span>
                            )}
                            {r.isRecurring && (
                              <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[9px] py-0 px-1.5 text-muted-foreground gap-0.5">
                                <BellRing className="w-2.5 h-2.5" /> متكرر
                              </Badge>
                            )}
                          </div>
                          <p className="text-sm text-foreground truncate">{r.message}</p>
                          {r.triggerCondition && (
                            <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mt-0.5 truncate">الشرط: {r.triggerCondition}</p>
                          )}
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-1">
                            <Switch checked={r.isActive} onCheckedChange={() => toggleActive(r)} aria-label="تفعيل التذكير" />
                            {r.isActive ? (
                              <BellRing className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-500" />
                            ) : (
                              <BellOff className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-muted-foreground" />
                            )}
                          </div>
                          <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7" onClick={() => openEdit(r)}>
                            <Pencil className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </Button>
                          <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7 text-muted-foreground hover:text-red-500" onClick={() => setDeleteId(r.id)}>
                            <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </Button>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </CardContent>
                  </Card>
                </motion.div>
              );
            })}
          </AnimatePresence>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Add/Edit dialog */}
      <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="max-w-md">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>{editId ? 'تعديل التذكير' : 'تذكير جديد'}</DialogTitle>
          </DialogHeader>
          <div className="space-y-4 py-2">
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>النوع</Label>
              <Select value={form.type} onValueChange={(v) => setForm({ ...form, type: v })}>
                <SelectTrigger className="w-full"><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  {REMINDER_TYPES.map((t) => (
                    <SelectItem key={t.id} value={t.id}>
                      <span className="flex items-center gap-2"><span>{t.icon}</span><span>{t.label}</span></span>
                    </SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>الرسالة</Label>
              <Textarea placeholder="مثال: راجع دروس الرياضيات" value={form.message} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, message: e.target.value })} rows={2} />
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>الوقت</Label>
                <Input type="time" value={form.scheduledTime} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, scheduledTime: e.target.value })} />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>متكرر؟</Label>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 h-9 px-3 rounded-lg border border-input bg-background">
                  <Switch checked={form.isRecurring} onCheckedChange={(v) => setForm({ ...form, isRecurring: v })} />
                  <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{form.isRecurring ? 'يومي' : 'مرة واحدة'}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>شرط التشغيل (اختياري)</Label>
              <Input placeholder="مثال: عند إكمال مهمة X" value={form.triggerCondition} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, triggerCondition: e.target.value })} />
            </div>
          </div>
          <DialogFooter>
            <DialogClose asChild><Button variant="outline">إلغاء</Button></DialogClose>
            <Button onClick={handleSave} disabled={!form.message.trim()}>{editId ? 'حفظ' : 'إضافة'}</Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>

      {/* Delete confirm */}
      <AlertDialog open={!!deleteId} onOpenChange={(o) => !o && setDeleteId(null)}>
        <AlertDialogContent>
          <AlertDialogHeader>
            <AlertDialogTitle>حذف التذكير؟</AlertDialogTitle>
            <AlertDialogDescription>لا يمكن التراجع عن هذا الإجراء.</AlertDialogDescription>
          </AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogFooter>
            <AlertDialogCancel>إلغاء</AlertDialogCancel>
            <AlertDialogAction onClick={confirmDelete} className="bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-700">حذف</AlertDialogAction>
          </AlertDialogFooter>
        </AlertDialogContent>
      </AlertDialog>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## 📝 الكود الكامل

```tsx
'use client';

// المشاركة الانتقائية — Selective Sharing Section

import { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { v4 as uuid } from 'uuid';
import {
  Link2, Plus, Trash2, Copy, Eye, EyeOff, Clock, ExternalLink,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea';
import { Switch } from '@/components/ui/switch';
import {
  Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogFooter, DialogDescription,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import {
  Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue,
} from '@/components/ui/select';
import { useAppStore } from '@/lib/store';
import { toast } from '@/hooks/use-toast';
import type { SharedLink } from '@/types';

const TARGET_TYPES: Array<{ value: string; label: string; emoji: string }> = [
  { value: 'project', label: 'مشروع', emoji: '🚀' },
  { value: 'certificate', label: 'شهادة', emoji: '📜' },
  { value: 'skill', label: 'مهارة', emoji: '⚡' },
  { value: 'achievement', label: 'إنجاز', emoji: '🏆' },
  { value: 'resume', label: 'سيرة ذاتية', emoji: '📄' },
  { value: 'portfolio', label: 'معرض كامل', emoji: '🌐' },
];

function fmtDate(s: string): string {
  if (!s) return '';
  try { return new Date(s).toLocaleDateString('ar', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' }); }
  catch { return s; }
}

function fmtDateTime(s: string): string {
  if (!s) return '';
  try { return new Date(s).toLocaleString('ar', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }); }
  catch { return s; }
}

function targetMeta(v: string) {
  return TARGET_TYPES.find((t) => t.value === v) || TARGET_TYPES[5];
}

interface ShareForm {
  targetType: string; targetId: string;
  title: string; description: string;
  password: string; expiresAt: string; maxViews: string;
}
const emptyForm: ShareForm = {
  targetType: 'portfolio', targetId: '',
  title: '', description: '',
  password: '', expiresAt: '', maxViews: '',
};

export function SelectiveSharingSection() {
  const { sharedLinks, addSharedLink, updateSharedLink, deleteSharedLink } = useAppStore();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [form, setForm] = useState<ShareForm>(emptyForm);
  const [confirmDelete, setConfirmDelete] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [revealedPassword, setRevealedPassword] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());

  const sorted = useMemo(
    () => [...sharedLinks].sort((a, b) => b.createdAt.localeCompare(a.createdAt)),
    [sharedLinks],
  );

  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    const active = sharedLinks.filter((l) => l.isActive).length;
    const totalViews = sharedLinks.reduce((s, l) => s + (l.viewCount || 0), 0);
    const expired = sharedLinks.filter((l) => l.expiresAt && new Date(l.expiresAt) < new Date()).length;
    return { total: sharedLinks.length, active, totalViews, expired };
  }, [sharedLinks]);

  const togglePassword = (id: string) => {
    setRevealedPassword((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id); else next.add(id);
      return next;
    });
  };

  const openAdd = () => { setForm(emptyForm); setOpen(true); };

  const handleSave = () => {
    if (!form.title.trim()) { toast({ title: 'العنوان مطلوب', variant: 'destructive' }); return; }
    const payload = {
      token: uuid().replace(/-/g, '').slice(0, 24),
      targetType: form.targetType,
      targetId: form.targetId || 'all',
      title: form.title.trim(),
      description: form.description.trim(),
      password: form.password,
      expiresAt: form.expiresAt,
      maxViews: form.maxViews ? Number(form.maxViews) : 0,
      viewCount: 0,
      isActive: true,
    };
    addSharedLink(payload);
    toast({ title: 'تم إنشاء الرابط' });
    setOpen(false); setForm(emptyForm);
  };

  const handleToggleActive = (l: SharedLink) => {
    updateSharedLink(l.id, { isActive: !l.isActive });
    toast({ title: l.isActive ? 'تم إلغاء تفعيل الرابط' : 'تم تفعيل الرابط' });
  };

  const handleDelete = (id: string) => {
    deleteSharedLink(id);
    setConfirmDelete(null);
    toast({ title: 'تم حذف الرابط' });
  };

  const buildUrl = (token: string) => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return `/share/${token}`;
    return `${window.location.origin}/share/${token}`;
  };

  const copyLink = async (l: SharedLink) => {
    const url = buildUrl(l.token);
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(url);
      toast({ title: 'تم نسخ الرابط' });
    } catch {
      toast({ title: 'تعذر النسخ', variant: 'destructive' });
    }
  };

  const isExpired = (l: SharedLink) => l.expiresAt && new Date(l.expiresAt) < new Date();
  const isExhausted = (l: SharedLink) => l.maxViews > 0 && l.viewCount >= l.maxViews;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-purple-100 dark:bg-purple-900/30 flex items-center justify-center">
            <Link2 className="w-5 h-5 text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-foreground">المشاركة الانتقائية</h2>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{stats.active} رابط نشط · {stats.totalViews} مشاهدة</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <Button size="sm" className="gap-1.5" onClick={openAdd}>
          <Plus className="w-4 h-4" /> رابط جديد
        </Button>
      </div>

      {/* Stats */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-3">
        <Card className="border border-border"><CardContent className="p-4 text-center">
          <p className="text-xl font-bold text-foreground">{stats.total}</p>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground mt-1">إجمالي الروابط</p>
        </CardContent></Card>
        <Card className="border border-border"><CardContent className="p-4 text-center">
          <p className="text-xl font-bold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">{stats.active}</p>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground mt-1">نشط</p>
        </CardContent></Card>
        <Card className="border border-border"><CardContent className="p-4 text-center">
          <p className="text-xl font-bold text-foreground">{stats.totalViews}</p>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground mt-1">إجمالي المشاهدات</p>
        </CardContent></Card>
        <Card className="border border-border"><CardContent className="p-4 text-center">
          <p className="text-xl font-bold text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400">{stats.expired}</p>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground mt-1">منتهي</p>
        </CardContent></Card>
      </div>

      {/* Links List */}
      {sorted.length === 0 ? (
        <Card className="border border-border"><CardContent className="p-8 text-center">
          <Link2 className="w-10 h-10 mx-auto mb-3 text-muted-foreground opacity-40" />
          <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm mb-3">لا توجد روابط مشاركة بعد</p>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-4">أنشئ رابطاً لمشاركة مشاريعك أو شهاداتك أو سيرتك الذاتية</p>
          <Button onClick={openAdd} variant="outline" className="gap-2">
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4" /> إنشاء رابط
          </Button>
        </CardContent></Card>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
            {sorted.map((l) => {
              const tm = targetMeta(l.targetType);
              const expired = isExpired(l);
              const exhausted = isExhausted(l);
              const disabled = !l.isActive || expired || exhausted;
              const showPwd = revealedPassword.has(l.id);
              const url = buildUrl(l.token);
              return (
                <motion.div key={l.id} layout initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -20 }}>
                  <Card className={`border transition-colors ${disabled ? 'border-border opacity-70' : 'border-border hover:border-border/80'}`}>
                    <CardContent className="p-4 space-y-3">
                      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                        <div className="flex items-start gap-3 min-w-0 flex-1">
                          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg bg-purple-100 dark:bg-purple-900/30 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 text-lg">
                            {tm.emoji}
                          </div>
                          <div className="min-w-0">
                            <h3 className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground line-clamp-1">{l.title}</h3>
                            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 mt-0.5">
                              <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-[10px] bg-muted text-muted-foreground">{tm.label}</Badge>
                              {l.isActive && !expired && !exhausted && (
                                <Badge className="text-[10px] bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 dark:bg-emerald-900/30 dark:text-emerald-400">نشط</Badge>
                              )}
                              {expired && <Badge variant="destructive" className="text-[10px]">منتهي الصلاحية</Badge>}
                              {exhausted && <Badge variant="destructive" className="text-[10px]">استُنفدت المشاهدات</Badge>}
                              {!l.isActive && !expired && !exhausted && (
                                <Badge className="text-[10px] bg-muted text-muted-foreground">متوقف</Badge>
                              )}
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex gap-0.5 shrink-0">
                          <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="h-7 w-7 text-muted-foreground hover:text-red-500" onClick={() => setConfirmDelete(l.id)} aria-label="حذف">
                            <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </Button>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {l.description && <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground line-clamp-2">{l.description}</p>}

                      {/* URL row */}
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <code className="flex-1 text-[11px] px-2 py-1.5 bg-muted rounded text-foreground truncate" dir="ltr">{url}</code>
                        <Button variant="outline" size="sm" className="h-8 gap-1 shrink-0" onClick={() => copyLink(l)}>
                          <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> نسخ
                        </Button>
                      </div>

                      {/* Meta row */}
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-1 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                        <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                          <Eye className="w-3 h-3" />{l.viewCount}{l.maxViews > 0 ? ` / ${l.maxViews}` : ''} مشاهدة
                        </span>
                        {l.expiresAt && (
                          <span className={`flex items-center gap-1 ${expired ? 'text-red-500' : ''}`}>
                            <Clock className="w-3 h-3" />تنتهي {fmtDate(l.expiresAt)}
                          </span>
                        )}
                        {l.password && (
                          <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                            <button type="button" onClick={() => togglePassword(l.id)} className="flex items-center gap-1 hover:text-foreground">
                              {showPwd ? <EyeOff className="w-3 h-3" /> : <Eye className="w-3 h-3" />}
                              كلمة المرور: {showPwd ? l.password : '••••'}
                            </button>
                          </span>
                        )}
                        <span className="text-muted-foreground/70">أُنشئ {fmtDateTime(l.createdAt)}</span>
                      </div>

                      {/* Toggle */}
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-2 border-t border-border">
                        <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">تفعيل الرابط</span>
                        <Switch checked={l.isActive} onCheckedChange={() => handleToggleActive(l)} />
                      </div>

                      <AnimatePresence>
                        {confirmDelete === l.id && (
                          <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, height: 'auto' }} exit={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
                            className="pt-2 border-t border-border">
                            <p className="text-xs text-red-500 mb-2">هل تريد حذف هذا الرابط؟ لا يمكن التراجع.</p>
                            <div className="flex gap-2">
                              <Button size="sm" variant="destructive" className="h-7 text-xs" onClick={() => handleDelete(l.id)}>حذف</Button>
                              <Button size="sm" variant="outline" className="h-7 text-xs" onClick={() => setConfirmDelete(null)}>إلغاء</Button>
                            </div>
                          </motion.div>
                        )}
                      </AnimatePresence>
                    </CardContent>
                  </Card>
                </motion.div>
              );
            })}
          </AnimatePresence>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Create Dialog */}
      <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="max-w-lg" dir="rtl">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>رابط مشاركة جديد</DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>أنشئ رابطاً آمناً لمشاركة محتواك</DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>نوع المحتوى</Label>
                <Select value={form.targetType} onValueChange={(v) => setForm({ ...form, targetType: v })}>
                  <SelectTrigger><SelectValue /></SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectContent>
                    {TARGET_TYPES.map((t) => <SelectItem key={t.value} value={t.value}>{t.emoji} {t.label}</SelectItem>)}
                  </SelectContent>
                </Select>
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>معرّف الهدف (اختياري)</Label>
                <Input placeholder="all أو معرّف محدد" value={form.targetId} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, targetId: e.target.value })} dir="ltr" />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>العنوان *</Label>
              <Input placeholder="مثال: مشاركة مشروع التخرج" value={form.title} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, title: e.target.value })} />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>الوصف</Label>
              <Textarea placeholder="وصف مختصر..." value={form.description} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, description: e.target.value })} className="min-h-[50px]" />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>كلمة المرور (اختياري)</Label>
              <Input type="text" placeholder="اتركه فارغاً للوصول المباشر" value={form.password} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, password: e.target.value })} dir="ltr" />
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>تاريخ الانتهاء (اختياري)</Label>
                <Input type="datetime-local" value={form.expiresAt} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, expiresAt: e.target.value })} />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>حد المشاهدات (اختياري)</Label>
                <Input type="number" min={0} placeholder="0 = غير محدود" value={form.maxViews} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, maxViews: e.target.value })} />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 p-3 rounded-lg bg-muted/50">
              <ExternalLink className="w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground shrink-0" />
              <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">سيتم إنشاء رابط فريد تلقائياً عند الحفظ.</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <DialogFooter>
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>إلغاء</Button>
            <Button onClick={handleSave} disabled={!form.title.trim()}>إنشاء الرابط</Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// ============================================
// MiMo Portfolio — Public Portfolio Section
// إدارة المعرض العام: تكوين المعرض، اختيار العناصر، السيرة، النسخ

import type { PortfolioConfig, Project, Certificate, Skill, Achievement } from '@/types';

const THEMES = [

  { value: 'slate', label: 'رمادي', color: 'bg-slate-500' },
];

const fmtDate = (s: string) => {
  if (!s) return '';
  try { return new Date(s).toLocaleDateString('ar', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' }); }
  catch { return s; }
};

export function PublicPortfolioSection() {
  const {
    portfolioConfigs, addPortfolioConfig, updatePortfolioConfig, deletePortfolioConfig,
    projects, certificates, skills, achievements,
  } = useAppStore();

  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

  const [showSkills, setShowSkills] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [showCerts, setShowCerts] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [showAchievements, setShowAchievements] = useState<string[]>([]);

  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    const active = portfolioConfigs.filter((c) => c.isActive).length;
    return { total: portfolioConfigs.length, active };
  }, [portfolioConfigs]);

  const openCreate = () => {
    setEditing(null);
    setTitle(''); setBio(''); setTheme('emerald'); setCustomDomain('');
    setShowProjects([]); setShowSkills([]); setShowCerts([]); setShowAchievements([]);
    setOpen(true);
  };

  const openEdit = (c: PortfolioConfig) => {
    setEditing(c);
    setTitle(c.title); setBio(c.bio); setTheme(c.theme); setCustomDomain(c.customDomain);
    setShowProjects([...c.showProjects]); setShowSkills([...c.showSkills]);
    setShowCerts([...c.showCertifications]); setShowAchievements([...c.showAchievements]);
    setOpen(true);
  };

  const toggle = (arr: string[], set: (v: string[]) => void, id: string) => {
    set(arr.includes(id) ? arr.filter((x) => x !== id) : [...arr, id]);
  };

  const handleSave = () => {
    if (!title.trim()) { toast({ title: 'العنوان مطلوب', variant: 'destructive' }); return; }
    const payload = {
      title: title.trim(),
      bio: bio.trim(),
      theme,
      customDomain: customDomain.trim(),
      showProjects, showSkills,
      showCertifications: showCerts,
      showAchievements,
      isActive: true,
    };
    if (editing) {
      updatePortfolioConfig(editing.id, payload);

  };

          <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm mb-3">لا توجد معارض عامة بعد</p>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-4">أنشئ معرضاً عاماً لمشاركة مشاريعك ومهاراتك وإنجازاتك</p>

              return (

                    <CardContent className="p-4 space-y-3">

            />

              selected={showCerts}

            />

              icon={<Trophy className="w-4 h-4 text-purple-500" />}
              title="الإنجازات"
              items={achievements.map((a: Achievement) => ({ id: a.id, label: a.title, sub: a.date }))}
              selected={showAchievements}
              onToggle={(id) => toggle(showAchievements, setShowAchievements, id)}
            />

            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </div>
  );
}

// ============ كتلة اختيار العناصر ============
interface SelectorItem { id: string; label: string; sub?: string; }
function SelectorBlock({ icon, title, items, selected, onToggle }: {
  icon: React.ReactNode;
  title: string;
  items: SelectorItem[];
  selected: string[];
  onToggle: (id: string) => void;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-2 p-3 rounded-lg border border-border">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          {icon}
          <span className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">{title}</span>
        </div>
        <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-[10px] bg-muted text-muted-foreground">{selected.length}/{items.length}</Badge>
      </div>
      {items.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground text-center py-2">لا توجد عناصر</p>
      ) : (
        <div className="max-h-44 overflow-y-auto space-y-1 pl-1">
          {items.map((it) => (
            <label key={it.id} className="flex items-center gap-2 p-1.5 rounded-md hover:bg-muted/50 cursor-pointer">
              <Checkbox checked={selected.includes(it.id)} onCheckedChange={() => onToggle(it.id)} />
              <span className="text-xs text-foreground flex-1 truncate">{it.label}</span>
              {it.sub && <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground shrink-0">{it.sub}</span>}
            </label>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```
