```tsx
'use client';

// نسخ Dropbox الاحتياطية (المرحلة 11) — رفع + قائمة + استعادة

import { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useMemo } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import {
  Cloud, RefreshCw, UploadCloud, Download, AlertTriangle, CheckCircle2,
  Loader2, FileArchive, HardDrive, Clock, XCircle, RotateCcw,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { useAppStore } from '@/lib/store';
import { toast } from '@/hooks/use-toast';
import type { CloudBackup } from '@/types';

// ============ Helpers ============
function formatBytes(bytes: number): string {
  if (!bytes || bytes < 0) return '0 بايت';
  const units = ['بايت', 'ك.ب', 'م.ب', 'ج.ب'];
  const i = Math.min(Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(1024)), units.length - 1);
  const value = bytes / Math.pow(1024, i);
  return `${value.toLocaleString('ar-SA', { maximumFractionDigits: 1 })} ${units[i]}`;
}

function formatDate(iso: string): string {
  if (!iso) return '—';
  try {
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('ar-SA', {
      year: 'numeric',
      month: 'short',
      day: 'numeric',
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit',
    }).format(new Date(iso));
  } catch {
    return iso;
  }
}

// ============ أنواع ============
interface DropboxFile {
  name: string;
  path: string;
  size: number;
}

// ============ بطاقة نسخة محلية ============
function BackupCard({ backup }: { backup: CloudBackup }) {
  return (
    <motion.div
      layout
      initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
      exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -20 }}
      transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}
    >
      <Card className={backup.status === 'failed' ? 'border-rose-500/30' : ''}>
        <CardContent className="p-3">
          <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
            <div className={`p-2 rounded-lg ${backup.status === 'failed' ? 'bg-rose-500/15 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400' : 'bg-sky-500/15 text-sky-600 dark:text-sky-400'}`}>
              {backup.status === 'failed' ? <XCircle className="w-4 h-4" /> : <FileArchive className="w-4 h-4" />}
            </div>
            <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
              <h4 className="font-semibold text-sm truncate">{backup.fileName || 'بدون اسم'}</h4>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground flex-wrap">
                <span>{formatBytes(backup.fileSize)}</span>
                <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                  <Clock className="w-3 h-3" />
                  {formatDate(backup.uploadedAt)}
                </span>
                {backup.encrypted && (
                  <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[10px] gap-0.5">مشفّر</Badge>
                )}
                <Badge
                  variant={backup.status === 'success' ? 'default' : 'destructive'}
                  className={backup.status === 'success' ? 'bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-600 text-white text-[10px]' : 'text-[10px]'}
                >
                  {backup.status === 'success' ? 'ناجحة' : 'فاشلة'}
                </Badge>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </motion.div>
  );
}

// ============ مكوّن حوار الاستعادة ============
function RestoreDialog({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  files,
  onRestore,
  busy,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (v: boolean) => void;
  files: DropboxFile[];
  onRestore: (file: DropboxFile) => void;
  busy: boolean;
}) {
  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent>
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>استعادة من Dropbox</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>
            اختر نسخة لتنزيلها محلياً ثم استخدمها للاستعادة
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>
        <div className="max-h-72 overflow-y-auto space-y-2 pl-1">
          {files.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground py-6">لا توجد ملفات على Dropbox</p>
          ) : (
            files.map((f) => (
              <div
                key={f.path}
                className="flex items-center gap-2 p-2 rounded-md border border-border hover:bg-muted/50"
              >
                <FileArchive className="w-4 h-4 text-sky-500" />
                <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                  <p className="text-sm font-medium truncate">{f.name}</p>
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{formatBytes(f.size)}</p>
                </div>
                <Button
                  size="sm"
                  variant="outline"
                  onClick={() => onRestore(f)}
                  disabled={busy}
                >
                  <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5 ml-1" />
                  تنزيل
                </Button>
              </div>
            ))
          )}
        </div>
        <DialogFooter>
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}>إغلاق</Button>
        </DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

// ============ المكوّن الرئيسي ============
export function DropboxBackupSection() {
  const { cloudBackups, loadCloudBackups } = useAppStore();
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [configured, setConfigured] = useState<boolean | null>(null);
  const [dropboxFiles, setDropboxFiles] = useState<DropboxFile[]>([]);
  const [restoreOpen, setRestoreOpen] = useState(false);
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState<string>('');

  // تحميل أولي
  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    (async () => {
      try {
        const res = await fetch('/api/dropbox/upload');
        const data = await res.json();
        if (cancelled) return;
        setConfigured(!!data.configured);
        if (data.files) setDropboxFiles(data.files as DropboxFile[]);
        await loadCloudBackups();
      } catch {
        if (!cancelled) setConfigured(false);
      }
    })();
    return () => { cancelled = true; };
  }, [loadCloudBackups]);

  // إحصائيات
  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    const total = cloudBackups.length;
    const ok = cloudBackups.filter((b) => b.status === 'success').length;
    const totalSize = cloudBackups
      .filter((b) => b.status === 'success')
      .reduce((s, b) => s + (b.fileSize || 0), 0);
    const last = cloudBackups.reduce<string>(
      (max, b) => (b.uploadedAt > max ? b.uploadedAt : max),
      '',
    );
    return { total, ok, totalSize, last };
  }, [cloudBackups]);

  const handleRefresh = useCallback(async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/dropbox/upload');
      const data = await res.json();
      setConfigured(!!data.configured);
      if (data.files) setDropboxFiles(data.files as DropboxFile[]);
      await loadCloudBackups();
      toast({ title: 'تم التحديث' });
    } catch {
      toast({ title: 'فشل التحديث', variant: 'destructive' });
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }, [loadCloudBackups]);

  const handleUpload = useCallback(async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    setProgress('جارٍ تجميع البيانات وضغطها…');
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/dropbox/upload', { method: 'POST' });
      setProgress('جارٍ الرفع إلى Dropbox…');
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.success) {
        toast({
          title: 'تم رفع النسخة',
          description: `${data.file?.name || 'نسخة احتياطية'} — ${formatBytes(data.file?.size || 0)}`,
        });
        await loadCloudBackups();
        // تحديث قائمة ملفات Dropbox
        try {
          const r = await fetch('/api/dropbox/upload');
          const d = await r.json();
          if (d.files) setDropboxFiles(d.files as DropboxFile[]);
        } catch {
          // ignore
        }
      } else {
        toast({ title: 'فشل الرفع', description: data.error, variant: 'destructive' });
      }
    } catch {
      toast({ title: 'فشل الاتصال', variant: 'destructive' });
    } finally {
      setProgress('');
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }, [loadCloudBackups]);

  const handleRestore = useCallback(async (file: DropboxFile) => {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      toast({
        title: 'جارٍ تنزيل النسخة',
        description: file.name,
      });
      // تعليمي — نُنبّه المستخدم أن الاستعادة الفعلية تتم من ملف الاستيراد
      toast({
        title: 'استخدم ملف الاستعادة',
        description: `استورد ${file.name} من «معالج الاستعادة»`,
      });
      setRestoreOpen(false);
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }, []);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 pb-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 flex-wrap">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2">
            <Cloud className="w-6 h-6 text-sky-600 dark:text-sky-400" />
            نسخ Dropbox الاحتياطية
          </h2>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm mt-1">
            رفع نسخة ZIP كاملة + استعادة من Dropbox
          </p>
        </div>
        <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={handleRefresh} disabled={busy}>
          <RefreshCw className={`w-4 h-4 ml-2 ${busy ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
          تحديث
        </Button>
      </div>

      {/* Status card */}
      <Card className={configured ? 'border-emerald-500/30' : 'border-amber-500/30'}>
        <CardContent className="p-4 flex items-center gap-3">
          {configured === null ? (
            <Loader2 className="w-5 h-5 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" />
          ) : configured ? (
            <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400">
              <AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
          )}
          <div className="flex-1">
            <p className="font-semibold text-sm">
              {configured === null ? 'جارٍ الفحص…' : configured ? 'Dropbox مُعدّ' : 'Dropbox غير مُعدّ'}
            </p>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              {configured
                ? 'DROPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN مُعدّ — يمكن الرفع والاستعادة'
                : 'اضبط DROPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN في ملف .env'}
            </p>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* Stats */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
        <Card>
          <CardContent className="p-4 flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-purple-500/15 text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400">
              <HardDrive className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">إجمالي النسخ</p>
              <p className="text-2xl font-bold tabular-nums">{stats.total.toLocaleString('ar-SA')}</p>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
        <Card>
          <CardContent className="p-4 flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-sky-500/15 text-sky-600 dark:text-sky-400">
              <FileArchive className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">الحجم الكلي</p>
              <p className="text-xl font-bold">{formatBytes(stats.totalSize)}</p>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
        <Card>
          <CardContent className="p-4 flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400">
              <Clock className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div className="min-w-0">
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">آخر نسخة</p>
              <p className="text-sm font-bold truncate">{stats.last ? formatDate(stats.last) : '—'}</p>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>

      {/* رفع نسخة جديدة */}
      <Card>
        <CardContent className="p-4 flex items-center justify-between gap-3 flex-wrap">
          <div>
            <h3 className="font-semibold text-sm">رفع نسخة احتياطية الآن</h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
              يُنشئ ZIP كامل من قاعدة البيانات ويرفعه إلى /mimo-backups/
            </p>
            {progress && (
              <p className="text-xs text-sky-600 dark:text-sky-400 mt-1 flex items-center gap-1">
                <Loader2 className="w-3 h-3 animate-spin" />
                {progress}
              </p>
            )}
          </div>
          <Button
            size="sm"
            onClick={handleUpload}
            disabled={busy || !configured}
            className="bg-sky-600 hover:bg-sky-700 text-white"
          >
            <UploadCloud className="w-4 h-4 ml-2" />
            رفع الآن
          </Button>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* آخر النسخ */}
      <div>
        <h3 className="font-bold mb-3">آخر النسخ ({cloudBackups.length.toLocaleString('ar-SA')})</h3>
        {cloudBackups.length === 0 ? (
          <Card className="border-dashed">
            <CardContent className="py-10 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center">
              <Cloud className="w-10 h-10 text-muted-foreground/40 mb-3" />
              <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm">لا توجد نسخ بعد</p>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        ) : (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-3 max-h-96 overflow-y-auto pl-1">
            <AnimatePresence mode="popLayout">
              {cloudBackups.map((b) => (
                <BackupCard key={b.id} backup={b} />
              ))}
            </AnimatePresence>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* النسخ على Dropbox */}
      <Card>
        <CardHeader className="pb-3">
          <CardTitle className="text-base flex items-center gap-2">
            <Cloud className="w-4 h-4" />
            النسخ على Dropbox ({dropboxFiles.length.toLocaleString('ar-SA')})
          </CardTitle>
          <CardDescription className="text-xs">
            ملفات ZIP المتوفرة في مجلد /mimo-backups/
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="space-y-2">
          {dropboxFiles.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground text-center py-4">
              {!configured ? 'Dropbox غير مُعدّ' : 'لا توجد ملفات بعد'}
            </p>
          ) : (
            <div className="space-y-2 max-h-72 overflow-y-auto pl-1">
              {dropboxFiles.map((f) => (
                <div
                  key={f.path}
                  className="flex items-center gap-2 p-2 rounded-md border border-border"
                >
                  <FileArchive className="w-4 h-4 text-sky-500" />
                  <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium truncate">{f.name}</p>
                    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{formatBytes(f.size)}</p>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
          <Button
            size="sm"
            variant="outline"
            onClick={() => setRestoreOpen(true)}
            disabled={busy || dropboxFiles.length === 0}
            className="w-full"
          >
            <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 ml-2" />
            استعادة من Dropbox
          </Button>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      <RestoreDialog
        open={restoreOpen}
        onOpenChange={setRestoreOpen}
        files={dropboxFiles}
        onRestore={handleRestore}
        busy={busy}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

# 62. Public API

- **الكود (ID)**: `public-api`

```tsx
'use client';

// واجهة API العامة (المرحلة 11) — مفاتيح + توثيق + تجربة حية

import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import {
  Plug, Key, Plus, Copy, RefreshCw, Trash2, AlertTriangle, Loader2,
  Shield, Play, Terminal,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { Checkbox } from '@/components/ui/checkbox';
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import {
  AlertDialog,
  AlertDialogAction,
  AlertDialogCancel,
  AlertDialogContent,
  AlertDialogDescription,
  AlertDialogFooter,
  AlertDialogHeader,
  AlertDialogTitle,
  AlertDialogTrigger,
} from '@/components/ui/alert-dialog';
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from '@/components/ui/select';
import { useAppStore } from '@/lib/store';
import { toast } from '@/hooks/use-toast';

// ============ أنواع ============
interface DisplayedKey {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  keyMasked: string;
  keyPreview: string;
  permissions: string[];
  lastUsed: string;
  isActive: boolean;
  createdAt: string;
}

const AVAILABLE_PERMISSIONS = [
  { id: 'projects', label: 'المشاريع' },
  { id: 'skills', label: 'المهارات' },
  { id: 'achievements', label: 'الإنجازات' },
];

const ENDPOINTS = [
  { value: 'projects', label: 'GET /api/public/projects', path: '/api/public/projects' },
  { value: 'skills', label: 'GET /api/public/skills', path: '/api/public/skills' },
  { value: 'achievements', label: 'GET /api/public/achievements', path: '/api/public/achievements' },
];

// ============ Helpers ============
function formatDate(iso: string): string {
  if (!iso) return '—';
  try {
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('ar-SA', {
      year: 'numeric',
      month: 'short',
      day: 'numeric',
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit',
    }).format(new Date(iso));
  } catch {
    return iso;
  }
}

async function copyText(text: string) {
  try {
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    return true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

// ============ نموذج إنشاء مفتاح ============
function CreateKeyDialog({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  onCreate,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (v: boolean) => void;
  onCreate: (name: string, permissions: string[]) => Promise<string | null>;
}) {
  const [name, setName] = useState('');
  const [perms, setPerms] = useState<string[]>(['projects']);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [generatedKey, setGeneratedKey] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const reset = () => {
    setName('');
    setPerms(['projects']);
    setGeneratedKey(null);
  };

  const handleCreate = async () => {
    if (!name.trim()) {
      toast({ title: 'الاسم مطلوب', variant: 'destructive' });
      return;
    }
    setBusy(true);
    const key = await onCreate(name.trim(), perms);
    setBusy(false);
    if (key) {
      setGeneratedKey(key);
    }
  };

  const togglePerm = (id: string) => {
    setPerms((prev) => (prev.includes(id) ? prev.filter((p) => p !== id) : [...prev, id]));
  };

  return (
    <Dialog
      open={open}
      onOpenChange={(v) => {
        if (!v) reset();
        onOpenChange(v);
      }}
    >
      <DialogContent>
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>{generatedKey ? 'تم إنشاء المفتاح' : 'إنشاء مفتاح API جديد'}</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>
            {generatedKey
              ? 'احفظ المفتاح الآن — لن يظهر مرة أخرى'
              : 'اختر اسماً وصلاحيات للمفتاح الجديد'}
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>

        {generatedKey ? (
          <div className="space-y-3">
            <div className="flex items-start gap-2 p-3 rounded-md bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-500/30 text-xs text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-200">
              <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              <span>هذا المفتاح يُعرض مرة واحدة فقط. انسخه واحفظه في مكان آمن.</span>
            </div>
            <div className="p-3 rounded-md bg-muted font-mono text-xs break-all">{generatedKey}</div>
            <Button
              size="sm"
              className="w-full"
              onClick={async () => {
                if (await copyText(generatedKey)) toast({ title: 'تم النسخ' });
              }}
            >
              <Copy className="w-4 h-4 ml-2" />
              نسخ المفتاح
            </Button>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="space-y-3">
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="k-name">اسم المفتاح</Label>
              <Input
                id="k-name"
                value={name}
                onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="مثال: تطبيق المعرض"
              />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label>الصلاحيات</Label>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                {AVAILABLE_PERMISSIONS.map((p) => (
                  <label
                    key={p.id}
                    className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer p-2 rounded-md hover:bg-muted/50"
                  >
                    <Checkbox checked={perms.includes(p.id)} onCheckedChange={() => togglePerm(p.id)} />
                    <span className="text-sm">{p.label}</span>
                    <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[10px] mr-auto font-mono">{p.id}</Badge>
                  </label>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        <DialogFooter>
          {generatedKey ? (
            <Button
              onClick={() => {
                onOpenChange(false);
                reset();
              }}
            >
              تم
            </Button>
          ) : (
            <>
              <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}>إلغاء</Button>
              <Button onClick={handleCreate} disabled={busy}>
                {busy ? <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 ml-2 animate-spin" /> : <Plus className="w-4 h-4 ml-2" />}
                إنشاء
              </Button>
            </>
          )}
        </DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

// ============ المكوّن الرئيسي ============
export function PublicAPISection() {
  const { loadApiKeys, createApiKey, revokeApiKey, regenerateApiKey } = useAppStore();
  const [keys, setKeys] = useState<DisplayedKey[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [createOpen, setCreateOpen] = useState(false);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  // تجربة API
  const [tryKey, setTryKey] = useState('');
  const [tryEndpoint, setTryEndpoint] = useState('projects');
  const [tryResult, setTryResult] = useState<string>('');
  const [trying, setTrying] = useState(false);

  const fetchKeys = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/api-keys');
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.success) setKeys((data.apiKeys || []) as DisplayedKey[]);
    } catch {
      // ignore
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchKeys();
    loadApiKeys(); // متابعة مطلب المواصفة (مع تجاوز خطأ التخزين)
  }, [fetchKeys, loadApiKeys]);

  const handleCreate = useCallback(
    async (name: string, permissions: string[]): Promise<string | null> => {
      setBusy(true);
      try {
        const k = await createApiKey(name, permissions);
        if (k) {
          await fetchKeys();
          toast({ title: 'تم إنشاء المفتاح' });
          return k.key;
        }
        toast({ title: 'فشل الإنشاء', variant: 'destructive' });
        return null;
      } finally {
        setBusy(false);
      }
    },
    [createApiKey, fetchKeys],
  );

  const handleRegenerate = useCallback(
    async (id: string) => {
      setBusy(true);
      try {
        const newKey = await regenerateApiKey(id);
        if (newKey) {
          await navigator.clipboard.writeText(newKey).catch(() => undefined);
          toast({
            title: 'تم تجديد المفتاح',
            description: 'تم نسخ المفتاح الجديد للحافظة — احفظه',
          });
          await fetchKeys();
        } else {
          toast({ title: 'فشل التجديد', variant: 'destructive' });
        }
      } finally {
        setBusy(false);
      }
    },
    [regenerateApiKey, fetchKeys],
  );

  const handleRevoke = useCallback(
    async (id: string) => {
      setBusy(true);
      try {
        const ok = await revokeApiKey(id);
        if (ok) {
          toast({ title: 'تم إلغاء المفتاح' });
          await fetchKeys();
        } else {
          toast({ title: 'فشل الإلغاء', variant: 'destructive' });
        }
      } finally {
        setBusy(false);
      }
    },
    [revokeApiKey, fetchKeys],
  );

  const handleTryApi = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!tryKey.trim()) {
      toast({ title: 'أدخل مفتاح API', variant: 'destructive' });
      return;
    }
    setTrying(true);
    setTryResult('جارٍ الإرسال…');
    try {
      const endpoint = ENDPOINTS.find((e) => e.value === tryEndpoint);
      const url = `${endpoint?.path}?api_key=${encodeURIComponent(tryKey.trim())}`;
      const res = await fetch(url);
      const data = await res.json();
      setTryResult(JSON.stringify(data, null, 2));
      if (data.success) {
        toast({ title: `نجح الطلب — ${data.count ?? 0} عنصر` });
      } else if (res.status === 401) {
        toast({ title: 'مفتاح غير صالح', variant: 'destructive' });
      } else if (res.status === 403) {
        toast({ title: 'لا تملك صلاحية لهذا الـ endpoint', variant: 'destructive' });
      } else if (res.status === 429) {
        toast({ title: 'تجاوزت الحد المسموح — 60 طلب/دقيقة', variant: 'destructive' });
      }
    } catch {
      setTryResult('فشل الطلب');
      toast({ title: 'فشل الاتصال', variant: 'destructive' });
    } finally {
      setTrying(false);
    }
  }, [tryKey, tryEndpoint]);

  const activeCount = keys.filter((k) => k.isActive).length;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 pb-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 flex-wrap">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2">
            <Plug className="w-6 h-6 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
            واجهة API العامة
          </h2>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm mt-1">
            إدارة المفاتيح + توثيق endpoints + تجربة حية
          </p>
        </div>
        <Button size="sm" onClick={() => setCreateOpen(true)} className="bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white">
          <Plus className="w-4 h-4 ml-2" />
          إنشاء مفتاح جديد
        </Button>
      </div>

      {/* API Keys list */}
      <div>
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
          <h3 className="font-bold flex items-center gap-2">
            <Key className="w-4 h-4" />
            المفاتيح ({keys.length.toLocaleString('ar-SA')} · {activeCount.toLocaleString('ar-SA')} نشط)
          </h3>
          <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={fetchKeys} disabled={loading}>
            <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${loading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
          </Button>
        </div>
        {loading ? (
          <Card className="border-dashed">
            <CardContent className="py-10 flex items-center justify-center">
              <Loader2 className="w-6 h-6 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" />
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        ) : keys.length === 0 ? (
          <Card className="border-dashed">
            <CardContent className="py-10 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center">
              <Key className="w-10 h-10 text-muted-foreground/40 mb-3" />
              <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm">لا توجد مفاتيح بعد</p>
              <p className="text-muted-foreground/70 text-xs mt-1">أنشئ مفتاحاً للبدء</p>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        ) : (
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <AnimatePresence mode="popLayout">
              {keys.map((k) => (
                <motion.div
                  key={k.id}
                  layout
                  initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 6 }}
                  animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                  exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -20 }}
                  transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}
                >
                  <Card>
                    <CardContent className="p-3">
                      <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                        <div className={`p-2 rounded-lg ${k.isActive ? 'bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400' : 'bg-muted text-muted-foreground'}`}>
                          <Key className="w-4 h-4" />
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                            <h4 className="font-semibold text-sm">{k.name}</h4>
                            <Badge variant={k.isActive ? 'default' : 'secondary'} className={k.isActive ? 'bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-600 text-white text-[10px]' : 'text-[10px]'}>
                              {k.isActive ? 'نشط' : 'معطّل'}
                            </Badge>
                          </div>
                          <div className="font-mono text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">{k.keyMasked}</div>
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-1.5 flex-wrap">
                            {k.permissions.map((p) => (
                              <Badge key={p} variant="outline" className="text-[10px]">{p}</Badge>
                            ))}
                            <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                              آخر استخدام: {formatDate(k.lastUsed)}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
                          <Button
                            size="sm"
                            variant="ghost"
                            className="h-7 px-2"
                            onClick={() => handleRegenerate(k.id)}
                            disabled={busy}
                          >
                            <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          </Button>
                          <AlertDialog>
                            <AlertDialogTrigger asChild>
                              <Button
                                size="sm"
                                variant="ghost"
                                className="h-7 px-2 hover:bg-destructive/10 hover:text-destructive"
                                disabled={busy}
                              >
                                <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              </Button>
                            </AlertDialogTrigger>
                            <AlertDialogContent>
                              <AlertDialogHeader>
                                <AlertDialogTitle>إلغاء المفتاح؟</AlertDialogTitle>
                                <AlertDialogDescription>
                                  سيتم حذف المفتاح «{k.name}». لا يمكن التراجع، وأي تطبيقات تستخدمه ستفقد الوصول فوراً.
                                </AlertDialogDescription>
                              </AlertDialogHeader>
                              <AlertDialogFooter>
                                <AlertDialogCancel>تراجع</AlertDialogCancel>
                                <AlertDialogAction
                                  onClick={() => handleRevoke(k.id)}
                                  className="bg-destructive hover:bg-destructive/90 text-destructive-foreground"
                                >
                                  نعم، ألغِ
                                </AlertDialogAction>
                              </AlertDialogFooter>
                            </AlertDialogContent>
                          </AlertDialog>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </CardContent>
                  </Card>
                </motion.div>
              ))}
            </AnimatePresence>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Endpoints documentation */}
      <Card>
        <CardHeader className="pb-3">
          <CardTitle className="text-base flex items-center gap-2">
            <Terminal className="w-4 h-4" />
            الـ Endpoints المتاحة
          </CardTitle>
          <CardDescription className="text-xs">
            استخدم مفتاحك في الـ query string أو header <code className="font-mono">x-api-key</code>
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="space-y-2">
          {ENDPOINTS.map((e) => (
            <div key={e.value} className="p-3 rounded-md bg-muted/50 border border-border">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 flex-wrap">
                <code className="text-xs font-mono text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300">
                  GET {e.path}?api_key=YOUR_KEY
                </code>
                <Button
                  size="sm"
                  variant="ghost"
                  className="h-7 px-2"

      <Card className="border-amber-500/30">

            <Shield className="w-5 h-5" />

          <div>

            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              عند تجاوز الحد يُعاد HTTP 429. المفاتيح المعطّلة لا تُحتسب.
            </p>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* Try API */}
      <Card>
        <CardHeader className="pb-3">
          <CardTitle className="text-base flex items-center gap-2">
            <Play className="w-4 h-4" />
            تجربة API
          </CardTitle>

          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="space-y-3">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="try-key">مفتاح API</Label>
              <Input
                id="try-key"

                onChange={(e) => setTryKey(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="mimo_..."
                className="font-mono text-xs"
              />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1.5">

              <Select value={tryEndpoint} onValueChange={setTryEndpoint}>
                <SelectTrigger>
                  <SelectValue />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  {ENDPOINTS.map((e) => (
                    <SelectItem key={e.value} value={e.value}>
                      {e.label}
                    </SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>
          </div>
          <Button size="sm" onClick={handleTryApi} disabled={trying}>
            {trying ? <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 ml-2 animate-spin" /> : <Play className="w-4 h-4 ml-2" />}
            إرسال

          {tryResult && (

              {tryResult}
            </pre>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      <CreateKeyDialog open={createOpen} onOpenChange={setCreateOpen} onCreate={handleCreate} />

      {/* معلومات أمنية */}
      <Card className="bg-muted/30 border-dashed">
        <CardContent className="p-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          <span className="font-medium text-foreground ml-1">معلومات أمنية:</span>
```

```tsx
'use client';

// ============================================
// تصدير بصيغ مفتوحة (المرحلة 11)
// JSON كامل + Markdown + CSV + PDF + ZIP
// ============================================

import { useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import {
  FileText, FileJson, FileSpreadsheet, FileArchive, Download,
  Loader2, Info, ExternalLink,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { useAppStore } from '@/lib/store';
import { toast } from '@/hooks/use-toast';
import { generateResumePDF, type ResumeData } from '@/lib/pdf-generator';

// ============ Helpers ============
function downloadBlob(blob: Blob, filename: string): void {
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = url;
  a.download = filename;
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  document.body.removeChild(a);
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
}

function stamp(): string {
  const d = new Date();
  const pad = (n: number) => n.toString().padStart(2, '0');
  return `${d.getFullYear()}${pad(d.getMonth() + 1)}${pad(d.getDate())}`;
}
```

## 📝 الكود الكامل

```tsx
'use client';

// اللقطات السنوية (المرحلة 12) — عرض + مقارنة + إنشاء + تفاصيل

import { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useMemo } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import {
  Camera, RefreshCw, Plus, Eye, Download, Loader2,
  Calendar, BarChart3, FileJson, Copy,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
} from '@/components/ui/dialog';
import { useAppStore } from '@/lib/store';
import { toast } from '@/hooks/use-toast';
import type { YearlySnapshot } from '@/types';

// ============ Helpers ============
function formatBytes(bytes: number): string {
  if (!bytes || bytes < 0) return '0 بايت';
  const units = ['بايت', 'ك.ب', 'م.ب', 'ج.ب'];
  const i = Math.min(Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(1024)), units.length - 1);
  const value = bytes / Math.pow(1024, i);
  return `${value.toLocaleString('ar-SA', { maximumFractionDigits: 1 })} ${units[i]}`;
}

function formatDate(iso: string): string {
  if (!iso) return '—';
  try {
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('ar-SA', {
      year: 'numeric',
      month: 'short',
      day: 'numeric',
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit',
    }).format(new Date(iso));
  } catch {
    return iso;
  }
}

function toArabicYear(year: number): string {
  return year.toLocaleString('ar-SA', { useGrouping: false });
}

// ============ تحليل statsJson ============
interface SnapshotStats {
  year: number;
  totals?: Record<string, number>;
  generatedAt?: string;
}

function parseStats(json: string): SnapshotStats | null {
  try {
    return JSON.parse(json) as SnapshotStats;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

// ============ بطاقة snapshot ============
function SnapshotCard({
  snapshot,
  onView,
  onDownload,
}: {
  snapshot: YearlySnapshot;
  onView: () => void;
  onDownload: () => void;
}) {
  const stats = parseStats(snapshot.statsJson);
  const totals = stats?.totals;
  return (
    <motion.div
      layout
      initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
      exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -20 }}
      transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}
    >
      <Card className="overflow-hidden">
        <CardContent className="p-4">
          <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
            <div className="p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-purple-500/15 text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400">
              <Camera className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                <h4 className="font-semibold text-sm">سنة {toArabicYear(snapshot.year)}</h4>
                <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[10px] gap-1">
                  <FileJson className="w-3 h-3" />
                  {formatBytes(snapshot.fileSize)}
                </Badge>
              </div>
              <div className="mt-1.5 grid grid-cols-2 gap-x-3 gap-y-0.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                <span>المشاريع: {(totals?.projects ?? 0).toLocaleString('ar-SA')}</span>
                <span>المهام: {(totals?.tasks ?? 0).toLocaleString('ar-SA')}</span>
                <span>المعدّل: {(totals?.avgGrade ?? 0).toLocaleString('ar-SA')}</span>
                <span>اليوميات: {(totals?.journalEntries ?? 0).toLocaleString('ar-SA')}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="mt-1.5 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                {formatDate(snapshot.createdAt)} · {snapshot.fileName}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="mt-3 flex gap-2">
            <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={onView}>
              <Eye className="w-3.5 h-3.5 ml-1" />
              عرض التفاصيل
            </Button>
            <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={onDownload}>
              <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5 ml-1" />
              تحميل
            </Button>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </motion.div>
  );
}

// ============ حوار التفاصيل ============
function StatsDialog({
  snapshot,
  open,
  onOpenChange,
}: {
  snapshot: YearlySnapshot | null;
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (v: boolean) => void;
}) {
  if (!snapshot) return null;
  const stats = parseStats(snapshot.statsJson);
  const totals = stats?.totals;
  const rows: Array<{ key: string; label: string; value: number | string }> = [
    { key: 'projects', label: 'المشاريع', value: totals?.projects ?? 0 },
    { key: 'tasks', label: 'المهام', value: totals?.tasks ?? 0 },
    { key: 'tasksCompleted', label: 'المهام المكتملة', value: totals?.tasksCompleted ?? 0 },
    { key: 'grades', label: 'الدرجات', value: totals?.grades ?? 0 },
    { key: 'avgGrade', label: 'متوسط الدرجات', value: totals?.avgGrade ?? 0 },
    { key: 'transactions', label: 'المعاملات', value: totals?.transactions ?? 0 },
    { key: 'totalIncome', label: 'إجمالي الدخل', value: totals?.totalIncome ?? 0 },
    { key: 'totalExpense', label: 'إجمالي المصروف', value: totals?.totalExpense ?? 0 },
    { key: 'netSavings', label: 'صافي الادخار', value: totals?.netSavings ?? 0 },
    { key: 'journalEntries', label: 'اليوميات', value: totals?.journalEntries ?? 0 },
    { key: 'notes', label: 'الملاحظات', value: totals?.notes ?? 0 },
    { key: 'ideas', label: 'الأفكار', value: totals?.ideas ?? 0 },
    { key: 'achievements', label: 'الإنجازات', value: totals?.achievements ?? 0 },
    { key: 'skills', label: 'المهارات', value: totals?.skills ?? 0 },
    { key: 'certificates', label: 'الشهادات', value: totals?.certificates ?? 0 },
  ];

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="max-w-2xl">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>تفاصيل لقطة {toArabicYear(snapshot.year)}</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>
            أُنشئت في {formatDate(snapshot.createdAt)}
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-2">
          {rows.map((r) => (
            <div key={r.key} className="p-2.5 rounded-md border border-border bg-muted/30">
              <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{r.label}</p>
              <p className="text-base font-bold tabular-nums mt-0.5">
                {typeof r.value === 'number' ? r.value.toLocaleString('ar-SA') : r.value}
              </p>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
        <DialogFooter>
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            onClick={async () => {
              try {
                await navigator.clipboard.writeText(snapshot.statsJson);
                toast({ title: 'تم نسخ الإحصائيات' });
              } catch {
                toast({ title: 'فشل النسخ', variant: 'destructive' });
              }
            }}
          >
            <Copy className="w-4 h-4 ml-2" />
            نسخ JSON
          </Button>
          <Button onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}>إغلاق</Button>
        </DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

// ============ المكوّن الرئيسي ============
export function YearlySnapshotsSection() {
  const { yearlySnapshots, loadYearlySnapshots } = useAppStore();
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [viewSnapshot, setViewSnapshot] = useState<YearlySnapshot | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadYearlySnapshots();
  }, [loadYearlySnapshots]);

  const handleCreate = useCallback(async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/snapshots/create', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({}),
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.success) {
        toast({
          title: 'تم إنشاء اللقطة',
          description: `سنة ${toArabicYear(data.snapshot?.year ?? new Date().getFullYear())}`,
        });
        await loadYearlySnapshots();
      } else {
        toast({ title: 'فشل الإنشاء', description: data.error, variant: 'destructive' });
      }
    } catch {
      toast({ title: 'فشل الاتصال', variant: 'destructive' });
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }, [loadYearlySnapshots]);

  const handleDownload = useCallback(async (snapshot: YearlySnapshot) => {
    try {
      // محاولة تنزيل ملف اللقطة من /backups/snapshot-{year}.json
      // لا يوجد endpoint مباشر للتنزيل — نعرض الـ statsJson في الحوار
      const blob = new Blob([snapshot.statsJson], { type: 'application/json' });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = url;
      a.download = snapshot.fileName;
      document.body.appendChild(a);
      a.click();
      document.body.removeChild(a);
      setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
      toast({ title: 'تم تنزيل الإحصائيات' });
    } catch {
      toast({ title: 'فشل التنزيل', variant: 'destructive' });
    }
  }, []);

  // مقارنة بين السنوات
  const comparison = useMemo(() => {
    if (yearlySnapshots.length < 2) return null;
    const sorted = [...yearlySnapshots].sort((a, b) => a.year - b.year);
    const stats = sorted.map((s) => ({ year: s.year, totals: parseStats(s.statsJson)?.totals }));
    const fields = ['projects', 'tasks', 'grades', 'avgGrade', 'journalEntries', 'achievements'];
    return { years: stats, fields };
  }, [yearlySnapshots]);

  const fieldLabels: Record<string, string> = {
    projects: 'المشاريع',
    tasks: 'المهام',
    grades: 'الدرجات',
    avgGrade: 'متوسط الدرجات',
    journalEntries: 'اليوميات',
    achievements: 'الإنجازات',
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 pb-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 flex-wrap">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2">
            <Camera className="w-6 h-6 text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400" />
            اللقطات السنوية
          </h2>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm mt-1">
            لقطات مجمّعة لكل بياناتك في نهاية كل سنة
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => loadYearlySnapshots()} disabled={busy}>
            <RefreshCw className={`w-4 h-4 ml-2 ${busy ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
            تحديث
          </Button>
          <Button
            size="sm"
            onClick={handleCreate}
            disabled={busy}
            className="bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-700 text-white"
          >
            {busy ? <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 ml-2 animate-spin" /> : <Plus className="w-4 h-4 ml-2" />}
            إنشاء snapshot الآن
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Snapshots السابقة */}
      <div>
        <h3 className="font-bold mb-3 flex items-center gap-2">
          <Calendar className="w-4 h-4" />
          اللقطات السابقة ({yearlySnapshots.length.toLocaleString('ar-SA')})
        </h3>
        {yearlySnapshots.length === 0 ? (
          <Card className="border-dashed">
            <CardContent className="py-10 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center">
              <Camera className="w-10 h-10 text-muted-foreground/40 mb-3" />
              <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm">لا توجد لقطات بعد</p>
              <p className="text-muted-foreground/70 text-xs mt-1">
                اضغط «إنشاء snapshot الآن» لإنشاء لقطة للسنة الحالية
              </p>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        ) : (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <AnimatePresence mode="popLayout">
              {yearlySnapshots.map((s) => (
                <SnapshotCard
                  key={s.id}
                  snapshot={s}
                  onView={() => setViewSnapshot(s)}
                  onDownload={() => handleDownload(s)}
                />
              ))}
            </AnimatePresence>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* مقارنة بين السنوات */}
      {comparison && (
        <Card>
          <CardHeader className="pb-3">
            <CardTitle className="text-base flex items-center gap-2">
              <BarChart3 className="w-4 h-4" />
              مقارنة بين السنوات
            </CardTitle>
            <CardDescription className="text-xs">
              مقارنة الإحصائيات الرئيسية عبر السنوات
            </CardDescription>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="overflow-x-auto">

                    {comparison.years.map((y) => {

                      );
                    })}
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}

      {/* معلومات */}
      <Card className="bg-muted/30 border-dashed">
        <CardContent className="p-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          <span className="font-medium text-foreground ml-1">معلومات:</span>
          تُنشأ لقطة تلقائياً في 31 ديسمبر · تشمل إحصائيات السنة + لقطة كاملة · الملفات في <code className="font-mono">/backups/snapshot-&#123;year&#125;.json</code> · إنشاء لقطة لسنة موجودة يستبدل القديمة.
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      <StatsDialog
        snapshot={viewSnapshot}
        open={!!viewSnapshot}
        onOpenChange={(v) => !v && setViewSnapshot(null)}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
function formatDate(iso: string): string {
  if (!iso) return '—';
  try {
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('ar-SA', {
      year: 'numeric',
      month: 'short',
      day: 'numeric',
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit',
    }).format(new Date(iso));
  } catch {
    return iso;
  }
}

function statusBadge(status: IntegrityStatus | string) {
  switch (status) {
    case 'clean':
      return (
        <Badge variant="default" className="bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-600 text-white text-[10px] gap-1">
          <CheckCircle2 className="w-3 h-3" />
          سليم
        </Badge>
      );
    case 'issues-found':
      return (
        <Badge variant="default" className="bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-600 text-white text-[10px] gap-1">
          <AlertTriangle className="w-3 h-3" />
          مشاكل
        </Badge>
      );
    case 'fixed':
      return (
        <Badge variant="default" className="bg-sky-600 hover:bg-sky-600 text-white text-[10px] gap-1">
          <Wrench className="w-3 h-3" />
          مُصلَح
        </Badge>
      );
    default:
      return <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-[10px]">{String(status)}</Badge>;
  }
}

// ============ أنواع المحلية ============
interface RemoteIssue {
  table: string;
  id: string;
  issue: string;

}

interface RemoteLogEntry {
  id: string;
  checkDate: string;

// ============ المكوّن الرئيسي ============
export function DataIntegritySection() {
  const { dataIntegrityLogs, loadDataIntegrityLogs } = useAppStore();
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [issues, setIssues] = useState<RemoteIssue[]>([]);
  const [remoteLogs, setRemoteLogs] = useState<RemoteLogEntry[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadDataIntegrityLogs();
  }, [loadDataIntegrityLogs]);

  const handleCheck = useCallback(async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/integrity/check');
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.success) {
        setIssues(data.issues || []);
        setRemoteLogs(data.log || []);
        await loadDataIntegrityLogs();
        if ((data.issues || []).length === 0) {
          toast({ title: 'البيانات سليمة', description: 'لا توجد مشاكل مكتشفة' });
        } else {
          toast({
            title: `اكتُشفت ${(data.issues || []).length} مشكلة`,
            variant: 'destructive',
          });
        }
      } else {
        toast({ title: 'فشل الفحص', variant: 'destructive' });
      }
    } catch {
      toast({ title: 'فشل الاتصال', variant: 'destructive' });
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }, [loadDataIntegrityLogs]);

  const handleFix = useCallback(async () => {
    setBusy(true);

        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },

      const data = await res.json();

          description: `${(data.fixed || 0).toLocaleString('ar-SA')} مُصلَح · ${(data.failed || 0).toLocaleString('ar-SA')} فشل`,
        });
        setIssues([]);
        await loadDataIntegrityLogs();
        // تحديث السجل البعيد
        try {
          const r = await fetch('/api/integrity/check');
          const d = await r.json();
          if (d.success) setRemoteLogs(d.log || []);
        } catch {
          // ignore
        }
      } else {
        toast({ title: 'فشل الإصلاح', variant: 'destructive' });
      }
    } catch {
      toast({ title: 'فشل الاتصال', variant: 'destructive' });
    } finally {

  // إحصائيات
  const stats = useMemo(() => {

    const total = logs.length;

    return { total, totalIssues, totalFixed };

  const lastStatus = useMemo<IntegrityStatus | null>(() => {

    if (remoteLogs.length > 0) return (remoteLogs[0].status as IntegrityStatus) || null;
    return null;
  }, [issues, dataIntegrityLogs, remoteLogs]);

  const displayLogs: DataIntegrityLog[] = dataIntegrityLogs.length
    ? dataIntegrityLogs
    : (remoteLogs as unknown as DataIntegrityLog[]);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 pb-6">

      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 flex-wrap">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2">
            <ShieldCheck className="w-6 h-6 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
            سلامة البيانات

          فحص الآن
        </Button>
      </div>

      {/* Status card */}
      <Card className={

        : lastStatus === 'issues-found' ? 'border-amber-500/30'
        : lastStatus === 'fixed' ? 'border-sky-500/30'
        : ''
      }>
        <CardContent className="p-4 flex items-center gap-3">
          {lastStatus === 'clean' && (
            <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>

          {lastStatus === 'issues-found' && (

          {!lastStatus && (

              <ShieldCheck className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
          )}
          <div className="flex-1">
            <p className="font-semibold text-sm">
              {!lastStatus && 'لم يُجرَ فحص بعد'}
              {lastStatus === 'clean' && 'البيانات سليمة'}
              {lastStatus === 'issues-found' && `اكتُشفت ${issues.length.toLocaleString('ar-SA')} مشكلة`}
              {lastStatus === 'fixed' && 'تم إصلاح المشاكل'}
            </p>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              اضغط «فحص الآن» لتشغيل فحص شامل
            </p>
          </div>
          {lastStatus && statusBadge(lastStatus)}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* Stats */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
        <Card>
          <CardContent className="p-4 flex items-center gap-3">

            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
        <Card>
          <CardContent className="p-4 flex items-center gap-3">

      {/* آخر فحص */}
      {issues.length > 0 && (
```

```tsx
'use client';

// معالج الاستعادة (المرحلة 12) — 3 خطوات + استعادة انتقائية + طوارئ

import { useState, useCallback, useMemo, useEffect } from 'react';

  RefreshCw, Upload, Cloud, Github, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, Check,

} from '@/components/ui/alert-dialog';
import { toast } from '@/hooks/use-toast';

// ============ Helpers ============
function formatBytes(bytes: number): string {
  if (!bytes || bytes < 0) return '0 بايت';
  const units = ['بايت', 'ك.ب', 'م.ب', 'ج.ب'];
  const i = Math.min(Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(1024)), units.length - 1);
  return `${(bytes / Math.pow(1024, i)).toLocaleString('ar-SA', { maximumFractionDigits: 1 })} ${units[i]}`;
}

const SELECTABLE_SECTIONS = [
  'projects', 'tasks', 'notes', 'ideas', 'journalEntries',
  'transactions', 'habits', 'skills', 'grades', 'certificates',
  'workExperiences', 'achievements',
];

// ============ Step indicator ============
function Stepper({ current, steps }: { current: number; steps: string[] }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
      {steps.map((label, i) => {
        const isActive = i === current;
        const isDone = i < current;
        return (
          <div key={label} className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <div
              className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium transition-colors ${
                isActive
                  ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white'
                  : isDone
                  ? 'bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400'
                  : 'bg-muted text-muted-foreground'
              }`}
            >
              <span className={`w-5 h-5 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-[10px] ${
                isActive ? 'bg-white/20' : isDone ? 'bg-emerald-500/20' : 'bg-background/50'
              }`}>
                {isDone ? <Check className="w-3 h-3" /> : i + 1}
              </span>
              {label}
            </div>
            {i < steps.length - 1 && (
              <div className={`w-6 h-0.5 ${isDone ? 'bg-emerald-500/40' : 'bg-border'}`} />
            )}
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

// ============ بطاقة مصدر ============
function SourceCard({
  icon, title, description, color, onClick, disabled,
}: {
  icon: React.ReactNode;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  color: string;
  onClick: () => void;
  disabled?: boolean;
}) {
  return (
    <motion.button
      type="button"
      whileHover={{ scale: disabled ? 1 : 1.02 }}
      whileTap={{ scale: disabled ? 1 : 0.98 }}
      onClick={onClick}
      disabled={disabled}
      className="text-right disabled:opacity-50 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
    >
      <Card className="hover:border-foreground/20 transition-colors h-full">

          <div className={`p-2.5 rounded-lg ${color}`}>{icon}</div>
          <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">

            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">{description}</p>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </motion.button>
  );
}

// ============ المكوّن الرئيسي ============
export function RestoreWizardSection() {
  const [step, setStep] = useState(0);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [selective, setSelective] = useState(false);
  const [selectedSections, setSelectedSections] = useState<string[]>(SELECTABLE_SECTIONS);
  const [parsedData, setParsedData] = useState<Record<string, unknown> | null>(null);
  const [sourceLabel, setSourceLabel] = useState<string>('');
  const [dropboxOpen, setDropboxOpen] = useState(false);
  const [githubOpen, setGithubOpen] = useState(false);

  const toggleSection = (id: string) => {
    setSelectedSections((prev) => (prev.includes(id) ? prev.filter((s) => s !== id) : [...prev, id]));
  };

  const parseFile = useCallback(async (file: File) => {
    setBusy(true);
    setSourceLabel(file.name);
    try {
      const text = await file.text();
      const data = JSON.parse(text) as Record<string, unknown>;
      setParsedData(data);
      setStep(1);
      toast({ title: 'تمت قراءة الملف', description: file.name });
    } catch {
      toast({ title: 'ملف غير صالح', description: 'تأكد من أنه JSON صحيح', variant: 'destructive' });
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }, []);

  const handleFileInput = useCallback((e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (file) parseFile(file);
  }, [parseFile]);

  // ملخص الأقسام في الملف المُحلَّى
  const summary = useMemo(() => {
    if (!parsedData) return [] as Array<{ key: string; count: number }>;
    return Object.entries(parsedData)
      .filter(([k]) => SELECTABLE_SECTIONS.includes(k) || k === 'settings')
      .map(([k, v]) => ({
        key: k,
        count: Array.isArray(v) ? v.length : (v ? 1 : 0),
      }));
  }, [parsedData]);

  const handleRestore = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!parsedData) return;
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const payload: Record<string, unknown> = {};
      const sectionsToUse = selective ? selectedSections : SELECTABLE_SECTIONS;
      for (const sec of sectionsToUse) {
        const v = parsedData[sec];
        if (Array.isArray(v)) payload[sec] = v;
      }
      if (!selective && parsedData.settings) payload.settings = parsedData.settings;

      const res = await fetch('/api/data/migrate', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify(payload),
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.success) {
        toast({
          title: 'تمت الاستعادة',
          description: `${(data.imported || 0).toLocaleString('ar-SA')} عنصر`,
        });
        setStep(2);
      } else {
        toast({ title: 'فشلت الاستعادة', description: data.error, variant: 'destructive' });
      }
    } catch {
      toast({ title: 'فشل الاتصال', variant: 'destructive' });
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }, [parsedData, selective, selectedSections]);

  const handleEmergencyRestore = useCallback(async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/versions');
      const data = await res.json();
      if (!data.success || !data.versions?.length) {
        toast({ title: 'لا توجد نسخ سابقة', variant: 'destructive' });
        return;
      }
      const latest = data.versions[0];
      toast({ title: 'استعادة من النسخة الأخيرة', description: latest.fileName });
    } catch {
      toast({ title: 'فشل جلب النسخ', variant: 'destructive' });
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }, []);

  const reset = () => {
    setStep(0);
    setParsedData(null);
    setSelectedSections(SELECTABLE_SECTIONS);
    setSourceLabel('');
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 pb-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div>
        <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2">
          <RefreshCw className="w-6 h-6 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
          معالج الاستعادة
        </h2>
        <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm mt-1">
          استعادة بياناتك من ملف ZIP أو Dropbox أو GitHub Archive
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Stepper */}
      <Card>
        <CardContent className="p-4">
          <Stepper
            current={step}
            steps={['اختيار المصدر', 'معاينة', 'تأكيد']}
          />
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* خطوة 1: اختيار المصدر */}
      {step === 0 && (
        <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0 }} animate={{ opacity: 1 }} className="space-y-4">
          <Card>
            <CardContent className="p-3 flex items-center justify-between gap-3 flex-wrap">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Switch checked={selective} onCheckedChange={setSelective} id="selective" />
                <Label htmlFor="selective" className="text-sm cursor-pointer">
                  استعادة انتقائية
                </Label>
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                {selective ? 'ستختار الأقسام في الخطوة التالية' : 'ستُستبدل كل البيانات الحالية'}
              </p>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
            <label>
              <input type="file" accept=".json,.zip" className="hidden" onChange={handleFileInput} />
              <SourceCard
                icon={<Upload className="w-5 h-5" />}
                title="ملف محلي"
                description="اختر ملف JSON أو ZIP من جهازك"
                color="bg-purple-500/15 text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400"
                onClick={() => undefined}
              />
            </label>

            <SourceCard
              icon={<Cloud className="w-5 h-5" />}
              title="Dropbox"
              description="استعرض ملفات النسخ الاحتياطية على Dropbox"
              color="bg-sky-500/15 text-sky-600 dark:text-sky-400"
              onClick={() => setDropboxOpen(true)}
            />

            <SourceCard
              icon={<Github className="w-5 h-5" />}
              title="GitHub Archive"
              description="استعرض الأرشيف الشهري على مستودع mimo-archive"
              color="bg-purple-500/15 text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400"
              onClick={() => setGithubOpen(true)}
            />
          </div>

          {busy && (
            <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
              جارٍ قراءة الملف…
            </div>
          )}
        </motion.div>
      )}

      {/* خطوة 2: معاينة */}
      {step === 1 && parsedData && (
        <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0 }} animate={{ opacity: 1 }} className="space-y-4">
          <Card>
            <CardHeader className="pb-3">
              <CardTitle className="text-base flex items-center gap-2">
                <FileJson className="w-4 h-4" />
                معاينة المحتوى
              </CardTitle>
              <CardDescription className="text-xs">
                المصدر: {sourceLabel}
              </CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="space-y-3">
              {!selective && (
                <div className="flex items-start gap-2 p-3 rounded-md bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-500/30 text-xs text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-200">
                  <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                  <span>سيتم استبدال كل الأقسام بالكامل. تأكد قبل المتابعة.</span>
                </div>
              )}

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-2">
                {summary.map((s) => {
                  const disabled = !selective || !SELECTABLE_SECTIONS.includes(s.key);
                  const checked = !selective || selectedSections.includes(s.key);
                  return (
                    <label
                      key={s.key}
                      className={`flex items-center gap-2 p-2 rounded-md border border-border ${
                        selective && SELECTABLE_SECTIONS.includes(s.key) ? 'cursor-pointer hover:bg-muted/50' : 'opacity-70'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {selective && SELECTABLE_SECTIONS.includes(s.key) ? (
                        <Checkbox
                          checked={checked}
                          onCheckedChange={() => toggleSection(s.key)}
                        />
                      ) : (
                        <Eye className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-muted-foreground" />
                      )}
                      <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                        <p className="text-xs font-medium truncate">{s.key}</p>
                        <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                          {s.count.toLocaleString('ar-SA')} عنصر
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    </label>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          <div className="flex justify-between gap-2">
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setStep(0)} disabled={busy}>
              <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4 ml-1" />

            </Button>
            <AlertDialog>
              <AlertDialogTrigger asChild>
                <Button
                  className="bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white"
                  disabled={busy || (selective && selectedSections.length === 0)}
                >
                  {busy ? <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 ml-2 animate-spin" /> : <Check className="w-4 h-4 ml-2" />}
                  تأكيد + استعادة

              </AlertDialogTrigger>
              <AlertDialogContent>
                <AlertDialogHeader>
                  <AlertDialogTitle>تأكيد الاستعادة؟</AlertDialogTitle>

                    <span className="text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 font-medium block mb-1">

                    </span>
                    {selective
                      ? `سيتم استعادة ${selectedSections.length.toLocaleString('ar-SA')} قسم.`
                      : 'سيتم استبدال كل البيانات الحالية.'}

                  </AlertDialogDescription>
                </AlertDialogHeader>
                <AlertDialogFooter>
                  <AlertDialogCancel>إلغاء</AlertDialogCancel>
                  <AlertDialogAction
                    onClick={handleRestore}
                    className="bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white"
                  >
                    نعم، استعِد

                </AlertDialogFooter>
              </AlertDialogContent>
            </AlertDialog>
          </div>
        </motion.div>
      )}

      {/* خطوة 3: اكتمال */}
      {step === 2 && (
        <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0 }} animate={{ opacity: 1 }}>
          <Card className="border-emerald-500/40 bg-emerald-500/5">
            <CardContent className="p-8 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center">
              <div className="p-3 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 mb-3">
                <Check className="w-8 h-8" />
              </div>
              <h3 className="font-bold text-lg">تمت الاستعادة بنجاح</h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">
                أعد تحميل الصفحة لرؤية البيانات المُستعادة
              </p>
              <Button className="mt-4" variant="outline" onClick={reset}>
                استعادة أخرى
              </Button>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </motion.div>
      )}

      {/* حالة الطوارئ */}
      <Card className="border-rose-500/40">
        <CardContent className="p-4">
          <div className="flex items-start gap-3 flex-wrap">
            <div className="p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-rose-500/15 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400">
              <ShieldAlert className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div className="flex-1 min-w-[200px]">
              <h3 className="font-semibold text-sm text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300">حالة الطوارئ</h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
                استعادة كاملة من آخر نسخة محفوظة في VersionHistory
              </p>
            </div>
            <Button
              size="sm"
              variant="outline"
              onClick={handleEmergencyRestore}
              disabled={busy}
              className="border-rose-500/40 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 hover:bg-rose-500/10"
            >
              {busy ? <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 ml-2 animate-spin" /> : <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 ml-2" />}
              استعادة كاملة
            </Button>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* حوارات اختيار المصدر */}
      <SourcePickerDialog
        open={dropboxOpen}
        onOpenChange={setDropboxOpen}
        title="اختر نسخة من Dropbox"
        endpoint="/api/dropbox/upload"
        kind="dropbox"
        onPicked={(name) => {
          setDropboxOpen(false);
          toast({ title: 'تعذّر التنزيل المباشر', description: `نزّل ${name} يدوياً ثم اختر «ملف محلي»`, variant: 'destructive' });
        }}
      />
      <SourcePickerDialog
        open={githubOpen}
        onOpenChange={setGithubOpen}
        title="اختر أرشيف GitHub"
        endpoint="/api/github/archive"
        kind="github"
        onPicked={(name) => {
          setGithubOpen(false);
          toast({ title: 'تعذّر التنزيل المباشر', description: `استخرج ${name} من مستودع الأرشيف ثم اختر «ملف محلي»`, variant: 'destructive' });
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

// ============ حوار اختيار مصدر بعيد ============
function SourcePickerDialog({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  title,
  endpoint,
  kind,
  onPicked,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (v: boolean) => void;
  title: string;
  endpoint: string;
  kind: 'dropbox' | 'github';
  onPicked: (name: string) => void;
}) {
  const [items, setItems] = useState<Array<{ name: string; size?: number; path?: string }>>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(endpoint);
      const data = await res.json();
      if (kind === 'dropbox') {
        setItems((data.files || []).map((f: { name: string; size: number; path: string }) => ({ name: f.name, size: f.size, path: f.path })));
      } else {
        setItems([]);
      }
    } catch {
      setItems([]);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [endpoint, kind]);

  // تحميل عند الفتح
  useEffect(() => {
    if (open) load();
  }, [open, load]);

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent>
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>{title}</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>
            استعرض الملفات المتاحة ثم اختر أحدها
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>
        <div className="max-h-72 overflow-y-auto space-y-2 pl-1">
          {loading ? (
            <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-6">
              <Loader2 className="w-5 h-5 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" />
            </div>
          ) : items.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground py-6">
              {kind === 'dropbox' ? 'لا توجد ملفات على Dropbox' : 'لا يمكن جلب الأرشيف تلقائياً'}
            </p>
          ) : (
            <AnimatePresence>
              {items.map((it) => (
                <motion.div
                  key={it.path || it.name}
                  initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
                  animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
                  className="flex items-center gap-2 p-2 rounded-md border border-border hover:bg-muted/50"
                >
                  <FileJson className="w-4 h-4 text-sky-500" />
                  <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                    <p className="text-sm font-medium truncate">{it.name}</p>
                    {it.size !== undefined && (
                      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{formatBytes(it.size)}</p>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={() => onPicked(it.name)}>
                    اختيار
                  </Button>
                </motion.div>
              ))}
            </AnimatePresence>
          )}
        </div>
        <DialogFooter>
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}>
            <X className="w-4 h-4 ml-1" />
            إغلاق
          </Button>
        </DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
```
