'use client';

// الرسوم البيانية المتقدمة (المرحلة 12) — 6 رسوم + فلترة فترة + تصدير SVG

import { useState, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import {
  BarChart3, LineChart as LineChartIcon, BarChart as BarChartIcon,
  PieChart as PieChartIcon, AreaChart as AreaChartIcon, TrendingUp,
  Loader2, Camera,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from '@/components/ui/select';
import {
  LineChart, BarChart, PieChart, AreaChart,
  Line, Bar, Pie, Area,
  XAxis, YAxis, CartesianGrid, Tooltip, ResponsiveContainer, Legend,
  Cell,
} from 'recharts';
import { useAppStore } from '@/lib/store';
import { toast } from '@/hooks/use-toast';
import type { JournalEntry } from '@/types';

// ============ Helpers ============
type PeriodKey = '7d' | '30d' | '90d' | 'year' | 'all';

const PERIODS: Array<{ value: PeriodKey; label: string }> = [
  { value: '7d', label: 'آخر 7 أيام' },
  { value: '30d', label: 'آخر 30 يوم' },
  { value: '90d', label: 'آخر 90 يوم' },
  { value: 'year', label: 'هذه السنة' },
  { value: 'all', label: 'الكل' },
];

const MOOD_SCORE: Record<JournalEntry['mood'], number> = {
  excellent: 5,
  good: 4,
  okay: 3,
  sad: 2,
  terrible: 1,
};

const PROJECT_STATUS_COLORS: Record<string, string> = {
  planning: '#a78bfa',
  'in-progress': '#f59e0b',
  completed: '#10b981',
  paused: '#94a3b8',
  archived: '#64748b',
};

const PROJECT_STATUS_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  planning: 'تخطيط',
  'in-progress': 'قيد التنفيذ',
  completed: 'مكتمل',
  paused: 'متوقف',
  archived: 'مؤرشف',
};

function periodStart(period: PeriodKey): Date | null {
  if (period === 'all') return null;
  const now = new Date();
  if (period === 'year') {
    return new Date(now.getFullYear(), 0, 1);
  }
  const days = period === '7d' ? 7 : period === '30d' ? 30 : 90;
  const d = new Date(now);
  d.setDate(d.getDate() - days);
  return d;
}

function formatNumber(n: number): string {
  return (n || 0).toLocaleString('ar-SA');
}

// ============ مكوّن بطاقة رسم بياني ============
interface ChartCardProps {
  title: string;
  icon: React.ReactNode;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}

function ChartCard({ title, icon, children }: ChartCardProps) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const handleExportPng = () => {
    if (!ref.current) return;
    const svg = ref.current.querySelector('svg');
    if (!svg) {
      toast({ title: 'لا يمكن التصدير', description: 'استخدم لقطة شاشة', variant: 'destructive' });
      return;
    }
    try {
      const serializer = new XMLSerializer();
      const source = serializer.serializeToString(svg);
      const blob = new Blob([source], { type: 'image/svg+xml' });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = url;
      a.download = `${title.replace(/\s+/g, '-')}.svg`;
      document.body.appendChild(a);
      a.click();
      document.body.removeChild(a);
      setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
      toast({ title: 'تم تصدير الرسم بصيغة SVG' });
    } catch {
      toast({ title: 'فشل التصدير', variant: 'destructive' });
    }
  };

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader className="pb-2">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <CardTitle className="text-sm flex items-center gap-2">
            {icon}
            {title}
          </CardTitle>
          <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" className="h-7 px-2" onClick={handleExportPng}>
            <Camera className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          </Button>
        </div>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent ref={ref} className="pt-0">
        <div className="h-64 w-full" dir="ltr">
          {children}
        </div>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

// ============ المكوّن الرئيسي ============
export function AdvancedChartsSection() {
  const { projects, tasks, transactions, journalEntries, grades, habits } = useAppStore();
  const [period, setPeriod] = useState<PeriodKey>('30d');

  const start = periodStart(period);

  // 1) المهام المكتملة يومياً
  const tasksByDay = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, number>();
    const today = new Date();
    const days = period === '7d' ? 7 : period === '30d' ? 30 : period === '90d' ? 90 : period === 'year' ? 365 : 90;
    for (let i = days - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const d = new Date(today);
      d.setDate(d.getDate() - i);
      const key = d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
      map.set(key, 0);
    }
    for (const t of tasks) {
      if (!t.completed) continue;
      const date = t.updatedAt || t.createdAt;
      if (!date) continue;
      const key = date.slice(0, 10);
      if (start && new Date(date) < start) continue;
      if (map.has(key)) map.set(key, (map.get(key) || 0) + 1);
    }
    return Array.from(map.entries()).map(([d, count]) => ({
      date: d.slice(5),
      count,
    }));
  }, [tasks, start, period]);

  // 2) الدخل مقابل المصروف (شهرياً)
  const financeByMonth = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, { income: number; expense: number }>();
    for (const t of transactions) {
      if (!t.createdAt) continue;
      if (start && new Date(t.createdAt) < start) continue;
      const key = t.createdAt.slice(0, 7);
      const entry = map.get(key) || { income: 0, expense: 0 };
      if (t.type === 'income') entry.income += t.amount;
      else entry.expense += t.amount;
      map.set(key, entry);
    }
    return Array.from(map.entries())
      .sort(([a], [b]) => (a < b ? -1 : 1))
      .slice(-12)
      .map(([month, v]) => ({
        month: month.slice(5),
        income: Math.round(v.income),
        expense: Math.round(v.expense),
      }));
  }, [transactions, start]);

  // 3) توزيع المشاريع حسب الحالة
  const projectsByStatus = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, number>();
    for (const p of projects) {
      map.set(p.status, (map.get(p.status) || 0) + 1);
    }
    return Array.from(map.entries()).map(([status, value]) => ({
      name: PROJECT_STATUS_LABELS[status] || status,
      value,
      color: PROJECT_STATUS_COLORS[status] || '#94a3b8',
    }));
  }, [projects]);

  // 4) تطور المزاج
  const moodSeries = useMemo(() => {
    const entries = journalEntries
      .filter((j) => !start || (j.date && new Date(j.date) >= start))
      .sort((a, b) => (a.date < b.date ? -1 : 1))
      .slice(-30)
      .map((j) => ({
        date: j.date.slice(5),
        mood: MOOD_SCORE[j.mood] || 3,
      }));
    return entries;
  }, [journalEntries, start]);

  // 5) الدرجات عبر الفصول
  const gradesBySemester = useMemo(() => {
    const map = new Map<string, { total: number; count: number }>();
    for (const g of grades) {
      const key = g.semesterId || 'بدون فصل';
      const entry = map.get(key) || { total: 0, count: 0 };
      entry.total += g.percentage;
      entry.count += 1;
      map.set(key, entry);
    }
    return Array.from(map.entries()).map(([sem, v], i) => ({
      semester: `فصل ${(i + 1).toLocaleString('ar-SA')}`,
      avg: v.count > 0 ? Math.round(v.total / v.count) : 0,
    }));
  }, [grades]);

  // 6) انتظام العادات (آخر 30 يوم)
  const habitsSeries = useMemo(() => {
    const today = new Date();
    const days = 30;
    const result: Array<{ date: string; rate: number }> = [];
    for (let i = days - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const d = new Date(today);
      d.setDate(d.getDate() - i);
      const key = d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
      const completed = habits.filter((h) => h.completedDates?.includes(key)).length;
      const rate = habits.length > 0 ? Math.round((completed / habits.length) * 100) : 0;
      result.push({ date: key.slice(5), rate });
    }
    return result;
  }, [habits]);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 pb-6">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 flex-wrap">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2">
            <BarChart3 className="w-6 h-6 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400" />
            الرسوم البيانية المتقدمة
          </h2>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm mt-1">
            تحليل بصري للبيانات عبر 6 أبعاد
          </p>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">

            <BarChart3 className="w-12 h-12 text-muted-foreground/40 mb-3" />
            <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm">لا توجد بيانات كافية للعرض</p>
            <p className="text-muted-foreground/70 text-xs mt-1">أضف مهاماً أو معاملات أو يوميات لرؤية الرسوم</p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}

      {/* Charts grid */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
        {/* 1) المهام المكتملة يومياً */}
        <ChartCard title="المهام المكتملة يومياً" icon={<LineChartIcon className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-500" />}>
          {tasksByDay.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyChart label="لا توجد مهام مكتملة" />
          ) : (
            <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
              <LineChart data={tasksByDay} margin={{ top: 8, right: 8, bottom: 8, left: 8 }}>
                <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="rgba(120,120,120,0.2)" />
                <XAxis dataKey="date" tick={{ fontSize: 10 }} />
                <YAxis tick={{ fontSize: 10 }} allowDecimals={false} />
                <Tooltip />
                <Line type="monotone" dataKey="count" name="المهام" stroke="#10b981" strokeWidth={2} dot={false} />
              </LineChart>
            </ResponsiveContainer>
          )}
        </ChartCard>

        {/* 2) الدخل vs المصروف */}
        <ChartCard title="الدخل مقابل المصروف (شهرياً)" icon={<BarChartIcon className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-500" />}>
          {financeByMonth.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyChart label="لا توجد معاملات" />
          ) : (
            <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
              <BarChart data={financeByMonth} margin={{ top: 8, right: 8, bottom: 8, left: 8 }}>
                <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="rgba(120,120,120,0.2)" />
                <XAxis dataKey="month" tick={{ fontSize: 10 }} />
                <YAxis tick={{ fontSize: 10 }} />
                <Tooltip />
                <Legend wrapperStyle={{ fontSize: 11 }} />
                <Bar dataKey="income" name="دخل" fill="#10b981" radius={[3, 3, 0, 0]} />
                <Bar dataKey="expense" name="مصروف" fill="#f43f5e" radius={[3, 3, 0, 0]} />
              </BarChart>
            </ResponsiveContainer>
          )}
        </ChartCard>

        {/* 3) توزيع المشاريع حسب الحالة */}
        <ChartCard title="توزيع المشاريع حسب الحالة" icon={<PieChartIcon className="w-4 h-4 text-purple-500" />}>
          {projectsByStatus.length === 0 || projects.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyChart label="لا توجد مشاريع" />
          ) : (
            <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
              <PieChart>
                <Pie
                  data={projectsByStatus}
                  dataKey="value"
                  nameKey="name"
                  cx="50%"
                  cy="50%"
                  outerRadius={80}
                  label={({ name, value }: { name?: string; value?: number }) => `${name}: ${formatNumber(value || 0)}`}
                  labelLine={false}
                >
                  {projectsByStatus.map((entry, i) => (
                    <Cell key={i} fill={entry.color} />
                  ))}
                </Pie>
                <Tooltip />
                <Legend wrapperStyle={{ fontSize: 11 }} />
              </PieChart>
            </ResponsiveContainer>
          )}
        </ChartCard>

        {/* 4) تطور المزاج */}
        <ChartCard title="تطور المزاج" icon={<AreaChartIcon className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-500" />}>
          {moodSeries.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyChart label="لا توجد يوميات" />
          ) : (
            <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
              <AreaChart data={moodSeries} margin={{ top: 8, right: 8, bottom: 8, left: 8 }}>
                <defs>
                  <linearGradient id="moodGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
                    <stop offset="5%" stopColor="#f43f5e" stopOpacity={0.6} />
                    <stop offset="95%" stopColor="#f43f5e" stopOpacity={0.05} />
                  </linearGradient>
                </defs>
                <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="rgba(120,120,120,0.2)" />
                <XAxis dataKey="date" tick={{ fontSize: 10 }} />
                <YAxis domain={[0, 5]} tick={{ fontSize: 10 }} />
                <Tooltip />
                <Area type="monotone" dataKey="mood" name="المزاج" stroke="#f43f5e" strokeWidth={2} fill="url(#moodGrad)" />
              </AreaChart>
            </ResponsiveContainer>
          )}
        </ChartCard>

        {/* 5) الدرجات عبر الفصول */}
        <ChartCard title="الدرجات عبر الفصول" icon={<BarChartIcon className="w-4 h-4 text-sky-500" />}>
          {gradesBySemester.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyChart label="لا توجد درجات" />
          ) : (
            <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
              <BarChart data={gradesBySemester} margin={{ top: 8, right: 8, bottom: 8, left: 8 }}>
                <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="rgba(120,120,120,0.2)" />
                <XAxis dataKey="semester" tick={{ fontSize: 10 }} />
                <YAxis domain={[0, 100]} tick={{ fontSize: 10 }} />
                <Tooltip />
                <Bar dataKey="avg" name="المتوسط" fill="#0ea5e9" radius={[3, 3, 0, 0]} />
              </BarChart>
            </ResponsiveContainer>
          )}
        </ChartCard>

        {/* 6) انتظام العادات */}
        <ChartCard title="انتظام العادات (آخر 30 يوم)" icon={<TrendingUp className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-500" />}>
          {habits.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyChart label="لا توجد عادات" />
          ) : (
            <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%">
              <LineChart data={habitsSeries} margin={{ top: 8, right: 8, bottom: 8, left: 8 }}>
                <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" stroke="rgba(120,120,120,0.2)" />
                <XAxis dataKey="date" tick={{ fontSize: 10 }} />
                <YAxis domain={[0, 100]} tick={{ fontSize: 10 }} />
                <Tooltip />
                <Line type="monotone" dataKey="rate" name="نسبة الإتمام" stroke="#10b981" strokeWidth={2} dot={false} />
              </LineChart>
            </ResponsiveContainer>
          )}
        </ChartCard>
      </div>

      {/* Summary badges */}
      <Card className="bg-muted/30 border-dashed">
        <CardContent className="p-3 flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap text-xs">
          <Badge variant="outline" className="gap-1">
            <LineChartIcon className="w-3 h-3" />
            {formatNumber(tasksByDay.reduce((s, d) => s + d.count, 0))} مهمة مكتملة
          </Badge>
          <Badge variant="outline" className="gap-1">
            <BarChartIcon className="w-3 h-3" />
            {formatNumber(projects.length)} مشروع
          </Badge>
          <Badge variant="outline" className="gap-1">
            <TrendingUp className="w-3 h-3" />
            {formatNumber(transactions.length)} معاملة
          </Badge>
          <Badge variant="outline" className="gap-1">
            <PieChartIcon className="w-3 h-3" />
            {formatNumber(journalEntries.length)} يومية
          </Badge>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

// ============ Empty chart ============
function EmptyChart({ label }: { label: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="h-full w-full flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center">
      <Loader2 className="w-6 h-6 text-muted-foreground/30 mb-2" />
      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{label}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

        }
      } catch {
        // ما في صور أو الـ API فشل — كمّل بدونها
      }

      const content = await zip.generateAsync({ type: 'blob' }, (metadata) => {
        setBackupSize(formatBytes(metadata.percent));
      });

      // عرض الحجم النهائي
      const finalSize = formatBytesReal(content.size);
      setBackupSize(finalSize);

      const url = URL.createObjectURL(content);
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = url;
      a.download = `mimo-portfolio-backup-${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.zip`;
      document.body.appendChild(a);
      a.click();
      document.body.removeChild(a);
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      toast({ title: 'تم التصدير', description: `حجم النسخة: ${finalSize}` });
    } catch {
      toast({ title: 'خطأ', description: 'حدث خطأ أثناء التصدير', variant: 'destructive' });
    }
    setBackupLoading(false);
  }, [exportData]);

  // ============ استعادة الصور من ZIP ============
  const restoreUploadsFromZip = async (zip: JSZip) => {
    const uploadsFolder = zip.folder('uploads');
    if (!uploadsFolder) return;
    const uploadFiles = Object.keys(uploadsFolder.files).filter((n) => !uploadsFolder.files[n].dir);
    for (const fname of uploadFiles) {
      try {
        const blob = await uploadsFolder.file(fname)?.async('blob');
        if (blob) {
          const formData = new FormData();
          formData.append('file', blob, fname.split('/').pop() || fname);
          await fetch('/api/upload', { method: 'POST', body: formData });
        }
      } catch {
        // تخطي
      }
    }
  };

  // ============ استيراد (ZIP أو JSON) ============
  const handleImport = () => {
    fileInputRef.current?.click();
  };

  const handleFileChange = useCallback(async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    setImportLoading(true);

    try {
      if (file.name.endsWith('.zip')) {
        // استيراد من ZIP
        const buffer = await file.arrayBuffer();
        const zip = await JSZip.loadAsync(buffer);
        const dataFile = zip.file('data.json');
        if (!dataFile) {
          toast({ title: 'خطأ', description: 'ملف ZIP غير صالح — لا يحتوي data.json', variant: 'destructive' });
          setImportLoading(false);
          return;
        }
        // استعادة قاعدة البيانات لو موجودة بالـ ZIP
        const dbFile = zip.file('custom.db');
        if (dbFile) {
          try {
            const dbBlob = await dbFile.async('blob');
            const formData = new FormData();
            formData.append('db', dbBlob, 'custom.db');
            const dbRes = await fetch('/api/data/db-backup', { method: 'POST', body: formData });
            if (dbRes.ok) {
              const dbResult = await dbRes.json();
              // لو الـ DB فيه بيانات، نعيد التحميل منه بدل data.json
              if (dbResult.success && dbResult.projectCount > 0) {
                const { useAppStore } = await import('@/lib/store');
                await useAppStore.getState().initialize();
                // رفع الصور
                await restoreUploadsFromZip(zip);
                toast({ title: 'تم الاستيراد', description: `تم استعادة قاعدة البيانات (${dbResult.projectCount} مشروع)` });
                setImportLoading(false);
                if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = '';
                return;
              }
            }
          } catch {
            // فشل استعادة DB — كمّل مع data.json
          }
        }

        const json = await dataFile.async('string');
        const success = importData(json);
        if (success) {
          // رفع الصور
          await restoreUploadsFromZip(zip);
          toast({ title: 'تم الاستيراد', description: 'تم استعادة البيانات والصور' });
        } else {
          toast({ title: 'خطأ', description: 'ملف غير متوافق', variant: 'destructive' });
        }
      } else {
        // استيراد JSON عادي
        const reader = new FileReader();
        reader.onload = (event) => {
          const result = event.target?.result as string;
          const success = importData(result);
          if (success) {
            toast({ title: 'تم الاستيراد', description: 'تم استعادة البيانات' });
          } else {
            toast({ title: 'خطأ', description: 'ملف غير صالح أو غير متوافق', variant: 'destructive' });
          }
          setImportLoading(false);
        };
        reader.readAsText(file);
        if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = '';
        return;
      }
    } catch {
      toast({ title: 'خطأ', description: 'حدث خطأ أثناء الاستيراد', variant: 'destructive' });
    }
    setImportLoading(false);
    if (fileInputRef.current) fileInputRef.current.value = '';
  }, [importData]);

  // ============ تصدير قسم واحد كـ JSON ============
  const handleExportSection = useCallback(() => {
    const store = useAppStore.getState();
    const sectionKey = exportSection as keyof typeof store;
    const data = (store as Record<string, unknown[]>)[sectionKey];

    if (!data) {
      toast({ title: 'خطأ', description: 'لم يتم العثور على البيانات', variant: 'destructive' });
      return;
    }

    const jsonStr = JSON.stringify(data, null, 2);
    const blob = new Blob([jsonStr], { type: 'application/json' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url;
    a.download = `${sectionKey}.json`;
    document.body.appendChild(a);
    a.click();
    document.body.removeChild(a);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    toast({ title: 'تم التصدير', description: `تم تصدير "${SECTION_NAMES[sectionKey]}" بنجاح` });
  }, [exportSection]);

  // ============ معاينة CV ============
  const handleCvPreview = useCallback(() => {
    setCvPreviewOpen(false);
    exportResume();
    toast({ title: 'معاينة', description: 'استخدم Ctrl+P للحفظ كـ PDF' });
  }, []);

  // ============ حذف جميع البيانات ============
  const handleClearAll = () => {
    if (clearStep === 0) {
      setClearStep(1);
    } else if (clearStep === 1) {
      setClearStep(2);
    } else if (clearStep === 2 && clearInput === 'حذف') {
      clearAllData();
      setClearStep(0);
      setClearInput('');
      toast({ title: 'تم الحذف', description: 'تم حذف جميع البيانات بنجاح' });
    }
  };

  const resetClear = () => {
    setClearStep(0);
    setClearInput('');
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 max-w-2xl">
      {/* الترويسة */}
      <div>
        <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground flex items-center gap-2">

          الإعدادات
        </h2>
        <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm mt-1">تخصيص التطبيق وإدارة البيانات</p>
      </div>

      {/* ============ الأمان ============ */}
      <div className="space-y-3">
        <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground">الأمان</h3>

        {/* تغيير كلمة السر */}
        <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
          <CardContent className="p-4 space-y-3">

                <button

                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">ينهي الجلسة الحالية</p>

              </div>
              <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={handleLogout} className="gap-1.5 border-border text-muted-foreground hover:text-destructive hover:border-destructive/50">

      {/* ============ الإشعارات ============ */}

        <Card className="border border-border bg-background">

              <div>
                <p className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">تصدير قسم (JSON)</p>
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">اختر قسمًا وصدّر بياناته كملف JSON</p>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Select value={exportSection} onValueChange={setExportSection}>
                <SelectTrigger className="h-9 text-sm w-40 border-border">
                  <SelectValue />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  {SECTION_KEYS.map((key) => (
                    <SelectItem key={key} value={key}>
                      {SECTION_NAMES[key]}
                    </SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                size="sm"
                onClick={handleExportSection}
                className="gap-1.5 border-border text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted"
              >
                <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                تصدير JSON
              </Button>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        {/* استيراد */}
        <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
          <CardContent className="p-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-lg bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-900/20 flex items-center justify-center">
                  <Upload className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400" />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <p className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">استيراد نسخة احتياطية</p>
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">يدعم ZIP و JSON</p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                size="sm"
                onClick={handleImport}
                disabled={importLoading}
                className="gap-1.5 border-border text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted"
              >
                {importLoading ? (
                  <div className="w-3.5 h-3.5 border-2 border-muted-foreground/30 border-t-muted-foreground rounded-full animate-spin" />
                ) : (
                  <Upload className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                )}
                استيراد
              </Button>
            </div>
            <input
              ref={fileInputRef}
              type="file"
              accept=".json,.zip"
              onChange={handleFileChange}
              className="hidden"
            />
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        {/* حذف جميع البيانات */}
        <Card className="border border-red-200 dark:border-red-900/30 bg-background">
          <CardContent className="p-4">
            <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
              <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-lg bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-900/20 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                  <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4 text-red-500" />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <p className="text-sm font-medium text-red-600 dark:text-red-400">حذف جميع البيانات</p>
                  <p className="text-xs text-red-400/80">هذا الإجراء لا يمكن التراجع عنه</p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
                {clearStep === 0 && (
                  <motion.div key="s0" initial={{ opacity: 0 }} animate={{ opacity: 1 }} exit={{ opacity: 0 }}>
                    <Button variant="destructive" size="sm" onClick={handleClearAll} className="gap-1.5">
                      <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> حذف
                    </Button>
                  </motion.div>
                )}
                {clearStep === 1 && (
                  <motion.div key="s1" initial={{ opacity: 0 }} animate={{ opacity: 1 }} exit={{ opacity: 0 }} className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Button variant="destructive" size="sm" onClick={handleClearAll} className="gap-1.5">تأكيد</Button>
                    <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={resetClear} className="border-border">إلغاء</Button>
                  </motion.div>
                )}
                {clearStep === 2 && (
                  <motion.div key="s2" initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 4 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -4 }} className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Input value={clearInput} onChange={(e) => setClearInput(e.target.value)} placeholder='اكتب "حذف"' className="h-8 w-28 text-xs border-border" autoFocus />
                    <Button variant="destructive" size="sm" disabled={clearInput !== 'حذف'} onClick={handleClearAll} className="h-8 text-xs">حذف نهائي</Button>
                    <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={resetClear} className="h-8 text-xs text-muted-foreground">إلغاء</Button>
                  </motion.div>
                )}
              </AnimatePresence>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>

      {/* ============ النسخ الاحتياطي التلقائي ============ */}
      <div className="space-y-3">
        <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground">النسخ الاحتياطي التلقائي</h3>

        <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
          <CardContent className="p-4 space-y-4">
            {/* معلومات الحالة */}
            <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
              <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-lg bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-900/20 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                  <Archive className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400" />
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <p className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">النسخ الاحتياطي اليومي</p>
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    مفعّل تلقائياً — يومياً الساعة 3:00 صباحاً
                  </p>
                  {autoBackupStats?.latestBackup && (
                    <p className="text-xs text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400">
                      آخر نسخة: {autoBackupStats.latestBackup.dateFormatted} ({autoBackupStats.latestBackup.sizeFormatted})
                    </p>
                  )}
                  {autoBackupStats && (
                    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      النسخ المحفوظة: {autoBackupStats.totalBackups} / {autoBackupStats.maxBackups}
                      {autoBackupStats.totalBackups > 0 && ` · الحجم الإجمالي: ${autoBackupStats.totalSizeFormatted}`}
                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
              <Button
                size="sm"
                onClick={handleCreateBackup}
                disabled={autoBackupLoading}
                className="gap-1.5 shrink-0"
              >
                {autoBackupLoading ? (
                  <div className="w-3.5 h-3.5 border-2 border-white/30 border-t-white rounded-full animate-spin" />
                ) : (
                  <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                )}
                {autoBackupLoading ? 'جاري الإنشاء...' : 'نسخة الآن'}
              </Button>
            </div>

            {/* قائمة النسخ */}
            {autoBackups.length > 0 && (
              <div className="space-y-2 pt-2 border-t border-border">
                <p className="text-xs font-medium text-foreground">النسخ المحفوظة ({autoBackups.length})</p>
                <div className="max-h-64 overflow-y-auto space-y-2">
                  {autoBackups.map((backup) => (
                    <div
                      key={backup.name}
                      className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 p-2 rounded-lg bg-muted/50 border border-border"
                    >
                      <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                        <p className="text-xs font-medium text-foreground truncate">{backup.name}</p>
                        <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                          {backup.dateFormatted} · {backup.sizeFormatted}
                        </p>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0">
                        <Button
                          variant="ghost"
                          size="icon"
                          className="h-7 w-7"
                          onClick={() => handleDownloadBackup(backup.name)}
                          title="تحميل"
                        >
                          <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        </Button>
                        <Button
                          variant="ghost"
                          size="icon"
                          className="h-7 w-7 text-amber-600 hover:text-amber-700"
                          onClick={() => setRestoreConfirm(backup.name)}
                          title="استعادة"
                          disabled={restoreLoading}
                        >
                          <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        </Button>
                        <Button
                          variant="ghost"
                          size="icon"
                          className="h-7 w-7 text-destructive"
                          onClick={() => handleDeleteBackup(backup.name)}
                          title="حذف"
                        >
                          <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        </Button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {autoBackups.length === 0 && (
              <div className="text-center py-4 border-t border-border">
                <Archive className="w-8 h-8 mx-auto mb-2 text-muted-foreground opacity-40" />
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">لا توجد نسخ احتياطية بعد</p>
                <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mt-1">
                  ستُنشأ أول نسخة تلقائياً الساعة 3:00 صباحاً أو اضغط "نسخة الآن"
                </p>
              </div>
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        {/* تأكيد الاستعادة */}
        {restoreConfirm && (
          <AlertDialog open={true} onOpenChange={(open) => !open && setRestoreConfirm(null)}>
            <AlertDialogContent>
              <AlertDialogHeader>
                <AlertDialogTitle>تأكيد الاستعادة</AlertDialogTitle>
                <AlertDialogDescription>
                  سيتم استبدال كل البيانات الحالية بالنسخة "{restoreConfirm}". لا يمكن التراجع عن هذا الإجراء.
                  <br />
                  <br />
                  <strong className="text-amber-600">⚠️ تحذير:</strong> سيتم مسح كل البيانات الحالية أولاً ثم استرجاعها من النسخة.
                </AlertDialogDescription>
              </AlertDialogHeader>
              <div className="flex gap-2 justify-end">
                <AlertDialogCancel asChild>
                  <Button variant="outline" size="sm" disabled={restoreLoading}>إلغاء</Button>
                </AlertDialogCancel>
                <Button
                  size="sm"
                  variant="destructive"
                  onClick={() => handleRestoreBackup(restoreConfirm)}
                  disabled={restoreLoading}
                  className="gap-1.5"
                >
                  {restoreLoading && <div className="w-3.5 h-3.5 border-2 border-white/30 border-t-white rounded-full animate-spin" />}
                  {restoreLoading ? 'جاري الاستعادة...' : 'استعادة'}
                </Button>
              </div>
            </AlertDialogContent>
          </AlertDialog>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* ============ حول التطبيق ============ */}
      <Collapsible open={aboutOpen} onOpenChange={setAboutOpen}>
        <Card className="border border-border bg-background">
          <CollapsibleTrigger className="w-full">
            <CardContent className="p-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                  <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-lg bg-muted flex items-center justify-center">
                    <Info className="w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                  </div>
                  <span className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">حول التطبيق</span>
                </div>
                <motion.div animate={{ rotate: aboutOpen ? 180 : 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}>
                  <ChevronDown className="w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                </motion.div>
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </CollapsibleTrigger>
          <CollapsibleContent>
            <div className="px-4 pb-4">
              <Separator className="mb-4 bg-muted" />
              <div className="text-center space-y-4 py-2">
                <div className="inline-block">
                  <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-emerald-500 to-teal-600 flex items-center justify-center text-white font-bold text-xl">M</div>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-foreground">MiMo Portfolio</h3>
                  <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">v2.0 — مستودع شخصي</p>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                  <Badge variant="outline" className="text-xs border-border text-muted-foreground">Next.js 16</Badge>
                  <Badge variant="outline" className="text-xs border-border text-muted-foreground">TypeScript</Badge>
                  <Badge variant="outline" className="text-xs border-border text-muted-foreground">Tailwind CSS</Badge>
                  <Badge variant="outline" className="text-xs border-border text-muted-foreground">Zustand</Badge>
                </div>
                <Separator className="bg-muted" />
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 text-sm">
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-muted-foreground">المطور</p>
                    <p className="font-medium text-foreground">Mohammad</p>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-muted-foreground">الموقع</p>
                    <p className="font-medium text-foreground">الخليل / دورا 🇵🇸</p>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground pt-2">جميع البيانات محفوظة محلياً على جهازك</p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </CollapsibleContent>
        </Card>
      </Collapsible>

      {/* ============ حوار معاينة CV ============ */}
      <AlertDialog open={cvPreviewOpen} onOpenChange={setCvPreviewOpen}>
        <AlertDialogContent dir="rtl">
          <AlertDialogHeader>
            <AlertDialogTitle>معاينة السيرة الذاتية</AlertDialogTitle>
            <AlertDialogDescription>
              سيتم فتح نافذة المعاينة. استخدم Ctrl+P للحفظ كـ PDF
            </AlertDialogDescription>
          </AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogFooter>
            <AlertDialogCancel>إلغاء</AlertDialogCancel>
            <AlertDialogAction onClick={handleCvPreview}>فتح المعاينة</AlertDialogAction>
          </AlertDialogFooter>
        </AlertDialogContent>
      </AlertDialog>
    </div>
  );
}

// ============ مساعدات ============
function formatBytes(percent: number): string {
  return `${Math.round(percent)}%`;
}

function formatBytesReal(bytes: number): string {
  if (bytes < 1024) return `${bytes} B`;
  if (bytes < 1024 * 1024) return `${(bytes / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB`;
  return `${(bytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(1)} MB`;
}
